scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
What a nice day, isn't it!
Welcome to Cat Merchant Group. We do anything to please our customers. We would even lie on our back if you want!
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
今天天氣真不錯，對吧！
歡迎光臨貓咪商會。我們竭誠為顧客服務，只要您願意，我們甚至可以四腳朝天躺給您看！

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
We provide teleport service between various regions based on our accumulated knowledge. We accept Malangdo Canned Specialties or Zeny, so you can pay however you like it~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
我們憑藉積累的知識，提供各地區之間的傳送服務。費用可用綿綿島罐頭特產或Zeny支付，您喜歡哪種都可以哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
那我先告辭了，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
恐怕還不夠呢。抱歉，不能免費幫您傳送哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
恐怕還不夠呢。抱歉，不能免費幫您傳送哦~

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please wait a minute.
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請稍等片刻。
首次到訪埃克拉珠的訪客，都必須填寫相關表格才能入城。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
首次到訪埃克拉珠的訪客，都必須在這裡填寫相關表格才能入城。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Great, you completed the forms.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很好，表格填好了。
歡迎來到拉菲尼的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
歡迎來到拉菲尼的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請填寫姓名、職業和等級，然後把表格交給那邊的管理員。
可能需要等一會兒，請耐心等待。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
最近經由彩虹橋從米德加爾特前來的人越來越多，我們才不得不設立這套手續，還請諒解。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
當然，表格用於入城管理後會妥善收存，請不必擔心。

scripts.text: Fill out the forms.
scripts.translation: 填寫表格

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 不填了

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請注意，不填寫表格就無法進入城市。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請在這裡填寫您的姓名、職業和等級。

scripts.text: Write your name.
scripts.translation: 填寫姓名

scripts.text: Write your occupation.
scripts.translation: 填寫職業

scripts.text: Write your level.
scripts.translation: 填寫等級

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果表格已經填好，請交給那邊的管理員。
可能需要等一會兒，請耐心等待。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
埃克拉珠受到彩虹橋的影響，各個種族之間可以順暢交流。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
因此不需要另外安排翻譯，而且這裡也有足夠的橋梁供步行的種族通行。祝您在此訪問愉快。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
埃克拉珠受到彩虹橋的影響，各個種族之間可以順暢交流。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
因此不需要另外安排翻譯，而且這裡也有足夠的橋梁供步行的種族通行。祝您在此訪問愉快。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
It won't be too long.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
您前面還有不少人，請等輪到您再過來。
不用等太久。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Whew! I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
There are just too many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
呼！抱歉讓您久等了。
來訪的人實在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Alright, next person in line please!
Next!
Next person!
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
好了，下一位請上前！
下一位！
下一位！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
What do you need?
As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
有什麼事？
您也看到了，我忙得不可開交。沒什麼事的話，請別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
哇，真是忙翻天了。
{0}，您的手續已經辦好了。
去和保安說一聲，就可以進城了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
那麼，請把表格放在這裡...

scripts.text:
[???]
Here!! These are my completed forms!!
This time it's all good, right?
Let me through quick!
scripts.translation:
[???]
在這裡！！這是我填好的表格！！
這次總沒問題了吧？
快放我過去！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
我會按來訪者抵達的先後順序辦理，請耐心等候。

scripts.text:
[???]
What are you talking about!
I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你說什麼呢！
我可比他們早到老半天了！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
可是您得先填寫表格，所以輪到您的時間往後延了，只能再等等。

scripts.text:
[???]
What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
什麼？！你剛才明明說按抵達順序辦理的！！！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Yes, I did say that but...
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
我是這麼說了，不過...

scripts.text: - SMACK!!! -

[???]
OW!! Why did you hit me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
好痛！！你為什麼打我？

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm so sorry.
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation:
[???]
真是抱歉。
我這個笨蛋朋友又在給您添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you calling stupid?!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你說誰是笨蛋？！

scripts.text:
[???]
If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation:
[???]
要不是你一開始把我的名字填錯，我們哪用在這兒等這麼久！

scripts.text:
[???]
Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation:
[???]
馬克·艾沙也好，馬德里也好，不都差不多嘛！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
哪裡一樣了！
再說，你怎麼會連認識了十五年的朋友叫什麼都不知道？

scripts.text:
[???]
It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
Madrid is just fine! Madrid!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我不是不知道——我就是故意的！！
馬德里就挺好！馬德里！

scripts.text: - SMACK -

[Mark Esha]
Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
嗚...真抱歉，我這朋友實在太蠢了。
請別介意我們，您忙您的吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
AHHHH!!!
LET ME IN!!!!
How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
啊啊啊！！！
放我進去！！！！
我還要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
Sorry. So sorry.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你就不能安分一會兒嗎？！！！
抱歉，實在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
哇，真是忙翻天了。
{0}，您的手續已經辦好了。
去和保安說一聲，就可以進城了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Shuffle, shuffle
scripts.translation:
[???]
挪啊挪，挪啊挪

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
杜連先生，也請帶上您的同伴進城吧。這裡吵得實在受不了了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Mwahah!!
SEE THAT?!
Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇哈哈！！
看見了吧？！
多虧了我，我們才能這麼快通過！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
You mean slower...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你是說更慢吧...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
Mwahah!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
真正的男子漢才不會糾結過去！！
辦手續時我雖然慢了點，但我可是第一個進埃克拉珠的人！
哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......Whew
I'm so sorry for everything.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
...呼
這一切真是抱歉。

scripts.text:
[???]
Well......
Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
那個...
馬克先生，杜先生已經走了。

[馬克·艾沙]
哦...
哦...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
My goodness......
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Ack...
I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
唉...
訪客這麼多，看來也不全是好事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I have to wait this long......
When is it going to be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
真不敢相信要等這麼久...
到底什麼時候才輪到我？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我的手續其實已經辦好了，只是想留下來欣賞這些花。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我帶了睡袋，乾脆就在這裡過夜！
只要受得了保安的白眼，倒也沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
埃克拉珠到底是座多麼美麗的城市呢？
光是想想就讓我心跳加速。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
不，我不是遊客。我是埃克拉珠的居民！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
真不敢相信遊客這麼多，害得我連家都進不去！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
聽說那裡的橡果很好吃，一點苦味都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
說不定能做出全世界最好吃的橡果涼粉。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
旅行時，行李還是輕便些好。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
反正走得越遠，行李只會越變越多。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
或許可以把它當成人生的重量吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Cool cool.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
不錯，不錯。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Snorrrreee....Erhem....
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呼嚕嚕嚕...咳嗯...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Err.... No.....
Curry.... Curry rice.... Snorrreeeee
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呃...不要...
咖哩...咖哩飯...呼嚕嚕嚕...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哦！你也是從米德加爾特來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
最近能看到這麼多米德加爾特人，真讓人振奮。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ow.... My legs...
You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哎喲...我的腿...
一路穿過彩虹橋來到這裡，居然還得繼續等？！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ahh...
Why are there so many people...?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
唉...
人怎麼這麼多啊...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I want to be alone......Sniff!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我只想一個人待著...（抽泣）

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hey!!!!!!!
Be careful over there!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精工匠]
喂！！！！！！
那邊小心！！

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 橋斷了，應該有辦法可以修好。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wait!!!!!
That's an unregistered visitor!!!!!!!
Security!!! Security!!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
等等！！！！！
那位訪客還沒登記！！！！！！！
保安！！保安！！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
進城前你有和保安談過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
橋有些損壞，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
這附近有些地方壞了，小心點。
不然會一路摔到底的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
scripts.translation: 目前的工程

scripts.text: The reason for the bridge being broken
scripts.translation: 橋梁損壞的原因

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
As you can see, I'm doing some carpentry work.
There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如你所見，我正在做木工。
最近來埃克拉珠的訪客多了起來，所以我主要負責修建橋梁。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦，就在剛才，有個人類一腳踩空，摔下來時撞斷了一根樹枝。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
修好之前你沒法從這裡通過，請多加小心。

scripts.text: [Fairy Carpenter]
scripts.translation: [妖精木匠]

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
拉菲尼族會飛，所以嚴格來說並不需要橋。不過，許多訪客爬樹時會摔傷，我們才修建這些橋。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
這裡離入口很近，得儘快修好。
我正琢磨著該立警告牌、收集維修材料，還是叫朋友來幫忙。

scripts.text: Give help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Don't give help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
修好之前你沒法從這裡通過，請多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wow!!!
You are going to help me?!
So... so kind...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哇！！！
你願意幫我？！
你...你人真好...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
真沒想到，這世上還有這麼善良的人...嗚，我都感動得眼眶溼了...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
那能麻煩你帶一段新的橋材來嗎？
為了不讓其他人受傷，我會先用魔法穩住這座橋。

scripts.text: What if you use magic to repair it?
scripts.translation: 用魔法修好不行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，也不是辦不到。不過，創造生命的魔法需要消耗大量魔力，不能隨便使用。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要說這有多蠢...就像把烤好的巧克力蛋糕重新變回麵粉。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
斷掉的地方離這裡大約有19米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
啊！我想起來了，以前可以按需要訂做特定長度的橋材。不過現在都改成批次生產，只能買到固定長度的了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
為了讓橋儘可能穩固，最好不要把多段橋材拼接起來。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
這座斷橋從這裡到那邊大約有19米，而預製橋材有3米、5米和10米三種長度...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm.......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm......
......

[Fairy Carpenter]
......Hmm.........
- It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 他頭上好像在冒煙？大概是我看錯了吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh ho!
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦！
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要用最少的橋材搭出一座19米長的橋，3米、5米和10米的橋材各要幾段？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
請填寫每種長度所需的橋材段數。不需要的長度請填0。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm that's kind of....
Would there be a better way?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，這個嘛...
有沒有更好的辦法？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Yeah, that sounds good, right?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
對，這主意不錯吧？
這樣也不用把橋材削得那麼筆直了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好，去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利。他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
He's too serious for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
哎，他居然還在操心那種事。
真是想太多了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
糟了！現在可不是做這個的時候。我得趕快把橋修好，去幫那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Ah!
Thank goodness!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
啊！
太好了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
要不是那根樹枝接住了我，我可就完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
我叫你小心點了！
你到底還想惹多少麻煩？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
...

[Du Lian]
No way!
They're those guys from earlier!
Oy!
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
不會吧！
是剛才那幫人！
喂！
我還以為已經甩掉他們了，看來沒那麼容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
抱歉。
自從遇見我們以後，你就一直沒遇上什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
這次就算了。要是你們再把橋弄斷，我就把你們關起來！
我自己也忙得很，別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
抱歉，我會格外小心，請放心。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
不過，跑了幾步橋就斷了，也太不結實了吧？
這樣一來，巨人豈不是根本沒法來埃克拉珠了...

scripts.text: - SNAP -
scripts.translation: - 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Mark Esha]
Oh dear....
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Uh oh...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
糟了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Look!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
等等！不，這次真的不是故意的！
你看！
警告牌上都寫著橋很危險，要抓緊扶手。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
All I did was just place my hand on it!
I really didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我只是把手搭上去而已！
我真的什麼也沒做！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Carpenter Fon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
搗蛋鬼，給我滾出去！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I am so sorry.
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
實在抱歉。
我晚些會來幫忙，哪怕得先把這傢伙綁在柱子上。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Don't come back!
Don't EVER come back!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
別再回來！
永遠都別回來！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oy........
I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
Looks like a long night again.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
唉...
我還以為今天忙完就能去見朋友...
看來今晚又得熬夜了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
這不是什麼大工程，我想辦法應該能修好。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
{0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
{0}，好了，你該去埃克拉珠了。
沿著這條路往前走，就能到城北。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
進城後就是中央廣場，那裡的人應該能告訴你不少訊息。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
順路幫我轉告朋友格拉西斯一聲，就說我今天去不了了，可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
But where are the materials.
I need to start repairing soon...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
可是材料呢？
我得趕快開始維修了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
我本來約好和朋友們見面，商量即將到來的生日，可眼下實在走不開。真要拜託你幫忙了，不能讓他們一直等。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
順路幫我轉告朋友格拉西斯一聲，就說我今天去不了了，可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
我本來約好和朋友們見面，商量即將到來的生日，可眼下實在走不開。真要拜託你幫忙了，不能讓他們一直等。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
真想早點見到朋友們啊。

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- There are just too many types that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請停下！！ -
- 物品種類太多， -
- 無法接收該物品。 -
- 請先減輕負重， -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Golie]
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
常有人說，生命是大自然最偉大的發明，而死亡不過是孕育更多生命的一種安排。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，可以把這個交給豐了。最近大家都很忙，還是麻煩你順便轉告他：請好好珍惜這些橋材。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees,
since Spring, Peco Peco
must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
長老樹精要生長，
從春天起，大嘴鳥便開始如此啼鳴。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
You lost the materials?
I will give you another since you are busy, but please take care.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
材料弄丟了嗎？
看你這麼忙，我再給你一份，不過這次可要收好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
不過，這些由魔法催生的嫩芽究竟算不算有生命？
魔法造出的橋，究竟算死物還是活物？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
我花了那麼多心血，從種子開始培育這些橋。看到它們一再損壞、被替換，實在令人心痛。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
這就是時代變遷嗎...？也許我創造的這些東西，註定要承受這樣的命運。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
這顆種子以我的名字命名為“戈利亞斯”。它會長出兩根莖和一片葉子，形狀奇特，因此被用作橋梁。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
多虧了戈利亞斯，橋梁短缺的問題總算解決了。但我仍擔心，有一天，濫用魔法、違背自然法則會釀成可怕後果。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我和身旁這位了不起的菲利一起工作，漸漸又有了幹勁。不過我向你保證，總有一天這一切都會得到解決。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights. 
And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
若你感到灰心沮喪，不妨找菲利談談，也許會有新的收穫。
還有...嗯...我們聊著聊著，橋已經修好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，現在可以把這個交給豐了。還有，雖然知道最近大家都很忙，能不能順便替我轉告他：請好好珍惜它們？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我一直忙著幫菲利做事，不過橋梁似乎也壞得太頻繁了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我一直忙著幫菲利做事，不過橋梁似乎也壞得太頻繁了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees
the alarm in the clock tower
again must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
長老樹精要生長，鐘樓裡的鐘怪
想必又如此啼鳴。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
It's a song given to me by a bard from Midgard. The lyrical and nature-oriented words really resonated with me.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
這首歌是米德加爾特的一位吟遊詩人送給我的。歌詞既有韻律又貼近自然，讓我很有共鳴。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I would love to hear any songs that you might know also.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
你若也會唱什麼歌，我很樂意聽聽。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hm......
The guys are late.
I can only imagine that they would be busy just looking at the number of people visiting Eclage nowadays but...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那幾個人遲到了。
最近來埃克拉珠的訪客這麼多，他們大概忙得不可開交吧，不過...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
The guys are late.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那幾個人遲到了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
唉，我不能離開這裡，免得其他人來了找不到我。要是你看到一個頭上長著黃色橘梗般東西的妖精，麻煩告訴他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh...
Moreng's age?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦...
莫倫的年齡？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎麼敢問女士的年齡！！！
我們的年齡不完全一樣，不過穆拉和莫倫也相差30歲，你去問穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Mm.. Something's missing... Mm, I couldn't tell you exactly...
You should go see Yube.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...好像還少了點什麼...我也說不清楚。
你去找尤貝看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Whoa!
We would need an enormous cake to fit all these candles...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哇！
這麼多蠟燭，得準備一個超大的蛋糕才插得下...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys? They even took Yube with them?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是誰？他們竟然把尤貝也帶走了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
奶油和巧克力，到底哪個更好呢...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
奶油和巧克力，到底哪個更好呢？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是他真的快走了，我們得趕在他離開前攔住他，至少給他辦場歡送會。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
It's going to feel really empty if Moreng leaves for Midgard.
It felt like this when Yube was dispatched to the Splendide unit before...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是莫倫去了米德加爾特，這裡一定會變得冷清。
以前尤貝被派去輝煌領域時，我也有過這種感覺...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Shul lives in the eastern part of the city.
I'm guessing he's near his place?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
舒爾住在城東。
他應該就在家附近吧？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
塔托在城西。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
A king lives in Eclage.
He is super good looking.
Hehe
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
埃克拉珠住著一位國王。
他可帥了。
嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
To think of it, I should probably visit Fon and Golie as well...
I guess I'll visit later.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
說起來，我好像也該去看看豐和戈利...
改天再去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Why... why do I have so much time at hand...?
Am I the only one with so much free time?
Am I really the only one?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
為什麼...我怎麼這麼閒？
難道只有我一個人這麼清閒？
真的只有我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?

[Glaces]
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Ah...
Oh...Well...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
啊...
哦...那個...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Um... This is sort of awkward for me...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...這讓我有點難為情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不是那個意思...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
You see, I have a boyfriend already.
Man.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那個，我已經有男朋友了。
哎呀。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
This is why I don't like to be kept waiting for long. My popularity just doesn't let me go anywhere without being noticed.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
所以我不喜歡等太久。畢竟我太受歡迎了，走到哪兒都有人注意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I mean... Mr. Fon told me to let you know that he won't be able to make it because of his work...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我是說...豐先生讓我轉告你，他工作忙，今天來不了了...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yeah, I feel like I should hide somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是啊，我覺得我該找個地方躲起來。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Anyways, Fon can't make it?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
總之，豐來不了了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's birthday is not long from now, and without being able to meet all this time, it might turn out to be a terrible party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫倫的生日快到了，大家卻一直碰不上面，這樣下去生日派對恐怕會辦砸。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yube even flew here from Splendide for Moreng's birthday...
Speaking of which, where did that guy go?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
尤貝甚至為了莫倫的生日從輝煌領域飛了過來...
說起來，那傢伙跑哪兒去了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
He was the one who suggested that we should meet at his own place.
The least he could do is opening the door before disappearing!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
明明是他提議在自己家碰面的。
他就算要消失，也該先把門開啟吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
唉，我不能離開這裡，免得其他人來了找不到我。要是你看到一個頭上長著黃色、像橘梗一樣東西的妖精，麻煩告訴他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
還有，告訴他再不馬上回來，我就把那根梗拔掉。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Great!!!
That
favor!
I will take care of it!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
太好了！！！
這個忙
就交給我吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hey! I told you not to interfere in other people's conversations!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
喂！我不是叫你別插手別人的談話嗎！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you talking about?
It's the job of a warrior to go wherever help is needed!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你說什麼呢？
哪裡需要幫忙，戰士就該出現在哪裡！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
And you!
There must be some kind of destiny here running into you over and over again!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
還有你！
我們一次又一次碰上，肯定是命運安排的！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Okay!
I made up my mind!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好！
我決定了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I don't usually recognize others like this, but I'll let you be my rival!
And as for the competition-!!
It is to help this girl fairy Graces!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我可不輕易認可別人，不過這次就讓你當我的對手吧！
至於比什麼——！！
就比誰能幫到這位妖精格拉西斯！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are you calling a girl? You got my name wrong too!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
誰是姑娘啊？還有，你連我的名字都叫錯了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Heh heh, don't you worry, baby girl.
I'll take care of you!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嘿嘿，別擔心，小姑娘。
一切包在我身上！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Well!
I'm off to find that tangerine stem!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好！
我這就去找那個橘梗頭！！！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
還有，告訴他再不馬上回來，我就把那根梗拔掉。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... I think we are apart by about 30 years...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我們大概差了30歲吧...

scripts.text: Then what's Glaces' age?
scripts.translation: 那格拉西斯幾歲？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎麼敢問女士的年齡！！！
我們的年齡不完全一樣，不過穆拉和莫倫也相差30歲，你去問穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉應該在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... Since everyone seems so busy, I'm going to give up meeting them today and just go to bake a cake big enough to fit the candles.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...大家好像都很忙，今天就不去找他們了。我還是去烤個能插下所有蠟燭的大蛋糕吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
沿著這條路走就是莫倫家。順便問問他生日想要什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Baby girl!
I brought the guy named Yube!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
小姑娘！
我把那個叫尤貝的傢伙帶來了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
What, who is this fool?
Let me go!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
喂，這傢伙是誰？
快放開我！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Do you mind not treating my friend like a piece of luggage?
And it's too late anyways!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
能不能別把我朋友當行李一樣扛著？
而且現在也太遲了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What?!
But there are two of them!
I have the disadvantage!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
什麼？！
可是他們有兩個人！
這下我吃虧了！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
There are four of us.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
我們有四個人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What do you mean?
We had that kid following us ever since we entered the city.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你說什麼？
從我們進城起，就一直有個小孩跟著我們。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Sure, he's kind of cute too, but we have our cutest Maggi to beat them all!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
沒錯，他是挺可愛的，不過我們還有最可愛的瑪姬，絕對不會輸給他們！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:
[???]
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你看得見我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you saying?
Your clothes stick out like a sore thumb.
Where are you from really?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你在說什麼？
你的衣服顯眼得不得了。
你到底是從哪兒來的？

scripts.text:
[???]
Ey~~
I thought you weren't able to see me but I guess not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
咦~~
我還以為你們看不見我呢，看來不是啊？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
How could I not see you?
Unless you were cloaking yourself like our Alp here!
Maybe it's because he is a Guillotine Cross, but he just seems so transparent even without using any skills.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我怎麼會看不見你？
除非你像阿爾普那樣隱身了！
可能因為他是十字斬首者吧，就算不用技能，他也跟透明人一樣沒存在感。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Maybe it's because he doesn't have much presence to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
也許他本來就沒什麼存在感。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Now that I think about it, I think I saw you somewhere...
Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
這麼說來，我好像在哪兒見過你...
到底是在哪裡呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
Eh...
It's been awhile since I had such a vivid dream...
scripts.translation:
[???]
呃...
好久沒做過這麼逼真的夢了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wahahahahah!
A dream!
Hey Mark, this guy thinks it's a dream!
How adorable!
Can we take him around?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇哈哈哈哈！
做夢？
嘿，馬克，這傢伙以為自己在做夢！
真可愛！
我們把他帶著到處逛逛怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
What are you saying?!
Don't touch whoever you want like that!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你在說什麼？！
別想對誰動手就動手！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Eeek~ I don't like this.
Besides, I'm not a kid or a child!
I have a great name called Oliver!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哎呀~我不喜歡這樣。
而且我不是小孩！
我有個很棒的名字，叫奧利弗！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I have been rejected straight up.
To put him next to our Maggi would be just downright adorable.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我居然被當面拒絕了。
把他和我們的瑪姬放在一起，一定可愛極了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm.
Wait, but don't you have something to give me?
You did earlier.
Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯。
等等，你們不是有東西要給我嗎？
剛才還在的。
去哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Now that I am rejected!
Off to find Moreng!
I won't lose this time for sure!
Let us begin!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
既然被拒絕了！
那就去找莫倫！
這次我絕不會輸！
我們走！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys?They even took Yube with them!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是誰？竟然把尤貝也帶走了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...尤貝應該能照顧好自己。
總之...
莫倫家就在這條路上，麻煩問問他生日想要什麼禮物。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well... I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...尤貝應該能照顧好自己。
總之...
莫倫家就在這條路上，麻煩問問他生日想要什麼禮物。

scripts.text: - She seems really busy making the cake. Let's not bother her. -
scripts.translation: - 她正忙著做蛋糕，還是別打擾她了。 -

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh you're back.
Did you ask Moreng what he wants?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，你回來了。
問到莫倫想要什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Huh!!!
The legend of the great bird?!
It's been close to a hundred years since I've known Moreng, and he's never talked about it before!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
什麼！！！
巨鳥的傳說？！
我認識莫倫快一百年了，他以前從沒提過這件事！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是他真的快走了，我們就得趕在他離開前攔住他，至少給他辦場歡送會。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我想去和莫倫談談，你能替我問問尤貝嗎？
他進去找東西了，應該還在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我想去和莫倫談談，你能替我問問尤貝嗎？
他進去找東西了，應該還在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I should first decide on what present to get him!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯，我得先決定送他什麼禮物！

scripts.text:
- Shuffle shuffle -
He's working on something.
Let's not bother him.
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙，沙沙 -
他正在忙著做什麼。
還是別打擾他了。

scripts.text: - Shuffle shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 沙沙，沙沙 -

scripts.text: - It looks like the fairy that Glaces was talking about. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來像是格拉西斯說的那個妖精。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa!
Who are you?!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哇！
你是誰？！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa! Who's this? It's
{0}?
You seem more like a Warlock now!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哇！這是誰？是
{0}？
你現在看起來倒更像大魔導士了！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I'm glad to see you at a place like this.
What's going on anyways?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
沒想到會在這裡見到你，真高興。
對了，到底發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: Share Glaces' story.
scripts.translation: 告訴尤貝格拉西斯的事

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I told her I'll be looking for materials to make candles with, but as expected, she wasn't listening.
She always loses her mind looking at herself through a mirror.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我跟她說我要去找做蠟燭的材料，她果然沒聽進去。
她總是對著鏡子欣賞自己，看得入迷。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
對了，莫倫現在多大了？
我記得他比我小，不過記不太清了...
能幫我問問格拉西斯他的年齡嗎？

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- You have too many items -
- in your inventory right now. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請停下！！ -
- 你的物品欄已經滿了， -
- 無法領取物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Oh!
You gathered enough already?
I also made enough wicks just in time!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哦！
材料已經收集夠了嗎？
我也剛好做好了足夠的燭芯！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
先把灰塵團捏成這樣，再像這樣插上燭芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
全都做好了！
請把蠟燭拿給格拉西斯。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
And also...
To return the favor, I'll let you use my house!
You can stay over whenever you want as long as you are in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
還有...
為了報答你，我把房子借給你住！
只要你人在埃克拉珠，隨時都可以來。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I work at Splendide for the most part anyways, so I don't come to Eclage very often.
Alright, thanks a lot~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
反正我大多時間都在輝煌領域工作，很少回埃克拉珠。
好了，多謝你啦～

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你要是不忙，能幫我帶些灰塵團來做蠟燭嗎？
蠟燭的數量得和莫倫的年齡一樣，所以麻煩你帶夠數量的灰塵團。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Huh?!
So no one knows how old Moreng is?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
什麼？！
所以誰都不知道莫倫幾歲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
先把灰塵團捏成這樣，再像這樣插上燭芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Wha.. You lost the candles?
I still have some wicks left, so if you bring me the clump of dust again, I'll remake them for ya.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
什麼...蠟燭弄丟了？
我還剩些燭芯，你再帶些灰塵團來，我就重新做給你。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
對了，莫倫現在多大了？
我記得他比我小，不過記不太清了...
能幫我問問格拉西斯他的年齡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Murah? Murah is at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
穆拉？她在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Shul? Shul is probably at the eastern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
舒爾？他大概在城東。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Tato? Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
塔托？他在城西。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Have you ever been to Jotunheim?
There are amazing giants that live there!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你去過約頓海姆嗎？
那裡住著很了不起的巨人！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, at least to summarize what everyone has said...
He's younger than me; 30 years age gap wtih both Glaces and Murah but Glaces and Murah are not the same age,
Shul's age is to add Moreng's age to my age of 100 years before; Shul is 2 years older than Glaces; the average age of me and Shul is Tato and Tato's age is 146, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，我把大家說的線索整理一下...
莫倫比我小；他和格拉西斯、穆拉都相差30歲，但格拉西斯和穆拉並不同歲。
舒爾現在的年齡，等於莫倫的年齡加上我100年前的年齡；舒爾比格拉西斯大2歲；塔托的年齡是我和舒爾的平均數，而塔托是146歲。這樣對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
...
Then how old is he?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
...
那麼，他到底幾歲？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Yes!
That's right!
Now I remember!!!
I think that's what it was!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
對！
沒錯！
我想起來了！！！
應該就是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm~ I don't think so.
Think harder.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯～我覺得不對。
再仔細想想。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm that means I still have to make more than a hundred candles...
Oy......
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，這麼說我還得做一百多支蠟燭...
唉...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你要是不忙，能幫我帶些灰塵團來做蠟燭嗎？
蠟燭的數量得和莫倫的年齡一樣，所以麻煩你帶夠數量的灰塵團。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
全都做好了！
請把蠟燭拿給格拉西斯。

scripts.text: Make the candles.
scripts.translation: 做蠟燭

scripts.text: Don't make the candles.
scripts.translation: 不做蠟燭

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Really?
If you need more, just let me know~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
真的不做嗎？
還需要的話，隨時告訴我~

scripts.text:
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 負重太重， -
- 無法領取物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I can make as many as 128. How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我最多能做128支。你要做幾支？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
先把灰塵團捏成這樣，再像這樣插上燭芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You aren't going to make them?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你不打算做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Mmm...
To make that much, I would probably need more clumps of dust...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯...
要做那麼多的話，恐怕還得再找些灰塵團...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
Don't lose them again~~~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
都做好了！
請把蠟燭交給格拉西斯。
這次可別再弄丟了哦~~~

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng's age?
I don't know it exactly...
Maybe Shul might know?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫倫的年齡？
我不太確定...
也許舒爾知道？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒爾家在城東邊，他應該就在那附近。
說起來，他們居然在我出生前就是朋友了，真不可思議。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Hmm... What amazing present should I give?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...送什麼特別的禮物好呢？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng, Yube, and Shul got to know each other a hundred years ago, and I remember that at that time, their age difference was pretty large that adding Moreng's and Yube's age equaled to that of Shul.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫倫、尤貝和舒爾是在一百年前認識的。我記得那時他們年紀相差很大，莫倫和尤貝的年齡加起來正好等於舒爾的年齡。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒爾家在城東邊，他應該就在那附近。
說起來，他們居然在我出生前就是朋友了，真不可思議。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Moreng's age?
Hmm...
It's been awhile since I kept track of everyone's age.
I just remember that Glaces was two years younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
莫倫的年齡？
嗯...
我已經很久沒記大家的年齡了。
只記得格拉西斯比我小兩歲。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
塔托住在城西，去那邊問問他吧。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Laphine's put their lives on the line to make Yai beautiful.
I'm a Laphine myself but that kind of priority is difficult to understand.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
拉菲尼族為了讓雅伊更美，不惜冒著生命危險。
我也是拉菲尼族，卻不太能理解這種取捨。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Come to think of it, not too long ago, Tato said that his age was the same as the average between my age and Yube's age.
Maybe Tato would remember it?
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
說起來，前陣子塔托說過，他的年齡正好是我和尤貝年齡的平均數。
也許塔托還記得？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
塔托住在城西，去那邊問問他吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
Moreng's age?
It hasn't been very long since I got to know him, so I don't know his age very well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
莫倫的年齡？
我認識他還沒多久，不太清楚他的歲數。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
But why is it that they don't know their own age either?!
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
不過，他們怎麼連自己的年齡都不知道？！

scripts.text: What's Tato's age?
scripts.translation: 塔托幾歲？

scripts.text:
[Tato]
I am 146 years old.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我今年146歲。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 還不知道莫倫的確切年齡，先回去找尤貝吧。 -

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 還不知道莫倫的確切年齡，先回去找尤貝吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Tato]
A friend of mine recently applied to the Splendide unit.
I heard Jotunheim is really cold. I hope he's doing well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我有個朋友最近申請加入輝煌領域部隊。
聽說約頓海姆非常冷，希望他一切都好。

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是個宜居的好地方。
鮮花常開，天氣也總是舒適宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
要是我也有一座漂亮的雅伊，那就真是天堂了！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
雅伊其實是“蛋”的意思。
對拉菲尼族來說，雅伊甚至代表著比家更重要的東西...

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是個適合居住的地方。
花兒總是盛開，天氣也總是舒適宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
要是我也有一座美麗的雅伊，那就真是天堂了！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, so you call those round houses a Yai.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哦，原來你們把那些圓房子稱為雅伊啊。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
雅伊其實是“蛋”的意思。
對拉菲尼族來說，雅伊甚至代表著比家更重要的東西...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
While I spent time and effort as much as putting my life into it, my Yai is nothing more than a fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我傾注了許多心血，甚至為此賭上性命，可我的雅伊終究只是贗品。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
It's called an egg and looks like an egg, but it's really not an egg!
It's just something else that just looks like an egg!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
它叫蛋，看起來也像蛋，但其實根本不是蛋！
只是某種長得像蛋的東西！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Hey, wait a minute!
Are you possibly from Midgard?!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
嘿，等一下！
你難道是來自米德加爾特嗎？！

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I see...
You sure looked like it, but I guess not.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
原來如此...
你看起來的確很像，不過看來不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ah, great!
Then would you happen to know anything about the legend that speaks of a great bird which lives in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
啊，太好了！
那你是否聽說過關於米德加爾特有一隻巨鳥的傳說？

scripts.text:
I heard a little from various travelers.
According to rumors, there is a legend of a great bird in Midgard that lays an egg as big as a house.
scripts.translation:
我從各地旅行者那裡聽到了一些訊息。
據說米德加爾特有一隻巨鳥，它下的蛋有房子那麼大。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, if it's an egg as big as a house, how many days would it take to eat it all?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇，如果蛋有房子那麼大，吃完它得花多少天啊？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
......

[Moreng]
When I first heard of that legend, I was so excited that I couldn't sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
第一次聽說那個傳說時，我興奮得好幾天睡不著。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But as time went by, and as I aged more, I gradually forgot about it.
Isn't that how all childhood dreams are like?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
可隨著時間流逝，我漸漸長大，也慢慢把它忘了。
童年的夢想不都是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But not too long ago when I went to the plaza, I met my old neighbor who told me about a traveler from Midgard holding an incredibly enormous feather...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
不過前陣子我去廣場時，碰到一位老鄰居。他說有個來自米德加爾特的旅行者，手裡拿著一根大得驚人的羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ever since I heard about it, I can't seem to put my mind on anything else.
Could that legend possibly be true?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
自從聽說這件事，我就再也沒法專心做別的事了。
那個傳說會不會是真的？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Truthfully, when I heard that story, I went searching all over the town but couldn't find anyone with a huge feather.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
說實話，聽到這個故事後，我找遍了整座城，卻沒找到任何拿著巨大羽毛的人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
你覺得那位老人的故事是真的嗎？還是在說謊？
我原以為那只是個被遺忘的傳說，如今卻害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
If you are a real man, don't be so meek!
Face it head on! And if you must, you can crash and burn afterwards!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
真正的男子漢就別畏畏縮縮！
勇敢面對！就算最後碰得頭破血流也認了！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Don't crash and burn anything...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
別把什麼東西撞得頭破血流...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
For something like that-!
I'll be the one to ask the old man and let you know!
And if the legend sounds fake, I won't tell you so don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
這點小事——！
我去問那個老人，再回來告訴你！
要是傳說聽起來是假的，我就不告訴你，放心吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Sometimes you should really remind yourself what it means to say 'ignorance is bliss.'
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
有時候你真該想想“無知是福”這句話是什麼意思。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Regardless, I didn't hear anything about that legend either.
Although, for a typical Laphine, something that's insignificant to us could be considered really huge...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
不管怎麼說，我也沒聽過那個傳說。
不過，對普通拉菲尼族來說，我們覺得微不足道的東西，或許已經算很大了...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
But since the land of Midgard is truly far and wide, there may be legends we haven't heard of...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
不過米德加爾特如此遼闊，說不定還有我們沒聽說過的傳說...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
沒錯，看來只能去找那位老人問問了！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你覺得那位老人的故事是真的嗎？還是在說謊？
我原以為那只是個被遺忘的傳說，如今卻害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
Let's go to the plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
沒錯，看來只能去找那位老人了！
我們去廣場吧！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你覺得那位老人的故事是真的嗎？還是在說謊？
我原以為那只是個被遺忘的傳說，如今卻害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
Is that for real?
I can't believe the legend was true...
scripts.translation:
那是真的嗎？
我簡直不敢相信這個傳說竟然是真的...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
What can I say?
I feel like I can't just stay here anymore.
I have to quickly pack my bags and leave for Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我還能說什麼呢？
看來我不能再繼續待在這裡了。
得趕緊收拾行李，出發去米德加爾特！

scripts.text: - Moreng seems like he's really about to leave soon. I should let Glaces know. -
scripts.translation: - 莫倫看起來真的很快就要離開了。我得告訴格拉西斯。 -

scripts.text: I plan to leave for Midgard as soon as my birthday-farewell party with my friends is over.
scripts.translation: 等和朋友們辦完生日兼送別派對，我就馬上動身去米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I would miss my friends for sure, but I should return that much quicker.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我一定會想念朋友們，不過我會盡快回來的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ooo~ So you changed your mind?
Ok then, I will tell you about the story that Light Standard told only me, about which he met a gold monster in the deep Midgard mountains that eats gems!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦～你改變主意了？
好吧，我就告訴你那個只有“光之標準”告訴過我的故事：他曾在米德加爾特深山遇到一隻吃寶石的金色魔物！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近來了不少有趣的訪客啊...
我年輕時，要去異國旅行可是得冒著生命危險。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Nowadays, things are way more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如今放寬管制後，出行方便多了。
再加上傳送和飛行，想去哪兒就去哪兒，冒險也沒了當年的浪漫。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
現在的年輕人大概連青蛙卵是什麼味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
攢夠傑勒比結晶買日本刀，彷彿還是昨天的事。可那把刀如今也被丟在倉庫某個角落了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Time really is merciless... If I had known this then, I would have...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
時間真是無情啊...早知道當年會這樣，我就...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey! Have you heard of a Laphine hero named Light Standard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嘿！你聽說過一位叫“光之標準”的拉菲尼英雄嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't think so.
scripts.translation: 不，我沒聽說過

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 聽說過

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
He's a hero from so long ago that this generation wouldn't even know who he is.
He is probably long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
他是很久以前的英雄，這一代人恐怕都不知道他是誰。他大概早就被遺忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
It's surprising how a young person like you would know of him.
I thought he would be long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
沒想到你這麼年輕，竟然也知道他。
我還以為他早就被遺忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
With a small physique, he was not even a high-level Laphine, but he fought against and defeated incredible monsters.
The word legend seemed to have been made for him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他身材矮小，甚至不是高階拉菲尼，卻能與強大的魔物交戰並將其擊敗。
“傳奇”一詞彷彿就是為他而生。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
His heroic accounts were so famous that kids would sing of them in the streets.
But as Ragnarok passed and peace was found, he suddenly retired.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他的英雄事蹟廣為人知，孩子們甚至會在街頭傳唱。
可仙境傳說結束、和平降臨後，他卻突然隱退了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And he was quickly forgotten...
He had great strength, superb intelligence, and strong, wonderful comrades, but he wasn't perfect....
scripts.translation:
[老人]
沒多久，他就被人遺忘了...
他力量強大、頭腦聰明，還有一群出色的夥伴，但他並非完美無缺...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you know what he was missing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你知道他缺少什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It was a 'friend' like me.
If only if he had reliable and big-hearted friends...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他缺的是像我這樣的“朋友”。
要是他當年有幾個可靠又寬厚的朋友就好了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But old man, would you happen to know anything about a legend regarding the great bird in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
老人家，您知道米德加爾特巨鳥的傳說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh!
You mean the legend of the great bird of Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦！
你說的是米德加爾特巨鳥的傳說？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
For that, there's probably no one who knows it better than I in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
在埃克拉珠，恐怕沒人比我更瞭解這個傳說了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it wasn't too long after Light Standard arrived in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那是在光之標準來到米德加爾特後不久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
He said he traveled in many adventures for a long time before coming to Midgard, but it was his first time seeing such a massive bird.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他說，來到米德加爾特之前，他經歷過許多冒險，但從沒見過那麼巨大的鳥。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I also honestly did not believe that there would be such a big bird.
That is, until I ran into a traveler with an immense feather at the town's entrance during my walk.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
說實話，我原來也不相信世上會有那麼大的鳥。
直到有天散步時，我在城鎮入口遇見一位旅行者，手裡拿著一根巨大的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
As soon as I saw that feather, I began to believe all that Light Standard told me.
For example, a clump of dust that was wearing a cone hat in Jotunheim...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
一看到那根羽毛，我就開始相信光之標準說的話了。
例如，他在約頓海姆遇到過一團戴著尖帽子的灰塵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm...
Earlier Moreng said he hasn't seen them in the city yet, so maybe he's still outside?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯...
剛才莫倫說還沒在城裡見到它們，也許它們還在城外？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's get to it then!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
那我們這就出發！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huh? But I haven't even begun to talk about a monster he met in Midgard who can break any kind of metal!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
咦？可我還沒講到他在米德加爾特遇到的那隻魔物呢！那傢伙能擊碎任何金屬！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
We will hear about it later~
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
以後再聽嘛~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Um...
Du already ran off...
If we let him be, I wonder what kind of trouble he'll create next.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
那個...
杜已經跑遠了...
要是不管他，真不知道他接下來又會闖出什麼禍。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
To get to the city's entrance, we have to get through the bridge that Du broke, but I wonder if it has been fixed.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
要去城門口，得經過杜弄壞的那座橋。不知道現在修好了沒有。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近來了不少有趣的訪客啊...
我年輕時，要去異國旅行可是得冒著生命危險。

scripts.text:
Old Man#ep14_2
Nowadays, things are much more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
老人#ep14_2
如今放寬管制後，出行方便多了。
再加上傳送和飛行，想去哪兒就去哪兒，冒險也沒了當年的浪漫。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
現在的年輕人大概連青蛙卵是什麼味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
攢夠傑勒比結晶買日本刀，彷彿還是昨天的事。可那把刀如今也被丟在倉庫某個角落了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Who are you?
I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你們是誰？
我以前沒見過你們。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat sack merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你們能進埃克拉珠吧？
廣場上有個賣貓包的商人。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh dear, my money...
I can't believe it was a fake...
Oy oy....
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哎呀，我的錢...
竟然是假的...
真倒霉...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你們也是來問羽毛的？
那不過是普通的裝飾品，大家卻老來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
想買的話就別費心了。
不管你們怎麼求，我都不會賣。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather.
It's not an ordinary feather.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
這根羽毛...
可不是普通羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Heh...
Well, it's actually too recent to even brag about...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呵...
不過這事發生得太近，實在沒什麼好炫耀的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It's just luck that I ran into it not too long after I arrived in Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我剛到艾爾海姆不久就遇上了它，只能說是運氣好。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It was so amazing. When it flapped its colossal wings, I couldn't even gather myself to attack because I was too busy just holding on.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那場面真是壯觀。它扇動巨大的翅膀時，我光顧著抓穩自己，根本騰不出手攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
But I am not one to give up so easily.
If I think about it, it was a very long fight.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不過我可不會輕易認輸。
回想起來，那場戰鬥持續了很久。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
That's weird. The old man earlier said that he saw it in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
奇怪了，剛才那位老人說是在米德加爾特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eck!
No... No way.
I definitely saw it at Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！
不...不可能。
我明明是在米德加爾特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I didn't want to show you this, but this scar is the proof.
It was truly a life-threatening battle.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本來不想給你們看，不過這道傷疤就是證據。
那真是一場生死之戰。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hmm...
For a fight not too long ago, the scar seems very old.
From how the scar looks, it doesn't even seem like it's been treated by magic...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
嗯...
既然戰鬥發生在不久前，這道傷疤看著卻很舊。
而且看起來也不像受過魔法治療...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eeck!!!!
If... If I really think about, it might be awhile back actually.
I can't remember too well having so many memoirs and souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！！！！
仔細想想...可能確實是很久以前的事了。
我經歷過太多事，也收了太多紀念品，記不太清了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But how did you travel to other places when you can't even enter Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
可是你連埃克拉珠都進不去，是怎麼去其他地方的？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
If it came near here somewhere, there's no way others haven't seen it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
如果它曾在這附近出現過，不可能沒人看見...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Keeeek!!!!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呃！！！！
好吧！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Actually, this isn't my first time here, but I had the opportunity to go to other places during when deregulation was at its peak awhile back.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
其實我不是第一次來，只是在前些年管制最寬鬆的時候，才有機會去過其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... But this feather...
If I look at it very closely, the shaft is too thick for its size
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
嗯...不過這根羽毛...
仔細看，它的羽軸和羽毛的大小比起來太粗了。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And doesn't the end of it seem really jagged?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
而且末端看起來也很參差不齊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Really?!
Wait! Let me see!!!!
Oh my, that's really true!
How dare that cat sell me a fake?!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
真的嗎？！
等等！讓我看看！！！！
天哪，真的有問題！
那隻貓竟敢賣假貨給我？！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oh.... You bought it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哦...這是買來的吧？

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
You bought it, right?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
這是買來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... Even so, I guess this is a great piece of work. It really seems like the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
嗯...即便如此，做得還真不錯，簡直跟真的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hu....
You have no idea how expensive this was!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
唉...
你們根本不知道我花了多少錢！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你們能進埃克拉珠吧？
廣場上有個貓商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那傢伙騙了我的錢，還...
嗯...
趁別人也被騙之前，快把那隻貓抓起來！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少先幫我攔住那隻貓，等我進了埃克拉珠再說！
拜託了！
求求你們！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那傢伙騙了我的錢，還...
唉...
趁別人也上當之前，快把那隻貓抓起來！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少先幫我攔住那隻貓，等我進了埃克拉珠再說！
拜託了！
求求你們！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你也是來打聽羽毛的？
那不過是個普通的裝飾品，大家卻總拿這事來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
想買的話就省省吧。
不管你們怎麼求，我都不會賣。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather..
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
這根羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我這裡有從非常非常遠的地方帶來的寶貝喵~
快來看看喵~
給你算個好價錢喵~

scripts.text: Talk about the feather.
scripts.translation: 打聽羽毛的事

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's not trueow~!
I'm seriouseow~!
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
才不是那樣喵~！
我說真的喵~！

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's definitely a precious item from Midgardeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那絕對是來自米德加爾特的珍貴寶物喵。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
This end of the feather here is not very convincing...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
這根羽毛的末端看起來不太像真的...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meoweoweow!!!
I...I can't believe you noticedeow...Pretty sharpeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵嗚嗚！！！
沒、沒想到被你發現了喵...眼光真尖喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Actually...
The feather is real for sure, but I modified just a tinyyy~tiny biteow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
其實...
羽毛本身絕對是真的，只是被我稍微、稍微加工了一點喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Because the feather was too big to carry around, I thought that I could cut it up into pieces and sell it to many moreow. But when I cut it, it was a bit weird so I just adjusted it, you seeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
羽毛太大，不方便攜帶。我本想把它切成小塊賣給更多人喵。可切開後總覺得有點奇怪，就稍微修飾了一下喵。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
This is just a cut piece?
Then how big was the real thing?
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
這只是切下來的一小塊？
那原來的羽毛到底有多大？

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Hmm..
It was from here to thereow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
嗯...
大概有從這裡到那邊那麼長喵。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
I couldn't possibly carry something that bigeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那麼大的東西，我怎麼可能搬得動喵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Whoa whoa!
If it's that big, you could probably make a fried egg with the size of this plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇！
要真有那麼大，煎出來的蛋恐怕比整個廣場還大吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
That's probably too much...
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
這也太誇張了...
總之，我們得到了重要線索，最好趕快告訴莫倫。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
總之，我們得到了重要線索，最好趕快告訴莫倫。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我這裡有從非常非常遠的地方帶來的寶貝喵~
快來看看喵~
給你算個好價錢喵~

scripts.text: - Looks like the door is locked. -
scripts.translation: - 門好像鎖著。 -

scripts.text: - Something seems a bit different. -
scripts.translation: - 這裡好像有些不對勁。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, the legend of a great bird?
I think there was one, but since I don't believe in myths, I didn't pay much attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，巨鳥的傳說？
好像是聽過，不過我不相信神話，所以沒怎麼留意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whew...
Done...
The ones I took last time couldn't be used because of a mistake, and I was scolded so much for that...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
呼...
總算弄好了...
上次拿來的東西出了差錯，沒法使用，我因此捱了好一頓罵...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Now that I'm done with work that Master wanted, I should get going to help out with the party.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
師父交代的工作已經做完了，我該去幫忙準備派對了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
How did you get in here?
Uninvited guests are not very welcome, you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你是怎麼進來的？
不請自來的客人可不怎麼受歡迎哦。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
請隨意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You didn't tell Glaces?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你沒告訴格拉西斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I guess if you look at Glaces' Yai...
When I first saw the crack, I was reminded of Glace's Yai.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
說起來...看到那道裂痕時，我想起了格拉西斯的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, finding the great bird's egg firsthand is probably better than receiving it as a gift, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
不管怎麼說，親自找到巨鳥的蛋，應該比收到別人送的禮物更好吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, I should hurry with the party preparations.
I'll send whatever is urgent to Splendide first...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
好了，我得趕緊準備派對。
先把急用的東西送去輝煌領域...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
It's always exciting to place seeds in a box...
One mistake can lead to immense consequences.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
把種子放進盒子時，總讓人興奮不已...
稍有差錯，後果就會很嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Please give me a minute since this is a critical process.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
這一步很關鍵，請稍等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, if you don't mind, could you take this to a delivery man at the plaza?
Master kindly sent me a delivery man specifically for this...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
那能麻煩你把這個送到廣場的送貨員那裡嗎？
師父特意派了送貨員來幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Maybe it's an underlying statement that I would be eliminated if it's not sent right away...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
也許師父是在暗示我：要是不馬上送出去，我就要遭殃了...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我這就出發，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
路上小心哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm, now what do we do?
Hey Mark, do we have some kind of schedule or whatever?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯，現在做什麼好呢？
喂，馬克，我們有行程安排之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Aren't you even a bit tired after all that?
Let's rest up a bit.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
忙了這麼久，你都不累嗎？
先休息一會兒吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hmm...
I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
嗯...
我餓了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns!
I saw many acorns just outside the city!
I want them!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
橡果！
我剛才在城外看到好多橡果！
我想吃！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Acorns?!
Are they any good?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
橡果？！
好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Alright then, shall we get some acorns?
I'll bring a bunch back!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
那我們去摘些橡果吧？
我會帶一大堆回來！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hey hey hey!
I told you not to pull on my cheeks!!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
喂喂喂！
我說過別捏我的臉！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Seriously, you just don't get tired huh...
Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
真是的，你怎麼一點都不累...
好吧，我和大家在這裡休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Greeeeat!
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
太棒了！
走吧，{0}！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我這就出發，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
路上小心哦~

scripts.translation:

謝謝！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Let's go!{0}!

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Yawn...
I'm full...
I'm sleepy...
scripts.translation:

好睏...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Acorns were so good...
Zzzz....
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

是要寄這個嗎？
我會妥善寄送，請放心。

scripts.text:

I need to get going in order to make it on time.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

The road from Splendide to Eclage used to be dangerous, but nowadays, it's actually better to come all the way to Eclage.

以前從輝煌領域到埃克拉珠的路很危險，不過現在直接送到埃克拉珠反而更方便。

scripts.text:

I don't know why people can't just make small amounts of pickled Poring for themselves instead of mailing them...
scripts.translation:

大家為什麼不自己醃一點波利，非要寄過來呢...

scripts.text:

Wait a minute...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm... Where did he go...?
Could he be... a ghost?!
scripts.translation:

嗯...他去哪兒了？
難道...是幽靈？！

scripts.text:

I didn't sense any use of magic or other things of the sort...
scripts.translation:

我沒感覺到有使用魔法之類的跡象...

Wait! Here's the hood that Oliver was wearing...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
等等！這是奧利弗戴過的兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
And... doesn't it feel like this room is different from before?
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
而且...你們不覺得這個房間跟剛才不一樣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey stop that!!
It's scaring me!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
喂，別鬧了！！
嚇死我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Arrrrr~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Oh!!! I just remembered...
Oliver...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
哦！！！我想起來了...
奧利弗...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
Oliver Hilpert...
.........is also known as the dreaming novelist...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...
奧利弗·希爾佩特...
...也就是那位“夢境小說家”...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And this book...
Why didn't I remember this book when Oliver was around?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
還有這本書...
奧利弗在的時候，我怎麼沒想起這本書？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey...
Did you just take that book out from your bag?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
喂...
你剛才是從包裡拿出那本書的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Yeah, that's because I'm a fan...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
嗯，因為我是他的粉絲...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why didn't you remember the book when you are such a fan..?
Not only that, do people usually carry books with them when they're fans?? Especially hardcover books?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
既然是粉絲，怎麼之前沒想起這本書？
再說，粉絲會隨身帶著書嗎？還是這麼厚的精裝書？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
You are a little bit weir...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你這人有點奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
More importantly... The title of this book...
is [The City of Fairies]?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
先不說這個...這本書的書名是...
《妖精之城》？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
And...
It's been many years since this book was published...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
而且...
這本書已經出版很多年了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
...This is getting kind of scary...?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
...這事怎麼有點嚇人？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
......
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:

......
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...

scripts.text:

But this is Volume 1. Does that mean there's more?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
但這是第一卷。難道還有後續？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
It has a total of 3 volumes.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
一共有三卷。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, how many are you carrying with you...
Why are you bringing all of them around...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇，你到底帶了幾本...
幹嘛把它們全都隨身帶著...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Everybody calm down!!!
This has to be some kind of a dream!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
大家冷靜！！！
這一定是在做什麼夢！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why are you hitting me, calling it a dream and all!
It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你說這是夢還打我幹嘛！
好痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Ahhhh maybe it really isn't a dream after all!!!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
啊啊啊，看來真的不是夢！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...A...A...Aaaaahhhhhhhhh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
...啊...啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Don't cry, Maggi~
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
瑪姬，別哭~

I wonder...
Why didn't I remember this...?
scripts.translation:

我怎麼會沒想起這件事？

I... I should have.. I should have gotten his autograph!!!
scripts.translation:
