[可疑男子]
信...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對！一封信！我正要把它交給他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you know who Wuhuru is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道烏胡魯是誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
Wu...huru...? That's...
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
烏...胡魯？那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來^0000cd你就是烏胡魯^000000。你弟弟托我把這封^0000cd信^000000交給你。
沒想到送信的過程會這麼曲折。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank...you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
謝...謝你。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
scripts.translation: - 你讓烏胡魯獨自讀信。 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
Ah.. What have I done...?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我、我竟然對弟弟做了這種事...烏哈里還好嗎？
啊...我到底做了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
你見過烏哈里了？那就好。
在這座監獄裡，我總算能稍微安心一點。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Any good news?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
有好訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
既然你見過烏哈里，也看到了，我原本並不是這副模樣。
我和弟弟在低階拉菲尼族中都算^0000cd特別瘦小^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
拉菲尼族如此重視外表，我們因此總覺得自己低人一等。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
因為體格不如別人，我們一直待在家裡讀書。也因此，我們比其他人聰明得多。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
有一天，一位名叫^0000cd姆瓦迪裡卡^000000的高階拉菲尼族人來找我。
他說自己是研究設施的成員，希望我協助他們進行一項秘密研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他給了我一份研究報告，裡面寫著實驗步驟和所需材料。
那是一項^0000cd強化拉菲尼族體格、讓他們更強壯也更美麗^000000的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我立刻答應了。那顯然是個讓我獲得認可的機會，根本沒有理由猶豫。
而且，要是能找到讓自己長高的方法...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他要求我對這件事保密，我便照他說的做了。
連最信任的弟弟，我都沒有告訴。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我也不知道這樣做究竟是對是錯...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
總之，經過大量研究，我終於得到了結果。
可當時沒有合適的實驗物件。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
於是我就拿自己做實驗。
結果你也看到了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
實驗一失敗，那位拉菲尼族人就立刻抽身離開了。
我試著獨自收拾殘局，最後卻落得被關在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
變成這副模樣後，我才發現自己寧願要回原來瘦小的身體。
現在的我簡直就是個魔物。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我並不想變成這樣...是我太貪心了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
要是我早點明白就好了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
抱歉，說了這麼多。
不管怎樣，我想自己這輩子都出不去了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
如果你能離開這裡，能不能告訴我弟弟，請他想辦法讓我恢復原來的樣子？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
弟弟比我還瘦小，卻一直比我聰明。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
今天這間牢房格外暖和。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外發現了一具拉菲尼族人的屍體

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
...A dead Laphine corpse?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
...一具拉菲尼族人的屍體？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^0000cd那是一具高階拉菲尼族人的屍體。^000000從他的情況來看，他似乎就是那個找你做研究的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還遇到一個目擊者。他說，在你被關進這裡之前，曾有另一位體型更大的拉菲尼族人追趕那位高階拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then he was murdered.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
後來，那位高階拉菲尼被殺了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
你這話是什麼意思？
是在說我是殺人犯嗎？

scripts.text: Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是因為氣憤才殺了他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
就算我承認...承認自己是殺人犯，又能怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
反正我都被困在這副身體裡了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He tricked me, you see!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
是他騙了我！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他騙我說，這項研究是為了讓拉菲尼族變得更美、更強，還讓我親自當實驗物件！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
實驗一失敗，他就逃走了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
直到臨死前，他才把真相告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他的真正目的，是向上級證明^0000cd自己確實有研究員的本事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他說自己連實驗內容和所用材料都沒仔細看過。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他還用卑劣的手段弄到了薩法的毛髮！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
後來宮裡發現了這項研究的內幕，便派人追捕我們。我因為參與研究，也被抓了起來。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What exactly did I do wrong?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我到底做錯了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我不過是他野心計劃中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你參與研究的目的，和他找你合作的目的差不多。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你確實是他陰謀的受害者，但你做過的事也很難讓人原諒...
不過，你被關在這裡，也算是在為自己的行為付出代價。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
I implore you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
求你...別把這些事告訴烏哈里。
我求你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我會當作從沒來過這裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
謝謝你...我欠你一個人情...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哇！喂！
能不能別突然冒出來？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哇！喂！
怎麼回事？嚇我一跳！
你想幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I'm a fragile, sensitive being!
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
我可是很脆弱、很敏感的！

scripts.text: Um, about Wuhuru...
scripts.translation: 嗯，關於烏胡魯的事...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哦，原來沒什麼事。
說到烏胡魯...具體情況我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
他一向過得平靜，真想不通怎麼會變成那樣。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
說起來，事發那天我聽見一聲^0000cd特別響的尖叫^000000...
村裡好多人嚇得有一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
沒過多久，宮裡就來了很多人，把烏胡魯帶走了。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
那陣子我難得出一次門，所以只看見烏胡魯被抓走。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
不過烏胡魯當時的樣子...他的樣子...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
總之，山羊仔當時也和我在一起，你去問問他吧。^0000cd他對這類事很敏銳^000000，應該還記得更多。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Did you want to know about something else?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
還有別的事想問嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去過皇宮嗎？
聽說那裡比我們的雅伊漂亮得多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
scripts.translation: 我和馬西奧內談過了...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
馬西奧內叫你來的？怎麼了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
scripts.translation: 我想問問烏胡魯的事

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，你是來打聽烏胡魯的。不過我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
He came by with some ^0000cdstranger^000000...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
啊！我想起來了，出事前我見過烏胡魯！
他和一個^0000cd陌生人^000000一起來的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我認識烏胡魯這麼久，還是頭一回見他那麼開心。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我問他為什麼這麼高興，他給我看了幾張^0000cd紙^000000，說自己很快就會變得很帥...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他身旁那人還示意他別聲張...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我當時有些擔心，可看他那麼高興，也就沒多說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那之後不久，就出了那場大事故。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
scripts.translation: 那張紙是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那東西嗎？我也不知道，離得太遠，看不清...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
對了，你去問問我^0000cd丈夫^000000吧。他和烏胡魯走得很近，可能知道得更多。

scripts.text: I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想了解烏胡魯合作的那位高階拉菲尼

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，那位高階拉菲尼？對~我想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
和烏胡魯一起來的陌生人就是高階拉菲尼。你說的是他吧？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
要是說那個人，他和烏胡魯待了一陣子後，就悄悄離開了。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
從那以後，烏胡魯就一直待在自己的雅伊裡。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
不過，那位拉菲尼^0000cd確實有一雙漂亮又惹眼的翅膀，顯得十分優雅；可他的眼神和舉止都透著可疑^000000。

scripts.text: Do you remember anything else?
scripts.translation: 你還記得別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯...我想起來了，^0000cd有一天蓬佩告訴我，他在花海之地看見一位高階拉菲尼遭遇了可怕的事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他說，當時那位拉菲尼也有^0000cd特別巨大又漂亮的翅膀...^000000

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Go see Pompe and check with him.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去找蓬佩問問吧。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
一無所有的人，大概只能靠做夢了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我妻子最大的心願就是去皇宮看看。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I know why you are here!
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我知道你為什麼來！

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something else from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
還有別的事要問我嗎？

scripts.text: I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我想問問烏胡魯手裡那張紙的事

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
沒錯。我妻子說他當時拿著類似的東西，但我也不知道那到底是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
不過，你為什麼要找那種東西？

scripts.text: Wuhari asked me a favor.
scripts.translation: 烏哈里拜託我幫忙

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
哦，是嗎？說起來，我忘了告訴烏哈里。
烏胡魯被抓走前，把一封^0000cd信^000000放在我家窗臺上。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
他大概是預感到自己的處境，才提前寫了這封信。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
他托我把一份密封的^0000cd檔案^000000交給弟弟。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
However!
We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
不過！
我們實在太忙了。即使聽說烏哈里回到附近，也沒能見到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
嗯...妻子說的那張紙，會不會就是這份密封檔案？
不管怎樣，你把這個交給烏哈里吧。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Let me see... Where did I put it...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我找找...放在哪兒了...

scripts.text: - Shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yes, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
找到了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我一直提醒自己要把它收好，結果反倒弄成這樣。
雖然又皺又髒，應該還是看得清。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Please help those poor kids.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
請幫幫那兩個可憐的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
真不明白，那麼好的孩子怎麼會變成那樣...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我也想幫她實現心願，可這怎麼可能呢？
尤其是我們現在這種處境...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
You dropped this, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你掉了東西吧？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
嘖嘖，年紀輕輕怎麼就這麼健忘？

scripts.text: Who's the high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation: 那位高階拉菲尼是誰？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
高階拉菲尼？嗯...我不太清楚是誰。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我以前從沒見過他，那也是我最後一次見到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你去問我妻子吧，她當時也在場。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我妻子比我機靈多了，這種事問她應該更有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我想幫她實現那個願望，但怎麼可能呢？
尤其是考慮到我們現在的處境...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I saw it!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我看見了！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哎喲！哇！你是誰？幽靈嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I really saw it!!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我真的看見了！！

scripts.text: I was sent by Goatie...
scripts.translation: 我是山羊仔派來的...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
山羊仔派你來的？怎麼了？
是上次給我的東西嗎？告訴他們再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我只是想問問你在野外看到的那位拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oy! That Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哦！那位拉菲尼？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Whoa! Don't even start with me!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哇，別讓我再提那件事！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
有天半夜我在野外幹活，突然出現了兩道黑影！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
先是一位^0000cd高階拉菲尼^000000飛快地消失在遠方。那景象實在太美，我忍不住看了好一會兒。
^0000cd他的翅膀又大又漂亮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
然後！沒過多久，突然！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
So suddenly!!!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
就在那一瞬間！！！
^0000cd一隻巨大的拉菲尼^000000追了上去！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
也許是當時太黑了，^0000cd那傢伙全身漆黑^000000，根本看不清是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
It was such a scary scream.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我沒多想，就回了家。過了一會兒，突然傳來一聲震徹整片野地的尖叫。
那叫聲嚇死人了。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
從那以後，我嚇得好一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
幾天前我又去野外，在角落裡發現了^0000cd一具巨大的屍體^000000！
附近還散落著許多^0000cd可疑的樹枝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
那景象太嚇人了，我沒敢靠近...

scripts.text: A corpse?
scripts.translation: 一具屍體？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
是啊！我不知道發生了什麼可怕的事，但^0000cd有一隻巨大的翅膀被撕裂了。仔細一想，那應該就是我見過的那位拉菲尼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
天哪~~真不知道怎麼會突然發生這種事。
高階拉菲尼應該有強大的魔力，卻這麼輕易就死了。那隻巨型拉菲尼一定非常可怕。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
所以我才不敢去野外。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
萬一我在野外時，那隻巨型拉菲尼襲擊我怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我的孩子還小，我得照顧他們！我可得保護好自己！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
You should stay away, too, if you can.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
你也儘量別靠近那裡。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
打擾一下，方便的話能佔用您一點時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您找到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I went to go see my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我去找父親了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不知道他去哪兒了...應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
Oh... I see you haven't yet...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您找到什麼了嗎？
哦...看來還沒有...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Father... Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
父親...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Where did he go...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他到底去哪兒了...？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
You really seem like you have an impressive aura.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您身上有種不凡的氣質。

scripts.text: Do you know the way?
scripts.translation: 您知道該怎麼走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm sorry? Do I know the way...?
No, no, I'm not someone like that.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
什麼？我知道怎麼走？
不不，我可不是嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I noticed from earlier that you are looking for something. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我剛才注意到您在找東西。沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'd like to make a ^0000cdsuggestion^000000.
Would you like to hear it?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我有個^0000cd提議^000000。
您想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 好，我聽聽

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
It won't be a waste of your time. To be honest, I'm actually ^0000cdlooking for someone^000000 here too.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不會耽誤您太久。說實話，我也^0000cd在這裡找一個人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親已經有一陣子沒回家了。我去他的工作地點找過，他們說他也好久沒去上班。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他不是會這樣不告而別的人，所以我到處打聽。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
聽說有人在這附近見過他，可我怎麼也找不到他。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
scripts.translation: 您問過當局了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
問過了。他們其實也在找我父親。
我猜他們還沒什麼進展。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我擔心他出了什麼事，所以親自出來找他。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不如我們結伴尋找，途中也互相幫忙找各自要找的東西？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
你覺得怎麼樣？一起行動總比各自尋找強。

scripts.text: What's he look like?
scripts.translation: 他長什麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
太好了，那你是願意和我合作了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father is similar to me. ^0000cdHe has particularly large wings and has a generally red aura around him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親和我很像。^0000cd他的翅膀特別大，周身常泛著紅色光暈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
His name is ^0000cdMwadirica^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他叫^0000cd姆瓦迪裡卡^000000。

scripts.text: I'm looking for him too!
scripts.translation: 我也在找他！

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, really? Why are you looking for my father?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
真的嗎？你為什麼要找我父親？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Actually, let's talk about this later and search for my father now.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
這件事我們之後再談，現在先去找我父親吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
If we find something, let's meet back here.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
有線索的話，我們就在這裡碰頭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把這個帶來了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What... Did you say you found something?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
什麼...你說找到線索了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm? Where did it go? Did I drop it on the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？東西去哪兒了？我是在路上弄丟了嗎？

scripts.text: - You describe the corpse that you found in the field and show the piece of wing -
scripts.translation: - 你描述了在野外發現屍體的情形，並拿出那片翅膀。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, oh....! This is.... Definitely my father's...
Sob... NOoo!
How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
哦...！這是...肯定是我父親的...
嗚...不要！！！
怎麼會這樣...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's in the eastern part of the field among the tall grasses. Should I accompany you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他在野地東邊的高草叢裡。要我陪你去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
No, no. I'll go alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不用，不用，我自己去。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Before that, I would like to hear about why you were looking for my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
在那之前，我想先聽你說說為什麼在找我父親。

scripts.text: - You share Wuhuru's research story -
scripts.translation: - 你講述了烏胡魯的研究經過。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father? He was certainly working on something very hard recently...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親？他最近確實一直在埋頭研究什麼...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ah, who in the world... did such a thing...
A kind person like him...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
啊...到底是誰做了這種事...
他那麼善良...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
In any case, thanks a lot. You found my father...
This couldn't possibly be enough compensation, but please take it.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
總之，謝謝你找到我父親...
這點報酬遠不足以表達謝意，請收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
And please tell Wuhuru about my father.
They worked together, so he should hear about my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
還有，請把我父親的事告訴烏胡魯。
他們曾一起工作，他有權知道。

scripts.text: I need a piece of your father's wing.
scripts.translation: 我需要你父親的一片翅膀

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Isn't that what you already have in your hand right now?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
你手裡拿著的不就是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Why would you need a piece of my father's wing...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
你為什麼需要我父親的翅膀碎片...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What! When did it get here?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼！它什麼時候跑到我這裡來的？！

scripts.text: - You briefly share Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 你簡單講述了烏胡魯的事。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I see... It resulted from their research together...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我明白了...這是他們一起研究造成的結果...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ok, sure. I will give it to you. I'm sure that's what my father would have liked you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
好吧，可以給你。我想父親也會願意把它交給你。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Please tell him I wish him the best.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
請替我祝他一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I would like to reminisce a bit more about my father here.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我想在這裡再回憶一會兒父親。

scripts.text: - An unidentifiable figure that looks like a huge flower bud -
scripts.translation: - 一個無法辨認的身影，看起來像巨大的花苞。 -

scripts.text: This looks like the Laphine corpse that Pompe talked about.
scripts.translation: 這應該就是蓬佩提到的那具拉菲尼屍體。

scripts.text: Looking at the shape of the wing, ^0000cdit is Mwaridica's high-level Laphine wing as described by Wuhuru and Giranni^000000.
scripts.translation: 觀察翅膀的形狀，^0000cd這應該是烏胡魯和吉蘭尼所說的姆瓦迪裡卡的高階拉菲尼翅膀。^000000

scripts.text: Seeing various scars on the body, he seems to have been ^0000cdmurdered^000000 after a fight.
scripts.translation: 屍體上有多處傷痕，看來他是在戰鬥後^0000cd遭人殺害^000000的。

scripts.text: If he were to be overpowered, it must have been ^0000cda creature of large physique^000000 that surpasses a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation: 如果他是被擊敗的，對手必定是^0000cd體型遠超高階拉菲尼的生物^000000。

scripts.text: Let's pick up these scattered wing pieces and go tell Giranni about this.
scripts.translation: 把散落的翅膀碎片收集起來，再去告訴吉蘭尼吧。

scripts.text: The scattered wing pieces are collected.
scripts.translation: 散落的翅膀碎片已經收集完畢。

scripts.text: - Around the corpse are some hair strands of a Sapha that look like tree branches -
scripts.translation: - 屍體周圍散落著一些薩法毛髮，看起來像樹枝。 -

scripts.text: - Since this is a research ingredient, let's take some -
scripts.translation: - 這是研究所需的材料，收集一些吧。 -

scripts.text: - A high-level Laphine corpse -
scripts.translation: - 一具高階拉菲尼的屍體。 -

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Take a look at me! How's this? Am I not so fabulous?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
看看我！怎麼樣？是不是風度翩翩？

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
A Laphine can freely change in between different clothes, but not any Laphine looks this great!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
拉菲尼族可以隨心更換衣服，不過不是每個族人都能穿出我這樣的風采！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
What nonsensical nonsense are you saying? No matter who looks at it, this region's best looker is me!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你在胡說八道什麼？誰看都知道，這一帶最帥的就是我！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
My fashion sense today is excellent as usual. Heh-
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
我今天的穿搭品味還是一如既往地出眾。哼哼。

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
Hello~ My beautiful body~
Every strand of hair is so beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你好~我這迷人的身姿~
連每一根頭髮都漂亮極了！

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Yes, it's definitely your garbage fashion sense that wreaks of trash as usual.
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
沒錯，你那品味果然還是一如既往地糟糕，簡直俗不可耐。

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I recently moved out of my parent's place!
I am so glad I finally have my own Yai!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我最近搬出父母家了！
終於有了自己的雅伊，真開心！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I'm going to make it the most decorative, beautiful Yai in Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我要把它裝飾成埃克拉珠最華麗、最漂亮的雅伊！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
Yay, woohoo!!!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
耶，太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
You are not from around here?
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[米賈尼]
你不是本地人吧？
歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
Of course, as long as you don't disrupt Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[米賈尼]
當然可以，只要別在埃克拉珠惹事。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
I also want to visit foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
我也想去外面的世界看看。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
But would foreigners leave me be when I am this adorable?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
不過我這麼可愛，外地人會放過我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
Man, wherever I go, my cuteness just complicates everything...
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
唉，不管去哪兒，我的可愛總會給我添麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Do you like things that twinkle?
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
你喜歡閃閃發亮的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
I love them so much!
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
我最喜歡了！

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
閃閃發亮~閃閃發亮~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
閃閃發亮~閃閃發亮~
亮晶晶~亮晶晶~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
Mmhahah~ Hahaha~ Hehehe~
Heh heh heh~ Huhuhe~ Hoho~
Kehehe~ Halala~ Fufu~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
閃閃發亮~閃閃發亮~
亮晶晶~亮晶晶~
嗯哈哈~哈哈哈~嘿嘿嘿~
嘿嘿嘿~呼呼嘿~呵呵~
嘻嘻~啦啦~呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
But there's nothing twinkling here...
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
可是這裡沒有閃閃發亮的東西...

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Ah~ I'm so hungry. What should I eat today?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
啊~肚子好餓。今天吃什麼好呢？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Come to think of it, I wonder how this foreigner will taste?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
說起來，不知道外地人吃起來是什麼味道？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Hey hey, you know I'm kidding, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
喂喂，我是在開玩笑，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
Why am I kneeling like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
我為什麼一直跪著？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
At first, it was because it was comfortable. Now it's because I can't stretch my legs out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
一開始是覺得這樣舒服。現在嘛，是腿已經伸不直了。

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
I try to stretch them out, and my legs are all asleep!!
Does that mean I have to fly around with my legs flexed like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
我試著伸直腿，結果整條腿都麻了！！
難道以後只能一直蜷著腿飛嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Wahahaha! How do you do!
It's perfect weather for a picnic, no?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
哇哈哈！你好啊！
今天天氣這麼好，正適合野餐，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
You say it's hard to pack for a picnic?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
你說野餐的準備很麻煩？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
別擔心！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This is a specialty combining acorns with 7 different kinds and 7 different levels of flavor collected by squirrels of Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
這是埃克拉珠的松鼠採集七種不同種類、七種不同口味的橡果，精心製成的特色美食！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This specialty to-go box is only 2,999 coins!!!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
這款特色外帶套餐只要2,999枚金幣！！！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Such a remarkable price!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
價格超划算！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
If you order now, we also give you a disposable fork that feels like new even with a hundred uses!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦人]
現在下單還送一把一次性叉子，用一百次都跟新的一樣！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
Do you see this balcony up top?
Mayor Jun appears there everytime there is an important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[臉紅的女孩]
看到上面的陽臺了嗎？
每逢重要場合，君市長都會在那裡露面！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
He's so handome!! Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[臉紅的女孩]
他好帥！！啊～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
We are Eclage's Tree Wing Choir~
We bring you heavenly harmonies~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
我們是埃克拉珠的樹翼唱詩班～
為大家獻上天籟般的和聲～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
Hello foreigner, we'll give you a taste of our harmony~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
你好，外地人。讓我們為你唱一曲吧～

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~~~
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~~
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Uhhurukukuruhuuhhurukukuruhuuh
Try to feel this~ The melody that flows~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
嗚呼嚕咕嚕呼嗚呼嚕咕嚕呼
感受一下這流淌的旋律～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
How is it!! Our harmony!!
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
怎麼樣！！我們的和聲！

scripts.text:
[Choir member]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班成員]
啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shuffle... Shuffle...
Tap... Tap... Creak... Creak...
Thud thud thud...
Thud Thud!!! Creak~ Thud!
What are these sounds?
scripts.translation: 這些是什麼聲音？

scripts.text: Ignore them and move on.
scripts.translation: 別管它們，繼續趕路

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are weird sounds of some kind...
I should go in and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
裡面好像傳來奇怪的聲音...
我該進去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's probably nothing.
I should just go on my way~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大概沒什麼事。
我還是繼續趕路吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
- Something hits you
over the head really hard.
Your body loses its strength and your vision goes blurry -
scripts.translation:
- 有什麼東西狠狠砸中了你的腦袋。
你渾身脫力，視線也逐漸模糊。 -

scripts.text: - Oh, I can't lose my consciousness like this -
scripts.translation: - 不行...不能就這樣昏過去... -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
剛才發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
There's no way the house is
in this much disarray without
a thief breaking and entering...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
家裡亂成這樣，肯定是有小偷闖進來了...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Just earlier, my necklace
was stolen!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
剛才我的項鍊被偷了！

scripts.text:
[Poppy]
Bow wow! Bow wow!
Grrrrr Bow Wow!
scripts.translation:
[波比]
汪汪！汪汪！
嗚——汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
This darn dog always
bites random strangers
that other Laphines hate it!
How many times did I say
that we should kick
this dog out for good?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
這隻臭狗總是亂咬陌生人，其他拉菲尼族人都討厭它！
我說過多少次了，乾脆把這隻狗趕走算了！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Poppy~ Be nice~
This person is not
someone to be afraid of,
Shh~ Shh~~
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
波比～乖一點～
這位不是壞人，不用怕。
噓～噓～

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And how many times 
did I tell you to lock the doors
properly, my dear!!
This is all because of you
not caring for our house enough!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
親愛的，我跟你說過多少次，一定要把門鎖好！！
你就是不夠上心，才讓家裡變成這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Hey, hey, you keep
blaming me too much!
Aren't we lucky enough 
that we are not
hurt anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
喂喂，你也太愛責怪我了吧！
至少我們都沒受傷，這不是已經很幸運了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What did you say?
My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你說什麼？
真是的！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm?
I think that person's awake!
Hey, are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯？
那個人好像醒了！
喂，你還好嗎？

scripts.text: My head hurts so much...
scripts.translation: 我的頭好痛...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
If the human's awake, get rid of it!
Our house just got robbed
and we don't have the 
luxury of taking care of someone!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
既然那個人醒了，就把他趕出去！
我們家才剛被搶，哪有閒工夫照顧別人！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Still, you shouldn't say that to someone who's been knocked out...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
可是，也不能對剛昏過去的人這麼說啊...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
How do you feel?
You were in front of our house, unconscious so we brought you inside.
What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你感覺怎麼樣？
你昏倒在我們家門口，所以我們把你帶進來了。
你怎麼會倒在那裡？

scripts.text: Someone came out... and...
scripts.translation: 有人衝出來...然後...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Wow... I can't believe something like that happened.
I think the person who knocked
you unconscious is the one 
who robbed our house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
哇...竟然發生了這種事。
把你打昏的人，應該就是搶我們家的人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How can you believe what {0} saying?
How do you know {1} not lying
after robbing our stuff {2}?
Search {3} possessions immediately!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你怎麼能相信{0}說的話？
{1}搶了我們的東西{2}，你怎麼知道對方沒有說謊？
立刻搜查{3}的隨身物品！！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No, how could you say such things?
In common sense, why would the robber be lying down in front of the house?
I think what this person is
saying is probably true...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
不，你怎麼能這麼說？
按常理，小偷怎麼會躺在自家門口？
我覺得這位說的應該是真的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
In any case. What do you plan to do?
Because our house just got robbed,
we don't have the means to take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
總之，你打算怎麼辦？
我們家剛被搶，實在沒辦法照顧你。

scripts.text: I'm not the type to be bullied around.
scripts.translation: 我可不是任人欺負的

scripts.text: I'll help you catch the thief.
scripts.translation: 我會幫你們抓住小偷

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... The way you look
seems like you would have 
been bullied around in the past..
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...看你的樣子，以前好像沒少受欺負...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, I guess
we'll need
your help
with this.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯，那這件事就拜託你幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, since you say that,
I can't trust you 100%, but
I'll trust you as best as I can.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
既然你這麼說，我就儘量相信你吧，雖然還不能完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll definitely
find the jerk who hit
me over my head.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯。我一定要找到那個從背後敲我腦袋的混蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before anything, I'll first listen to your
observations on what may have happened.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在開始之前，我先聽聽你們觀察到的情況。
請儘量配合我。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Sure, you got it.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
好，交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't know about this...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
這事我可不太放心...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Alright, let's go for it.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
好，那就查檢視吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... The stories you told me...
Now I've processed through them..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...你們剛才講的那些事...我已經整理過了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are some points of interest
that I am considering right now...
First of all..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有幾個關鍵點值得注意...
首先...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The likely suspect is...
A person with short, red hair.
We aren't sure whether the
person is male or female, but
has a familiar face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嫌疑人很可能是個留著紅色短髮的人。
還不確定是男是女，但看起來很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dames came back from meeting with a friend..
The friend is nice.
He's a bit immature, but doesn't
seem to be of a particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
達姆斯是去見朋友後回來的。
那位朋友人不錯，雖然有點不成熟，但不像會惹出什麼大麻煩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rosa was coming back from shopping.
Since I was lying unconscious
and the house was a mess,
she was afraid of me and left me 
there and stayed inside the house.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
羅莎買東西回來時，看見我昏倒在地，屋裡也亂成一團。
她嚇壞了，把我留在門外，自己進了屋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought the daughter discovered
me first but Rosa was already
in the house by then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原以為是女兒先發現我的，可那時羅莎已經在屋裡了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The daughter told me that 
she saw Balumin passing
by the house...
He seemed to be preoccupied
with something...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
女兒說，她看到巴盧明從屋旁經過...
他看起來心事重重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In other words... the person who
discovered me first was Rosa
and I was lying in front of
the house.
The house was in much disarray
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也就是說...羅莎最先發現了我，而我當時倒在門外。
屋裡亂成一團，而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why was I just passed
by when I was unconcious?
Something's not right.
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是我昏倒在門外，為什麼有人經過時沒有理會？
這不太對勁...而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Dames actually
suspects Rosa the most.
Their marriage has been becoming
more difficult. She's been asking him for
more things. Their relationship doesn't seem healthy.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，達姆斯最懷疑羅莎。
他們的婚姻最近越來越緊張。她不斷向他要東西，兩人的關係似乎不太好。而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The stolen necklace was
what the husband bought for his wife..
Recently, the wife asked him to 
buy her a necklace, but he refused.
That's why he suspects her.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被偷的項鍊是丈夫送給妻子的。
最近妻子要他再買一條，他拒絕了，所以他才懷疑她...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She said she doesn't suspect anyone.
She trusts her family entirely.
The stolen necklace was
something that she
really cared for.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她說自己不懷疑任何人，完全信任家人。
那條被偷的項鍊對她來說非常珍貴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are no particularly expensive
items in the house and neither was the necklace.
It was just a meaningful item.
It is weird that it was stolen
when it didn't seem very expensive.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
屋裡沒有什麼貴重物品，項鍊本身也不值錢，只是很有紀念意義。
偏偏小偷拿走了它，這點很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The analysis is enough for now and
the second thing I have to do is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前分析到這裡。接下來要做的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Field examination!
The robber must have left
some evidence!
Shall I start?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
勘查現場！
小偷一定留下了什麼線索！
現在開始嗎？

scripts.text: - Let's examine Poppy first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查波比。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the messy
bookshelves first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查亂糟糟的書架。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the damaged
book first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查被弄壞的書。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
container first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查容器。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
messed up table first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查亂成一團的桌子。 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh......
What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊...
我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh... What happened here?
I can't believe that the house was robbed...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊...這裡發生什麼事了？
真不敢相信家裡被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope the robber
is caught soon..
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
希望能快點抓到小偷...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok then,
I will begin interviewing
the victims.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，我先詢問幾位當事人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice
so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，請認真回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你剛才從哪裡回來？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was taking a walk
in the land of blooming flowers.
I was reading a book and enjoying the breeze.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我剛才在花海之地散步。
一邊看書，一邊吹著風。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If I go to a place where there are soft breezes,
I feel much better and
forget everything about the house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
去有微風的地方走走，心情就會好很多，也能暫時忘掉家裡的煩心事。

scripts.text: Was there anyone suspicious?
scripts.translation: 你有看到什麼可疑的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...我不太確定。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh! Come to think of it, there was!
There was a person with short, red hair hurriedly going somewhere.
I wondered to myself
what's the big hurry?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊！想起來了！
有個紅色短髮的人急匆匆地往某處趕。
我還納悶他為什麼這麼著急。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
It was an uncommon hair color
so it made me stare at the person 
for a bit, wondering who it was.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
那種髮色很少見，所以我多看了那人幾眼，想知道他是誰。

scripts.text: Was the person male or female?
scripts.translation: 那人是男是女？

scripts.text: Do you know anyone with short, red hair?
scripts.translation: 你認識留紅色短髮的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That I'm not sure...
Hmm, now that you ask.
I wonder what the gender is.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
這個我不太清楚...
嗯，你這麼一問，我也好奇那人到底是男是女。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm...
No matter how much I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...
我怎麼想都想不起來...

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
The physique seems
more masculine, but
the hair seemed more
feminine...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
體格看著比較像男性，可頭髮又顯得比較女性化...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
And... Something about
the person was familiar
to me..
I'm not exactly sure though.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
還有...那人讓我覺得有些面熟...
不過我也不確定。

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 誰第一個發現我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 你還在別處見過紅短髮的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我想...應該是我第一個發現你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
沒有，我後來沒再見過那人。
不過回家的路上，我看到爸爸的朋友巴盧明從家門前經過。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我第一次發現你時，你正昏倒在家門口。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我嚇了一跳，還以為你已經死了，幸好你還有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我正想趕緊把你搬進屋，沒想到屋裡亂成這樣，又嚇了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
可是媽媽已經在屋裡了。
有人昏倒在門外，她怎麼能什麼都不做，就直接進屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you
was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
這麼說來，第一個看到你的大概是媽媽。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我離他很遠，看不清楚，不過他當時滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我沒和他說話，但他看起來心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if he passed by our house,
he must have seen you unconscious body but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
仔細想想，巴盧明經過我家時肯定也看見你昏倒在地。他為什麼什麼都沒做呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
總之，我知道的就這些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你如實回答

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
沒關係。
希望多少能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
希望能抓到小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I have never seen anyone else with that hairstyle.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不，我沒見過其他留這種髮型的人。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
At least from the people that I know,
I don't think there was ever a person like that.
Yeah... Not at all!
This I know for sure!
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
至少在我認識的人裡，沒有這樣的人。
對，絕對沒有！這一點我很確定！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If it was a color as 
obvious as that,
there is no way I wouldn't remember!
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
髮色那麼顯眼，我不可能不記得！

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 誰第一個發現我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair before?
scripts.translation: 你以前見過紅色短髮的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我想...應該是我第一個發現你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不，我沒有再見到那個人。
不過在我回家的路上，我看到爸爸的朋友巴盧明
從我家門前經過。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我第一次發現你的時候，你正躺在屋前，已經失去了意識。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我當時嚇了一跳，還以為是一具屍體，但幸好你還有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
所以我急忙想把你抱進屋裡，但看到屋裡一片狼藉，又嚇了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不過，媽媽已經在屋裡了。
有人昏倒在門外，她怎麼能什麼都不做，就直接進屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
所以真要說的話，第一個看到你的應該是媽媽。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我離他比較遠，所以沒看清細節，但他當時滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我沒有和他說話，但他看起來
心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if Balumin passed by our house, too,
he must have seen you unconscious
but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
仔細想想，巴盧明經過我家時肯定也看見你昏倒在地。他為什麼什麼都沒做呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's 
pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
總之，我知道的就這些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你的坦誠回答

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
沒關係。
希望多少能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
希望能抓到小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你是說要勘查現場？
有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You were working on the field examination, right?
But I guess you aren't done.
Please let me know what you find
when you are done.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你還在勘查現場，對吧？看來還沒結束。
結束後告訴我你發現了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You finished with all of the
field examination!
Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
現場都勘查完了嗎？
有什麼發現？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Maybe...
The necklace wasn't stolen, but
was just lost somewhere in the house...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
會不會...項鍊根本沒被偷，只是不小心掉在屋裡了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, that wasn't the case,
and I should do a 
survey investigation of
various people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惜不是這樣。接下來我得向其他人逐一打聽。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh, I see...
But aren't you doing
too much for us?
Honestly, we are very
thankful for what
you've already done...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
哦...我明白了。
不過，你為我們做的已經夠多了。
說真的，我們非常感謝你...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What are you saying?
No matter what! My necklace!
And the thief who took it!
We have to find them!
No matter what!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你在說什麼？不管怎樣，我的項鍊和小偷都一定要找到！
無論如何都要找到！

scripts.text:
- Footstep sounds -
- It sounds like someone is walking toward the house -
scripts.translation:
- 腳步聲 -
- 好像有人正朝屋子走來 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother~ Father~
I'm back~!
What the...?!
What happened to the house?
Was it robbed?!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
媽媽～爸爸～
我回來啦～！
咦...？！
家裡怎麼了？被搶了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How am I possibly
your mother??
You take that back right away!!
How many times did I tell you to
stay away from my daughter, huh?!
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我怎麼會是你媽媽？
馬上把那句話收回去！！
我說過多少次了，離我女兒遠點！
現在立刻滾出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother!! If something
has been robbed, I will
definitely find it for you!
You can trust me, mother!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
媽媽！！要是東西被偷了，我一定幫你找回來！
相信我，媽媽！！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are just a nuisance.
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你真是個麻煩精。
馬上給我滾出去！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That guy must be Luen's
boyfriend... Before it
gets messier here, I should
get on with my
survey investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那傢伙肯定是露恩的男朋友...
趁這裡鬧得更亂之前，我還是繼續調查吧。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你是說要勘查現場？
有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: I found out who the robber was.
scripts.translation: 查出小偷是誰了

scripts.text: I haven't figured things out yet.
scripts.translation: 我還沒查清楚

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I... I see...
Finding the robber is important, but...
The necklace is even more important...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我...我知道了...
抓到小偷固然重要，可是...項鍊更重要...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh my.. Really?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
天哪...真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes.
Of course, I also found out
where the robbed necklace was..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。
當然，我也查到了被偷項鍊的下落...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now..
I'll let you know the 
results of my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼...
我來告訴你調查結果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't I gather all of the victims and suspects and go through the thought process with you.
This place is not appropriate so let us go to another location.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如把受害者和嫌疑人都叫來，一起梳理案情。
這裡不方便，我們換個地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's get going.

- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 繼續交談前得先減輕負重。 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I told my parents and
all the others.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我已經把事情告訴父母和其他人了。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That my boyfriend was the one.
I knew about it already.
But, I couldn't tell my parents because if they were to find out the truth,
they would oppose him even more...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
小偷就是我男朋友...我早就知道了。
可我沒法告訴父母，若讓他們知道真相，只會更加反對我們...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But thank you so much for helping us both physically and emotionally.
This is just a small token of my appreciation.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
真的很謝謝你，不只幫了我們的忙，也給了我們安慰。
這是一點小小心意。再次謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you so much for helping us
both physically and emotionally.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
非常感謝你這段時間幫我們解圍，也給了我們安慰。
再次謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh, this kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
呵，這種事啊。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It's the first time this kind of
thing ever happened to us.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我們家還是頭一回遇上這種事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this, I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你已經聽說了。為了查明這起盜竊案，我要向你詢問一些情況，請配合調查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so
please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，請仔細回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你剛才從哪裡回來？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I was coming back from
meeting with a friend.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我剛和朋友見面回來。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I talked to him about my daughter.
I talked to him about my wife.
I talked to him about life.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我們聊了女兒、妻子，還有生活上的事。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Then I came back home
and it was a mess.
My wife and daughter were devastated.
And you were lying unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
回到家時，屋裡一片狼藉。
妻子和女兒都很難過，而你則昏倒在地。

scripts.text: What kind of friend is he?
scripts.translation: 他是個什麼樣的人？

scripts.text: Did you talk about anything else?
scripts.translation: 你們還聊了別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He's not anyone particularly mean or bad.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
他不算什麼壞人，也不刻薄。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Although he's a bit immature
no matter how much he ages...
To put it positively, he lives young, but to put it negatively, he's just an immature kind of a guy.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
他都這麼大歲數了，還是有點不成熟...
往好處說是童心未泯，往壞處說就是不夠穩重。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
he is no trouble at all.
He's that kind of a friend.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
除此之外，他從不給人添麻煩。
他就是這樣的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Actually..
Not too long ago,
the guy asked
me a favor..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
其實...
不久前，那傢伙...
拜託我一件事...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He said he has an urgent need
for some money..
And asked me to help him out..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
他說自己急需一筆錢...
問我能不能幫幫他...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
So since I didn't have money myself
and it's not the best to exchange money
between friends,
I told him that I was sorry
and sent him off after
treating him to a meal.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我自己手頭也不寬裕，而且朋友之間借錢也不太好。
所以我向他道歉，請他吃了頓飯，就送他離開了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
I don't see anything
suspicious about him..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
除此之外，我看不出他有什麼可疑之處...

scripts.text: Has he been suspicious before?
scripts.translation: 他以前做過什麼可疑的事嗎？

scripts.text: Do you suspect him after the incident?
scripts.translation: 事發後你懷疑過他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
To be honest,
I suspect my wife.
She has been complaining about
every little thing recently.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
老實說，我懷疑的是妻子。
她最近總為雞毛蒜皮的小事抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No matter what I say, she either says 'no' or 'I don't like it.'
It's not for any specific reason but she just opposes me for
the sake of opposing me.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
不管我說什麼，她不是反對，就是說不喜歡。
也沒什麼特別理由，簡直是為了反對而反對。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Recently, she's been asking for this and that, and getting mad about this and that.
It's really been tough.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
她最近總是要這要那，還動不動就生氣。
真讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
The item that was stolen is my wife's necklace...
It's a necklace that I got for her.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
被偷的是妻子的項鍊...
那是我送給她的。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
When the house was robbed I was really worried.
But when I found out that it was the necklace...
I recalled what my wife had told me not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
家裡被偷時我非常擔心。
可得知丟的是項鍊後，我想起妻子前些日子說過的話。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
She said that she wants a new necklace.
I told her that I will buy her one for her next birthday...
She was mad still.
I wonder if this kind of thing happened because of that in the end.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
她說想要一條新項鍊。我答應下個生日買給她...
她還是不高興。
這次的事會不會就是因此而起呢？

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你坦誠回答

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Not a problem.
I hope my responses 
will help you.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
不客氣。
希望我的回答能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Only if we can
catch that robber soon,
how wonderful that would be.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
要是能儘快抓到小偷，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are getting through your field examination.
I ask that you would
give your all.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
看來你正在勘查現場。
請盡力調查。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are continuing your investigation.
Are you thinking of 
talking to my friend as well?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
看來你還在調查。
也打算問問我的朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
How is the
investigation going?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
調查得怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 繼續交談前得先減輕負重。 -

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I heard most of the story
from Cruyan.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
克魯揚把事情經過大致告訴我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It was pretty shocking...
but in some ways, I could
see why he did it.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
這確實很令人震驚...
不過某種程度上，我也明白他為什麼那麼做。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thank you for helping us
throughout this time.
You went through a lot for us.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
謝謝你這段時間幫忙。
你為我們費了不少心。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I know that it's up to us
from now to figure
things out...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
接下來得由我們自己把事情處理好...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Here's something for you.
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
這個送給你。再次感謝，祝你今後一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
再次感謝，祝你今後一切順利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this,
I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你已經聽說了。為了查明這起盜竊案，我要向你詢問一些情況，請配合調查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，請仔細回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你剛才從哪裡回來？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't really trust you
but I'll talk to you for
the sake of my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我不太信任你，不過為了找回項鍊，我還是願意回答。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was shopping around
in the store nearby
to see if there's anything
I should get.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我剛才在附近的商店逛，看看有沒有什麼需要買的。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I didn't really have anything 
I liked, so I just came back home.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
沒看到喜歡的東西，就回家了。就這樣。

scripts.text: Why did you just go into the house?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼直接進屋了？

scripts.text: Was there anything suspicious?
scripts.translation: 你有發現什麼可疑之處嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I first saw you
lying down, I was shocked
out of my mind, and actually
thought that if you were alive,
I need to do something about it!
I'm not that bad, you know!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
一開始看到你倒在地上，我嚇壞了，還想過你要是沒死，我就得想辦法救你！
我可不是壞人！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But the world today, is it all that simple?
There are so many kinds of accidents these days!
A feeble housewife like me really can't do much!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
可如今世道哪有那麼簡單？意外多得很！
我一個弱女子，能做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
So I first went into the house,
and planned to pick you up
with the rest of my family!
But when I went into the house,
the house was in chaos
as if it was robbed!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
所以我先回屋，打算叫家人一起把你抬進來！
沒想到屋裡也亂成一團，像是被洗劫過一樣！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
A person lying at the door!
A robbed house!
I was so scared that
I couldn't go out to get you!
Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
門口躺著個人，家裡又被搶了！
我嚇得不敢出去救你！你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I came into the house,
aside from it being so messy,
there wasn't anything else!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
進屋後，除了滿地狼藉，沒發現別的異常！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Of all things, why was my
necklace stolen...?
Why couldn't the robber
just take that useless
dog instead!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
偏偏被偷的是我的項鍊...
那個沒用的狗怎麼沒被偷走呢！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
The more I think about, the more annoying it gets!
......
............
I'm sorry... I was venting
on you for no reason...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
越想越氣！
...
...
抱歉...我不該無緣無故衝你發火...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Anyways, I don't think there was
anything peculiar about it.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
總之，我沒發現什麼特別可疑的地方。

scripts.text: Do you suspect anyone?
scripts.translation: 你懷疑誰？

scripts.text: Is there anything else missing?
scripts.translation: 還有別的東西丟了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Not sure.
Even though my husband is apathetic to me, he's not a bad person.
My no-good daugther doesn't listen to me when I tell her to break up with her boyfriend.
But she's still a nice girl...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
不知道。丈夫雖然對我冷淡，但人不壞。
女兒也不爭氣，叫她和男朋友分手她偏不聽...不過她本性不壞。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And it's not that our house is 
filled with expensive items,
and the necklace is one
precious item that I
truly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我們家也沒什麼貴重物品，那條項鍊是我真正珍惜的東西之一...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That's what got robbed!
It's not my family for sure!
There's no way I'd suspect them!
Not at all!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
被偷的就是那條項鍊！
肯定不是家裡人乾的！
我絕不會懷疑他們！絕對不會！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
We don't have anything in our house that's particularly expensive.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我們家沒有什麼特別貴重的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
In fact, the necklace is also not
all that expensive. But it's just 
that it's an object of multiple
significance...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
其實那條項鍊也不算貴，只是對我有多重意義...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
It's obvious that the necklace 
is not that pricey.
Even if you sell it..
I don't think it would be all that much.
I have no idea why it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
那條項鍊明顯不值多少錢。
就算賣掉，也換不了多少。我也不知道為什麼小偷會拿走它。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你坦誠回答

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I really wish...
that you would find my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我只希望...你能幫我找回項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That necklace. It's what
my husband got me.. So it's
very important to me.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
那條項鍊是丈夫送我的...對我來說非常重要。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 繼續交談前得先減輕負重。 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
......
I heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
...
我都聽說了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I never really liked Cruyan in the first place but I feel more disappointed in my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我本來就不太喜歡克魯揚，不過我更失望的是女兒。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was actually pretty doubtful...
With all that, I sincerely appreciate you for being so helpful.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
其實我一直很懷疑你...
但你幫了我們這麼多，我還是由衷感謝。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But...
It turns out that 
Cruyan or my daughter
don't have the necklace.
For that I'm still pretty upset.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
可是...克魯揚和女兒都沒有項鍊。
想到這點，我還是很生氣。

scripts.text:
- While carefully handing -
- Rosa her necklace -
- I tell her where it was found -
scripts.translation: - 你小心地把項鍊遞給羅莎，並告訴她發現項鍊的地點。 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I see... I didn't know it
was in such a place.
You had already found it but to figure out the truth behind everything.
You kept it all to yourself until now.
I didn't know you put such deep consideration for this...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
原來如此...我不知道它會在那麼遠的地方。
你早就找到了，但為了查明真相，一直把它藏在身邊。
沒想到你考慮得這麼周到...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我真是
無話可說。
非常感謝，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't have much...
If this is alright with you,
this is just my gratitude.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我沒有多少錢...
如果你不介意，這只是我的一點心意。
真的非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Oh my. How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
天哪，怎麼會這樣...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I would have never imagined
that our house would be robbed!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我從來沒想過
我們家會被入室盜竊！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are going to do a field examination?
Great, do what you need to do!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你要進行現場勘查嗎？
太好了，請隨意調查！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You'll be carrying out your
investigation carefully, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你會仔細
進行調查的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Is the investigation going
alright...?
Somehow I can't really... trust...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
調查進展順利嗎...？
我總覺得...不太放心...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我都不知道該說什麼了。
真的非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello.
You must be Luen's boyfriend
who just visited the house, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。你就是剛來家裡拜訪的露恩男朋友吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Oop.
...
Yes. That's right.
And you are...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
啊。
...
沒錯。你是...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the detective who 
is responsible for this case.
I have a few questions to ask and I would appreciate your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是負責調查此案的人。有幾個問題想問你，請配合。

scripts.text: Where were you 10 minutes ago?
scripts.translation: 十分鐘前你在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Your possessions are too 
heavy that I can't confirm
my alibi. Please lighten
your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
你帶的東西太多，我沒法確認不在場證明。請先減輕負重再來。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
At the time, I was in the land of blooming flowers.
I heard that monster infestations are increasing,
so I was just taking care of some as exercise.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
當時我在花海之地。聽說那裡的魔物越來越多，我就去清理了一些，順便鍛鍊。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I did not steal
the necklace!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
項鍊不是我偷的！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And I will find that necklace no matter what and bring it to mother!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
無論如何，我都會找到項鍊，交還給母親！

scripts.text: Did anything particular happen?
scripts.translation: 當時發生過什麼特別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
When I was on my way out of
the land of blooming flowers,
I saw the friend of 
my girlfriend's father
hurrying somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
離開花海之地時，我看到女朋友父親的朋友正匆忙趕路。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And, I just came back to the town to see my girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
之後我回城來見女朋友。

scripts.text: Could you confirm your alibi?
scripts.translation: 你能證明自己當時在場嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Of course.
The loot that I got from hunting monsters there is this Concentration Potion.
See, have I confirmed it now?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
當然。我在那裡打魔物得到的戰利品就是這瓶集中藥水。
這樣能證明了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Since you seem to be working hard, I'll give you this Concentration Potion that I got from hunting~
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
看你這麼認真，我把打怪得到的集中藥水送給你吧~

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
So we are done with these questions, right?
And since I will find that necklace for sure, you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
問題都問完了吧？
反正我一定會找到項鍊，你不用擔心。

scripts.text: - If I go to the land of the blooming flowers and hunt these monsters, I can confirm whether or not this item can really be obtained -
scripts.translation: - 去花海之地擊敗這些魔物，就能確認它們是否會掉落這個物品。 -

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 繼續交談前得先減輕負重。 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
To be honest, I blamed you a lot for this.
If it worked out, it could have been a chance to win mother's trust...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
老實說，我之前因為這件事怪過你。
要是事情辦成了，我本來就有機會贏得母親的信任...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
But...
Once I confessed everything,
I was so ashamed of
myself for thinking of such
things in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
可是...把一切都坦白之後，我才發現自己竟然會想出那種辦法，真是羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Thank you...
I also heard that
you found the
necklace...
I really owe you
in many ways...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
謝謝你...
我聽說項鍊也找到了...
我欠你太多了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
From now on, I won't depend on these dumb ploys.
I will face Luen's mom straight on and do my best.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
今後我不會再耍這種小聰明了。
我會堂堂正正地面對露恩的母親，盡力爭取她的認可。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Please take this as an expression of my gratitude.
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
請收下這個，聊表謝意。謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I will find that necklace
no matter what and
bring it to mother.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
無論如何，我都會找到那條項鍊，交給母親。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
So we are done with these questions, right?
And since I will find that necklace you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
問題問完了吧？
我會找到那條項鍊，你就不用擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Since I will find that necklace you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我會找到那條項鍊，你就不用擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
From now on, I won't depend on these dumb ploys.
I will face Luen's mom straight on and do my best.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
今後我不會再耍這種小聰明了。
我會堂堂正正地面對露恩的母親，盡力爭取她的認可。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 繼續交談前得先減輕負重。 -

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I got to hear the whole story, but I never thought something like that would happen.
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
我聽說了事情經過，真沒想到會發生這種事。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
As a friend, I felt
pretty bad about myself
for being more of a
burden than help.
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
