我確實喜歡喝酒和賭博，可露恩的母親不喜歡這些，所以我一直戒著，想贏得她的信任！

scripts.text: Why would I believe that?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要相信？

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
While that wandering merchant
smells of alcohol, I don't have the
slightest hint of alcohol smell do I!?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
那個流浪商人一身酒氣，可我身上連一點酒味都沒有，不是嗎！？

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And I have never seen that merchant before!
Should I ask him?
Whether I gambled
with him or not?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我以前根本沒見過那個商人！
要不要問問他，我有沒有跟他賭過？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Merchant]
I remember all of my
customers, but
Hmm, I don't think I've
seen Cruyan.
I'm sure of it~ Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
我記得每一位客人...
嗯，我不記得見過克魯揚。
這點我敢肯定~嗝~

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
{0}
He committed such a crime
to earn the approval for
his relationship with Luen!
scripts.translation:
{0}
他犯下這種罪行，是想換取羅莎認可他和露恩交往！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What... What in the 
world do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎女士]
你...你這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh... Let's first
hear him out.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
呵...先聽他說完吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
From the beginning,
Cruyan who likes gambling and alcohol was never liked by Rosa. 
He tried to change himself in a variety of ways, but...

[Cruyan]
Haha... What on earth are you talking about? Huh?
I was hunting in the land of blooming flowers during the time of crime.
The Concentration Potion is the proof.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
哈哈...你們到底在說什麼？嗯？
案發時我明明在繁花之地打獵。
這瓶集中藥水就是證據。

scripts.text: I see... Hmm...
scripts.translation: 我明白了... 嗯...

scripts.text: I'm afraid that's not true.
scripts.translation: 恐怕這不是真的

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Of course!
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
當然！
我清白得很！！
你們還是趕緊去找真正的竊賊吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
What about it is not true?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
哪裡不是真的？

scripts.text: According to Luen's statements...
scripts.translation: 根據露恩的證詞...

scripts.text: According to Balumin's statements...
scripts.translation: 根據巴盧明的證詞...

scripts.text:
{0}
Luen said she definitely
didn't see you before
you came over.
scripts.translation:
{0}
露恩說，在你過來之前，她根本沒見過你。

scripts.text:
{0}
However, if you were really
hunting in the land
of blooming flowers,
would it have been possible
for you to get from there
to the house in such a short time?
scripts.translation:
{0}
可是，如果你當時真的在繁花之地打獵，又怎麼可能這麼快趕到這棟房子？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm a Laphine!!
Maybe you aren't familiar,
but I have wings and
can fly that kind of distance
in no time!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我是拉菲尼族！！
你可能不清楚，我們有翅膀，轉眼就能飛這麼遠！！

scripts.text: Oh, I didn't know you could.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不知道你能飛

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我清白得很！！
你們還是趕緊去找真正的竊賊吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
Balumin said
that even though he hunted 
in the land of blooming flowers
where you presumably were
hunting also, he never caught
a sight of you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
巴盧明說，他也在你聲稱打獵的繁花之地，卻從來沒見過你。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Even... Even if that were true,
I don't have the necklace!!
It's true!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
就...就算你說的是真的，我也沒有項鍊！！
我沒撒謊！！

scripts.text: Look through his possessions.
scripts.translation: 搜查他的隨身物品

scripts.text: Explain it without looking.
scripts.translation: 不搜查，直接解釋

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Ok, look through it all you want.
I really don't have the necklace!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
好啊，儘管搜吧。
我真的沒有項鍊！！

scripts.text: - You search through Cruyan's possessions -
scripts.translation: - 你搜查了克魯揚的隨身物品 -

scripts.text: - You find nothing -
scripts.translation: - 一無所獲 -

scripts.text:
{0}
That's because when you
were about to steal the
necklace, you were caught
by Luen.
scripts.translation:
{0}
因為你正要偷項鍊時，被露恩撞見了。

scripts.text:
{0}
Although Luen 
was shocked to see her
boyfriend trying to rob and 
going through the house,
she got to hear his side of
the story.
scripts.translation:
{0}
露恩看到男友入室偷竊，自然大受打擊，但她還是聽了你的解釋。

scripts.text:
{0}
She must have sympathized
with how you felt, but probably
disagreed with you. She must 
have physically resisted you 
trying to steal the necklace, and
in the process, the necklace was lost...

{0}
And that's when I was coming in
from outside. And since you
didn't want to be caught,
you knocked me out...

{0}
You were both afraid of
what might have happened to me..
The necklace was lost in the process..
And since your parents were about
to return home, you hurriedly
left the house.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你們都擔心我會出事...
項鍊也在混亂中丟了...
眼看露恩的父母就要回家，你們便匆匆離開了房子。

scripts.text:
{0}
You tried to do something
with me, but Rosa was
already on her way back at
the time, so you couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你本想對我做些什麼，但羅莎當時已經在回家的路上，所以你沒能下手。

scripts.text:
{0}
And Cruyan, as soon as you
got to the house, you said
that the necklace was stolen.
How did you know that when
nobody had told you
about it?

scripts.translation:
{0}
傢俱被翻得亂七八糟，波比卻沒有對竊賊吠叫；
露恩和克魯揚又因驚慌編出了漏洞百出的說辭。
順著這些線索查下去...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Stop... Please stop...
I don't want to be even more miserable
than I already am...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
夠了...求你別說了...
我已經夠難受了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Yes... I am the thief...
I won't try to 
justify that.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
是的...我就是竊賊...
我不想為自己辯解。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
As for Luen... my girlfriend
did nothing wrong..
It's all my fault..
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
露恩...我的女朋友沒有做錯任何事...
全都是我的錯...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
The rest of this,
I'll confess and explain everything..
And I'll make my apologies...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
接下來我會坦白一切，把事情解釋清楚...
我也會向大家道歉...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I ask you...
Please don't involve yourself any further...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
求求你...
別再插手這件事了...

scripts.text:
{0}
I... I guess
I must have gotten something wrong.
I'll think about it more and figure out who the robber is...

[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for lightening 
our burdens...
Cruyan and I will resolve
the rest of this issue.
Would you please go outside now?
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
謝謝你替我們減輕了負擔...
剩下的事，我和克魯揚會處理。
請你先到外面去，好嗎？

scripts.text: Leave the house.
scripts.translation: 離開房子

scripts.text: Leave after a bit.
scripts.translation: 稍後離開

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for everything...
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
謝謝你幫了我們這麼多...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Please let us know
when you're leaving.
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
你準備離開時告訴我們一聲。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
- It's floating in mid-air
but it feels like I could
enter it -
scripts.translation:
- 它浮在半空中，
但感覺可以走進去 -

scripts.text: Don't enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 不進入住宅

scripts.text: Enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 進入住宅

scripts.text: - Let's check it out later -
scripts.translation: - 過會兒再來看看 -

scripts.text: Don't exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 不離開住宅

scripts.text: Exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 離開住宅

scripts.text: - Let's leave a bit later -
scripts.translation: - 過會兒再離開 -

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
What are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎喲，肚子好痛！！
你看什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
Aren't Green Herbs so common?
I can't believe they're not in stock!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎喲，肚子好痛！！
綠色藥草不是很常見嗎？
居然還會缺貨！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm...I'm sure I took the right medicine...
but why isn't it getting better?
Maybe it's not just a stomachache?
Could it be that I have...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...我明明吃了對症的藥...
怎麼還是不見好？
難道不只是胃痛？
該不會是...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞真是想到一齣是一齣。
她明明知道我喜歡看書...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Did I read any books recently?
Umm...yea, I read a lot usually.
I don't have anything else to do at the clinic.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近看過什麼書嗎？
嗯...平時我確實看了不少。
在診所裡也沒別的事可做。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Is Cecilia investing something?
Right? Isn't she? Am I right? Right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞是不是在打什麼主意？
對吧？是不是？我猜得沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Well, then...
Should I start punishing Dominic for giving a stomachache to this beautiful lady!!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然如此...
我要懲罰多米尼克，竟敢害這位美麗女士胃痛！！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you done yet?
I'm tired of waiting~
Let's hurry it up a little more.
Pranks are not fun if you think about it too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你還沒弄好嗎？
我都等累了~
再快一點嘛。
惡作劇想太多可就不好玩了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I'm all ready here.
Now, I mix what you brought like this, and...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我這邊準備好了。
現在把你帶來的東西這樣混在一起，然後...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm? It's weird.
There's something weird about you.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯？真奇怪。
你身上好像有些不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Have we...have we succeeded at last?!
Now, go plant this secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我們...我們終於成功了嗎？！
現在把這個偷偷種在多米尼克的書架附近。
他要是發現書架旁長出不知名的雜草，肯定會氣壞的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Kekeke, I could hear Dominic screaming from here.
Is he really upset now?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿嘿，我在這兒都聽見多米尼克尖叫了。
他現在真的氣壞了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Poor little Dominic he won't dare mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
可憐的多米尼克，這下再也不敢惹我了。

scripts.text: [Eirinn]
scripts.translation: [艾琳]

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近也沒吃什麼奇怪的東西，怎麼老是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近也沒吃什麼奇怪的東西，怎麼老是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you still there?
Good, you came at just the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你還在嗎？
很好，你來得正是時候。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I was going to get a perscription for my stomachache but, they don't have herbs for it in the warehouse anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我本來想開點治胃痛的藥，可倉庫裡的藥草已經用完了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Just like an old saying,
'Even green herbs are difficult to find when you need them.'
Could you go out and find herbs and things like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
俗話說得好：
“需要的時候，連綠色藥草都找不到。”
你能出去幫我找些藥草之類的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Fine, then don't bother me
and go away.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好吧，那就別來煩我了。
走開。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I need
^ff000010 Green Herbs^000000
I hope you hurry before Eclage is filled with the sounds of my groaning.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要
^ff000010 份綠色藥草^000000
趁埃克拉珠到處都響起我的呻吟聲之前，快去快回。

scripts.text: Give Herbs
scripts.translation: 給予藥草

scripts.text: Go somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 去別的地方

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Didn't your kindergarten teacher tell you?
'Lying is bad!'
I wonder if she said something about helping those in need, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
幼兒園老師沒教過你嗎？
“說謊是不對的！”
她應該也教過你要幫助有困難的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, thank you so much!
I'll prepare my medicine then.
I hope it helps...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，太感謝你了！
我這就去配藥。
希望它能管用...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
By the way, I was looking through the warehouse and I found some herbs. They're not for stomachaches so, I'll give you some to repay your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
對了，我在倉庫裡翻到了一些藥草。雖然治不了胃痛，就送給你，感謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
You can usually find them around here but it's really effective, so a lot of the adventurers like them.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
這附近通常就能找到這種藥草，而且效果很好，很多冒險者都喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Something serious? Like, something untreatable??
Am I going to be like the leading actress who plays a tragic role in a soap opera?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很嚴重嗎？比如說...治不好？
難道我要像肥皂劇裡演悲情戲的女主角一樣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
If you remember any other stories, tell me again.
and if you remember, ask Cecilia why she asked such a question.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你要是還記得別的故事，記得再告訴我。
還有，記得問問塞西莉亞為什麼打聽這件事。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, before I had this stomach ache,
I borrowed a book.
It was about where you came from and it was really interesting. But why?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，胃痛之前我借過一本書。
書裡寫的是你來自哪裡，特別有意思。
不過，她為什麼要問這個？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
Anyway, tell her I said so.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞真是想到一齣是一齣。
她明明知道我喜歡看書...
總之，替我把話帶給她。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Wing for wing, feeler for feeler, and trick for trick!
This is our law.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
以翅還翅，以觸角還觸角，以惡作劇還惡作劇！
這就是我們的規矩。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Since Dominic takes good care of the bookshelves, should I make a mess around that area to annoy him?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
多米尼克那麼愛護書架，我是不是該在附近弄亂一點，好氣氣他？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Okay, I've decided.
Let me ask you another favor, please?
Could you bring me a plant stem and Green Herb, one each?
I'm going to do some magic here.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好，我決定了。
能再幫我一個忙嗎？
請各帶一份植物莖和綠色藥草來。
我要在這裡施個小魔法。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Umm...I guess I can't help it if you don't want to.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...你不願意的話，我也不能勉強。
看來只能找別人了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
It's very simple, so it shouldn't take that long, right?
I'll be preparing here, so hurry and make a quick trip!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
事情很簡單，不會花太久，對吧？
我會在這裡準備，你快去快回！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
What I need is a stem of the plant and Green Herb, one each.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要各一份植物莖和綠色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ta-da~
A simple summoning tool: sprout is finished!
It's available for everyone~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
鏘鏘~
簡易召喚道具“嫩芽”完成了！
人人都能使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Scripts written by Eirinn!
Featuring{0}!
The villain's role played by Dominic
We're all here and the props are ready!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
劇本：艾琳！
主演：{0}！
多米尼克出演反派！
人都到齊了，道具也準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now if we plant this secretly around the bookshelves that Dominic is taking care of, our mission is completed!
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
現在只要把它偷偷種在多米尼克照看的書架附近，任務就完成了！
他要是發現書架旁長出不知名的雜草，肯定會氣壞的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快點，磨蹭太久就不好玩了。
走，我們去幹這件事！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now, take this again and don't forget to plant it secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
拿好這個，別忘了偷偷種在多米尼克的書架附近。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快點，磨蹭太久就不好玩了。
走，我們去幹這件事！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Too bad I couldn't see for myself how he was creating a scene there.
I should try it again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真可惜，沒能親眼看到他在那裡大吵大鬧。
以後得再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange. I've been losing my stuff recently like things I put in my pocket or even the things I put away properly.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪。最近我老丟東西，連放進口袋或收好的東西也會不見。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Uh oh, you... didn't you promise
to give a good spanking to the little guys outside?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哎呀，你...你不是答應要好好教訓外面那些小傢伙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Give the 20 fairies outside what they deserve and come back, please~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它們就在門外，我就不用特地告訴你位置了吧？
去把外面那20只妖精教訓一頓，再回來，拜託啦~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm? You're done already?
Puhahahah!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯？這麼快就辦完了？
噗哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange...
I can't find my pen anywhere.
I've been using it pretty often...
Who would have done this to me...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪...
我的筆不見了，怎麼找都找不到。
我最近明明常用它...
是誰幹的呢...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
All of a sudden, people from Midgard started to visit Eclage more and more.
So, we're getting information about Midgard as well and I'm interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
最近來自米德加爾特的人突然越來越常來埃克拉珠。
所以我們也在打聽米德加爾特的訊息，我也很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Books? Well, I like books a lot.
There are many books on Midgard that just came out recently so I read them myself.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
書？我很喜歡書。
米德加爾特最近出了不少新書，我自己也讀了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm...I smell it...
I smell something fun going on here...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯...我聞到了...
這裡好像有什麼好玩的事...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
A real gentleman should give what he has received!
I will not tolerate this.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真正的紳士，有恩必報！
我可咽不下這口氣。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Wooo, I'm on fire!!
My whole body is filled with the spirit of pranks!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哇，我渾身都來勁了！！
身體裡惡作劇的熱情正熊熊燃燒！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good!
I'm ready as well.
Let's see...it's been a while since the last time I used a material conversion spell.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
好！
我也準備好了。
讓我想想...我已經很久沒用物質轉換魔法了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
No, something's weird here.
I feel like there's something wrong.
Ah, whatever! Take this anyway.
I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
不對，這裡好像有點古怪。
總覺得哪裡不太對。
啊，算了！先拿著這個吧。
我不想再想了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw what you received in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把你拿到的東西扔到多米尼克面前。
它會變成老鼠，在他身邊跑來跑去。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Ahah~by the way,
What could Dominic have done about the rat?
It wouldn't come back at me like a boomerang, would it?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
啊哈~對了，多米尼克會拿那隻老鼠怎麼辦？
它不會像迴旋鏢一樣又飛回我這兒吧？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
希望他能明白，論惡作劇我技高一籌，以後就不敢再來捉弄我了。

scripts.text: [Bourbon]
scripts.translation: [波本]

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, I'm sure the little pranksters outside are doing this to me.
They must have taken my stuff while I wasn't here.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沒錯，肯定是外面那群小搗蛋鬼在搞鬼。
他們一定趁我不在時拿走了我的東西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I would like to teach them a lesson but I have a work to do and I can't go anywhere.
And if I leave for personal reasons like this I'll get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我也想教訓他們，可我還有工作要做，不能離開。
要是為了這種私事擅離職守，我會捱罵的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
So, you're here just in time!
Could you teach the little gangsters outside, a lesson on my behalf?
How does that sound, will you?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你來得正好！
能替我教訓一下外面那群小混混嗎？
怎麼樣，肯幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm, I guess I can't force you.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯，我也不能強迫你。
看來只好找別人了...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good, you promised.
Go outside and give 20 fairies what they deserve.
Then I'll feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好，你答應了。
去外面教訓那20只妖精一頓。
這樣我就舒坦多了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它們就在門外，我就不用特地告訴你位置了吧？
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I think something went wrong here.
Could you talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
好像出了點問題。
能再和我談談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good luck, then.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
那麼，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You need to brush off your clothes.
You have feathers all over.
Would it have been that hard...?
Hmm, it seems like you've suffered badly. Let me give you a reward.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你得把衣服上的羽毛撣掉。
你身上沾得到處都是。
拍掉有那麼難嗎...？
嗯，看來你吃了不少苦頭。讓我給你點報酬吧。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Anyway, thanks.
But I feel like somebody took my pen while you were gone...who could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
總之，多謝了。
不過你離開的時候，好像有人拿走了我的筆...會是誰呢...？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
I wonder if there's any new book that came out...
I should go check.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
這裡好像不算理想的居住地，不過聽起來挺有意思。
不知道最近有沒有新書出版...
我得去看看。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I was interested seeing how there's a sudden influx of visitors from your village into Eclage.
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
最近突然有許多來自你們村子的人湧入埃克拉珠，這讓我很感興趣。
這裡好像不算理想的居住地，不過聽起來挺有意思。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Let's see what Dominic hates the most...
Ahah~I'm all fired up.
My name is Bourbon a real prankster from birth.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
讓我想想多米尼克最討厭什麼...
啊哈~我已經迫不及待了。
我叫波本，天生就是個惡作劇高手。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure he said he hates something small, swift, and with a long tail.
The more I think about doesn't it sound like a...rat?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我記得他說過，討厭小小的、動作快、尾巴又長的東西。
這麼一想...那不就是老鼠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, it's a rat. Nothing's going to stop me now.
I shall release some rats then!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沒錯，就是老鼠。誰也攔不住我了。
我要放幾隻老鼠出來！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...but come to think of it there are no rats here, right?
Let me ask you another favor.
This is a matter of my pride. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...不過仔細一想，這裡沒有老鼠吧？
我還想再拜託你一件事。
這關係到我的面子，你肯幫我嗎？

scripts.text: I'd rather not...
scripts.translation: 我不想...

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
What? How could you!
Can't you hear my heart beating like a drum?
It's not reasonable if you pretend not to see and turn your back on me.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
什麼？你怎麼能這樣！
你聽不見我的心跳得像打鼓一樣嗎？
你裝作沒看見就轉身走人，也太不夠意思了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Now that's the spirit!
You're just like me a cheeky little monkey!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
這才像話！
你跟我一樣，都是調皮的小猴子！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'll fill you in on the details once we're done preparing and what we need right now is 2 rat tails
Obviously we don't have rats here so it might take you sometime to find one.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
等我們準備好了，我再告訴你詳情。
眼下先幫我找兩根鼠尾。
這裡當然沒有老鼠，你可能得花點時間找找。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Thanks, my friend.
Hahahahaha!
We're already in the same camp.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
謝啦，朋友。
哈哈哈哈！
咱們現在可是同一陣營了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...umm?
You couldn't find any rat tails yet?
I know it's pretty hard but I'm counting on you, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...嗯？
你還沒找到鼠尾嗎？
我知道這不容易，就拜託你了，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You see, this is just a small tail right now but it'll be a great...
well, it's just a rat and not a 'great' rat after all but still, with a mysterious power
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你看，它現在只是一截小尾巴，不過很快就會變成了不起的...
嗯，說到底它只是只老鼠，算不上什麼了不起的老鼠，不過還是有股神秘力量的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Shazam! The spell is now done.
Throw what you received next to Dominic!
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
This completes our 'mission'!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沙贊！咒語完成了。
把你拿到的東西扔到多米尼克旁邊！
它會變成老鼠，在他身邊跑來跑去。
這樣我們的“任務”就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe...
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我興奮得不得了。
你還愣著幹什麼？快去！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw this in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把這個扔到多米尼克面前。
它會變成老鼠，在他身邊跑來跑去。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe....
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我興奮得不得了。
你還愣著幹什麼？快去！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure Dominic couldn't have movednot even a finger.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我敢肯定，多米尼克連一根手指都動不了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
希望他能明白，論惡作劇我技高一籌，以後就不敢再捉弄我了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm... what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯...嗯...我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text: - She seems too busy to talk to you. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起來忙得沒空理你。 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
What should I do?
No matter how many times I check some items are missing...
Is it because of the wanderers randomly showing up in town nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
怎麼辦才好？
不管我檢查多少遍，總有些東西不見了...
是因為最近鎮上常有外來者出沒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hey~ hey~ listen!
Hey you, what are you doing over there?
You heard everything I said just now didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
喂~喂~聽我說！
你在那邊幹什麼呢？
剛才我說的話，你都聽見了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It can't be that we have thieves in Eclage.
The more I think about it seems like an outsider is responsible for this.
Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
埃克拉珠怎麼可能會有竊賊呢？
越想越覺得是外來者乾的。
你說是不是？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
For that reason you, who knows that our supplies are missing and who happens to be an outsider as well.
Must be a thief!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你知道我們的物資失竊，又剛好是個外來者。
所以竊賊肯定就是你！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You have the right to have an attorney present and... no, never mind.
Let's hear what you have to say after putting you in prison first.
Here, you're accused of stealing how do you feel now?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你有權要求律師到場...不，算了。
先把你關起來，再聽你怎麼說。
喂，被指控偷竊是什麼感覺？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You see, we suffer an unforeseen misfortune in life sometimes.
We're all like that.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你看，人生難免會遭遇意外。
誰都一樣。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亞]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, you want to exercise your right and just remain silent?
Let's see how long you can hold your tongue!
I have an idea. Do you want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，你要行使沉默權？
我倒要看看你能沉默多久！
我有個主意，想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你到底在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Here's your last chance!
It's something that could save both of us.
You want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
這是你最後的機會！
這辦法能救我們兩個。
想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 我不想聽！

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 好吧

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, well!
Then I'll have to hand you over to prove my innocence.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
好吧！
那我只好把你交出去，證明自己的清白了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What kind of a fairy is this, so immoral?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（這是什麼妖精啊，怎麼這麼沒道德？！）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, should I start to plant evidence on you?
You just need three fairies to make up anything even if it's the Yggdrasil Tree.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
現在，我該開始在你身上栽贓了嗎？
只要三個妖精，哪怕是世界樹也能編出來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Maybe I should just run away.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（要不我還是逃跑吧。）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
There's a simple and ordinary solution for this.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
這事有個簡單直接的解決辦法。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
That is you finding what's missing and refilling the shelves.
I can't go anywhere because I have to look after the warehouse.
It's better to take some trouble than being accused of stealing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你去把丟失的東西找回來，補滿貨架就行。
我得留在倉庫看守，哪兒也去不了。
總比被當成竊賊強，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let me tell you what you need to find.
First of all, ^66000010 Piles of Acorns^000000, ^66000010 Worn Out Pages^000000, and lastly, ^66000010 Mould Powders^000000.
It's strange how 10 of each item are missing exactly...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我告訴你要找什麼。
先找^66000010堆橡果^000000、^66000010頁破舊書頁^000000，最後是^66000010份黴菌粉末^000000。
奇怪的是，每種東西都恰好少了10個...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in the same boatnow.
Technically, we call it 'accomplices'.
Now, good luck!
You'll be able to find them easily around here.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
現在咱們是一條船上的人了。
說得準確些，就是“共犯”。
那就祝你好運！
在這附近應該不難找到。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You didn't get caught, right?
Let's see what you have then...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你沒被抓到吧？
讓我看看你帶回了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's still not enough...
You didn't forget what I asked for, did you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
還不夠...
我交代你找的東西，你沒忘吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You're more skilled than I thought.
Everything is as written in the books now.
So, we're both safe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你比我想的能幹。
現在貨架上的東西都和賬本對上了。
這樣我們就都沒事了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You need to find Piles of Acorns, Worn Out Pages, and Mould Powders, 10 of each.
Don't forget this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
橡果堆、破舊書頁和黴菌粉末，各找10份。
這次可別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
When you come back again you'd better be bringing everything we need.
If they find out that some items are missing, then...
No, I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
下次回來時，最好把要找的東西全帶齊。
要是他們發現東西少了...
不，我不敢想下去。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in this together so I don't have to thank you, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
咱們是一夥的，我就不用謝你了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll go check if there's anything else missing as well.
It's so strange how these missing items were all very trivial.
Besides, exactly 10 of each item were stolen.
I feel like this is more than just a theft.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我也去檢查一下還有沒有別的東西不見了。
奇怪的是，丟的都是些不起眼的小東西，而且每種還恰好少了10個。
我覺得這不像單純的盜竊。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
How strange...
I'm sure I organized everything but why is it so messy here.
Could it be that someone really hates me...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
真奇怪...
我明明都整理好了，這裡怎麼又亂成這樣？
難道有人真的這麼討厭我嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, by the way,
I heard you met Eirinn and Bourbon.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，對了，我聽說你遇到了艾琳和波本。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I heard Eirinn has a stomachache and I also heard that you helped Bourbon find lost items.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我聽說艾琳胃痛，還聽說你幫波本找到了丟失的物品。

scripts.text: - Cecilia seems to be lost in deep thought -
scripts.translation: - 塞西莉亞似乎陷入了沉思 -

[塞西莉亞]
...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
If things that have never happened before happened, then there's something new going on.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
發生了從前沒發生過的事，就說明最近出了新狀況。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, shall we go find out what it is?
This time, it's not a theft, of course.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我們去查清楚是什麼情況吧？
當然，這次不是調查失竊。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你能去問問艾琳和波本最近讀書的事嗎？
問問他們最近有沒有借書或看書。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你能去問問艾琳和波本最近讀書的事嗎？
問問他們最近有沒有借書或看書。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met both of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經見過他們兩個了。

scripts.text: ^000088You tellCecilia what Eirinn and Bourbon said.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000088你把艾琳和波本說的話告訴了塞西莉亞。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mmm, I see.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So, they have recently borrowed and read books, too?
Good, this solves the mystery!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
所以他們最近也借過書、讀過書？
好，謎團解開了！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I borrowed some books as well to learn about people from Midgard since there are so many visitors coming from that area lately.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
最近有很多米德加爾特的訪客來這裡，所以我也借了幾本書，想了解一下他們。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我、艾琳和波本有個共同點：
我們最近都讀過書。
可我不明白，為什麼這會給我們三人都帶來厄運。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我覺得多米尼克可能知道些什麼。
他也許知道...或者...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我、艾琳和波本有個共同點：
我們最近都讀過書。
可我不明白，為什麼這會給我們三人都帶來厄運。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, did you visit Dominic by any chance?
Dominic takes care of the bookshelves and I feel like he might know something.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
對了，你有沒有去找過多米尼克？
他負責管理書架，我覺得他可能知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, and as the manager of the warehouse let me give you something in return.
You found lost items and helped here and there...so, think of it as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
作為倉庫管理員，我也該給你點回報。
你幫忙找回了失物，還到處幫了不少忙...
就把這個當作謝禮吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You'll be able to read as many books as you want from the bookshelves in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
廣場書架上的書，你想看哪本都可以。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亞]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我覺得多米尼克可能知道些什麼。
他也許知道...或者...

scripts.text: Tell Cecilia about Dominic.
scripts.translation: 告訴塞西莉亞多米尼克的事

[塞西莉亞]
...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So I was right.
It was somebody's prank.
Dominic has always been like that so petty and strange.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
看來我猜對了。
原來是有人在惡作劇。
多米尼克一直都這麼小心眼，又古怪。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I hope you don't misunderstand us.
Most of the residents in Eclage;
No, an absolute majority of the residents here are never against outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
希望你別誤會我們。
埃克拉珠的大多數居民——
不，絕大部分居民都不排斥外來者。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's just Dominic who's acting very weirdly so I hope you don't have a prejudice against us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
只有多米尼克的舉止特別古怪，希望你別因此對我們抱有成見。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Anyway, now that I found out about it,
I shouldn't just sit silently!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
總之，既然我已經查清楚了，就不能繼續坐視不理！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let's start planning for revenge, shall we?
I'll give Eirinn and Bourbon notice in advance.
You should go talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我們來計劃一下怎麼報復他吧？
我會先通知艾琳和波本。
你也去跟他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll get permission from above so that you can read any books from the bookshelves that Dominic is in charge of.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我會向上面申請許可，讓你可以閱讀多米尼克負責的書架上的書。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's about where you came from and I'm sure you'll like it.
If your perspective on something changes, the way you evaluate that object changes as well.
Explore Midgard from our perspective~!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
書裡寫的是你來自的地方，我相信你會喜歡。
看待事物的角度變了，評價也會隨之改變。
從我們的視角探索米德加爾特吧~！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hope you have a good time in Eclage.
I have to take inventory now,
so I can't talk to you anymore, sorry~
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
祝你在埃克拉珠玩得愉快。
我得去盤點庫存了，抱歉，不能再陪你聊天了~

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what do you want?
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but I hope you don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...你有什麼事？
我不攔著你在埃克拉珠四處走動，只要別來煩我就行。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but, don't bother me you outsider!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不攔著你在埃克拉珠四處走動，但別來煩我，你這個外來者！

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，愛告訴誰就告訴誰！
我才不怕呢。
他們最好知道我有多厲害。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I feel...something's not right.
I feel like something bad is going to happen any minute...
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我覺得...好像有點不對勁。
總覺得馬上就要出什麼事了...

scripts.text: Cecilia says...
scripts.translation: 塞西莉亞說...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cecilia told me that someone's fooling around with people who borrowed books recently.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塞西莉亞告訴我，有人最近一直在捉弄借過書的人。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Huh? Kekeke.
In principle, people living here in the capital of Eclage are not supposed to discriminate against outsiders, but not everyone is like that.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哈？呵呵。
原則上，住在埃克拉珠首都的人不該歧視外來者，但也不是人人都這麼想。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I hate it so much when people in Eclage are talking about Midgard.
Why are they so fascinated about foreign areas when this place is perfect and peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我最討厭埃克拉珠的人談論米德加爾特。
這裡明明完美又和平，他們為什麼對外面的地方那麼著迷？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I don't like fairies here writing about Midgard nowadays and I hate how those books are distributed far and wide.
So, I decided to play a little trick on them.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不喜歡這裡的妖精最近寫米德加爾特，更討厭這些書到處流傳。
所以我決定給他們一點教訓。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，愛告訴誰就告訴誰！
我才不怕呢。
他們最好知道我有多厲害。

scripts.text: - Do you want to throw the rat tail? -
scripts.translation: - 要把鼠尾扔出去嗎？ -

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: - The rat tail became a rat even before hitting the ground. -
scripts.translation: - 鼠尾還沒落地，就變成了一隻老鼠。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
What, where did it come from out of the blue!
I'm sure people from Midgard brought it here!
You little filthy thing, ah!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
什麼？這東西怎麼突然冒出來了！
肯定是米德加爾特的人帶來的！
你這髒東西，啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(His reaction is not that fun.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反應沒那麼有趣。）

scripts.text: - You were told to plant weeds. -
scripts.translation: - 你被要求種些雜草。 -

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 不種

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 種吧

scripts.text: - Plant weeds secretly . -
scripts.translation: - 悄悄種下雜草。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, what are you doing over there?
You'd better not be doing anything weird.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，你在那邊做什麼？
最好別搞什麼鬼。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what the...
Why are weeds growing here?
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...這是什麼...
這裡怎麼長出雜草了？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Well, I don't care.
I guess there's no such thing as 'weeds.' Every plant is special in its own way.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
算了，我不在乎。
說不定根本沒有“雜草”這種東西，每種植物都有自己的特別之處。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's up with his reaction?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他這反應是怎麼回事？）

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看見一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是一本關於米德加爾特的書。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, outsider who said you can touch my books?
Stay away from my bookshelves!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
喂，外來者，誰準你碰我的書了？
離我的書架遠點！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看見一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是一本關於盧恩·米德加茲城市的書。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還是別看了。

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的首都普隆德拉，到處都是精心設計的美麗建築。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 這裡的統治者被稱為“國王”，過去還會替人安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 這裡有許多競技場，戰士們會在那裡賽跑、摔跤，一較高下。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 據說勝者能得到某種獎勵，不過這些比賽如今似乎已經不流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 要小心，普隆德拉有些人擁有超凡的力量。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他們只用幾拳就能砸壞任何武器或盔甲，手裡拿的卻只是一把小錘子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation:
我不明白冒險者為什麼總把工具放在他們腳邊。
難道他們是祭司，人們在向他們獻祭嗎？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 森林裡有個叫斐揚的村莊，那裡還有一處“宮殿”，用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也許那是普隆德拉成為盧恩·米德加茲首都之前留下的...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人類也會在居住區邊界附近建立邊境城鎮，阿爾德巴蘭就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation:
村子中央有座鐘樓，裡面住著鐘形魔物。
為什麼村子中央會出現魔物，還得繼續調查。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation:
雖然叫鐘樓，裡面的魔物卻比鍾還多。
我自己數過，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是偉大魔法師建造的城市，最顯眼的就是城中央的魔法師之塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔細想想，普隆德拉中央有噴泉，阿爾德巴蘭有鐘樓，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
人類的城市規劃或許講究對稱或環形佈局。
我覺得這可不怎麼高明。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation:
依斯魯得是座港口城市，也是通往普隆德拉的門戶。
人類不會飛，所以只能坐大箱子旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation:
我敢說，他們覺得大箱子對文明貢獻很大...
真有那麼神奇嗎？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的人要去別的國家時，常會經過艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation:
那裡有許多船——也就是能浮在水上的移動箱子——
人們會搭船出行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation:
說真的，人類的本事真讓人失望...
聰明的話，直接用空間傳送術不就好了。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克村據說是惡魔之王夢羅克的棲身之處。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation:
在荒涼的不毛沙漠裡開鑿水道和湖泊...
人類還真做了件了不起的事。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation:
我覺得那裡很寧靜...
至少在魔物出現在首領長眠的建築裡之前是這樣。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲東臨大海，南接沙漠，中部遍佈森林與植被，北部則是群山。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果讓孩子畫出一個世界，他們不也會畫成這樣嗎？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 不過，那地方既不理想，也不適合居住。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看見一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是一本關於盧恩·米德加茲城市的書。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還是別看了。

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人類常常會為了未知的未來冒險，並從中獲得極大的樂趣。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation:
克魔島的人為了所謂的“運氣”賭上自己的未來。
不過，這似乎跟治理王國沒什麼關係。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: “女子與腳排球”和“遊戲排名委員會”這類來歷不明的團體，把城裡的比賽都取消了。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation:
克魔島曾是座充滿歡樂的海濱城市，過去能在那裡找到各種娛樂。
不過現在是否依然如此，我就不清楚了。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 村裡有位受人敬仰的女祭司，她的存在似乎自有其道理。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation:
人們獻上鑽石作為貢品，她則回贈神明的禮物。
不過，想得到禮物似乎還得有相當好的運氣...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 這本書開篇，我想先向勇於挑戰的人類致敬。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 汶巴拉是一座由巨樹構成的村莊，那裡的人會因為各種理由挑戰從高樹上跳下。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation:
仔細想想，這還真奇怪。
我以為從樹上跳下來是人類男性的成年禮，沒想到還有別的理由。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔島是這片大陸南部唯一的村莊。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那麼，帕樂斯燈塔又是做什麼用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 目前那一帶只有一名水手駐守，也沒有證據表明那裡有政治或社會團體活動，因此調查只好暫時擱置。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以抵達一座名為巴伊亞的島嶼，島上有個地下洞窟。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 島上竟有如此深邃漫長的洞窟，真是地理學上的謎團！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation:
而且，誰能解釋人類為何能在水下呼吸？
那裡明明全是水，他們又沒有鰓。

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是座大城市，穩定供應各類資源至關重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水，人類很脆弱，沒有水連30天都活不了。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 所以他們建造了一座巨大的建築，看起來像是供水和排汙設施...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation:
可為什麼我在城裡找不到入口？
是建築結構的問題，還是出於安全考慮？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆——一座宏偉古堡的廢墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation:
這裡發生過什麼、背後又有什麼故事，很快就會揭曉。
我們還是關注事態的發展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆的上層和下層分佈著十多個區域，許多魔物在其中棲息。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation:
這個地區的詳細地理資料少得可憐...
真想揪住哪個城市規劃師的衣領問個明白。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 人類文明已經發展到足以建立國家，卻沒有積累知識，只是不斷把注意力從一處轉向另一處，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 他們似乎連不同種類的樹木和草都分辨不出來。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation:
要不然，他們怎麼會把這片規劃整齊的森林叫作“神秘森林”？
僅僅因為找不到路，就起這麼奇怪的名字，真讓人想不通。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation:
他們或許曾認為語言是人類獨有的。
不過遇見我們這些妖精後，我相信他們改變想法了。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 可他們看到有些貓比普通貓大得多，還能組成社會、與人類交流，居然一點也不驚訝。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation:
有件事我還不清楚。
要把真相揭露出來嗎？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突發訊息：關於一處秘密地點的見聞

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 離普隆德拉不遠的一座修道院裡，剝削和騷擾的事一直在發生。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他們誘騙那些想走在神之道上的人，叫他們採蘑菇或長跑...這怎麼能被允許！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看見一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是一本關於米德加爾特北部的書。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還是別看了。

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人類先讓大箱子漂在江河和海上，後來甚至開始征服天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他們下一步要去哪裡？地下？還是要穿越時空？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照這樣下去，人類說不定還想回到過去。人類科技的發展可得好好留意。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布羅克到處都是機器。這裡似乎不怎麼生產工業品，不過機器肯定就是他們的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那麼多工廠到底在生產什麼？人們又是為了什麼而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他們難道不知道，文明進步未必能提升生活的價值嗎？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 從艾音布羅克搭火車，就能到達一個叫艾音貝赫的村莊。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 我當然討厭這種交通工具（鐵鏽味實在太重），不過它價格便宜、載貨量大，對人類來說倒是很實用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 說起來，他們的材料還不夠鋪鐵軌嗎？什麼時候才會延長火車路線呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毀葛是座小鄉村，就像南方的克魔島。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那裡有各種小遊戲，風景也很田園。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 不過，這些娛樂設施不是應該建在國家中心地帶嗎？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 竟然有座叫朱諾的城市漂浮在空中！太不可思議了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 逃出迷宮的人還能獲得特別獎勵：那裡有個能讓人轉生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人類真可怕。不過，我好像在哪裡見過這個迷宮...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 阿魯納佩斯首都拉赫的居民中，有一種小巧可愛、通體雪白，看起來軟綿綿的生物。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到小雪獸，那就錯了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是一位女孩，她既是祭司，也是領袖。畢竟阿魯納佩斯是個神權國家。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 奧丁神殿原野上生活著許多魔物花和食草動物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 看到它們攻擊人類，你或許會覺得它們不像食草動物，不過——

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它們真是肉食動物，又靠什麼為生呢？而且，它們攻擊路過的冒險者後，也沒有把人吃掉的記錄。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯這座建在山丘上的村莊，看起來規劃得井井有條。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 雖然讓人摸不著頭腦，不知道該從哪裡進出，不過——

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看看石頭吞掉你掉落的硬幣之類的奇景，這裡倒值得一遊。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 阿魯納佩斯某處還有個熱得驚人的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那裡的熱浪像是要把我的翅膀整個燒焦，居民看起來也不太友善。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好中止探險。讀者們也最好離那地方遠點。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 我可不是害怕那裡的守衛哦！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 裡希塔樂鎮有座由技術人員建造的巨型建築，他們在裡面究竟做什麼，實在令人起疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不確定以營利為目的的企業是否該做這種事。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 而且，城裡的乾淨區和髒亂區竟然分得涇渭分明...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是介紹米德加爾特各地的書。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還是別看了。

scripts.text: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔搭船，可以前往許多地方。

scripts.text: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
scripts.translation: 不知道為什麼那麼多航線都從艾爾貝塔出發，不過這樣旅行確實方便多了。

scripts.text: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔可以前往這些地方：

scripts.text: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Luoyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
scripts.translation: 諸神之國天津町、避世之地崑崙、武術高手雲集的洛陽、矗立著巨大雕像的哎喲泰雅，還有許多別處。

scripts.text: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
scripts.translation: 最近許多國家的使節都抵達了那裡，看來今後還會有更多地方開放通行。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
scripts.translation: 有個地方是搭船能去的著名目的地。

scripts.text: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
scripts.translation: 可惜他們沒肯載我這個獨自旅行的人，連船票折扣都不給。

scripts.text: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
scripts.translation: 身為學者，我對那位前往爪哇伊的船長的無知怒不可遏。即使身處戰亂，歷史學家也不該遭受敵意。

scripts.text: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔還能前往一座以海龜眾多聞名的島嶼。

scripts.text: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
scripts.translation: 那裡沒有固定航線，不過經過一番調查，我發現有位船長專程前往。

scripts.text: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
scripts.translation: 到了那裡，我看見各種奇特的烏龜：冰龜、火龜，還有忍者龜。

scripts.text: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
scripts.translation: 從鐘樓村出發，找一位全年穿著厚重紅衣的老人，就能抵達一座雪村。

scripts.text: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
scripts.translation: 整個村莊都被白雪覆蓋。那裡正在籌備慶典，氣氛果然很熱鬧。

scripts.text: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
scripts.translation: 村裡還有一家生產玩具的工廠，不知為何，他們卻把我趕了出來。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
scripts.translation: 搭船能去的地方中，還有一座小島，擱淺的船隻就停在那裡。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚那艘船是不是準備打撈，不過已經有奇怪的生物佔據了那裡。

scripts.text: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
scripts.translation: 這片大陸信奉的主神是奧丁，因此也建有奧丁神殿。

scripts.text: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
scripts.translation: 我在那裡也被排斥了。人們對外來者毫無待客之道，更談不上慷慨。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南邊有幾個碼頭。我調查了很久，想弄清楚它們的用途，卻始終沒有頭緒。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 後來我跟著偷偷使用碼頭的冒險者，總算發現了他們前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那裡看到的景象也著實令人震驚。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒險者理應記錄所見的一切，但這件事涉及政治敏感內容，不便公開，就說到這裡吧。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南邊有幾個碼頭。我調查了很久，想弄清楚它們的用途，卻始終沒有頭緒。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 後來我跟著偷偷使用碼頭的冒險者，總算發現了他們前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那裡看到的景象也著實令人震驚。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒險者理應記錄所見的一切，但這件事涉及政治敏感內容，不便公開，就說到這裡吧。

scripts.translation: [記者]：是什麼讓您在過去十年裡一直專注於精煉？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I went to a swimming pool when I was little, and I could just float in the water even though I didn't know how to swim. I could just do it. That's how I started working as a refiner.
scripts.translation: 小時候我去游泳池，明明不會游泳，卻能漂在水面上。我天生就會漂。這就是我後來做精煉師的原因。

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I don't do cheap weapons like that. It should be at least level 4.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：我可不精煉那種便宜武器。至少得是四級武器。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Huh? Cheap weapons? You're kidding, right?

scripts.text: Monthly Rune-Midgarts, November edition
scripts.translation: 《盧恩·米德加茲月刊》十一月號

scripts.text: This month's reader's memoir is on Malangdo, an island of cats. Aren't you excited to find out what's going on in Malangdo?!
scripts.translation: 本月的讀者遊記帶你探訪貓島馬蘭島。你不好奇馬蘭島上發生了什麼嗎？！

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text:
Reader's memoir
Exploring MalangdoX Records on refinementO
scripts.translation:
讀者遊記
探訪馬蘭島 × 精煉記錄 ○

scripts.text: Malangdo, an island of cats. So soft and tender, ah...it's an island filled with lovely cats. Aww, what should I do...they're all so cute and lovely that I wanted to hug...
scripts.translation: 馬蘭島，貓咪之島。軟綿綿、毛茸茸，啊...島上滿是可愛的貓咪。哎呀，我該怎麼辦...它們都太可愛了，好想抱一抱...

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: them...yes, I wanted to, until I met these scary father cat and his daughter.
scripts.translation: 它們...是啊，我本來想抱抱它們，直到遇見那隻可怕的貓爸爸和他的女兒。

scripts.text: Yes, I was waiting to catch the King Octopus. I guess it was when I was passing by a boat? I met a cat with slanted eyes.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我當時在等國王章魚。大概是經過一艘船時吧？我遇見了一隻眯眯眼的貓。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: That cat introduced himself and told me that he studied in Morocc.
scripts.translation: 那隻貓自我介紹說，他曾在夢羅克留學。

scripts.text: Then he assured me that he could upgrade my +9 Violet Fear to +10 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 接著他拍胸脯保證，能把我的+9納戶特基格的雙劍精煉成+10。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: He sounded so reliable since he studied abroad and all that, right? So I trusted him and gave him my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 他留過洋，聽起來特別可靠，對吧？所以我信了他，把+9納戶特基格的雙劍交給了他。

scripts.text: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
scripts.translation: 結果我的+9納戶特基格的雙劍碎成了片。我震驚極了，因為那是我唯一的武器。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: I spent all of my money to buy a Enriched Oridecon, too. Right, I couldn't trust him 100% even if he studied abroad.
scripts.translation: 我還花光了所有錢買了一塊濃縮神之金屬。是啊，就算他留過洋，我也不該百分之百相信他。

scripts.text: So I comforted myself and mourned for my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 我只能安慰自己，為碎掉的+9納戶特基格的雙劍默哀。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: But that wasn't the end. After that, a little cat approached me, saying she has a hammer that can refine even the stars in the sky.
scripts.translation: 可事情還沒完。後來一隻小貓湊過來，說她有把連天上的星星都能精煉的錘子。

scripts.text: A hammer that refines the starts in the sky! Doesn't it sound awesome? Since I lost my only weapon, I thought I should strengthen my armors. So I gave her everything I had.
scripts.translation: 能精煉天上的星星！聽起來多厲害啊？既然我失去了唯一的武器，就想著至少強化一下防具。於是把身上所有東西都交給了她。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: Shoes, clothes, armor, and even helmet...everything I had is just gone...now that I think about it, she said it's a hammer that can refine the stars of the sky.
scripts.translation: 鞋子、衣服、盔甲，連頭盔都沒剩下...我所有東西全沒了...現在想想，她只說那是能精煉星星的錘子。

scripts.text: But she didn't say it doesn't break things, right? So, if you ever visit Malando, be aware of those cats called 'Strip' and 'Shatter.' I'm a Rune Knight and I still catch Porings...you don't want to be like me...
scripts.translation: 可她沒說不會把裝備敲壞，對吧？所以你要是去馬蘭島，小心那些叫“Strip”和“Shatter”的貓。我堂堂盧恩騎士，結果還在抓波利...你可別學我...

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: This is a story of 'Appearing in Morocc Chocheon****.'
scripts.translation: 這是一個關於“夢羅克晨星****現身”的故事。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
You are working for.. The king.
I grant you access.
Come this way.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
你是替國王辦事的...我準你通行。
跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
This the prison where we put criminals.
No outsiders can enter.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
這裡是關押罪犯的監獄。
外來者不得進入。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
喂，衛兵~我覺得這裡溼氣太重了，皮膚都要變差了。這樣沒問題嗎？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
......
^000099Looking tired, the prison guard glances at the prisoner. He seems irritated from constantly bickering with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099獄卒疲憊地瞥了囚犯一眼。他似乎被囚犯沒完沒了的爭吵惹惱了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Mr. Clever, you have to understand this. You are currently under a sentence as a prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
聰明鬼先生，你得明白，你現在是囚犯，正在服刑。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, I know. I know that. So please bring me some kind of furnace up here. The humidity is too much and making everything really sticky.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我知道，我知道。那就給我搬個爐子來吧。這裡太潮了，弄得渾身黏糊糊的。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Don't you get it? There's no such thing as making the conditions favorable for a prisoner to serve their sentence.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你還不明白嗎？囚犯服刑可沒有改善待遇這一說。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
How cheap...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
真小氣...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
(Enraged)
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
（憤怒）

scripts.text: ^000099The guard, holding his anger, just returns to his position. He is too gracious in letting the prisoner have his way.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099獄卒強忍怒火，回到了崗位。他對囚犯也未免太縱容了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Oh! You are the one from earlier. I'm so thankful that you're here! Please help me out. I can't seem to take care of things here.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
哦，你就是剛才那位！太感謝你來了，請幫幫我。我實在應付不了這裡的狀況。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
You are here.{0}I don't know what you did but Mr. Clever is quiet now.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你來了。{0}不知道你做了什麼，不過聰明鬼先生現在安靜了。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
{0}Are you already leaving? Ah... That's no good~ It just got quiet!!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
{0}你這就要走了嗎？啊...別呀~這裡才剛安靜下來！！

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Yes~~ You are here!!
I was waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
太好了~~你來了！！
我一直在等你！

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Are you leaving already...
(The prison guard looks on hopefully)
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你這麼快就要走了嗎...
（獄卒滿懷期待地望著你）

scripts.text: [Prison Guard]
scripts.translation: [獄卒]

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
別東張西望~別跟別的囚犯說話~眼裡只准有我~~跟我待在一起時，要乖乖聽話哦~~

scripts.text: ^000099The situation was immediately understandable. The prison guard was in need of someone to help him out with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099情況一目瞭然：獄卒需要有人幫忙對付這個囚犯。^000000

scripts.text: Well I didn't submit a requisition...
scripts.translation: 我又沒填什麼申請...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
An official request? No, it's not even necessary. You came to visit Mr. Clever, right? Here, look. It's already been recorded.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
正式申請？不用，完全沒必要。你是來探望聰明鬼先生的吧？你看，這裡已經登記好了。

scripts.text: ^000099It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099當著我的面隨便編造官方記錄，恐怕不太合適吧。^000000

scripts.text: Do I need to fill out a visitation form?
scripts.translation: 我需要填寫探視申請嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
No, no! What are you saying...{0}Your prison visits are welcome at any time. I'll do it for you especially if it's for Mr. Clever!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
不不！你說什麼呢...{0}隨時歡迎你來探監。尤其是探望聰明鬼先生，我一定幫你安排！

scripts.text: ^000099Yeah, I keep thinking about it. It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099嗯，我也是這麼想的。最好別當著我的面隨便編造官方記錄。^000000

scripts.text: Well, I thought my time for the visit was over...
scripts.translation: 我還以為探視時間已經結束了...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
What! What are you talking about? {0} Is the time for a visitation a problem for you? Here.. I will extend it for 3 hours!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
什麼！你在說什麼？{0}探視時間不夠嗎？來，我給你延長三小時！

scripts.text: ^000099How he makes things up so randomly... I don't have anything to say anymore...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099他怎麼什麼都能隨口編出來...我都不知道該說什麼了...^000000

scripts.text: Has Clever been giving you problems again?...
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼又給你添麻煩了嗎？...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
It's not a song. {0}when you are not here, Mr. Clever keeps chanting some kind of spell and tortures me!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
那才不是歌。{0}你不在的時候，聰明鬼先生一直念著什麼咒語折磨我！

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Since you are here, let me first record this for you!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
既然你來了，我先把這件事替你登記一下！

scripts.text: ^000099I'm getting used to this with his making stuff up all the time now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099他總是這麼胡編亂造，我都快習慣了。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever is still deep asleep. Be careful not to awaken him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099聰明鬼還在熟睡。小心別把他吵醒。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Clever scribbled a map on my hand. It looks like the place where the books are.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099聰明鬼在我手上畫了張地圖，看起來像是藏書的地方。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099I see Clever working hard with his writing tools. It must be the new history report. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我看見聰明鬼正拿著筆認真寫東西。那一定是新的歷史報告。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm, In any case, I've never seen you before. Why are you here to visit me?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯，總之我以前沒見過你。你為什麼來看我？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
別東張西望~別跟別的囚犯說話~眼裡只准有我~~跟我待在一起時，要乖乖聽話哦~~

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Snore snore...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
呼嚕...呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Wow, you really brought me some. In any case, did you even request a visit? Hey~ Guard!! Don't you have to see if this guy came here with a formal visitation request? Random people can't be in here!
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哇，你真的給我帶來了。對了，你申請探監了嗎？喂~衛兵！！你不該查查這傢伙有沒有正式探視許可嗎？可不能讓隨便什麼人進來！

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Whew~ How refreshing. You are the only visitor I could appreciate this entire past year of imprisonment.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
呼~真舒服。這一年牢獄生活裡，你是唯一讓我覺得開心的訪客。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hey hey, who's this? You're my friend from earlier. Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嘿嘿，這位是誰？哦，是之前提到的那位朋友啊。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
This is the area of interest I used to research prior to imprisonment. The history of the birth of Eclage. And they are parts of history that have not been recorded in the official history documents.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
這就是我入獄前研究的領域：埃克拉珠誕生史。其中有些片段並未記載在官方史書裡。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
You are here.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm? It wasn't anything? I thought he had a problem with our having this conversation...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？沒什麼事嗎？我還以為他不想讓我們聊這個呢...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
The reason why Hiel was researching rift fragments is because he has the same goal as I do. ^000099He wants to resolve things by directly meeting the Laphines of the past by transcending the space-time continuum.^000000
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
希爾研究裂隙碎片，是因為他和我有同一個目標。^000099他想穿越時空，親自見見過去的拉菲尼族。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我想請你用希爾的裂隙工具，去見見過去的埃特蘭和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
You're here.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Mm? Who are you? You aren't a visitor. Guard~!!! Guard~!!! There is a suspicious person here! What are you doing not taking him away?!
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？你是誰？你不是來探監的。衛兵~！！！衛兵~！！！這裡有個可疑人物！怎麼還不把他帶走？！

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
等等，獄卒正看著這邊。先看看他在做什麼，暫時換個話題。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
^000099Clever is diligently transcribing things on paper.^000000
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
^000099聰明鬼正專心地謄寫紙上的內容。^000000

scripts.text: I never wanted to visit you either.
scripts.translation: 我也沒想來看你

scripts.text: What crime did you commit?
scripts.translation: 你犯了什麼罪？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Oh~ Really? Ok, you get out of here. I'm going to start torturing the guard. Let's see... Alright, I'll sing to him!
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦~真的？那你滾吧。我要開始折磨那個獄卒了。讓我想想...好，我給他唱歌！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as Clever starts singing, the guard looks at me in exhaustion. Of course, it was torture for myself as well.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099聰明鬼一開口唱歌，獄卒就疲憊地看向我。當然，對我來說這也是一種折磨。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm?
For what crime? Why do you ask such a boring question?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？
犯了什麼罪？幹嘛問這麼無聊的問題？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I thought you were kind of interesting, seeing how you come to visit a stranger. How disappointing~ I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我還以為你會來看一個陌生人，應該挺有趣的呢。真失望~我要把這首歌唱完。

scripts.text: ^000099I saw real fear and despair in the guard's face. The prisoner known as Clever was getting ready to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我從獄卒臉上看到了真切的恐懼與絕望。名叫聰明鬼的囚犯正要開唱。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
求求你，幫幫我。讓聰明鬼先生閉嘴吧！我聽他唱了一整年，快被逼瘋了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
The prisoner is singing a song that seems to come from another dimension.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
囚犯正在唱一首彷彿來自異世界的歌。

scripts.text: Wait! Wait! Stop your singing for a minute!
scripts.translation: 等等！先別唱了！

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm? Why? Do you have an interesting story?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？為什麼？你有有趣的故事要講嗎？

scripts.text: Try entertaining him.
scripts.translation: 想辦法逗他開心

scripts.text: Tell him about the journey until now.
scripts.translation: 告訴他一路上的見聞

scripts.text: Tell him about Midgard.
scripts.translation: 告訴他米德加爾特的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he wants to eat.
scripts.translation: 問他想吃什麼

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm. What do I want to eat? I have lots of things I want to eat. After all, I've been eating stale prison rice all this time. I had one thing in particular.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯，我想吃什麼？想吃的可多了。畢竟我一直都在吃難吃的牢飯。有一樣東西我尤其想念。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
At one point, some adventurer shared with me as a present some ^000099Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000 and it was really refreshing.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
以前有位冒險者送過我^000099葡萄果汁草藥茶^000000，喝起來特別清爽。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If you bring me ^0000991 cup of Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000, I'll tell you various gossip stories of Eclage in return. How's that?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
給我帶一杯^000099葡萄果汁草藥茶^000000，我就告訴你一些埃克拉珠的秘聞。怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I'll think about it later.
scripts.translation: 我以後再考慮

scripts.text: That's no problem.
scripts.translation: 沒問題

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Alrighty~ It was nice meeting you. I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
好吧~見到你很高興。我要把這首歌唱完了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Ho~ Ok, then shall I wait for you getting some sleep?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
呵~好吧，那我等你去睡一覺再來？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
[Clever]
Hmm hmm.. Let me think for a bit...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
[聰明鬼]
嗯嗯...讓我想一會兒...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm hmm.. Let me think for a bit...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯嗯...讓我想一會兒...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Sorry~ I'd rather be singing!
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
抱歉~我還是更想唱歌！

scripts.text: ^000099He looks like he won't wake up until I bring back some Grape Extract Herb Tea.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099看來不帶葡萄果汁草藥茶回來，他就不會醒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
NO I DON'T HAVE TO! I DON'T HAVE TO CHECK!
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
我才不用檢查！不用檢查！

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's irritated voice screamed from afar.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099遠處傳來獄卒惱火的吼聲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Well, the guard says it's ok. Thanks for bringing it to me. Since I am a prisoner, I don't have much to give aside from praying for a blessing upon home tree.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯，獄卒說可以。謝謝你把茶帶來。我身為囚犯也沒什麼能給你的，就替你向家園之樹祈求祝福吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你獲得了家園之樹的祝福，並得到基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text: Ask about Eclage gossip stories.
scripts.translation: 打聽埃克拉珠的秘聞

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Oh?
Yes, that's right~ I did promise you that.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦？
沒錯~我答應過你。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
There's so many. Why don't you choose one among these topics.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
秘聞可多了。你挑個話題吧。

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王父親的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王縱火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
scripts.translation: 參謀長的真實姓名

scripts.text: A dimensional rift in nearby regions
scripts.translation: 附近區域的空間裂隙

scripts.text:
[Clever]
This is a secret gossip related to the old king. Have you heard about a first-rate criminal named Florence? He was a first-rate criminal, but he was the father of an old king named Seneth.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
這是和老國王有關的秘密。你聽說過一流罪犯弗洛倫斯嗎？他雖是個大罪犯，卻是老國王塞內斯的父親。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
There's also a secret tale about Florence's son, King Seneth. Because of his low self-esteem related to having a criminal father, he is a king who implemented radical policies.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
還有一段關於弗洛倫斯之子塞內斯王的秘聞。他因為父親是罪犯而自卑，因此推行了激進的政策。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
This is a story that most Laphines don't recognize. The assistant chief of staff Shenime's real name is not Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
大多數拉菲尼族都不知道這件事：參謀長謝尼梅的真名並不是謝尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I don't mean to brag, but I used to be a historian, researching the Alfheim continent along with geography, biology, and archaeology.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我可不是自誇，以前我當過歷史學家，也研究阿爾夫海姆大陸的地理、生物和考古。

scripts.text: [Clever]
scripts.translation: [聰明鬼]

scripts.text:
[Clever]
What crime did he commit? Haha, no one knows that. But in Eclage, ^000099it's actually prohibited to mention the name Florence^000000.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
他到底犯了什麼罪？哈哈，沒人知道。不過在埃克拉珠，^000099提起弗洛倫斯的名字其實是禁忌^000000。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If you mention his name, you might be in the same situation as I am.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你要是提起他的名字，說不定也會落得和我一樣的下場。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
There are also rumors that he had a mental illness, I don't know to what degree that is true. I heard that he actually chewed through the stem of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
還有傳言說他精神不太正常，具體是真是假我也不知道。聽說他甚至啃斷了世界樹的樹幹。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Can you imagine? What it could mean for the Mayor to cause harm to Yggdrasil? It's a terrible thing.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你想想看，市長傷害世界樹意味著什麼？這可是件可怕的事。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
There are rumors that after disconnecting himself from Yggdrasil, he grew sicker and sicker, and ultimately set himself on fire.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
據說他與世界樹斷開聯絡後，病情日益加重，最後還放火燒了自己。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Of course, it's just a hearsay, so I can't guarantee that it's true, but I'm positive that ^000099he was the first Mayor to break the relationship with Yggdrasil^000000.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
當然，這只是傳聞，我不能保證屬實。不過我敢肯定，^000099他是第一位與世界樹斷絕聯絡的市長^000000。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
But no one remembers what is real name is. It's the same with me. It's as if a giant eraser stormed through the mind.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
但沒人記得他的真名，我也一樣。就像腦海裡刮過一陣橡皮擦風暴，把一切都抹掉了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
All I know for sure is that Shenime is not his real name. So I conjured up an interesting story. Do you happen to know what it means to control the public?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我只確定謝尼梅不是真名，所以編了個有趣的故事。你知道操縱輿論意味著什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
