If you have a strong ability in controlling the public, I could make you believe that not just my name but my face also ^000099are my original ones even if they really weren't^000000.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
只要擅長操縱輿論，我就能讓你相信我的名字和長相^000099都是原本的模樣，即使它們根本不是^000000。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Shenime formed that kind of identity... Or rather, changed into such an identity. But this is also one of many rumors. Heh.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
謝尼梅塑造了那樣的身份...或者說，變成了那種身份。不過這也只是眾多傳聞之一。呵。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Recently, they discovered a suspicious rift in this vicinity. Because of how I am now, I couldn't check it out myself, but my colleague participated in the research team here and seemed to have brought back something.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
最近有人在附近發現了可疑的裂隙。我現在這個樣子，沒法親自去查，不過我的同事參加了調查，似乎帶回了什麼東西。

scripts.text: What do you mean something? Did he bring back something like a rift fragment?
scripts.translation: 你說的是什麼？他帶回了裂隙碎片之類的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I think so. I don't know if you understand this, but if you utilize a dimensional rift fragment, you can travel through time or different dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
大概吧。你可能不清楚，利用空間裂隙碎片可以穿越時間，或前往不同次元。

scripts.text: Yes, that is why I am here in the first place.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我就是為此來到這裡的

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Oh, that's right. You are a human traveller from Midgard, so you would know more about this than I do.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦，對了。你是從米德加爾特來的旅行者，這方面肯定比我懂。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
In any case, the discovery of a rift in this vicinity is an absolute secret.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
總之，在附近發現裂隙這件事絕對要保密。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
How fun would it be to return to the past with the rift fragment~ I would be able to do whatever I want out of this boring prison.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
要是能用裂隙碎片回到過去，該有多有趣啊~我就能離開這無聊的監獄，想做什麼就做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm~ I've said too much. I think I talked to much for a cup of herb tea. I'm going to rest a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯~我說得太多了。為了喝一杯草藥茶，我可真是說了不少。我要休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Oh right. You showed some interest when I talked about the dimensional rift fragment.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦，對了。我提到空間裂隙碎片時，你好像很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If you are wondering about something, you can go find my friend ^000099Hiel^000000. He's as crazy as I am, but he's a good guy, hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
有疑問就去找我的朋友^000099希爾^000000。他和我一樣瘋，不過人不錯，呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Thanks for being my ears. I don't have the strength to talk any more, so I have to rest up.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
謝謝你願意聽我說話。我沒力氣繼續聊了，得休息一下。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever seems to be in deep sleep.^000000

[Clever]
I have many other gossip stories. What else do you want to hear about?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我還知道不少秘聞。你還想聽什麼？

scripts.text: I'm just gonna be on my way.
scripts.translation: 我先走了

scripts.text: I think Hiel's experiment succeeded.
scripts.translation: 我覺得希爾的實驗成功了

scripts.text:
[Clever]
What? You don't find any inspiration from hearing my voice? That's sad.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
什麼？聽我說話竟然沒給你帶來靈感？真令人難過。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hmm?
Hold on... Keep your voice down. What did you just say?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？
等等...小聲點。你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text: The experiment succeeded.
scripts.translation: 實驗成功了

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I can't believe it. Did you help him? Wait, that's not the important part. The most important thing is understanding how that was possible.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
不敢相信！是你幫了他嗎？等等，這不重要。最要緊的是弄清楚他是怎麼做到的。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Even a non-engineer like me understands that if the rift fragment reacts to pressure, it releases a force beyond understanding.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我雖不是工程師，也明白裂隙碎片一旦受到壓力併產生反應，就會釋放出難以想像的力量。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
But I couldn't experience anything related to the rift from here. That means...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
可我在這裡並沒有感受到任何裂隙相關的動靜。這就說明...

scripts.text: That must mean that it succeeded without any particular side effects...
scripts.translation: 這說明實驗成功了，也沒有造成什麼特別的副作用...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, I see that Hiel must have resolved all technical aspects. Did something happen after the reaction? Could you tell me whatever you saw?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
沒錯，看來希爾已經解決了所有技術問題。反應之後發生了什麼？把你看到的一切都告訴我吧。

scripts.text: Demonstrate what happened.
scripts.translation: 演示給他看

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Two Laphines related to home tree appeared? I have to look for the history records that I organized. Wait here.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
出現了兩位與家園之樹有關的拉菲尼族？我得找找整理好的史料。你等一下。

scripts.text: So it's part of the Unofficial history?
scripts.translation: 所以這是非官方史料的一部分？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Even if there are great accomplishments, there are times when those can't be recorded in the history.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
有些偉大的事蹟，也無法載入史冊。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If there were ^000099oppositions among Dona forces^000000 of nobility, or ^000099slaughtering among Dona forces^000000, those acts cannot be recorded as official history.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
如果貴族之間的^000099多納勢力內部存在對立^000000，或是^000099多納勢力內部發生屠戮^000000，官方史書都不會記載這些事。

scripts.text: Then how do those accounts get recorded?
scripts.translation: 那這些事又是怎麼記錄下來的？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Even if you don't want to reveal it, history is history. There is unofficial history as handed down among historians like me.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
即便有人不願公開，歷史仍然是歷史。像我這樣的歷史學家之間，會口耳相傳一些非官方史料。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Of course, there would be thorny pieces of history among the higher-level members of Dona forces. There are a lot of facts distorted for political reasons. My job is to discover those aspects and correct them.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
多納勢力的高層當然也有許多棘手的歷史。很多事實都因政治原因遭到歪曲，而我的工作就是揭露並糾正這些問題。

scripts.text: Could your imprisonment be due to...
scripts.translation: 你被關起來，難道是因為...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
No, I was only imprisoned for defacing properties...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
不是，我只是因為在公物上亂塗亂畫才坐牢的...

scripts.text: (I was foolish to expect something like that)
scripts.translation: （我真不該期待會有什麼驚天內幕。）

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I digressed a bit there. The story of the birth of Eclage is actually an unofficial history record handed down as classified material. But there have been parts of it that were incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我扯遠了。埃克拉珠的誕生史，其實是以機密資料形式流傳的非官方史料，不過其中有些記載並不準確。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
First, the figure with the short hair. He must be the Dona named Etran who was recorded in the unofficial academy. He is the one who argued for Bifrost's recovery.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
先說那個短髮的人物。他應該是非官方學院史料中記載的多納族埃特蘭，主張復興彩虹橋。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
And the figure with the long hair, I'm sure he's a Dona named Robert. He's the head of the group that promoted the recovery of Bifrost and restored home tree.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
至於長髮那位，我確定是名叫羅伯特的多納族。他帶領眾人推動彩虹橋復興，並重建了家園之樹。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
They were excluded from the official history records for their deep antagonism despite their profound contribution to the birth of Eclage. However...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
他們為埃克拉珠的誕生立下大功，卻因彼此嚴重對立而被排除在官方史書之外。不過...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
How does it seem from your perspective? Eclage is operating so peacefully. It's way too normal for a city that has been antagonized by high-class Donas.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你怎麼看？埃克拉珠如今運作得如此安穩。要是高階多納族之間真的有那麼深的仇怨，這座城市不該這麼平靜才對。

scripts.text: Doesn't really seem that way to me.
scripts.translation: 我倒沒覺得有那麼嚴重

scripts.text: It does seem peaceful.
scripts.translation: 看起來確實很和平

scripts.text: [Clever]
scripts.translation: [聰明鬼]

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Really? But at least take a look at this place's home tree. It's doing just so well! And all of the plant life in Bifrost are vividly alive... If there was an antagonist force, it should have been impossible.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
是嗎？可你看看這裡的家園之樹，長得多好！彩虹橋的植物也都生機盎然...如果真有敵對勢力，這一切根本不可能。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, it is just as you say. This place's home tree is alive and well. And the plant life of Bifrost are also vivacious...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
沒錯，正如你所說，這裡的家園之樹生機勃勃，彩虹橋的植物也欣欣向榮...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If there was really as much antagonism as to be excluded from the history, Eclage and Bifrost could not be the way they are now.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
如果他們真的對立到要被史書除名，埃克拉珠和如今的彩虹橋就不可能是這副模樣。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
The explanations would not be enough with just the documents in this jail cell. Hold on a minute. I will let you know where there are book references that you can use to look it up yourself.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
光憑牢房裡的這些檔案還不足以解釋清楚。等我一下，我告訴你可以去哪裡查閱相關書籍。

scripts.text: I came back after viewing those references.
scripts.translation: 我看完那些參考資料後回來了

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Looks like you read quite a bit. How did you like that journal? Others claim that it is a third-rate journal, but the information in that journal is actually more accurate than legitimate journals.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
看來你讀了不少。那本期刊怎麼樣？有人說它是三流刊物，可裡面的資訊其實比正規期刊還準確。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
It's not that the journal itself is very systematic, but more so that it's not examined by the superiors because it's so negatively criticized for being a third-rate.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
倒不是它的內容有多系統，只是因為被批成三流刊物，上面的人懶得審查它。

scripts.text: I didn't really discover much.
scripts.translation: 我沒發現什麼特別的

scripts.text: I had a question...
scripts.translation: 我有個問題...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Really?
I thought that you were a savvy adventurer, but I guess I thought wrong.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
真的嗎？我還以為你是個機靈的冒險者，看來是我看走眼了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hoh~ You seem like you discovered something. Great, what did you find there?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦~看來你發現了什麼。很好，說來聽聽？

scripts.text: Are Dona and Papang in opposition?
scripts.translation: 多納族和帕潘族彼此對立嗎？

scripts.text: Ask about Etran and Robert.
scripts.translation: 問問埃特蘭和羅伯特的事

scripts.text: Do Laphines like Mayor Jun?
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族喜歡君市長嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
No, Dona and Papang are just words for distinction, not discrimination. Some without thought use them for fun but no one really thinks that way.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
不，多納和帕潘只是區分族群的稱呼，不帶歧視意味。雖然有人隨口拿來開玩笑，但沒人真這麼想。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
[Clever]
Oh, you talking about Mayor Jun? Just call him His Majesty. He is an idol-like existence to us.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦，你說君市長？叫他陛下就行。他在我們心目中就像偶像一樣。

scripts.text: [Clever]
scripts.translation: [聰明鬼]

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If you walk around talking about those things without caution, you'll become like me. Yes, certainly, I'm not in here because of that. Like I said before, I was charged for anonymous defacement of properties...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你要是不小心到處談論那些事，就會落得和我一樣的下場。當然，我可不是因為這個才被關起來的。就像我說的，我只是因為匿名塗鴉破壞公物被起訴...

scripts.text: ^000099I ended up imagining Clever's daily life of spray painting the walls, remembering the ones I saw in Monthly Eclage. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我不禁想像聰明鬼每天拿噴漆塗牆的樣子，和《埃克拉珠月刊》裡寫的一模一樣。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Of course, pure scholars like Hiel and I don't care much for him. I heard he was very beautiful, but I don't really care about the current world.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
當然，像希爾和我這樣的純粹學者不太在意他。我聽說他長得很俊美，不過我對當今世界不怎麼關心。

scripts.text: ^000099Along with that, Clever rattled on about things that I had no idea about like 'Valkyries are best. Uncle loves so much'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099除此之外，聰明鬼還滔滔不絕地說些我聽不懂的話，比如：“瓦爾基里最好了，叔叔最喜歡了。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
You even looked up stories about Etran and Robert. In fact, we know that most Laphines here were established by the elder assemblies that influenced the noble forces at the time.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你還查了埃特蘭和羅伯特的故事。事實上，當時這裡的大多數拉菲尼族，都是由影響貴族勢力的長老議會建立的。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
However, the real history was built on the sacrifices of the young Laphines. At first, as a historian, I could not accept that truth.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
然而，真正的歷史是由年輕拉菲尼族的犧牲鑄成的。起初，身為歷史學家的我也無法接受這個事實。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Unofficial documents that are being constantly discovered always talk about the sacrifies of two young Laphines, so how could they be believed as legitimate?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
不斷出土的非官方文獻都提到兩位年輕拉菲尼族的犧牲，誰能輕易相信這才是正史呢？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
So I tried to present on the topic by writing a related paper but... As expected, the outcome was terrible.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
於是我試著寫論文討論這件事...結果不出所料，糟透了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I mean what else could be done? It must have been ridiculous for them since a young scholar was insisting on his ideas just because he didn't like the recorded history.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
還能怎麼辦呢？在他們看來，一個年輕學者只是因為不喜歡既有記載，就固執己見，當然很荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
After losing my mind due to the presentation's failure, I was imprisoned after spray painting all Yai's of Eclage with 'Eat dirt you Laphine Official Aacademy scumbags'. Well, I could have avoided being caught.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
報告發表失敗後，我一時失控，在埃克拉珠所有的雅伊上噴了“吃土吧，拉菲尼官方學院的混蛋”，結果就被關起來了。其實我本來可以不被抓到的。

scripts.text:
^000099This guy... He's a pit bull. ^000000
^000099He's a pit bull to his roots.^000000

[Clever]
Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
等等，獄卒正看著這邊。先看看他在做什麼，暫時換個話題。

scripts.text: ^000099(No, that's not it!! It's actually the opposite!)^000000

[Clever]
Well, let me make one thing clear. What I'm going to tell you from now, I never told anyone else until now.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
先說清楚一件事：接下來我要告訴你的秘密，我從未對任何人說過。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
If you don't like something about it, or don't want to involve yourself, just forget everything I told you. But if my story interests you, or you have an inkling of desire to help me...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
如果你不喜歡其中任何內容，或是不想捲入，就把我說的一切都忘掉。但如果我的故事讓你感興趣，或者你願意幫我...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Could you promise me that you'll keep everything that you hear from me a secret and help me out?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
你能答應替我保守秘密，並幫我一把嗎？

scripts.text: I can't believe you.
scripts.translation: 我不太相信你

scripts.text: Well I got this far, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 既然都聊到這一步了，我就聽你說完

scripts.text:
[Clever]
That's too bad. You are the only adventurer that I ever told this much. I guess I can't do much about it. Come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
真遺憾。你是唯一一個聽我說了這麼多的冒險者。既然如此，我也沒辦法。等你改變主意再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Great. That's a deal. First, I thank you for this favor. I hope that home tree will have many blessings.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
太好了，一言為定。先謝謝你願意幫忙。願家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099在獲得家園之樹的賜福後，你獲得了經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
For me, it is to find out the truth about history and for Hiel, it is to obtain one of the limited copies of the interior architectural planning of home tree.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我的目標是查明歷史真相；希爾的目標，則是取得家園之樹內部建築規劃圖的限量副本。

scripts.text: Somehow, it feels like Hiel's goal is different.
scripts.translation: 不知為何，感覺希爾的目標和你不太一樣

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Let him be. He's an engineer, so he has that passion only engineers have. While he sometimes lacks the sense of conventionality, but his ability as an engineer is considered outstanding.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
隨他去吧，他是工程師，有工程師特有的熱情。雖然有時不太懂人情世故，但工程本領確實出眾。

scripts.text: ^000099Well, even a person like you are far from the normal Laphines, aren't you...? The thought just crosses my mind.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099不過，像你這樣的人也遠不算普通的拉菲尼族吧...我腦中突然冒出這個念頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
While we were talking about history this way, I bet the guy figured out dozens of ways to operate through and apply the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我們聊歷史聊到這兒，我敢說那傢伙已經想出幾十種操作和運用次元裂隙的方法了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
He might be already talking about the engineering manual with the Laphines of the past.
Since we're talking about this...
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
他現在說不定正和過去的拉菲尼族討論工程手冊呢。
說到這裡...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
麻煩你用希爾的裂隙工具，去見見過去的埃特蘭和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哪怕只是些瑣事也沒關係。請你把所有事情詳細記錄下來，再回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哪怕只是些瑣事也沒關係。請你把所有事情詳細記錄下來，再回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, did Hiel's research find good outcome?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
對了，希爾的研究有進展嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about the things that happened.
scripts.translation: 把發生的事告訴他

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, I see.
As expected, the sacrifices of Etran and Robert, two young Donas, built this Eclage. Now it's for certain that the official history is recorded incorrectly.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
我明白了。
果然，是埃特蘭和羅伯特這兩位年輕多納族犧牲自己，才建立了埃克拉珠。現在可以確定，官方歷史記載有誤。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Thank you so much. {0} if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have been able to achieve my long-cherished wish.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
太感謝你了。{0}要不是有你幫忙，我這輩子的夙願恐怕就無法實現了。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Oh, wait... The two friends reunited together again, right?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
哦，等等...那兩位朋友後來重逢了嗎？

scripts.text: That I am not sure.
scripts.translation: 我不太清楚

scripts.text: I'm sure they would sometime soon, right?
scripts.translation: 我想他們很快就會重逢吧？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Yes, I guess we wouldn't know that at this point.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
也是，現在的我們無從得知。

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Well, I guess that doesn't matter anymore!
I feel like I accomplished something truly significant! Shall we sing?!
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
算了，這也不重要了！我覺得自己完成了一件大事！來唱歌吧？！

scripts.text: ^000099I can see Etran's face through Clever's smile. This must be from the joy he's feeling.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099看著聰明鬼的笑容，我彷彿看到了埃特蘭的臉。那一定是因為他心中充滿喜悅。^000000

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Thank you for hearing me out all this time. Thanks to you, after my release from prison, I have much to record into the history with full confidence. In return, I will pray for home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
謝謝你一直聽我傾訴。多虧了你，等我出獄後，就能滿懷信心地把許多事寫進歷史。作為回報，我會祈求家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree from Clever, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099聰明鬼為你祈求家園之樹的祝福後，你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It is said that the leaves from home tree have the length X with the average m and standard deviation of 4. If P(m<X<a)=0.3413 ... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
據說家園之樹的葉長為X，平均值是m，標準差為4。若P(m<X<a)=0.3413...（喃喃自語）

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm? What brings a human traveler to my room? This is not a room that anyone can enter.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯？是什麼風把人類旅行者吹到我的房間來了？這裡可不是誰都能進的。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't really believe that you could have a normal conversation with the socially inept Clever, but I'll at least give you the benefit of the doubt. So, what did he tell you?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我不太相信你能和不善交際的聰明鬼正常聊天，不過姑且先信你一次吧。他跟你說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't really believe that you could have a normal conversation with the socially inept Clever, but I'll at least give you the benefit of the doubt. So, what did he tell you?
Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我不太相信你能和不善交際的聰明鬼正常聊天，不過姑且先信你一次吧。他跟你說了什麼？
呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh, are you here to help me out? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，你是來幫忙的嗎？看來他們說得沒錯。不好意思要麻煩你，能幫我從他們那裡取回那些資料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Did you find something out?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
有發現什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm... But this is very strange. I arranged them exactly the way it says on the documents, but why isn't there any reaction?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯...真奇怪。我明明完全按照檔案上的說明擺好了，為什麼一點反應也沒有？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Did you see that just now?! The weird sounds. Ahhh~ I'm an engineer who does not believe in spiritual things. Is it because I haven't studied enough? How could there be such an illogical occurrence?!
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你剛才看見了嗎？！那些奇怪的聲音！啊~我可是個不信鬼神的工程師。難道是我研究得還不夠？怎麼會發生這麼不合邏輯的事？！

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't think this is anything spiritual, but rather a moment from the past.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我覺得這不是什麼靈異現象，而是過去某個時刻的影像。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
While you are gone, I tried constructing a portable rift reactor, but I think there is a slight problem.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你不在的時候，我試著造了一臺行動式裂隙反應器，不過好像有點問題。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm... I think this is the problematic area here. Darn, I should have had studied more.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯...問題應該出在這裡。可惡，我早該多做些研究的。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You're back. {0} While you were gone, I added various functionalities onto the spare rift reactor.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你回來了。{0}你不在的時候，我給備用裂隙反應器加了不少功能。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It always feels like looking into a mirror whenever I meet Sir Robert...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
每次見到羅伯特爵士，都像是在照鏡子...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hey hey~ Now it's almost complete.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嘿~現在差不多快完成了。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh, hello~ I'm busy as usual, ahah.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，你好~我還是一如既往地忙，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Cat merchants are stationed at various places in El Dicastes which is far east of Mora village. I am not exactly sure which of those really have that information...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
穆拉村以東很遠的埃爾迪卡斯特，各處都駐紮著貓族商人。我不太確定哪位手裡有那些資料...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
看來我怎麼弄它都沒反應。你想親自試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
If you would like to find out more about the dialogue heard in the reaction, go talk to Clever in prison. He is far better than I am in that field.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
想了解剛才聽到的對話，就去監獄找聰明鬼吧。他比我更懂那方面的事。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
His personality is like fire. If you would like to lead the way to home tree, please exit this place and go to the center of the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
他的性子像火一樣。如果你想前往家園之樹，請離開這裡，到廣場中央去。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Please handle the reactor with care. That's the only one we can use at this time...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
小心操作反應器。目前能用的只有這一臺...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Focus on the rift reactor.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
專心看著裂隙反應器。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm, what else should I fix. I should have had studied more...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯，還要修什麼來著？我真該多做些研究...

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt doesn't look like I'll understand anything he says. Let's get out of here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他說的我好像完全聽不懂。還是先離開這裡吧。^000000

scripts.text: I was referred to meet you here.
scripts.translation: 有人介紹我來見你

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh~ Someone referred you to me? Who was it? You better make sense, or I'll be sure to kick you out.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦~有人介紹你來的？是誰？最好說清楚，不然我可要把你趕出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1} referred me ({2}) to you.

[Hiel]
Oh really? Give me a minute. I'm going to wrap up what I am doing and come back.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
這樣啊？等我一下，我先把手頭的事做完，馬上回來。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't know that person! Aren't you suspicious!
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我不認識那個人！你很可疑啊！

scripts.text: Forget this conversation.
scripts.translation: 就此打住

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王父親的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王縱火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
scripts.translation: 參謀長的真實姓名

scripts.text: A dimensional rift in nearby regions
scripts.translation: 附近地區的次元裂隙

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
How uninteresting. I'm busy so why don't you go on your way.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
真無聊。我很忙，你還是走吧。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
The current name of the assistant chief of staff is not real?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
參謀長現在用的名字不是真名？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
呵~你還真會找有趣的話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't have much interest in the rumors about the royalty here.
Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我對這裡的王族傳聞沒興趣。
呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't even know how this gossip is going to useful for me. Is this all you talked about with Clever?
Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我實在不明白這些八卦對我有什麼用。你和聰明鬼就聊了這些？
呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I mean, even so, how does that matter to me? I'd rather just continue my research.
Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
就算如此，又關我什麼事？我還是繼續研究好了。
呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: ^000099Hie, super excited, showed me a weird container filled with rubble and talked on and on for 30 minutes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希爾興奮地拿出一個裝滿碎石的奇怪容器給我看，還滔滔不絕地講了半個小時。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is... irritating on a different level from Clever. I have to somehow stop his nonstop talking...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099這傢伙的煩人方式和聰明鬼截然不同。我得想辦法讓他停下這沒完沒了的講話...^000000

scripts.text: Ask about using the rift
scripts.translation: 詢問裂隙的用法

scripts.text: Ask how the fragment was obtained
scripts.translation: 詢問他如何取得碎片

scripts.text: So what can you do with this?
scripts.translation: 這東西能做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Well, I am working on figuring that out. The past and the future. I just know for sure that you can trascend the conception of space and overcome the dimensional barriers.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我正在研究它的用途：過去、未來...我只確定一點，它能突破空間概念與次元屏障。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Not too long ago, there was a huge dimensional rift. Although, lots of Laphine soldiers are regulating the area now.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
不久前那裡出現了一道巨大的次元裂隙。不過現在有許多拉菲尼族士兵在那一帶巡邏。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh...
Hmm... (Deflate...)

[Hiel]
If you can operate the rift fragment properly, it would not be very hard to meet ^000099historical figures of the past^000000.
Oh...
Hmm... (Deflate...)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
只要能正確操作裂隙碎片，見到^000099過去的歷史人物^000000應該不難。
哦...
嗯...（洩氣...）

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Very briefly, for research purposes, they allowed access to the area. That's when I slipped one for myself.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
簡單來說，他們為了研究開放了那片區域，我就趁機偷偷拿了一塊出來。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Of course, if this is discovered, I would immediately be jailed. So please don't let anyone else know.
Oh...
Hmm... (Deflate...)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
當然，這事要是被發現，我馬上就會坐牢。所以千萬別告訴別人。
哦...
嗯...（洩氣...）

scripts.text:
Oh...
Hmm... (Deflate...)
Why are you getting down on yourself?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼突然這麼沮喪？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You see, I tried everything possible. Haha... This rift fragment won't listen to me at all. It is essentially void of any reaction.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我什麼辦法都試過了。哈哈...這塊裂隙碎片根本不理我，幾乎毫無反應。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
What I really desire is to witness with my own eyes the kind of chemical reaction given off by this metaphysical thing.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我最想親眼看看這件超自然物質會產生怎樣的化學反應。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
But it's not like I have the necessary resources or information... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
可我既沒有所需的資源，也沒有相關資料...（喃喃自語）

scripts.text:
^000099This guy's mood swings are insane!^000000
^000099How does someone get so depressed so quickly?! ^000000
scripts.translation:
^000099這傢伙情緒起伏也太大了吧！^000000
^000099怎麼一下子就沮喪成這樣？！^000000

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I heard that you human beings have succeeded in combining the right materials to create a reaction with the rift fragment. Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我聽說你們人類已經把合適的材料組合起來，成功讓裂隙碎片產生反應了。是真的嗎？

scripts.text: That's how I got here.
scripts.translation: 我就是這樣來到這裡的

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I guess those cats were right.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
看來那些貓說得沒錯。

scripts.text: Cats?
scripts.translation: 貓？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Guys who regarded themselves as former cat merchants came by here to sell books containing the knowledge of Midgard humans.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
有幾個自稱前貓族商人的傢伙來這裡賣書，書裡記載著米德加爾特人類的知識。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
At that time, they told me that they knew the contents of humans' rift experiments, so I called them liars and kicked them out.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
他們當時說知道人類進行裂隙實驗的內容，我不信，就把他們當騙子趕走了。

scripts.text: Cats don't mess around with money.
scripts.translation: 貓可不會亂花錢

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh, is that right? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，是這樣嗎？看來他們說的是真的。真不好意思麻煩你，能幫我去找他們拿回那些資料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I would like to go myself, but as you can see, I have to continue my research... And... (Fidget fidget)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我也想親自去，可你看，我還得繼續研究...而且...（扭捏）

scripts.text: Hmm, I'd like to, but I'm busy myself...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我是想幫忙，可我自己也很忙...

scripts.text: Sure, I'll go check it out.
scripts.translation: 好，我去看看

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh... I guess it was too much to ask for. That's too bad then.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦...看來是我強人所難了。真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Wow wow! Thank you so much! I'll return the favor by operating it together when the experiments are complete! In the meantime, I'll start preparing for material combination!
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哇哇！太感謝你了！實驗完成後，我會和你一起操作，報答你的幫忙！趁這段時間，我先準備材料組合！

scripts.text: [Hiel]
scripts.translation: [希爾]

scripts.text: Tell him about the materials necessary.
scripts.translation: 告訴他需要哪些材料

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I see, both Dark Debris and Gem Stone are unfamiliar to me. Could it be that my work was just impossible to begin with...?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
原來如此，暗黑碎片和寶石我都沒聽說過。難道我的研究從一開始就註定不可能...？

scripts.text: It does seem impossible. You should give up.
scripts.translation: 看來確實不可能。你還是放棄吧

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I see, I guess changing the very physics is an impossible thing...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
原來如此，改變物理法則果然是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Would you do that for me?? If so, I have nothing more to ask!
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你願意替我做這件事嗎？那我就沒別的要求了！

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Ooo, so this is what is called Dark Debris. I'm so glad that I can continue my experiments.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，原來這就是暗黑碎片。太好了，我的實驗可以繼續了。

scripts.text: I didn't say that I'd just give them to you.
scripts.translation: 我可沒說要把它們給你

scripts.text: Give the materials to him.
scripts.translation: 把材料交給他

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
How ruthless... Saying that he won't give them after showing them to me.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
也太無情了吧...給我看了，卻又不肯給。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Wow~ This will be a big step forward in the scientific progress among the Laphines. I pray for your home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哇~這會讓拉菲尼族的科學向前邁出一大步。願家園之樹保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Wait, but where is the material you are talking about? I don't see it.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
等等，你說的材料呢？我沒看到啊。

scripts.text: [Hiel]
scripts.translation: [希爾]

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving Scientist Hiel's blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你獲得了科學家希爾給予的家園之樹祝福，並得到基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm. Is it this way? No, that's not it. Is it this way? Okay here. We'll put this guy over here. And there.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯，是這樣嗎？不對。這樣擺嗎？好，就放這裡。再把那個放到那邊。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Ahh~ Why isn't this working! You, you have to react when I place you like this!! Ahh nothing is working! Whoa, it slipped from my hand! (CLASH)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
啊~怎麼還是不行！我把你擺成這樣，你就該有反應啊！！什麼都不管用！哎呀，滑出手了！（哐當）

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel, moving wildly for lack of reaction, dropped the Dark Debris to the floor. At this rate, it might shatter...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希爾因遲遲沒有反應而手忙腳亂，把暗黑碎片掉在地上。再這樣下去，它可能會摔碎...^000000

scripts.text: I grabbed it before it dropped to the floor.
scripts.translation: 我趕在它落地前接住了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, how can you handle something like this so carelessly! This is hard to find!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎麼能這麼不小心！這東西很難找的！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099暗黑碎片剛放到希爾擺設的中央，四周便陷入黑暗，一個陌生的聲音憑空響起。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
Ok, let's say that you restore home tree first. Then what? What are you going to do about all of the energy it's going to suck from the land?
scripts.translation:
[????]
好吧，假設你先讓家園之樹復甦，然後呢？它會從土地吸走大量能量，你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[????]
You might be right. To restore home tree, we will probably need a life force that is beyond our imagination. But even so, home tree must be revived.
scripts.translation:
[????]
你或許說得對。要讓家園之樹復甦，恐怕需要超乎想像的生命力。即便如此，我們還是必須讓它復甦。

scripts.text:
[????]
Then what are you going to do about all the other living creatures? The land might grow barren for at least decades, or even centuries. Are things aside from home tree not even considered living?
scripts.translation:
[????]
那其他生靈怎麼辦？土地可能會荒蕪幾十年，甚至幾百年。難道除了家園之樹，其他生命都不算生命嗎？

scripts.text:
[????]
Even if you sustain other life forms, it won't be for long without home tree. We have to tolerate the immediate losses. Don't you know that, Etran?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
就算保住其他生命，沒有家園之樹也撐不了多久。我們必須承受眼前的損失。埃特蘭，你不明白嗎？！

scripts.text:
[????]
Sure, it would be easy to restore the land after we revive home tree!
scripts.translation:
[????]
等家園之樹復甦之後，恢復土地當然就容易了！

scripts.text:
[????]
But do we even have the right to let all other life forms die while we wait until home tree revives?
scripts.translation:
[????]
可我們有權讓其他生命在等待家園之樹復甦時死去嗎？

scripts.text:
[????]
I don't think anyone has that right! No one!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我不認為任何人有這種權利！誰都沒有！

scripts.text:
[????]
You are dreaming big, Etran. In any case, this isn't something that we can solve by arguing. I'm going to follow the decision of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[????]
埃特蘭，你想得太理想了。總之，這不是爭論就能解決的問題。我會遵從長老議會的決定。

scripts.text: Tell him what was seen.
scripts.translation: 把你聽到的告訴他

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Yes, what I heard was the same. I don't know what that was. And I never heard anything about reviving a home tree.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
沒錯，我聽到的也是這些。我不知道剛才那是什麼，而且從沒聽說過復甦家園之樹的事。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Ok, there's no other way. If it's not of our imagination, we have to confirm it again to identify what that sound really was. We have to make sure that it's just just some hallucinations.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
好吧，只能再確認一次，弄清楚那聲音究竟是什麼。我們得確認那只是一場幻覺。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel took more time to rethe arrangements = but the rift fragment did not react to any of his movements.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希爾花了更多時間重新擺放裝置，但裂隙碎片對他的操作仍毫無反應。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
看來我怎麼弄它都沒反應。你想親自試試嗎？

scripts.text: Do you have an idea of whose those voices may be?
scripts.translation: 你覺得那些聲音可能是誰發出的？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
No, no, I have no historical knowledge. But I do have a friend who is truly an expert in that field. He's also the person you met recently.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
不，我不懂歷史。不過我有位朋友是這方面的專家，而且你最近剛見過他。

scripts.text: Oh... You don't mean Clever..?
scripts.translation: 哦...你是說聰明鬼？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Yeah, that's him. He really has problems with his social skills that left him in prison. In historical knowledge, he is truly unparallel.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
沒錯，就是他。他社交能力差得很，才會坐牢。不過論歷史知識，他無人能及。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
If you want to figure out more about the content of that dialogue, it would be better to go and ask him. In the meantime, I'll analyze the arrangement of this.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
想弄清楚那段對話的內容，最好去問問他。我會繼續研究這個裝置。

scripts.text: A slight problem?
scripts.translation: 你說的小問題是什麼？

scripts.text:
[????]
Who in the world are you! How are you looking just like me? Answer me! Are you an imposter established by the Elder Assembly to be used after assassinating me?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
你到底是誰！為什麼長得和我一模一樣？回答我！你是長老議會派來刺殺我、再頂替我的冒牌貨嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Excuse me, please calm down and listen to me. My name is Hiel and the Elder Assembly no longer exists in the world.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
請先冷靜下來聽我解釋。我叫希爾，長老議會早已不復存在了。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You see... This is very complicated to explain... Where do I start...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
這個嘛...實在太複雜了...我該從哪兒說起...

scripts.text: ^000099A Dona that looks surprisingly similar to Hiel (^990000Although he seems so much more dignified...^000099) is holding Hiel by his collar. Who could that Dona be?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099一個與希爾驚人相似的多納族正揪著他的衣領（^990000不過那人看起來威嚴得多...^000099）。那位多納族究竟是誰？^000000

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but who are you?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，請問您是哪位？

scripts.text:
[????]
My name is ^000099Robert^000000.
I am a high-level Laphine Life Restorer. How are you related to this look-alike of mine?
scripts.translation:
[????]
我叫^000099羅伯特^000000。
我是高階拉菲尼族生命復原師。你和這個長得像我的人是什麼關係？

scripts.text: ^000099Robert?... Is this the Life Restorer whose sillouette I've been seeing all this time?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099羅伯特？...難道這就是我一直看到的那位生命復原師的身影？^000000

scripts.text: Explain the situation until now.
scripts.translation: 把事情經過解釋給他聽

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm, this is very difficult for me to comprehend. So you are saying that you are from thousands of years away? My head is beginning to hurt.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嗯，這實在難以理解。你是說自己來自幾千年以後？我聽得頭都疼了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, but if I were to let you know another thing...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，不過我還想告訴你另一件事...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The engineer scientist Hiel and Sir Robert are very similar in appearance, but the way he carries himself is extremely different. So please refrain yourself from stating that the two look alike. It hurts me to listen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
工程師希爾和羅伯特爵士長得很像，可舉止截然不同。請別再說你們長得相像了，聽得我都難受。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I thought I was looking into a mirror.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我還以為自己在照鏡子呢。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
To hear that we are so different in quality, I am quite offended... At any rate, let me explain the current situation.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
聽說我們氣質差這麼多，我可有點受打擊...總之，先讓我說明一下目前的情況。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel added his explanation of his research up to now. Robert seemed to follow most of the story.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希爾補充說明了他迄今為止的研究，羅伯特似乎聽懂了大半。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
That's the basic gist. Anyways, I'm having trouble remaining calm. I can't believe you, Sir Robert, really existed.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
大致情況就是這樣。總之，我實在很難冷靜下來。真不敢相信羅伯特爵士真的存在！

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You are like a legend to all engineering scientists. It's almost difficult to believe a person like you existed in the past.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
對所有工程師來說，您簡直是傳奇人物。很難相信過去真的有您這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It's just so incredible how you were able to construct home tree in its amazing form by amalgamating the life and the setting.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
您竟能將生命與環境融為一體，建造出如此壯觀的家園之樹，真是不可思議。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
home tree... I can't believe it grew back... It was nearly an impossible task. It has restored to its full form in the future of thousands of years later?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
家園之樹...我真不敢相信它重新長起來了...這幾乎是不可能完成的任務。幾千年後的未來，它真的恢復了原貌？

scripts.text: It's true. I can show it to you if you'd like.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。您想看的話，我可以帶您去

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I thought it was impossible. In the end, it actually succeeded in the future. Please take me to home tree immediately! If you lied to me, I won't let you off easy.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我原以為絕無可能，沒想到未來竟真的成功了。快帶我去家園之樹！你要是騙我，我可不會輕饒你。

scripts.text: Robert disappeared during the conversation.
scripts.translation: 羅伯特在交談中消失了

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh, that error. Hoh... Oh no! It's a problem that I did not anticipate.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，是那個故障啊。呵...糟了！我沒料到會出這種問題。

scripts.text: That sounds very risky...
scripts.translation: 聽起來挺危險的...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Ahahhaa, no, it's not like that. I just found out a few minor problems while operating the portable rift reactor.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
啊哈哈，沒那麼嚴重。我只是操作行動式裂隙反應器時發現了幾個小問題。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
This thing is made portable, so the output is not very strong. In other words, the range of reaction is very limited.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
這臺機器為了方便攜帶，輸出功率不高。也就是說，反應範圍很有限。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
To find Sir Robert, this machine's chronological frequency is set at the time right when we encountered him. We will be able to meet him many times over.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
為了找到羅伯特爵士，我把機器的時間頻率設定在與他相遇的那個時刻。我們可以多次和他見面。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
The only problem is that... it has to be at a designated location.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
唯一的問題是...必須在指定地點使用。

scripts.text: Does that mean it can't be at any other location?
scripts.translation: 所以不能在別的地方使用嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I think so, according to my estimation. Entities with life cannot communicate beyond the range of this reactor while inanimate objects are not affected the same way.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
根據我的估算，應該不行。生命體無法在反應器範圍之外交流，無生命物體卻不受同樣的限制。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
^000099(Holding up a very worn out pen)^000000 The pen that Sir Robert was using is still here as proof even though we lost contact with him.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
^000099（舉起一支磨損嚴重的鋼筆）^000000即使我們失去了聯絡，羅伯特爵士用過的鋼筆仍留在這裡，作為證據。

scripts.text: ^000099When did he steal that... ^000000
Then could we also meet his contemporary, Etran?
scripts.translation: 那我們也能見到和羅伯特同時代的埃特蘭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Theorectically, we could. However, we have to go to the location where he may have been. No matter how many times we operate this reactor here, we can only meet Robert.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
理論上可以。不過得去他當時可能在的地點。在這裡無論啟動多少次反應器，都只能見到羅伯特。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
We could expand this machine's output to increase the range, but at this time it's not possible. We can't do much else for now.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
提高這臺機器的輸出功率，就能擴大範圍，但現在還辦不到。眼下我們也沒別的辦法。

scripts.text: I see, that's too bad.
scripts.translation: 明白了，真遺憾

scripts.text: Would you let me see that reactor for a minute?
scripts.translation: 能讓我看看那臺反應器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I don't know how long it will take. It would be difficult to meet Etran and Robert simultaneously for now.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我也不知道還要多久。目前恐怕沒法同時見到埃特蘭和羅伯特。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You are not thinking of taking this out to Bifrost, are you? I think you are taking things too far. It's probably too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你該不會想把它帶去彩虹橋吧？這也太冒險了，實在危險。

scripts.text: I am a person who made it all the way here alive and well.
scripts.translation: 我可是一路平安地活著走到這裡的

scripts.text: Don't you want to test out your theory?
scripts.translation: 你不想驗證自己的理論嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
No, I'm not worried about you. I'm worried that this precious reactor will break.
Who's worrying about you?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我才不是擔心你。我擔心這臺寶貝反應器會壞掉。誰擔心你了？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm...

[Hiel]
Arg...
(It is so obvious that Hiel is genuinely in a dilemma)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
啊...
（希爾顯然左右為難）

scripts.text: Surely, it is dangerous. But what you're saying is right. The engineer's blood that runs through me wants to test this machine out.
scripts.translation: 確實危險。不過你說得沒錯，我身為工程師，真的很想試試這臺機器。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Arg. Well, it can't be helped! Please be careful with this! While I do have a spare, that's the only one with the correct chronological frequency settings!
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
唉，好吧！沒辦法了。請務必小心！我雖然有備用機，但只有這臺設定了正確的時間頻率！

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel's rift reactor was obtained. The energy from the reactor feels like it's channeling through the body.
scripts.translation: ^000099獲得了希爾的裂隙反應器。反應器的能量彷彿在你體內流動。

scripts.text: You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Now the rift will react wherever you are at the speed of light. Also infinite data transfer is now made available. Ah, what should I call this?
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
現在無論你身在何處，裂隙都會以光速產生反應。此外還實現了無限資料傳輸。啊，該給它起個什麼名字呢？

scripts.text: Can we obtain a leaf of home tree?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家園之樹的葉子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Huh? Even if the reactor were to be very capable, it can't possibly do something like creating a home tree leaf. That just couldn't be. This is merely a communicator.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
什麼？反應器再厲害，也不可能憑空造出家園之樹的葉子。這根本辦不到，它只是個通訊器。

scripts.text: Explain to him the promise made with Etran.
scripts.translation: 向他說明你和埃特蘭的約定

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm, even so, that's very difficult. Any action that harms a home tree leaf is illegal in Eclage. The consequence is immediate exile.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯，即使如此也很難。損害家園之樹的葉子在埃克拉珠是違法的，會被立即流放。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Besides, dried up home tree leaves don't just drop to the ground, but transform into life energy and spread throughout the land. It's impossible to even pick them up as dried leaves.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
而且，枯萎的家園之樹葉不會落到地上，而是化成生命能量散佈到各處。連枯葉都撿不到。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm... I wonder if there's a way.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯...不知道有沒有辦法。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm...Hmm...

[Hiel]
Maybe...
This is just a maybe.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
也許...
這只是個猜想。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It won't be illegal if the creator of home tree himself hands you its leaf.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
如果由家園之樹的創造者親手把葉子交給你，那就不違法了。

scripts.text: You mean Robert?
scripts.translation: 你是說羅伯特？

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
That's right. I don't know why I didn't think of that earlier. If it's Robert who gives you the home tree leaf, it would be perfectly fine.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
沒錯。我怎麼之前沒想到呢？只要是羅伯特親手交給你的家園之樹葉子，就完全沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Let's try channeling our way to Robert. Well... This isn't exactly to test out the machine's new functionality. (Hesitating)
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我們試著通過機器聯絡羅伯特吧。嗯...這倒不完全是為了測試機器的新功能。（猶豫）

scripts.text: I'll look for another way.
scripts.translation: 我再想想別的辦法

scripts.text: Let's try communicating with Robert.
scripts.translation: 那就試著聯絡羅伯特吧

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Hmm, that's too bad. If you are thinking of attacking home tree, it's way too dangerous. You'll just be jailed.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯，真遺憾。要是你想攻擊家園之樹，那也太危險了，只會害你被關進監獄。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Alright!! Awesome, awesome!
Now, shall we start our communication? Place your hand on the reactor here.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
好！！太棒了！那我們開始通訊吧。把手放在這裡的反應器上。

scripts.text: Not in the least bit delightful...
scripts.translation: 一點也不高興...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
I only met him twice, and I feel really familiar and somewhat nostalgic when I meet him. I don't know how to call it. It's just a very familiar feeling.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
我只見過他兩次，可每次見到他都覺得很親切，甚至有些懷念。我也說不上來，就是有種熟悉的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh, anyways, don't you lose your focus on the reactor. It is currently connecting.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
哦，對了，集中精神看著反應器。現在正在連線。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
The current range of this reactor surpasses Eclage and reaches Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
反應器的範圍已經超出埃克拉珠，延伸到了彩虹橋。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
If I modify it a bit, I am sure I could even freely select the time point of interest.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
稍作改造後，我肯定就能自由選擇要前往的時間點了。

scripts.text: Etran wanted me to thank you on his behalf.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭托我代他向你道謝

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Really? I'm glad... I would like to one day help Sir Etran and Sir Robert to reunite within this reactor.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
真的嗎？太好了...希望有一天能讓埃特蘭大人和羅伯特大人在這臺反應器中重逢。

scripts.text: ^000099Instantly, Hiel's smile reminded me of Robert. I must have been in the moment.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希爾的笑容一下子讓我想起羅伯特。我大概是被當時的氣氛感染了。^000000

scripts.text: I just came by to say hi.
scripts.translation: 我只是順道來打個招呼

scripts.text: Ask to modify Etran's necklace.
scripts.translation: 請求調整埃特蘭的項鍊

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Well, there's really nothing else to improve. I'll let you, {0}, especially to use this whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
嗯，已經沒什麼可改進的了。{0}我特別允許你隨時使用這臺機器。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Please come anytime to use it. I made it to reach a variety of time channels, but I don't exactly know what will come of it myself.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
隨時都可以來用。我把它改造成能連線各種時間通道，不過連我也不知道最後會連到哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You mean Sir Etran's keepsake? I could try to utilize a special magic power stone to imbue the desired effects, but it is an expensive material costing 10 Splendide Coins...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你是說埃特蘭大人的信物？我可以試著用特殊魔力石賦予它想要的效果，不過材料很貴，要10枚輝煌領域硬幣...

scripts.text: I guess I'll come back next time...
scripts.translation: 我下次再來...

scripts.text: I have the necessary coins.
scripts.translation: 我帶夠硬幣了

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll imbue the desired effects.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
好，準備好後告訴我，我就為它賦予效果。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Oh ok, then should we try imbuing the effects? This process isn't my specialty so I'm a bit nervous, but... hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
好，那我們現在就賦予效果嗎？這不是我的專長，我有點緊張...哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It looks like you don't have enough coins. I would like to take care of it for you, but the material is just way too expensive...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你帶的硬幣好像不夠。我很想幫你，可材料實在太貴了...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You don't seem to carry Etran's keepsake with you right now.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你身上好像沒帶埃特蘭的信物。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
The effect was imbued successfully.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
成功賦予效果了。

scripts.text: I'll do it next time~
scripts.translation: 下次再說吧~

scripts.text: Imbue Physical Ability
scripts.translation: 賦予物理能力

scripts.text: Imbue Magical Ability
scripts.translation: 賦予魔法能力

scripts.text: Imbue Ranged Ability
scripts.translation: 賦予遠端能力

scripts.text: Imbue Recovering Ability
scripts.translation: 賦予恢復能力

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll restore its effects.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
好，準備好後告訴我，我會恢復它的效果。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
It looks like you don't have enough coins. I would like to take care of it for you, but the material is just way too expensive...
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你帶的硬幣好像不夠。我很想幫你，可材料實在太貴了...

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
You don't seem to carry Etran's keepsake with you right now.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
你身上好像沒帶埃特蘭的信物。

scripts.text:
[Hiel]
The effect was imbued successfully.
scripts.translation:
[希爾]
成功賦予效果了。

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的東西好像太重了。減輕負重後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Ford. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099他正忙著和福特打架。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Huh?
Where did you find that canned food?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
嗯？
你從哪兒弄來那些罐頭的？

scripts.text: I got it for myself.
scripts.translation: 這是我自己要吃的

scripts.text: I brought it for you guys.
scripts.translation: 我是特地帶給你們的

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
You are a human being and you eat canned food? What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
你一個人類居然吃罐頭？你在搞什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Shelby is looking away!! Ford doesn't miss this chance! (Pow pow)
scripts.translation:
[福特]
謝爾比分心了！！福特不會放過這個機會！（砰砰）

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Ow~ This useless cat!!
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
哎喲~你這隻沒用的貓！

scripts.text: ^000099The fight continues. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099戰鬥還在繼續。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
 should I really receive this from you?......
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
你真的要把這個給我嗎？...

scripts.text: Forget it if you don't want it.
scripts.translation: 如果你不想要就算了

scripts.text: Yeah of course~
scripts.translation: 當然啦~

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Nah, I'm just kidding! Why would I?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
騙你的啦！我怎麼會不要呢？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Alright. What is it that you want? Is it what you asked earlier, about dimensional rift fragment?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
好吧，你想要什麼？是之前問過的次元裂隙碎片相關資料嗎？

scripts.text: Ask about activating the rift fragment.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何啟動次元裂隙碎片

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
I see, that is what you wanted. It was really difficult to find out since even Midgard scientists try to keep the information away from everyone. Although the information itself was relatively simple compared to the security for it.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
原來你想要這個。找到資料可不容易，連米德加爾特的科學家都想把它保密。不過比起重重防護，資料內容本身倒挺簡單。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
First, to activate the dimensional rift fragment, you need ^0000991 Dark Debris ^000000 to serve as a host. Since the fragment reacts with Moroq's body, you need something that at least resembles it.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
首先，要啟動次元裂隙碎片，需要^0000991份暗黑碎片^000000作為載體。碎片會和夢羅克的身體產生反應，所以載體至少得和它相似。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
If you have Dark Crystal, you could exert a greater force, but I could not attain that combination method.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
如果有暗黑水晶，產生的力量會更強，不過我沒能弄清楚那種組合方法。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
If I were to arrange all of the ingredients, you need ^0000991Dark Debris ^000000in addition to ^000099Red/Yellow/Blue Gemstones, 2 of each^000000.
Why do you need gemstones?
scripts.translation: 為什麼需要寶石原石？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
When you create a reaction with rift fragment with the Dark Debris as the host, the surrounding is placed under much metaphysical force. At that time, if you don't have something to offthat side effect = what would happen?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
以暗黑碎片為載體和裂隙碎片反應時，周圍會受到強烈的超自然力量影響。要是不拿東西抵消副作用，你猜會怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
You probably have seen it before. Like the dimensional rift found in Morocc, the area surrounding it deteriorates. The sacrificial fodder to prevent that are the gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
你應該見過類似情況。夢羅克的次元裂隙周圍就會逐漸衰敗。寶石原石就是用來吸收影響的犧牲品。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Now, did I explain that enough? But why are you trying to activate such dangerous items as rift fragments? Are you trying to hold a ritual of summoning from hell or something?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
這下解釋清楚了吧？不過你為什麼要啟動這麼危險的裂隙碎片？想舉行什麼地獄召喚儀式嗎？

scripts.text: First hand him the canned food.
scripts.translation: 先把罐頭給他

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hmm? What happened to the canned food you had until a minute ago? Why are your hands empty now?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
咦？你剛才手裡還有罐頭，怎麼一下子不見了？現在怎麼兩手空空？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Oh! Thanks! This is the first time to receive salary from a human being. I bless your future in the name of the Leopard God.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
哦！謝啦！這是我第一次收到人類發的薪水。我以豹神之名祝福你的未來。

scripts.text: ^000099Shelby's chubby front paw pats your back to bless you. You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099謝爾比用胖乎乎的前爪拍了拍你的背，為你送上祝福。你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hmm
If you want cat merchant service, you should look for the agent, not me.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
嗯？
想用貓族商人的服務，就去找代理人，別來找我。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Here's some advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
聽我一句勸，別在我這兒浪費時間，去找別人幫忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Let me remind you before you forget, the materials you need to activate the rift fragment are ^000099 1 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
免得你忘了，我提醒一下：啟動裂隙碎片需要^0000991份暗黑碎片，以及紅、黃、藍寶石原石各2顆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hey~ Did you do the past experiment well?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
嘿~之前的實驗順利嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hmm? What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
嗯？怎麼了？

scripts.text: What an interesting cat.
scripts.translation: 真是隻奇怪的貓

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Why? Is it weird to see me after seeing all the cats that are so polite and overly excited?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
怎麼，見過那些禮貌又熱情過頭的貓之後，再看到我就覺得奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Meow~ How are youeow~ I really liked canned fisheow~!!...Is this what you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
喵~你好嗎喵~我最喜歡魚罐頭喵~！！...這就是你想聽的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Just because we are cats, it doesn't mean we are all the same. I'm also really depressed right now, so it's probably best for you to look for other cats to help you.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
我們雖然都是貓，可也各不相同。我現在心情也很差，你還是去找別的貓幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Ask about dimensional rift fragments
scripts.translation: 詢問次元裂隙碎片

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Haha, I can't believe you are asking a cat about that. Our science is not something a lot of people pay attention to. We have our biggest interest in commerce and fishery.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
哈哈，真不敢相信你會問一隻貓這種事。沒多少人關心我們的科學，我們最感興趣的還是貿易和漁業。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Here's an advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
聽我一句勸，別在我這兒浪費時間，去找別人幫忙吧。

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的東西好像太重了。減輕負重後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Shelby. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099他正忙著和謝爾比打架。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ford]
^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
^000099特嫩裡牌罐頭^000000是我們的工資，可現在沒發。福特很難過。那邊的^000099謝爾比^000000看起來也很沮喪~

scripts.text:
[Ford]
You gave us salary! You are kind! Shelby likes you too! We don't have to starve anymore!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
你給我們發工資了！你真好！謝爾比也喜歡你！我們不用捱餓了！

scripts.text: [Ford]
scripts.translation: [福特]

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Shut up Ford!!
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
閉嘴，福特！！

scripts.text: Ask about the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 詢問次元裂隙

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Meow?
Ford doesn't know a difficult thing like that. Ford knows sardines well! Also mackerels! ^000099Dimension... Stuff Shelby knows better!^000000 But Shelby isn't working because he's a down. I don't either!!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
喵？
福特不懂那麼複雜的東西。福特很懂沙丁魚！還有鯖魚！^000099次元...那些謝爾比更懂！^000000可謝爾比心情不好，不肯工作。我也一樣！！

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Shut up Ford!!
scripts.translation:
[謝爾比]
閉嘴，福特！！

scripts.text: ^000099You hear the sound of two cats fighting.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你聽見兩隻貓打架的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
...
^000099Seeing how Shelby isn't screaming at Ford, he really must be in a good mood now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099謝爾比沒有衝福特大喊大叫，看來他的心情確實好多了。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I see, I don't think I ever saw you on our visitor's list. Who are you visiting?
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
我好像沒在訪客名單上見過你。你要探望誰？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
This is all thanks to you! The fact that Mr. Clever is sleeping, it means that he won't be awake for a few days.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
這都多虧了你！聰明鬼現在睡著了，接下來幾天應該都不會醒。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I've never seen you before... Are you a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
我以前沒見過你...你是來探監的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
求求你，幫幫我。讓聰明鬼先生閉嘴吧！我聽他唱了一年，快被逼瘋了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Do you need something else?
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你還需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
^000099{0}^000000? ... That means...

[Prison Guard]
Hmm? You want to visit ^000099{0}^000000? I don't see that visitation on the list. Are you sure you made a formal request?
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
嗯？你要探望^000099{0}^000000？我在名單上沒看到預約。你確定正式申請過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Huh? I've got a visitor? Yahoo! It's a visit! Yay~
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嗯？有人來看我？耶！有人探監啦！太棒了~

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Ahh...
^000099The guard's expression grows dim. He looks so terrible upon just mentioning the name Clever...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099獄卒的臉色暗了下來。光是提起聰明鬼的名字，他就一臉痛苦...^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Well, on the list at least... It doesn't seem like there is a visit scheduled with Clever...
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
嗯，至少名單上...沒有安排探望聰明鬼的記錄...

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hey~ Guard~ What are you doing? Open this cell quickly, would you! This is a visit, hahaha! If you interfere with my visits, I'm going to sing everytime you work! Aren't you excited?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
嘿~獄卒~你在幹什麼？快開牢門！有人來看我，哈哈哈！你要是敢妨礙探視，我每次上班都唱歌給你聽！是不是很期待？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Actually, why don't I start singing now?
scripts.translation:
[聰明鬼]
要不我現在就開始唱？

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's face grows even dimmer. His expression betrays his great irritation with the curent situation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099獄卒的臉色更加陰沉了，神情裡滿是對當前狀況的不耐煩。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
You aren't on the list, but, haha, I guess this is an administrative error. Please go ahead. As far as the time for visitation, hm...
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你確實不在名單上，不過，哈哈，大概是行政上的疏漏。請進吧。至於探視時間嘛...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
You can take as much time as you want. Don't worry about it, and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
你想待多久都行。別擔心，慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I don't know when's the last time I've had this much peace. I pray for the blessing of your home tree.
scripts.translation:
[獄卒]
我都不記得上次這麼清靜是什麼時候了。願你的家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points, thanks to Clever's sleep and the guard's happiness.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099多虧聰明鬼睡著了、獄卒心情大好，你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.translation: 帶我離開這裡

scripts.translation: 合上書

scripts.translation: 絕望之地的定居——第7頁

scripts.translation: 長老議會的暴行——第48頁

scripts.text: Eternal farewell--------132p
scripts.translation: 永別——第132頁

scripts.text: (Faded out areas)
scripts.translation: （此處已褪色）

scripts.text: ^000099Doesn't seem very interesting.^000000

^000099Chapter 1. Land of Despair^000000
Is there a problem in Yggdrasil? A smell of death began to fill the peaceful land.
scripts.translation:
^000099第一章：絕望之地^000000
世界樹出問題了嗎？死亡氣息開始瀰漫在這片寧靜的土地上。

scripts.text: Polluted gardens, dried lands, attack of various mutant life forms. A huge change is found in Laphine's place of life.
scripts.translation: 花園遭到汙染，土地乾涸，各種變異生物發起攻擊。拉菲尼族的居住地發生了鉅變。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip through various faded out pages.)^000000

Laphine's leaders did not doubt that this is the best place for Yggdrasil's guardian. Because of the Elder Assemblly's pressure to establish at such a barren land, it is now difficult to control Laphine citizens.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的領袖們原本深信，這裡最適合成為世界樹守護者的居所。但長老議會強迫他們在如此貧瘠的土地上建城，如今族人已難以管束。

scripts.text: Cursed times passed with many families and friends suffering through multiple diseases and attacks by indigenous life forms.
scripts.translation: 在那段黑暗時期，許多家庭和朋友飽受疾病與當地生物襲擊之苦。

scripts.text: ^000099(The rest of it is faded out significantly, so it is hard to tell.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（剩下的部分褪色得太嚴重，難以辨認。）^000000

scripts.text:
^000099Chapter 2. Elder Assembly's Scheme^000000
Elder Assembly continued to blame the Laphine leaders for ongoing failures.
scripts.translation:
^000099第二章：長老議會的陰謀^000000
長老議會將持續的失敗歸咎於拉菲尼族領袖。

scripts.text: Upon hearing that the land has been selected incorrectly, they internally decided to move the capital to the southern areas where the area is flourishing with forests.
scripts.translation: 得知選址有誤後，他們私下決定把首都遷往南方森林茂密的地區。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip a ripped page.)^000000
The scouts sent south found the shocking truth. The forests in the south could not be close to being safe. 90% of the scouts sent were eliminated by an unknown monstrous figure.
scripts.translation: 派往南方的偵察隊發現了驚人真相：南方森林並不安全。派出的偵察兵中有九成遭不明魔物殺害。

scripts.text: However, the Elder Assembly insisted that the area was our destiny and continued to delegate scouting teams. It was a ridiculous decision.
scripts.translation: 然而長老議會堅持認為那片土地是族人的命運，繼續派出偵察隊。這決定簡直荒唐。

scripts.text: As for the leaders, they needed something drastic to oppose Elder Assembly's ridiculous demands. The elders were just too old and ambitious to think practically.
scripts.translation: 領袖們必須採取果斷行動，反對長老議會荒謬的要求。那些長老年紀太大、野心太盛，根本不切實際。

scripts.text: At this point, two Donas, ^000099Etran and Robert,^000000 suggested large-scale restorative efforts to the leaders. These were individuals of greatest restorative abilities and authority among the Laphines.
scripts.translation: 這時，兩位多納族——^000099埃特蘭和羅伯特^000000——向領袖們提出大規模復原計劃。他們是拉菲尼族中最有能力、最有威望的復原專家。

scripts.text: The leaders began to listen to the strategies suggested by the experts of nature restoration who lived out the principles of restoration all their lives.
scripts.translation: 領袖們開始聽取自然復原專家的方案。他們畢生踐行復原之道。

scripts.text: The suggestions made by the two Dona were crystal clear. ^000099It was to create an enormous home tree to directly fellowship with Yggdrasil and to restore the land all at once^000000.
scripts.translation: 兩位多納族的建議十分明確：^000099建造一棵巨大的家園之樹，直接與世界樹溝通，一舉復原土地^000000。

scripts.text: As expected, Elder Assembly completely undermines their suggestion. ^000099In order to create home tree, it was necessary to drain the life force from the land. ^000000
scripts.translation: 不出所料，長老議會徹底否決了他們的提議。^000099因為建造家園之樹需要汲取土地中的生命力。^000000

scripts.text: As such, ^000099creating a home tree to restore the land could be an obstacle instead.^000000 The Elder Assembly argued that the process would be impossible.
scripts.translation: 因此，^000099建造家園之樹來復原土地，反而可能造成阻礙。^000000長老議會聲稱這根本辦不到。

scripts.text: And they continued to say that for everyone to live, it would be better to move to the south than to restore the barren land. That was their ploy to begin with.
scripts.translation: 他們還說，與其復原貧瘠之地，不如遷往南方，讓所有人活下來。這從一開始就是他們的盤算。

scripts.translation: ^000099（這裡有許多墨跡，像是有人故意塗掉了文字。）^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a page of reflections by Laphine readers. It might be that they were anonymous, but the comments were written aggressively.^000000

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000Who ruined this part here? This is the only copy left!! I love this story.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: I have another copy that I made. If you want it, let me know.
scripts.translation:
^990000回覆：^000000是誰把這部分弄壞了？這是僅存的一份！！我最喜歡這個故事。
----------
^990000回覆：^000000我還有一份自己做的副本。想要的話告訴我。

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Hey guys, do you know this? The Elder Assembly at first completely opposed the building of home tree. But it says in the history books that they're the ones that came up with the idea. Isn't that weird? Who's right?
scripts.translation: ^990000回覆：^000000大家知道嗎？長老議會最初完全反對建造家園之樹，可歷史書卻說是他們提出這個主意的。這不奇怪嗎？到底誰說得對？

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000If you are a Laphine with a wing span greater than 180cm, I'll consider dating you.
----------
<- Anais likes this.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation:
^990000回覆：^000000如果你是翼展超過180釐米的拉菲尼族，我就考慮和你約會。
----------
<- 阿奈斯喜歡這條。
----------
^990000回覆：^000000你怎麼想出這種條件的？

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I heard this from my father, but to fight against Elder Assembly's decisions, ^000099Etran and Robert argued one another in front of the elders on purpose.^000000 Is that true?
scripts.translation: ^990000回覆：^000000我聽父親說，為了反對長老議會的決定，^000099埃特蘭和羅伯特曾故意在長老面前爭吵。^000000這是真的嗎？

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I heard that too. ^000099To make sure they seem authentic, they started arguing each other a bit by bit from a few days before the meeting^000000. That's the most controversial topic among historians.
scripts.translation: ^990000回覆：^000000我也聽說了。^000099為了讓演戲顯得逼真，他們在會議前幾天就開始一點點爭吵。^000000這是歷史學家間最有爭議的話題。

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000There are more idiots that believe this stuff. Hey kids, Eclage Monthly is a third-rate gossip magazine. Don't confuse it with history.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: Oh I see. Thank you so much for your wisdom. I guess if you leave comments like that on a third-rate magazine, you just look incredibly smart.
scripts.translation:
^990000回覆：^000000還有人信這種鬼話。喂，小鬼...《埃克拉珠月刊》是三流八卦雜誌，別把它和歷史混為一談。
----------
^990000回覆：^000000噢，明白了。多謝指教。看來在三流雜誌上留言，確實顯得自己特別聰明。

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000I'll be running with the high profile photo of Mayor Jun in undies. I'll give it to the first one to claim it!
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: I'll take the photo. I'll put you on our editorial staff.
scripts.translation:
^990000回覆：^000000我要刊出一張君市長穿內衣的高畫質照片。誰先認領就送給誰！
----------
^990000回覆：^000000照片我要了，順便把你招進編輯部。

[????]
Hmm? What is this? Am I dreaming? Something feels different.
scripts.translation:
[????]
嗯？這是什麼？我是在做夢嗎？總覺得哪裡不一樣。

scripts.text: Can you hear me? Would you be Sir Etran?
scripts.translation: 你聽得到我說話嗎？您是埃特蘭大人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You know my name? Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
你知道我的名字？你是誰？

scripts.text: Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 向他說明情況

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huhhh?
Are you telling me to believe that story? You are from the future of thousands of years away? That kind of science is available in the future?

[埃特蘭]
啊？
你要我相信這種說法？你來自幾千年後的未來？未來竟有這種技術？

scripts.text: Explain to him about the rift reactor.

[{0}]
Sir Etran, it's not that we are from the future, but rather, we opened the walls between the past and the future just temporarily. I have so many questions to ask.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃特蘭大人，並不是我們來自未來，而是暫時打通了過去與未來之間的屏障。我有很多問題想請教您。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭竟然和聰明鬼長得很像。難道聰明鬼和希爾是埃特蘭和羅伯特的轉世？不，不可能...^000000

^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
^000099埃特蘭竟然和聰明鬼長得很像。難道聰明鬼和希爾是埃特蘭和羅伯特的轉世？不，不可能...^000000
說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今的彩虹橋已經衰敗得太嚴重，無論投入多少生命力，似乎都看不到盡頭。
