scripts.text: Ask about the fight with Robert.
scripts.translation: 詢問他和羅伯特爭吵的事

scripts.text: Ask about land restoration project.
scripts.translation: 詢問土地復原計劃

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hmm, the Elder Assembly is really a rotten organization. They're like fossils, still living in the times when Laphines began to exist.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
長老議會真是腐朽不堪。他們像一群活化石，還活在拉菲尼族剛誕生的年代。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Oh yeah, you talking about the time we argued in front of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哦，你是說我們在長老議會面前爭吵的事。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今的彩虹橋已經衰敗得太嚴重，無論投入多少生命力，似乎都看不到盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
They try to interfere with presidency, politics, culture, and everything else. They are even minding the matters that deal with our survival.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
他們想幹涉領導層、人事、政治、文化，什麼都要管。甚至連關乎我們生死的事也不放過。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
The elders are trying to ignore the practical young leaders of this area who want to establish a capital nearby here. They are only trying to carve out their place in the center of this issue regarding the capital.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
長老們不理會那些務實的年輕領袖。年輕人想在附近建立首都，長老們卻只想在首都問題上爭權奪勢。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
That's why they are pushing for the ridiculous idea of settling in the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
所以他們才會極力推動那個荒唐的南遷計劃。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
The young Laphines could never accept that. That's why Robert and I made the outrageous claim that we could restore the area here and blocked off the movement toward the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
年輕的拉菲尼族絕不會接受。於是羅伯特和我提出一個大膽的主張：復原這片土地，以此阻止南遷。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Of course... It would only be significant if we succeed. If we fail, many more young Laphines would be sent off to the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
當然，只有成功才有意義。一旦失敗，就會有更多年輕的拉菲尼族被送往南方。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I can no longer let the elders shed the blood of the young Laphines.
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我不能再讓長老們犧牲年輕拉菲尼族的性命。
說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今彩虹橋已衰敗得太嚴重，再多生命力也看不到盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
That happened about a year ago from the dimension that I'm currently in. Because we wanted to draw the elders' attention to our idea, we made them focus on only two issues, home tree's restoration or the land's restoration.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
那是我所在的維度裡，大約一年前發生的事。為了讓長老們正視我們的主張，我們把議題集中在兩件事上：復原家園之樹，還是復原土地。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
We succeeded ultimately. They didn't even get to discuss the option of settling in the forests of the south. It just had too many Laphine lives at stake.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
最後我們成功了。他們甚至沒能討論遷往南方森林的方案，因為那會犧牲太多拉菲尼族的性命。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
If I could meet Robert later, I wish to continue that conversation.
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
若之後能再見到羅伯特，我還想把那次談話繼續下去。
說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今的彩虹橋已衰敗得太嚴重，再多生命力也看不到盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Furthermore, the energy that the home tree consumes is just too colossal and too rapid.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
而且家園之樹消耗能量的規模太大，速度也太快。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Robert is probably doing everything he can. Once the home tree connected to a piece of land, the entire area will be consumed. To prevent that, he put his life on the line.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
羅伯特一定在竭盡全力。家園之樹一旦紮根某片土地，整片區域都會被它吸乾。為了阻止這一切，他賭上了性命。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You get the idea right? Our roles are in two parts right now. Me, who focuses on pouring out the energy into the land. Robert, who blocks off the home tree's wild consumption.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
明白了嗎？我們現在各司其職：我負責把能量注入土地，羅伯特負責阻止家園之樹瘋狂汲取能量。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
If the balance between us two is not maintained, the entire land will be destroyed along with home tree. The problem is, I just don't know if we are doing it all correctly.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
如果我們無法維持平衡，整片土地和家園之樹都會毀滅。問題是，我不知道我們的做法到底對不對。

scripts.text: Actually, your project succeeded.
scripts.translation: 實際上，你的計劃成功了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You succeeded. Bifrost, full of flowers and grass, is a land of plenty.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你成功了。彩虹橋繁花綠草遍地，是一片富饒的土地。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I succeeded...?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我成功了...？

scripts.text: Would you like to see for yourself?
scripts.translation: 你想親眼看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sure. Lead the way. I'll follow...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
當然。帶路吧，我跟你去...

scripts.text: ^000099The additional reaction does not get reduced.^000000

[Etran]
Oh? Something's familiar. Would you be that traveler from the future?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哦？這感覺真熟悉。你就是那位來自未來的旅行者吧？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You are here! I was worried that you wouldn't come back!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
你來了！我還擔心你不會再回來了！

scripts.text:
[Etran]
After your visit, I felt so much lighter. I was also excited to control the life force.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
你來過之後，我感覺輕鬆多了，也更有信心去操控生命力了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
More importantly, did you give the necklace to Robert? And what about the leaf of the home tree?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
對了，你把項鍊交給羅伯特了嗎？家園之樹的葉子呢？

scripts.text: Give the necklace and the home tree leaf.
scripts.translation: 交出項鍊和家園之樹的葉子

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Wow, it was true that home tree has grown! What a relief!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哇，家園之樹真的長大了！太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Etran]
But even so, it's a bit sad that he didn't keep the necklace...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
不過，他沒把項鍊留下，還是有點讓人難過...

scripts.text: Tell him what Robert said.
scripts.translation: 告訴他羅伯特的話

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I see. Robert, as usual, is strong unlike me. That's Robert's strong point.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
原來如此。羅伯特一如既往地堅強，而我卻不一樣。這正是羅伯特的過人之處。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And, Sir Robert also asked me to tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有，羅伯特先生讓我轉告您：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That as much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000...

[Etran]
Robert really said that? Really?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
羅伯特真的這麼說？真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I think this is the first time he's ever said he trusts me ever since we started working together. Now I can just focus and give all my heart to putting energy into this land.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
這是我們開始合作以來，他第一次說信任我。現在我可以全心投入，把能量注入這片土地了。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's shoulders seem to be trembling.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭的肩膀似乎微微顫抖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I didn't get to know you very long, but thank you, traveler from the future.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
雖然我們相識不久，還是謝謝你，來自未來的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
By the way, the necklace that Robert refused to keep. I'll give it to you as a token of gratitude. Just keep it for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
對了，羅伯特不肯收下的項鍊，就送給你作謝禮吧。請你留著。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Well then, I should get going. Also, please send my word of appreciation to the person who built this incredible machine.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
那麼，我該繼續忙了。也請替我向製造這臺奇妙機器的人道謝。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's keepsake was received. It is possible to equip it, but ^ff0000to utilize its full strength,^000099 I would need Hiel's help later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你得到了埃特蘭的信物。雖然可以裝備，^ff0000但要發揮它的全部力量，^000099之後還得請希爾幫忙。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is a grave where communication with Etran was established. He must have spent his last days around here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099這裡是與埃特蘭建立聯絡的墓地。他晚年應該就在附近度過。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a cemetery unfitting with the tower. It's so worn down that it's difficult to tell whose graves these are.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099這座墓地和高塔格格不入。墓碑風化得太嚴重，已經難以辨認墓主。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[????]
This is tough. The energy consumed by the home tree is greater than I thought. Even if Robert is providing some control, was this impossible to begin with?
scripts.translation:
[????]
這很難辦。家園之樹消耗的能量比我想像的要大。即使有羅伯特進行一些控制，這從一開始就是不可能做到的嗎？

scripts.text: ^000099I'm here!! Let's take this reactor closer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我來了！！我們把反應器再往前移一點吧。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Whoa... This is..!!!

[Etran]
Is this real. This isn't a dream, is it... {0}.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
這是真的嗎。這不是夢，對吧... {0}。

scripts.text: It's not a dream
scripts.translation: 這不是夢

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What you are seeing now is home for thousands of Laphine descendants, Bifrost the land of life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你現在看到的，是數千名拉菲尼族後裔的家園——生命之地彩虹橋。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I wasn't wrong. I wasn't wrong.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我沒有錯。我沒有錯。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran started to sob and seemed to be free from the burden of his life. He seemed to remember something and asked a question.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭開始啜泣，似乎卸下了生命中的重擔。他似乎想起了什麼，問了一個問題。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
But, what about Robert's home tree? What happened to his home tree?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
那麼，羅伯特的家園之樹呢？長得怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: His home tree also grew very well.
scripts.translation: 他的家園之樹也長得很好

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I see. I would like to see the home tree he nurtured... Would you take me there too?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
是嗎...我真想看看他培育的家園之樹...你能帶我去看看嗎？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, that can't happen...
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，那不可能...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, this reactor's range is too small that while I try to take you there, the connection will drop. I'm afraid it's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很遺憾，這臺反應器的作用範圍太小，帶您過去的話，連線就會中斷。恐怕辦不到。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Did Robert really succeed too? Are you trying to keep his failures from me by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
羅伯特真的成功了嗎？你該不會是在隱瞞他的失敗吧？

scripts.text: Should I bring something to prove it to you?
scripts.translation: 我該帶點什麼來證明給你看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
A proof?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
證明？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
A proof?
Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
證明？
啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text: Bring a cat's canned food.
scripts.translation: 帶一份貓的罐頭

scripts.text: Bring a Laphine coin.
scripts.translation: 帶一枚拉菲尼族硬幣

scripts.text: Bring a home tree leaf.
scripts.translation: 帶一片家園之樹的葉子

scripts.text:
[Etran]
A cat's canned food? How does that have anything to do with home tree?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
貓罐頭？這和家園之樹有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
A Laphine's coin? Is it something new? Does home tree produce coins now?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
拉菲尼族的硬幣？那是什麼新東西嗎？家園之樹還會長硬幣？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I was just talking nonsense for a bit.
Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我剛才隨口亂說的。
啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that doesn't happen. I just chose a bad example.
Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不會那樣。我只是舉了個不恰當的例子。
啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How does a home tree leaf look like? Are there characteristics that make it unique such as color?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
家園之樹的葉子是什麼樣的？有什麼特別之處嗎，比如顏色？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I only heard about it. I never saw it myself. I've heard that a home tree with abundant life force demonstrates a gold color.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我只聽說過，自己從沒見過。據說生命力旺盛的家園之樹會呈現出金色。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I don't know anything besides that. But if it is a real home tree leaf, there's no way I wouldn't be able to tell. The life reaction from a home tree leaf is incredible.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
除此之外我就不知道了。但如果是真正的家園之樹葉子，我肯定認得出來。它散發的生命反應非常強烈。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
If you bring me a fully grown home tree leaf, I will never give up. You can't fake Robert's success, you see.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
如果你帶來一片完全成熟的家園之樹葉子，我就絕不會放棄。畢竟羅伯特的成功是偽造不了的。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Also, I have another favor.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
還有，我有另一個請求。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
This necklace... Please give it to Robert. Tell him that I never gave up and that we must give our all...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
這條項鍊...請把它交給羅伯特。告訴他我從未放棄，我們必須全力以赴...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's figure begins to fade out. The reactor's force must have weakened. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭的身影開始消散，反應器的能量似乎減弱了。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099His necklace dropped onto the grass as Etran's figure faded away. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099隨著埃特蘭身影的消失，他的項鍊掉在了草地上。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You obtained a worn out necklace. It feels like an unknown energy of life is entering the body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你獲得了一條破舊的項鍊。感覺有一股未知的生命能量正湧入體內。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你獲得了經驗值和職業經驗值。^000000

scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Th... This.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
這...這是。

scripts.text: This is the home tree that you nurtured.
scripts.translation: 這就是你培育的家園之樹

scripts.text:
[Robert]
It grew up so well. I thought it was impossible... I thought I would never see it.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
它長得真好。我曾以為這是不可能的...我以為我永遠看不到這一天。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert teared up, full of emotion. Right then, Robert's figure started fading away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099羅伯特淚流滿面，情緒激動。就在那時，羅伯特的身影開始消散。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm? I feel weird. What's happening to my body? Am I dreaming?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嗯？我感覺不對勁。我的身體怎麼了？我是在做夢嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hey, are you there? I can't hear my own voice. Hey!! {0} Can you hear me?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嘿，你在嗎？我聽不到自己的聲音了。嘿！！{0} 你能聽到我嗎？

scripts.text: ^000099It hasn't even been more than a few minutes, but Robert's figure disappeared. Let's go back to Hiel first and figure out what may be going on.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099這才過了幾分鐘，羅伯特的身影就消失了。讓我們先回到希爾那裡，弄清楚到底發生了什麼。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[????]
Whoaaa~ It's a green monster! Run awayyy! (Static static)
scripts.translation:
[????]
哇哦~是綠色的怪物！快跑啊！（滋滋聲）

scripts.text:
[????]
Is the meat ready yet? I can't wait any longer... (Static static)
scripts.translation:
[????]
肉好了嗎？我等不及了...（滋滋聲）

scripts.text:
[????]
Ayyyy!!! What did I tell you!!!
scripts.translation:
[????]

[Robert]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I see. That's what happened.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我明白了。原來是這麼回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只是...他很擔心您的情況，尤其是沒法確認您的家園之樹是否成功長成。

scripts.text:
[Robert]

scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]

scripts.text: Is it possible to obtain a home tree leaf?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家園之樹的葉子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]

scripts.text:
[Robert]

[羅伯特]

[Robert]

[羅伯特]
抱歉，我笑了。

scripts.text: ^000099What if Etran and Robert were the prisoner and the guard?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099如果埃特蘭和羅伯特就是囚犯和獄卒呢？^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
嘿，衛兵~這裡溼氣太重了，我的皮膚都要毀了。這樣行嗎？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Wash your face.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
洗把臉吧。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Oh...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哦...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were put to work as cat merchants.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭和羅伯特被安排去當貓族商人了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Welcome welcomeow~! We are cat merchants, always serving guests as our kingeow~! Special sale! One piece of meat for 200 Zeny!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
歡迎歡迎喵~！我們是貓族商人，會像招待國王一樣招待客人喵~特價優惠！肉一塊只要200 Zeny！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
If you buy it now, we will also give you 3 canned foodseow!! Buy lotseow!!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
現在買還送三罐貓糧喵！！多買些喵！！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
(Hey, Robert! Don't just stand there and imitate a cat or something! If you just stand still, we are gonna be kicked out!)
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
（喂，羅伯特！別站著學貓叫啊！你再不動，我們就要被趕走了！）

scripts.text:
[Robert]
GRRRRRR....
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嗚嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
A dog?...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
一隻狗？...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were placed in a Flight machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特蘭和羅伯特被安排進了一臺飛行器。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
Hey Robert, don't you love this machine that flies in the air?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
嘿，羅伯特，你不喜歡這臺能在天上飛的機器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
Huh? Why are you looking so green? What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
嗯？你臉色怎麼發青了？不舒服嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Etran, I was looking for a restroom here.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
埃特蘭，我在找洗手間。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Ok, so what about the restroom.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哦，那洗手間怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
They don't have one here. No restrooms here.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
這裡沒有洗手間。哪兒都沒有。

scripts.text: ^000099We will be arriving at Izlude Airport in 6 hours. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我們將在6小時後抵達依斯魯得島機場。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hahahha, I can't keep myself from laughing after listening to you.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
哈哈哈哈，聽你這麼一說我就忍不住笑。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ughh....
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
呃...

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Let us go as we are to Izlude!!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我們就這樣飛去依斯魯得島吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......
^000099Iron Chef Robert^000000

[Robert]
I'm going to bake a pie now.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我現在要烤個派。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Really really?
Are you going to add some blueberries too? I love blueberry pies!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
真的嗎？真的嗎？
會加藍莓嗎？我最喜歡藍莓派了！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Of course. I'm also going to add some raspberries from morning and add some syrup too.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
當然。我還會加上早上摘的覆盆子，再淋些糖漿。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Really really?
Raspberries will add that berry citrus flavor!! I love raspberry pies! How many are you baking? Isn't two just too little?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
真的嗎？覆盆子會增添莓果的酸香！我超愛覆盆子派！你烤幾個？只烤兩個不嫌少嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I'm going to bake 1. You aren't getting one.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我只烤一個。你沒份。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huh??....
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
啊？...

scripts.text: ^000099Robert actually likes beer.^000000

[Robert]
Oh man~ I'm craving for some chilled beer and yakitori back in the human world~
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
哎呀~真想念人類世界的冰啤酒和烤串啊~

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Robert! Robert! Did you see the new yakitori place here? They are doing a grand opening sale today! Let's go eat some!
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
羅伯特！你看到新開的烤串店了嗎？今天開業大酬賓！一起去吃吧！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
(Really, they actually sell that here?)
How could you be talking about beer? You should be ashamed of yourself, Etran~
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
（真的？這裡居然有賣烤串？）
居然提啤酒？埃特蘭，你該感到羞愧~

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huh?... You don't like beer, Robert?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
咦？羅伯特，你不喜歡啤酒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
That's just something that humans drink. You go ahead. I don't really care for it.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
那是人類喝的東西。你去喝吧，我沒興趣。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Ok. Oh well then.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
好吧，那算了。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
But do they have good yakitori there?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
不過，那裡的烤串好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Yeah!! Totally good! Do you want to go? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
好吃！！特別好吃！你也想去嗎？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Well, it's not that I really want yakitori or anything, but....
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
我也不是特別想吃烤串啦，不過...

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Yayyy!!!!
^000099Robert the cook^000000

[Robert]
MmmMmm~ Smells so good.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嗯嗯~真香。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Etran is going to be back soon. By then, it should be ready.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
埃特蘭很快就回來，應該剛好能烤好。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ah~ very good. Look at this perfect pie. The fragrance is amazing, too. Should I taste it a bit?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
啊~真不錯。看看這完美的派，香氣也很棒。要不要先嚐一口？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm.. No.
I'll eat it with him when Etran comes home.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嗯...不。
等埃特蘭回家再一起吃。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert who went over to Etran's house with the pie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099羅伯特帶著派去了埃特蘭家。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran's Notice]
Welcome to Etran's home! I went to Bifrost to water some plants! It's going to take at least two days because the land is so large. Any gifts can be left at the door.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭的告示]
歡迎來我家！我去彩虹橋給植物澆水了！地方太大，至少要花兩天。有禮物的話就放門口吧。

scripts.text:
[Etran's Notice]
Oh, I'm sure there won't be anyone with gifts. Especially nothing like Robert bringing a nicely baked pie, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭的告示]
當然，肯定沒人帶禮物來。更不會有人像羅伯特那樣帶來剛烤好的派，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ok, I didn't! My gosh, I didn't bake the pie!!!
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
才沒有！天啊，我根本沒烤派！！！

scripts.text: ^000099Childhood friends, Etran and Robert^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099童年好友：埃特蘭與羅伯特^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hey, why are you crying like that?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
嘿，你為什麼哭成這樣？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sob sob...Dona of the same class are making fun of my size and calling me a Papang...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
嗚嗚...同班的多納族笑我個子矮，還叫我帕潘族...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
That's all it was? Just because they call you a Papang, it doesn't mean you, a Dona, will turn into a Papang! Those guys just wanted to see you cry. Why don't you stop crying?
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
就因為他們叫你帕潘族？你是多納族，怎麼可能就變成帕潘族！他們只是想看你哭，別哭了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sob...
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Really now... You cry too often.
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
真是的...你太愛哭了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I wish I was as calm and cool as you were, Robert.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
我真希望自己能像你一樣冷靜又帥氣，羅伯特。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Psh, you are 100 years too early to be as cool as I am...
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
哼，想變得像我這麼帥，你還差一百年呢...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
^FF0000This is the place where those kids who make fun of Etran hang out often. Shall I see who they are?^000000
scripts.translation:
[羅伯特]
^FF0000那些嘲笑埃特蘭的小鬼常在這裡出沒。要不要查查他們是誰？^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Nobody knows why, but it was told that the Laphines who made fun of Etran were hospitalized for 4 weeks.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099沒人知道原因，不過據說那些嘲笑埃特蘭的拉菲尼族住院了四周。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You shouldn't be a kid like this~ School violence is an unforgivable crime. Friends should stay away from violence and spend good times together.
scripts.translation:
[埃特蘭]
別做這種幼稚的事~校園暴力不可饒恕。朋友之間應該遠離暴力，好好相處。

scripts.text: ^000099In boiling water~ 3 minutes~ ... Static static^000000
^0000993 minutes in boiling water... What after that. Does it mean it will die 3 minutes in boiling water? Do I pour the boiling water over a monster or something?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099沸水煮三分鐘...然後呢？是說它會在沸水裡煮三分鐘後死掉嗎？我要把沸水倒在魔物身上嗎？^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Houston~ Houston~ This is CHTTTCHTTT~ We see a large tower and a tree. It seems like there are life forms here on this planet as well~ STATIC~ ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099休斯頓~休斯頓~這裡是嘶嘶嘶~我們看到一座高塔和一棵樹。這個星球上似乎也有生命體~雜音~^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Some desperate voices are heard. Not sure what the words, planets and life forms, are referring to.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099傳來幾道絕望的聲音。我不明白他們說的“行星”和“生命體”指什麼。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There's too much static. Try adjusting the frequency. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099雜音太多了。試著調一下頻率。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The work desk is a huge mess.^000000

[Fili]
It's always so beautiful with flowers blooming everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
到處鮮花盛開，真美啊。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Are the adventurers doing okay? Don't forget to check all three of them~
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
冒險者們都還好嗎？記得確認他們三個人的情況哦~

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thank goodness they're all okay. What a relief. But did they tell you when they'll be out?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
謝天謝地，他們都沒事。真讓人放心。他們有沒有說什麼時候出來？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Do you see the tower here? I don't know when it was built or who built it, but I heard it's been here since forever.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看到這座塔了嗎？我不知道它何時建成、由誰建造，只聽說它一直都在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Four Laphines are preparing to work today. Make sure you tell every one of them.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
今天有四位拉菲尼族要開始工作，記得逐個通知他們。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng!? I think they already started the work. The field is breathing again. There are many stories to this field, you know.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
啊？！他們好像已經開始工作了。這片土地又恢復生機了。這片土地的故事可多著呢。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Now that I see...you're a traveler, right? Sorry, I can't really notice anything unless I'm interested.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
現在才注意到...你是旅行者吧？抱歉，除非是我感興趣的事，否則我很難注意到。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Look at this beautiful field filled with little blades of grass and twigs breathing!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看看這片美麗的田野，小草和細枝都在呼吸呢！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Looking at this beautiful field, the song sings itself~
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看著這片美麗田野，歌聲彷彿自然而然就響起來了~

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Take a look at this beautiful field. It feels like you can hear each twig and blade of grass singing, right?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看看這片美麗的田野。彷彿能聽見每根細枝、每株小草都在歌唱，對吧？

scripts.text: Start a conversation
scripts.translation: 開始交談

scripts.text: Laphine that loves the earth
scripts.translation: 熱愛大地的拉菲尼族

scripts.text: Asking after adventurers
scripts.translation: 詢問冒險者的情況

scripts.text:
[Fili]
What is Eclage like? It's such a nice place.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
埃克拉珠是什麼樣的地方？那裡真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
People wouldn't hate or hold each other at knife point if their hearts are filled with love for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
如果心裡充滿對花朵和大地的愛，人們就不會彼此憎恨，也不會刀劍相向。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
You should avoid going into the tower. It's dangerous. We can't do much for the ones who have already entered, though.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
別進塔裡，那裡很危險。至於已經進去的人，我們也幫不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Glad you're here. We're about to start working again. Would you help us?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
很高興你來了。我們馬上要重新開工，能幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I appreciate what you did last time. The earth seemed to be in a good mood, too. I could just feel it. Would you mind helping us again?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
上次多虧你幫忙。大地看起來心情也很好，我能感覺到。你願意再幫我們一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It seems like the earth is feeling well right now. A little break would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看來大地現在感覺不錯，稍微歇會兒也好。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
There are four in the work group. Don't forget to tell everyone.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
工作組有四個人，記得通知大家。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks. Can you hear the earth singing? The sound of flowers and trees dancing in the wind. You'll hear it someday.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
謝謝。你聽見大地的歌聲了嗎？那是花草樹木在風中起舞的聲音。總有一天你也會聽見。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
There are three adventurers in the tower still. I understand they have their own reasons, but I can't help worrying about them.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
塔裡還有三名冒險者。我知道他們各有理由，可還是忍不住擔心。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I don't have any responsibility. But the earth will be sad if any of the adventurers gets hurt here.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
這不算我的責任，但要是有冒險者在這裡受傷，大地也會難過。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We should go check if the adventurers are okay.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我們去看看冒險者們是否平安吧。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Should I say it's a relief that they're all alive...? Well...at least it's good that they're still alive.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
該說他們都活著真讓人安心嗎...嗯...至少還活著就好。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I'm glad they're all safe and sound. I'll be relieved if they finish their business quickly and go back...Thanks anyway!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他們都平安無事，真好。要是他們辦完事趕緊回去，我就放心了。總之，多謝你！

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I can't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我幫不了忙

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks so much! Tell Laphines to start working!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
太感謝了！告訴拉菲尼族們開始工作吧！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Do you hear the voice of the earth fading to a whisper? Looks like it's not feeling well today.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
你聽見大地的聲音微弱得像耳語嗎？看來它今天不太舒服。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We should do something to bring cheer to the earth at a time like this!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
這種時候，我們得想辦法讓大地開心起來！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Please, make sure you check how the adventurers are doing. Who knows, you'll get some help from them in the future.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
記得確認那些冒險者的情況。說不定以後會需要他們幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Will you help checking the safety of the adventurers today?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
今天能幫我看看冒險者們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm an adventurer, too!
scripts.translation: 當然，我也是冒險者！

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm kind of tired today.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我今天有點累

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks! Make sure all three of the adventurers are doing well!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
謝謝！確認那三名冒險者都平安無事吧！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Hmm, it's unfortunate, but I guess it can't be helped. I'm worried though, especially for the one who was singing.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
嗯，真遺憾，不過也沒辦法。我還是很擔心他們，尤其是那個唱歌的人。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Hmm...I can't just ignore them though...
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
嗯...可我還是沒法對他們置之不理...

scripts.text: The adventurer on the third floor is starving!
scripts.translation: 三樓的冒險者快餓壞了！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Seriously...I can't believe it's an adventurer. Would you mind giving it some food if you have any?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
真是的...居然會有冒險者餓成這樣。你有食物的話，能分給他一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Let's see...this is all I've got. It's not much, but hopefully it'll help him.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我看看...手邊只有這些。雖然不多，希望能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I should start checking their safety regularly. Stop by again later, please.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我得定期確認他們是否平安。請過一陣子再來。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
And we're trying to stop travelers going into the tower since there are monsters inside.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
塔裡有魔物，所以我們一直在勸旅行者別進去。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But you know, travelers...they want to go even more if it's dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
可你知道，旅行者越聽說危險，越想進去。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
^FF0000three adventurers^000000went into the tower recently. I'm not sure if they're still alive...
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
^FF0000最近有三名冒險者^000000進了塔。我不確定他們還活著沒有...

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I should have tried harder to stop them...Could you go check if they're safe and sound?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我早該更努力地攔住他們...你能去看看他們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: I'll do it! I'm an adventurer, too!
scripts.translation: 我去！我也是冒險者！

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't do it right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在沒法去

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Good. There are three adventurers in the tower right now.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
好。塔裡現在有三名冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's nothing urgent, but I'm worried about the adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
雖然不是什麼急事，可我還是擔心那些冒險者。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The first adventurer went inside just now. He's pretty young and I gave him a good scolding. You'll find him in just a few minutes.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第一名冒險者剛進去沒多久。他挺年輕，我還訓了他一頓。進去幾分鐘就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The second adventurer seemed like an uptight lady. I wonder how she's doing.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第二名冒險者看起來是位嚴肅的女士。不知道她怎麼樣了。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The third adventurer is the problem here...I don't know what he's doing but he's been inside for about a month now.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第三名冒險者最讓人擔心...不知道他在裡面做什麼，已經待了一個月左右。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
He said proudly that he'll be out in a second and took his instrument to make a song inside the tower. But I haven't heard from him since then. Please look for him.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他信誓旦旦地說馬上就出來，還帶著樂器進塔唱歌。可之後就再沒訊息了。請幫我找找他。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
They're all preparing somewhere in the field.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他們都在田野某處準備著。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
You'll be able to hear its story from somewhere if you love flower, trees, and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
如果你喜歡花草樹木和拉菲尼族，或許能在某處聽到這片土地的故事。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I think their work for the field is finished for the day. By the way, ^FF0000there's another work. Ask about it if you're interested.^000000
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他們今天的田野工作應該結束了。對了，^FF0000還有別的工作，感興趣的話可以問問。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I'll introduce myself first. My name is Fili and I'm a Laphine. I do a variety of work in Eclage. You can tell from these muscles, ahng?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
先自我介紹一下，我叫菲利，是拉菲尼族，在埃克拉珠做各種工作。看看我這身肌肉就知道了，昂？

scripts.text: What's up with that 'ahng' sound you make?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼總髮出“昂”的聲音？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's just a habit, don't mind. Anyway, it's time to start the work for the day...you're a traveler, right? Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
只是習慣，別介意。總之，該開始今天的工作了...你是旅行者吧？能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: See what kind of work it is.
scripts.translation: 看看是什麼工作

scripts.text: Tell him you're busy.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你很忙

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng? It's simple. Tell Laphines that are scattered all over the field to start today's work.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
昂？很簡單，告訴散佈在田野各處的拉菲尼族開始今天的工作。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng? Well, too bad. But if you have time later, please drop by. I could use a little help here.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
昂？真遺憾。之後有空的話再來吧，我正好需要人幫忙。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Laphines love this field, and in their own ways, they're sharing their energy with trees, grasses, winds, and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
拉菲尼族熱愛這片田野，會用自己的方式把能量分享給樹木、草地、風和大地。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We're not sure how much it actually helps. They're mysterious creatures, you know.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我們也不知道這到底有多大作用。它們可是神秘的生物。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But we want to try anything that might help.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
但只要可能有幫助，我們都願意一試。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's something that I've been doing by myself usually. But now that my shoulder is injured, I can't really leave this place anymore. Help me, please.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
平時這些事都是我一個人做。可我傷了肩膀，沒法再離開這裡了。拜託你幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But for some reason, I feel like I can't hear them breathing anymore. So, little Laphines water and sing to cheer them up.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
可不知為何，我好像聽不見它們呼吸了。所以小拉菲尼族會澆水、唱歌，讓大地打起精神。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I think it's time for Laphines to start today's work.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我想該讓拉菲尼族們開始今天的工作了。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Whew, did I sing too much? I'm so thirsty. A glass of rice wine sounds great, hah~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
呼，唱太久了嗎？好渴啊。真想喝一杯米酒，哈~

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Did the great Fili send you? Man, he's got skills for sure! I shall start singing then!?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
是偉大的菲利派你來的？他可真有辦法！那我開唱了！？

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I suppose you came to tell me to start working? Don't worry, my voice will touch the earth~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
你是來叫我開工的吧？放心，我的歌聲會打動大地~

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Can you...hear the voice of the earth? It sounds very sad right now.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
你...聽得到大地的聲音嗎？它現在聽起來很悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I'm singing for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
我在為花朵和大地歌唱。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I think it's time to start singing...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
我想該開始唱歌了...

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
It feels great to sing for the earth.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼族]
為大地歌唱真開心。

scripts.text: As soon as the Laphine started singing, it began to warm my heart.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族一開口歌唱，我的心也暖了起來。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I think the earth is running dry.
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
我覺得大地快乾了。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I think this is enough for the day. I have to take a break and draw water, too. Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
今天澆到這裡就夠了。我也得休息一下，去打點水。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'll water these dying flowers and grasses again. This brings them back to life! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
再給這些快枯萎的花草澆澆水，它們就能恢復生機！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'm watering here and there. You look so tired! Should I water you, too?
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
我正在到處澆水呢。你看起來很累，要不要也給你澆一點？

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'm sure Eclage needs a Laphine like me! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
埃克拉珠肯定需要我這樣的拉菲尼族！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Oh, they started working? I'll start watering the earth then. I mean, sometimes we Laphines can be practical, too!
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
哦，他們開工了？那我也來給大地澆水吧。我們拉菲尼族有時也很務實呢！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Do you hear the sound of grasses and flowers coming alive again? It's all because I watered them diligently! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
你聽到花草重新煥發生機的聲音了嗎？這可都是我勤快澆水的功勞！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Hehe~! Now that I'm done watering, I should wait for the great Fili.
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
嘿嘿~水澆完了，該等偉大的菲利來了。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
It's my job to water the earth.
scripts.translation:
[澆水的拉菲尼族]
給大地澆水就是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
You mean the great Fili said to start the work? But why would he ask you to tell us?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
偉大的菲利讓我們開工了？他為什麼不自己來告訴我們？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
It's important to warm up like this before you start dancing. One, two, three, four....
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
跳舞前這樣熱身很重要。一、二、三、四...

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I would love to see the great Fili next time...
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
下次真想讓偉大的菲利看看...

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Ah, it's you again! You're so insensitive. Anyway, you're here to tell me to start working, right? I see, I see. You can go now.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
啊，又是你！真不解風情。你是來叫我開工的吧？知道了，知道了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I can't dance well when adventurers like you are watching! Don't worry and just go~ I won't slack off on the job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
有冒險者看著，我跳不好！放心走吧~我不會偷懶的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
我難過時就跳嘻哈舞。嗯？那是一種舞蹈，很優雅，看了會讓人心疼。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I would really love to see the great Fili next time.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
我真希望能再次見到偉大的菲利。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
When the grasses sway in the wind, doesn't it look like they're actually dancing?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
當草兒在風中搖曳時，看起來是不是就像在跳舞一樣？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I could've showed Fili my new moves!
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
我本可以向菲利展示我的新舞步的！

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Oh well, I'll just do the moves I was doing earlier today. You know, Fili should be the first one to see my new moves, so...
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
算了，我就跳今天早些時候跳的那些舞步吧。畢竟，菲利應該是第一個看到我的新舞步的人，所以...

scripts.text: So, how does dancing help the earth exactly...?
scripts.translation: 跳舞到底是怎麼幫助大地的...？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Look at you, a cold-hearted adventurer! All the Laphines living in this area can feel it. We hear the sounds of the earth and creatures.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
你可真是個冷酷的冒險者！住在這裡的拉菲尼族都能感受到，我們聽得到大地和生靈的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
You'll see as you continue your adventure. Anyway, I'll start working now.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼族]
繼續冒險下去你就會明白了。總之，我要開工了。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Is this the first time that you're seeing a blooming field? It's so beautiful, just like me.
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
你第一次看到鮮花盛開的田野嗎？真美，就像我一樣。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
It takes a cute person like me to bring joy to the earth...Too bad that you'll never be able to do so!
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
只有我這麼可愛的人，才能讓大地開心...可惜你永遠做不到！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You're new, right? Tell him I'll start the work.
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
你是新來的吧？告訴他我這就開工。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
你可能覺得一直對大地微笑很容易，其實沒那麼簡單。首先，要像我這麼可愛就很難啦~

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
I hope someday the flowers, trees, grasses, and little creatures on this earth will smile with joy.
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
希望有一天，地上的花朵、樹木、小草和小生靈都能開心地笑。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Don't you always smile when you remember good memories of the past?
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
想起美好的回憶時，你不也會笑嗎？

scripts.text: I'm here at Fili's request.
scripts.translation: 我是受菲利所託來的

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You mean you were asked a favor from the great Fili? Are you a new worker then?
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
你接受了偉大的菲利委託？那你是新來的幫手嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm an adventurer
scripts.translation: 不，我是冒險者

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Don't be shy. I started working just recently, too. But since I was here first, I'm your boss, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
別害羞嘛，我也是最近才開始工作的。不過我比你先來，所以我是你的老闆，懂嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
So, what's your specialty?
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
那麼，你有什麼特長？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
We all love the earth, but we express it in different ways. Like, thorugh dancing or singing.
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
我們都熱愛大地，只是表達方式不同，比如跳舞或唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Looks like...you're not really good at anything!
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
看起來...你似乎沒什麼特長嘛！

scripts.text: Well, what do you do then?
scripts.translation: 那你是做什麼的？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Oh come on~You're insensitive, too? Look at me, so cute and nice!
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
哎呀~你也太遲鈍了吧？看看我，多可愛、多親切！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
My job is to share my smile with the earth. If I smile like this, I'm sure the earth will feel so much better!
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
我的工作就是把笑容分享給大地。我這樣笑，大地一定會舒服多了！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Anyway, you should find some work for the earth as well. Tell Fili that I'll start working.
scripts.translation:
[可愛的拉菲尼族]
總之，你也該為大地做點事。告訴菲利我開始工作了。

scripts.text: As soon as he finished talking, he put on a bright smile.
scripts.translation: 他說完便露出了燦爛的笑容。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Anyway, this isn't an ordinary place. This place, it's filled with newsworthy stories!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
總之，這裡可不是普通的地方，而是新聞不斷的好地方！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Oh my gosh! You scared me! What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
天哪！你嚇到我了！你在這兒幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
It's you again! Oh, is it because I'm a woman? Let me make it clear here. I'm going nowhere until I get a news item.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
又是你！哦，因為我是女人，你就覺得我不行嗎？我說清楚，在挖到新聞之前我哪兒也不去。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I need to get a scoop. Something that will catch the eyes of adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我得挖到獨家新聞，找到能吸引冒險者目光的大訊息！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
This tower is very quiet yet mysterious. It's definitely something that adventurers would love, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
這座塔既安靜又神秘，冒險者肯定喜歡這種地方，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Gosh, you're just bugging me. Don't worry, I can take care of myself just fine!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
真是的，別煩我了。我能照顧好自己！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Don't worry, I'll get the biggest scoop of the year!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
放心，我一定會挖到年度最大新聞！

scripts.text: Explain the situation
scripts.translation: 解釋情況

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I see...I didn't know they're worried about me. But I can't go back now. I'm a journalist.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
原來如此...我不知道大家這麼擔心我。可我現在不能回去，我是記者。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I write news articles for adventurers for a magazaine called Monthly Brigan.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我在一本叫《月刊佈里根》的雜誌上為冒險者撰寫新聞。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I had a hard time coming here, and I feel like I'll get an exclusive scoop here any minute! But it's just not happening yet...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我費了好大勁才來到這裡，總覺得隨時就能挖到獨家新聞！可現在還沒動靜...

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Anyway, I'm doing well. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
總之，我過得很好。告訴他別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Don't take me lightly just because I'm young. I've already been to every part of Midgard continent. I'm a real adventurer, you know.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
別看我年輕就小瞧我。我已經走遍米德加爾特大陸每個角落了，是真正的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You really shouldn't worry about me. I'll go out when I'm done exploring...Tell him I'm doing okay.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
真的不用擔心我。探索完我就會出去...告訴他我一切都好。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Are you an adventurer, too? Don't you dare cut in here. I was here first.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你也是冒險者？別插隊，是我先來的。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I'm exploring every inch of the tower. I'll write about it in my memoirs later.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我正在探索這座塔的每個角落，以後要把經歷寫進回憶錄。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You want my autograph? If not, please don't interrupt.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你想要簽名嗎？不然就別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
別擔心，我會成為偉大的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
這座塔神秘又有趣。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I shall leave to explore different parts now.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我現在要去探索別的地方了。

scripts.text: What do you mean? I didn't cut in!
scripts.translation: 你什麼意思？我沒有插隊！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Well, I was exploring here first. So you should come back later. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
明明是我先在這裡探索的，你晚點再來吧。我會成為偉大的冒險者！

scripts.text: Explain the situation
scripts.translation: 解釋情況

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Hah, that Laphine must be very idle, worrying about an adventurer. He shouldn't worry about a guy who's going to be the king of adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
哈哈，那個拉菲尼族可真閒，居然擔心一個冒險者。我可是要成為冒險者之王的人，沒什麼好擔心的！

scripts.text: King of adventurers?
scripts.translation: 冒險者之王？

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I'll leave my footprints in every part of the world, find all kinds of treasures and hide them somewhere. Every adventurer will try to follow my path then!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我要走遍世界每個角落，找到各種寶藏再藏起來。到時候每個冒險者都會追隨我的足跡！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
If you get an autograph from me now, you might be able to feed three generations of your family in the future. How does it sound, you want one?
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
現在拿到我的簽名，將來能養活你們家三代人。怎麼樣，要不要？

scripts.text: Never mind, young boy.
scripts.translation: 算了吧，小鬼頭

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You certainly are a poor judge of character! Anyway, tell him not to worry about me. I'll be the king of adventurers! I shall go explore more then.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你真不會看人！總之告訴他別擔心，我會成為冒險者之王！我繼續探索去了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...What a relief...I'm so glad you're here. I was about to leave this tower alone! But I think I'm lost.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
啊...總算鬆了口氣...幸好你來了。我本來想獨自離開這座塔，結果好像迷路了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Good to see you again, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
朋友，很高興又見到你！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
You're done collecting the bookmarks!? Full of reminiscences as expected. Everyone would love it!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
書籤都收集齊了嗎！？果然滿載著回憶，大家一定會喜歡！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Don't worry. I'm pretty much done writing a song. I'm almost done with the lyrics as well as the melody.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
別擔心，我的歌快寫完了，歌詞和旋律都差不多了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I've been thinking about it...and I think they would love ^FF0000bookmarks made of fallen leaves!^000000 It's full of reminiscences of the past! I'm sure!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我想了想...大家一定會喜歡^FF0000用落葉做的書籤！^000000那滿載著過去的回憶！我敢肯定！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Good job! Now, let's enjoy the rest of...No! I mean, let's find a way out!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
幹得好！現在來享受剩下的...不！我是說，快找條出路！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Of course I'm lost because I have a poor sense of direction...but there's another reason to it, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我迷路是因為方向感差...不過還有另一個原因！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Yey it's meat! I loooove meat!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
耶，是肉！我最最最愛肉了！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I guess this is it for me...I had such a good life...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
看來我就要死在這裡了...這一生過得真不錯...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Are you a...human? Cough cough.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
你是...人類嗎？咳咳。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No need to worry about me! ^FF0000I'll definitely go home this time!^000000 Thanks for everything! I'll take you out for a nice meal next time!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不用擔心我！^FF0000這次我一定會回家的！^000000謝謝你幫忙！下次我請你吃頓好的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Are you done yet? Well, I'm still working on the lyrics, too...but you have to hurry up. It's time to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
你弄好了嗎？我還在寫歌詞...不過你得快點，我們該離開了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...I guess this is the fear of death...memories of the past are going through my mind like a flash...like happy moments we had at the south gate of Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
啊...這就是死亡的恐懼嗎...過去的回憶像走馬燈一樣閃過...比如我們在普隆德拉南門度過的快樂時光...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It doesn't have to be delicious...just give me any food...I feel so weak that I can't even walk.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不用好吃的...隨便給我點吃的就行...我虛弱得走不動了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah, I felt so dizzy that my head was spinning before, and now I can't see anything at all! Is it night or day? I'm so hungry...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
剛才我頭暈得天旋地轉，現在什麼也看不見了！這是白天還是晚上？我好餓...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
A glass of red potion for breakfast~another glass of red potion for lunch~you're already addicted~ Ah, I'm too hungry to sing...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
早餐一杯紅色藥水~午餐再來一杯紅色藥水~你已經上癮啦~啊，我餓得唱不動了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm hungry again from walking around so much...I'm so hungry that I can't walk anymore.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
走了這麼多路，我又餓了...餓得連路都走不動。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Did I walk too much? I'm covered with dust again. It keeps covering my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我是不是走太多了？身上又沾滿灰塵，眼睛都快睜不開了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Whew, I guess I was walking around really hard...somehow, I lost all the souvenirs they collected for me...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
呼，我剛才一定走得太急了...不知怎麼的，大家給我的紀念品全丟了...

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're still alive.
scripts.translation: 來看看你還活著沒有

scripts.text: Give him food
scripts.translation: 給他食物

scripts.text: Brush off the dust
scripts.translation: 拍掉灰塵

scripts.text: Gifts for friend
scripts.translation: 給朋友的禮物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It's from that muscular Laphine, right? He's a good guy. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
是那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族送來的吧？他人很好。告訴他不用擔心我。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah, how long has it been since the last time I saw food! Yummm! Thank goodness it's meat! I think it's a little tough...and not warm enough...but still, it's meat!!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
啊，我多久沒吃東西了！真好吃！謝天謝地是肉！雖然有點硬，也不夠熱...但這可是肉啊！！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Food...I need food...It seems as if the sky is falling...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
食物...我需要食物...感覺天都要塌下來了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...I'm so glad that I met a good friend like you.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
啊...能遇見你這樣的好朋友真好。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hey, you really are a good adventurer! I'm actually starting to like you even more.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
嘿，你真是個好冒險者！我越來越喜歡你了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Eek! I was going to get out on my own while you were gone. But then I found something interesting...so I guess I was wandering around a little...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
哎呀！趁你不在時我本想自己出去，可後來發現了有趣的東西...就到處逛了逛...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks! Man, you're awesome! What a desirable and talented individual you are!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
謝謝！你太棒了！真是個迷人又有才華的人！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, come to think of it, I lost the bookmarks you collected for me...I mean the ones made of fallen leaves...I should collect them again...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
對了，我把你收集的落葉書籤弄丟了...得重新收集才行...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
When I came to myself, I realized that everything you brought me was gone! I thought I put it right here!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
回過神來才發現你帶來的東西全不見了！我明明放在這裡的！

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奧茲]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I really liked the meat you brought. Except that it wasn't really well seasoned and the texture was a little crumbly...but...it was still eatable, haha...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我很喜歡你帶來的肉。雖然調味不足，口感也有點散...不過還是能吃，哈哈...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
As you can see...I couldn't find a way out of this tower again. And I'm so hungry that I feel like I might pass out...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
你看...我又找不到離開這座塔的路了。我餓得快暈過去了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ahaha, no need to worry about me! I can do this by myself!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
哈哈，不用擔心我！我自己能搞定！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
These guys are not really visible and they're so annoying. Ah...I asked you to clean up, but it's not because I'm lazy or anything. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
這些傢伙不太顯眼，卻煩人得很。啊，我讓你來清理可不是因為我懶，哈哈...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I think I have enough souvenirs! They'll be surprised to see these souvenirs with lots of memories!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
紀念品應該夠了！朋友們看到這些充滿回憶的東西，一定會很驚喜！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I don't need that many. Maybe one for each of them?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我不用拿那麼多，每人一份就夠了吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I guess I'll have no problem finding my way out of this tower now. I'm full...and I just need to get a few more souvenirs...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
現在我應該能找到出口了。我吃飽了...再收集幾個紀念品就好...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll be fine if only I could get rid of those in my way, haha...We're almost out, right?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
只要把擋路的傢伙弄走就行，哈哈...我們快出去了吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm starving to death though... Could you please help me, my friend?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不過我快餓死了...朋友，能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thank you so much!! Yum yum. You're such a good friend! Munch munch.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
太感謝了！！好吃好吃。你真是我的好朋友！嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should get a hustle on and find a way out now! I feel like I can get out of here this time!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我得趕緊找出口！這次感覺一定能出去！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Cough! Cough! Meat...Cough! Meat...meat...
Seeing his eyes and hearing him coughing constantly, I can tell he needs something to eat, like meat.
scripts.translation: 看他眼神渙散，又咳個不停，應該是餓了，得給他吃點肉。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I thought I was so close to getting out of this tower. But when I looked around, I was at the same place again.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我以為快走出塔了，結果一看，又回到了原地。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Maybe this tower is under a curse.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
這座塔說不定被詛咒了。

scripts.text: Or maybe it's just that you have a poor sense of direction?
scripts.translation: 還是你方向感太差了？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
...I wouldn't really deny that. But anyway, could you get me something to eat? I'm starving...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
...我也不否認。總之，能給我點吃的嗎？我快餓死了...

scripts.text: Alright! I'll be back in a second!
scripts.translation: 好！我馬上回來！

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去找吃的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks. I prefer meat, if possible...I really liked what you gave me last time, and I think acorns go well with meat. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
謝啦。能給肉最好...上次你帶來的東西真不錯，我覺得橡果配肉也很合適。哈哈。

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奧茲]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Okay...I see. I'll try to find another way then. If you meet that muscular Laphine on your way out, tell him I won't be able to see him again...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
好吧...那我再想別的辦法。你出去時要是遇到那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族，告訴他我可能再也見不到他了...

scripts.text: Why don't you just eat whatever I get you!
scripts.translation: 你就吃我帶來的東西吧！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
As long as I'm getting something to eat, I was just hoping for a good one. I'm sorry, but do me a favor please. I couldn't forget the taste of the meat.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
有吃的就行，我只是想吃點好東西。不好意思，再幫我一次吧，我忘不了那肉的味道。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll take care of the rest. I can't just keep bothering you, right? Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
剩下的我自己來，不好一直麻煩你，對吧？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
And then these guys piled up again!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
然後這些傢伙又堆起來了！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Of course I can do it on my own~ But if I do it alone, then I'll end up using too much of my energy, and then I'll get hungry again...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我當然能自己來~可那樣太耗體力，之後我又會餓...

scripts.text: So you want me to help you brushing off the dust?
scripts.translation: 所以你想讓我幫你拍掉灰塵？

scripts.text: Do it yourself then!
scripts.translation: 那你自己來吧！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
How did you know? I think we're really clicking! If I have a chance, I'll let you join my guild later.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
你怎麼知道？我們真有默契！以後有機會，我讓你加入我的公會。

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奧茲]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I see. Just don't feel too guilty if you find me dead next time you're here. It's not your fault.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我知道了。下次你要是發現我死在這裡，也別太自責，不是你的錯。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Fight off some Cherenes then. You don't have to eliminate that many because I'll start fighting soon, too! Haha.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
去打倒幾隻切雷涅斯吧，不用打太多，我很快也會加入戰鬥！哈哈。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I hope to see you again in Midgard! We should team up and begin a great adventure together!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
希望能在米德加爾特再見！到時我們組隊，一起展開偉大冒險！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll make sure to give my friends all the souvenirs you collected for me, and I'll tell them about you, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我會把你收集的紀念品送給朋友，也會告訴他們你的事！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Would you mind helping me with that? What are friends for! Hahaha! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
願意幫我嗎？朋友就是互相幫忙的嘛！哈哈，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm really really sorry, but could you help me again? Just the thought of seeing my friends makes me cry like this. Please~?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
真不好意思，又要麻煩你了。一想到要見朋友，我就忍不住哭成這樣。拜託啦~？

scripts.text: What a poor guy! I'll help him.
scripts.translation: 可憐的傢伙，我幫你

scripts.text: I can't take it anymore!
scripts.translation: 我受夠了！

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奧茲]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Bookmarks made of fallen leaves...Ah, they bring so many memories back and make my eyes teary. I'm sure my friends will love it!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
落葉做的書籤...啊，勾起好多回憶，我都快掉眼淚了。朋友們一定會喜歡！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I see...It's my fault. I'll probably end my life here, collecting souvenirs...but it's none of your business...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我明白了...是我的錯。看來我只能在這裡收集紀念品，直到死去...不過與你無關...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I just finished writing a song. Do you want to listen?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我剛寫完一首歌，想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26On that path again~I was wandering for a while~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^D96E26又走上那條路~我徘徊了好久~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26Familiar dungeon~full of monsters~and hunger in a maze~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^D96E26熟悉的迷宮~滿是魔物~還有揮之不去的飢餓~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26when I was trying to run away~thankfully no monster was there~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^D96E26我正想逃走~幸好那裡沒有魔物~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26but I couldn't make it~that far~I was faint with hunger.^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^D96E26可我沒能走遠~餓得快要暈倒了。^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
So far so good, right? If you think it's similar to another song, it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
目前聽起來還不錯吧？你要覺得像別的歌，那一定是錯覺！

scripts.text: I think it's excellent.
scripts.translation: 我覺得寫得不錯

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before.
scripts.translation: 我好像聽過這首歌

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奧茲]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks! If I have a chance, I'll make a song about how you helped me, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
謝謝！有機會我也會寫首歌，講講你怎麼幫我的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ahaha...really? You might be right...? Oh well, I'll make another one, don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
啊哈哈...真的嗎？也許你說得對...算了，我會再寫一首，別擔心...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should really get going now. I've been to most parts of the tower and I'm pretty full, too.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我真該走了。塔裡大部分地方都逛過了，也吃飽了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks again, my friend! I hope to see you again somewhere. I can find a way out on my own.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
再謝你一次，朋友！希望以後還能再見。我能自己找到出口。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^FF0000By the time you're done collecting souvenirs,^000000 I'll probably be done. Thanks again, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^FF0000等你收集完紀念品，^000000我應該也差不多好了。謝啦，朋友。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
If you look at the books scattered all over the tower, there are bookmarks inside. I think it'll be a great gift for my friends even though it has someone else's memories.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
塔裡散落的書中夾著書籤。雖然上面留著別人的回憶，但我覺得送給朋友會是很棒的禮物。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^FF0000A good melody^000000 just came across my mind, and I think I should start writing a song now. You should collect souvenirs for me in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
^FF0000我剛想到一段好旋律^000000，得馬上寫首歌。你先幫我收集紀念品吧。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
...but then, I feel like something's missing. I should bring some souvenirs since I'll probably never come here again, right?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
...不過總覺得還缺點什麼。既然可能再也不來這裡，不如帶點紀念品回去？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Actually...I feel like my friends would just get mad at me if I go back empty-handed.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
其實...要是空手回去，朋友們肯定會生我的氣。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should bring some souvenirs to make them feel better. Is there anything I could use?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我該帶點紀念品讓他們開心。有什麼合適的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Jellopy
scripts.translation: 傑勒比結晶

scripts.text: Lucky Egg
scripts.translation: 幸運蛋

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Jellopies are good collectables...but I think it's a little too common. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
傑勒比結晶確實適合收藏...不過太常見了。還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Baphomet Card
scripts.translation: 巴風特卡片

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hey... but it's not something we can get around here.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
這個嘛...附近可弄不到。

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hmm? What's that for? I guess new items came out while I was travelling.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
嗯？那是什麼？我旅行期間出新道具了嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I can't get them unless I know what they are. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我都不知道那是什麼，怎麼收集？還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Old Card Album
scripts.translation: 老舊卡冊

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Card Album... I can't give my friends something that might be come up with nothing! Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
卡冊啊...萬一什麼都開不出來，我可沒法送給朋友。還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Loots from local monsters...hmm, that sounds interesting!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
當地魔物的戰利品...嗯，聽起來不錯！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm sure they haven't made it here yet. So it's something new for them, too! Right?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
他們肯定還沒見過這些，對他們來說也是新鮮玩意！對吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
And it tells them where I've been to so far.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
而且還能讓他們知道我去過哪些地方。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
That's a good idea. Let's think about what to collect then.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
好主意。那我們想想收集什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
You see those guys over there? I think they're stopping me from finding a way out for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
看到那邊那些傢伙了嗎？我覺得它們在故意攔著我，不讓我找出口。

scripts.text: I don't see anything.
scripts.translation: 我什麼也沒看到

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No, you have to see them carefully. Those Dustballs over there are covering my eyes, and when I can't see clearly, I get sleepy and hungry...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不，你仔細看。那些塵埃球擋住了我的視線，看不清就會犯困、肚子餓...

scripts.text: I think it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation: 我覺得那是你的錯覺！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No, no. I'm sure they're stopping me. Get rid of them, please. Maybe just a couple of them? I have some lyrics coming into my mind just now...so I should write them down...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不，我確定它們在搗亂。拜託把它們趕走，幾隻就好。我剛想到幾句歌詞，得趕緊記下來...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Yum yum. Munch munch. Yum yum!
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Munch munch. Yum yum yum. Munch munch
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Man, it's so good! This is it! Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
哇，真好吃！就是這個味道！好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
If I find a way out, I should make a song for that muscular Laphine. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
找到出口後，我要給那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族寫首歌。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm not...sure when that would be though...munch munch.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不過...不知道要等到什麼時候...嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Is there a problem?
scripts.translation: 出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, it's nothing. Don't worry. I came into this tower by accident and I got lost. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
沒什麼，別擔心。我是不小心進了這座塔，結果迷路了。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
To tell you the truth, I got lost somewhere about 2 years ago and I traveled around to wherever. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
說實話，我大概兩年前就迷路了，只能到處流浪。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
and then I found this tower and came inside because I thought it'd be fun. But I haven't found a way out since then.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
後來發現這座塔，覺得有趣就進來了，可從那以後一直沒找到出口。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I feel so much better now. Thanks, my friend! This must be a destiny! Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我感覺好多了，謝謝你，朋友！這一定是命運！你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It's kind of sad that I'm actually starving to death...but I had a good time, my beloved guild members...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我快餓死了，真有點難過...不過我過得很開心，我親愛的公會成員們...

scripts.text: I brought some meat from Fili!
scripts.translation: 我從菲利那裡帶了些肉！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, I loooove meat! But...is there any vegetable?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
哦，我超愛肉！不過...有蔬菜嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Like...garnishes for meat, you know. I could get tired of eating just meat...Could you get me some?
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
就是肉的配菜嘛。我怕光吃肉會膩...能幫我找點嗎？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I mean something like acorns! I saw a pile of acorns just outside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
像橡果那樣的東西！我在塔外看到一堆橡果。

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're doing okay.
scripts.translation: 我來看看你還好嗎

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I don't know if I should say I'm okay...or not...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我也不知道自己算不算好...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I haven't eaten anything for days...I feel like I'm going to pass out any minute.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
我好幾天沒吃東西了...感覺隨時都會暈倒。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
But for now, I'm ^FF0000still^000000 alive...but no one knows until when...ah, I'm getting sleepy again...
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
不過我^FF0000還活著^000000...誰知道還能撐多久...啊，我又困了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
You know that Laphine outside...yes, that muscular Laphine...tell him to bring me some food before I die.
scripts.translation:
[新奧茲]
你知道外面那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族吧？讓他在我死前給我帶點吃的。

scripts.text:
You are not wearing the correct equipment
Where is your shield?
scripts.translation:
你沒有穿戴正確的裝備
你的盾牌呢？

New Oz
What you see right now is a regular expression.
scripts.translation:
新奧茲
這是普通表情。

scripts.text:
New Oz
and this is smiling.
scripts.translation:
新奧茲
這是微笑表情。

scripts.text:
New Oz
You want a little more smile?
scripts.translation:
新奧茲
想笑得更開心一點嗎？

scripts.text:
New Oz
This is a hungry expression...
scripts.translation:
新奧茲
這是飢餓的表情...

scripts.text:
New Oz
Confirm and report, okay?
scripts.translation:
新奧茲
確認後告訴我，好嗎？

scripts.text: EEK!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！

scripts.text:
[Briquet toothpick]
Tell me all that you want!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱牙籤]
想說什麼儘管說！

scripts.text: Quest Initialization
scripts.translation: 初始化任務

scripts.text: 20 Star Shape Mushrooms
scripts.translation: 20個星形蘑菇
