scripts.translation: 塗鴉調查前

scripts.text: Right before final compensation
scripts.translation: 最終報酬前

scripts.text:
[Operation Briquet]
There it is!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱行動]
找到了！

scripts.text: [Operation Briquet]
scripts.translation: [布里凱行動]

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the conversation
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
How did you get up here?
You couldn't seem more frail!
Are you a monster that I created?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你是怎麼上來的？
看起來這麼弱不禁風！
難道你是我創造的魔物？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Busy, busy, busy! Monsters, I have to create more monsters!
Danger! I don't know when attack will come!
It's coming! It's all coming!
Like a tsunami!!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
忙死了！我得創造更多魔物！
危險！不知道敵人什麼時候會來！
它來了！全都來了！
像海嘯一樣！！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
This is my portrait?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
這是我的畫像嗎？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
There's not enough ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 !
I was trying to do something at the time with 20 mushrooms. If you don't bring me enough,
I may not be able to remember enough either!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
^FF0000星形蘑菇^000000不夠！
我當時正用20個蘑菇做實驗。你要是不帶夠，我也沒法回憶起多少！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You brought me 20 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
Yes, yes, it feels like my memory is about to burst back!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你帶來了20個^FF0000星形蘑菇^000000。
對，對，我的記憶好像快回來了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You studied all of the doodles?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你把所有塗鴉都調查過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Hey monster, thanks to you I think my memory is returning bit by bit.
But why did I get stuck in this tower?
And for what reason did I put Bifrost to sleep?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
嘿，魔物，多虧了你，我的記憶一點點恢復了。
可我為什麼會困在這座塔裡？
又為什麼讓彩虹橋沉睡了？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Did you find all Diary Frogs?
You only found three?
Did all the rest just get destroyed?
I should have thrown them a little more gently... 
Thanks a lot. Thanks to you, I found my portrait and got back some of my memories.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
日記青蛙都找齊了嗎？
只找到三隻？其他的都毀了嗎？
我當時應該輕點扔的...
多謝你幫忙！你幫我找到了畫像，也讓我恢復了一些記憶。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Thanks a lot for helping me remember.
But nothing is still all that clear.
I'm so curious, that it angers me, but I don't have any more Diary Frogs to throw...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
多謝你幫我回憶。
可事情還是不清楚。
我好奇得快發火了，卻沒有別的日記青蛙可以扔...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
這個房間的書架上有很多書，我的畫像夾在其中一本里。幫我找找！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Every wall has so much doodling.
It looks like my writing. I must have done it.
Please take a look at five different walls, analyze what I doodled, and let me know what you find.
I'm so curious, so curious that all my memories might float away.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
每面牆都畫滿了塗鴉。
看起來像我的筆跡，肯定是我畫的。
請檢視五面不同的牆，看看我都畫了什麼，再來告訴我。
我好奇得快忘掉所有記憶了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I threw one Diary Frog to the floor right below.
While you go look for that one I'll try to remember where I threw the others.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我把一隻日記青蛙扔到樓下去了。
你去找找，我再想想其他幾隻被我扔到哪兒了。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I just remembered! I threw one Diary Frog to the first floor of the tower.
It sure rolled around and about.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
想起來了！我把一隻日記青蛙扔到塔的一樓了。它肯定滾得到處都是。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I just remembered! I threw one Diary Frog so recklessly, and it just kept on rolling and disappeared out of the tower.
It must still be around the tower somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
想起來了！我隨手扔了一隻日記青蛙，它一路滾出了塔。應該還在塔附近。

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I have a job for you, so strengthen yourself to the level of an incubus and then return to me!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我有事交給你。先把自己練到魅魔的程度再回來！

scripts.text: What's coming?
scripts.translation: 接下來會發生什麼？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Please tell me about Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 告訴我彩虹橋的事

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
EEEK!
How did you get up here? I kept many monsters around the tower!
There's no way anyone could have invaded it! That means, you... you are!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
哎呀！
你怎麼上來的？我在塔周圍放了那麼多魔物！
沒人能闖進來才對！難道你...你是！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
這問題可難倒我了。幾百年前我明明還記得清清楚楚，現在卻全忘了。
如今我只能做最拿手的事：
製造魔物，再把它們放出去。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Bifrost? It's sleeping.
It's in a deep sleep.
I might also be sleeping a lot later..
It's going to be my turn next!
No, no! I can't just be the one to take it.
Monsters, I have to let more monsters loose!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
彩虹橋？它睡著了。
睡得很沉。
我以後可能也要睡很久...
下一個就輪到我了！
不行，我不能坐以待斃。
魔物！我得再放出更多魔物！

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Are you a monster that I created?
You have to be!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你是我製造的魔物嗎？
你一定是！

scripts.text: I want to know about the tower.
scripts.translation: 我想知道這座塔的事

scripts.text: It's a talking worm!
scripts.translation: 這是一隻會說話的蟲子！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
A tower? What tower?
This was a tower?
Why am I in a tower?
It's been so long that I forgot everything!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
塔？什麼塔？
這裡是塔嗎？
我為什麼在塔裡？
過了太久，什麼都忘了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why am I a bug?
You monster!
Just because I made you without much effort are your eyes just that much deficient?!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我怎麼變成蟲子了？
你這魔物！
就因為我隨手把你造出來，你就覺得我的眼光這麼差嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
這是個很難回答的問題。
直到幾百年前我還記得，但現在我完全想不起來了。
我現在只能做我最擅長的事。
製造魔物，然後放它們出去。

scripts.text: Professor Worm probes his own face and becomes shocked. He sees his own face through the silver plate and is really shocked.
scripts.translation: 沃姆教授摸摸自己的臉，驚訝不已。他從銀盤裡看到自己的倒影，更是大吃一驚。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
When did my handsome face become like this? My name is...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我英俊的臉怎麼變成這樣了？我叫...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Professor Worm!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沃姆教授！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's right!
Wait, no that's not it..
My goodness, I even forgot the name!
Don't just stand there please go and find my portrait!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
對！
不，不對...
天啊，我連名字都忘了！
別愣著，快去找我的畫像！

scripts.text: I'm busy!
scripts.translation: 我很忙！

scripts.text: Why should I!
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要幫你！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You came all the way up here in your free time and you are telling me you're busy?!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你利用空閒時間特意跑到這裡來，卻告訴我你很忙？！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well, you have to be curious.
While my memory got worse my intuition improved so much!
If you want to hear what you want to hear help me get my memory back!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你肯定很好奇。我的記憶雖然越來越差，直覺倒是敏銳多了！
想知道答案就幫我恢復記憶！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
這是個很難回答的問題。
直到幾百年前我還記得，但現在我完全想不起來了。
我現在只能做我最擅長的事。
製造魔物，然後放它們出去。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在這個房間書架上的許多書中，我的畫像被夾在某處作為書籤。請找到它！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
This is how I used to look?
...
Oh yeah, it is me!
But how did I become like this?
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我以前長這樣？
...
對，是我！
可我怎麼變成這樣了？
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I am remembering something vaguely...
The weather, the landscape at the time...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我隱約想起了一些事...
當時的天氣、那裡的景色...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I... yeah, it was a land with many blooming flowers where I was collecting something... That's right!
I was collecting some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我...對了，那是個繁花盛開的地方，我在那裡採集東西...沒錯！
我在採集^FF0000星星香菇^000000！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why was I doing that....
Hey monster, if you go to the land of many blooming flowers and bring me some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000,
I might remember everything you see!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我當時為什麼要採那個...
嘿，魔物，去繁花盛開的地方幫我找些^FF0000星星香菇^000000，我說不定就能想起更多！

scripts.text: Please just try to remember things now.
scripts.translation: 現在就試著回想一下吧

scripts.text: I'll bring them back for you.
scripts.translation: 我幫你帶回來

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well, I even forgot my name and I can't remember anything right now!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我連自己的名字都忘了，現在怎麼可能想起來！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
From the land of blooming flowers bring me 20 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
I think monster 'Petal' would usually roam with them in their mouths.
You couldn't expect me to remember things with just a few mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
去繁花盛開的地方給我帶20個^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
花瓣怪蟲嘴裡通常叼著這種蘑菇。
就帶幾個回來，你還指望我想起多少事？

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 should be easily found through finding Petals roaming the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
去繁花盛開的地方找花瓣怪蟲，應該很容易弄到^FF0000星星香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I was using these as ingredients for... some potions!
It wasn't for anything good though...
I had other ingredients too...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我把這些當作製作...某些藥劑的原料！
不過並不是為了什麼好事...
我還有其他原料...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Before I forget, I should make note of these things on the wall. Wait...
Who doodled so much on this wall?!
The writing is just like mine!
... I must have done it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在我忘記之前，我應該把這些事情記在牆上。等等...
誰在這面牆上畫了這麼多塗鴉？！
字跡跟我的一模一樣！
...一定是我畫的！

scripts.text:
Every wall is filled with Professor Worm's notes.
If I study the walls carefully I might be able to gain some information on the tower or Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
每面牆上都寫滿了沃姆教授的筆記。
如果我仔細研究這些牆壁，也許能獲取一些關於中央塔或彩虹橋的資訊。

scripts.text: The contents of the doodles were analyzed and reported to the professor.
scripts.translation: 塗鴉的內容被分析並報告給了教授。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I see. I was producing medicines to put Bifrost to sleep. For that, I was punished and transformed into a worm and my memories deteriorated so rapidly.
Let me think about this for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我明白了。我當時正在製造讓彩虹橋入睡的藥物。為此，我受到了懲罰，變成了一條蟲子，記憶也迅速衰退。
讓我想想這件事。

scripts.text: Don't ask me that!
scripts.translation: 別問我！

scripts.text: Think harder!
scripts.translation: 再努力想想！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
How dare a monster irritate its creator!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
一隻魔物竟敢惹怒自己的創造者！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Ahhhh, my head feels like it's about to explode.
I should make more notes on the wall.
Wait, there are no more spaces on the wall!
Who doodled so much on the walls?
Is it you, monster?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
啊，我的頭快炸了！
我得在牆上多寫些筆記。
等等，牆上沒地方了！
是誰畫了這麼多塗鴉？
是你嗎，魔物？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I guess I would have to write a diary then...
Oh that's right, I used to keep a diary!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
看來我得寫日記了...
對了，我以前寫過日記！

scripts.text: What did you do with a diary again?
scripts.translation: 你以前用日記做什麼來著？

scripts.text: Show it to me.
scripts.translation: 拿給我看看

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I must have written things that I should have never forgotten!
Why are you so sarcastic, anyways?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我肯定記下了那些絕不能忘的事！
話說你怎麼這麼愛挖苦人？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well.. It's not an ordinary notebook... I used a ^0000FFDiary Frog^000000 which is a frog that can record things.
Everytime I was really mad, I threw it all over the place, so they all scattered.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
嗯...那不是普通筆記本。我用的是^0000FF日記青蛙^000000，能記錄事情的青蛙。
我每次氣急了就把它們扔得到處都是，所以全散落了。

scripts.text: What a temper you have!
scripts.translation: 你脾氣可真大！

scripts.text: Should I find the Diary Frog?
scripts.translation: 我去找日記青蛙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why don't you try living imprisoned yourself?
If you were in my place you wouldn't just throw some frogs, but the entire household!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你自己試試被關起來是什麼滋味！換作是你，恐怕不只扔幾隻青蛙，連整個家都要砸了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I threw them all over the place.
If they didn't scatter too much I'm sure they're still around somewhere.
Let me see, maybe I can remember a few...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我把它們到處亂扔了。
只要沒滾太遠，應該還在附近。
讓我想想...也許能記起幾處...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's right, I threw one Diary Frog to the floor right below.
While you go look for that one,
I'll try to remember where I threw the others.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
對了，我把一隻日記青蛙扔到樓下去了。
你去找找，我試著回憶其他幾隻的下落。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
But nothing is still all that clear.
I'm so curious, that it angers me, but I don't have any more Diary Frogs to throw...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
事情還是不清楚。
我好奇得快發火了，卻沒有別的日記青蛙可以扔...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I'll try to figure out other ways to get back my memory. And when I do please help me again.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我再想別的辦法恢復記憶。想起來後，還得請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I'll try to figure out other ways to get back my memory. And when I do, please help me again.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我再想別的辦法恢復記憶。想起來後，還得請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
It seems like it's somewhere here.
Let's look closer.
scripts.translation:
它好像就在附近。
仔細找找吧。

scripts.text: Every book is bookmarked with some memos and pictures. It might just be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation: 每本書裡都夾著備忘紙條或圖片，也許就在這一帶。

scripts.text:
Found it!
...or not. It's just a doodle.
Let's look around here a little more.
scripts.translation:
找到了！
...才怪，只是張塗鴉。
再仔細找找。

scripts.text:
Just a ton of random things.
Let's look through anything and everything.
scripts.translation:
全是亂七八糟的東西。
我們仔細翻翻看。

scripts.text: Found the portrait!
scripts.translation: 找到畫像了！

scripts.text:
He looked totally different.
With so much flamboyance he seems he used to be a magician full of vanity.
Unfortunately, the paper is too worn out that the name has been erased.
scripts.translation:
畫像上的他和現在完全不同。
穿著華麗，看起來像個自負的魔法師。
可惜紙張磨損嚴重，名字已經看不清了。

scripts.text: Let's show this to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 把畫像拿給沃姆教授看看。

scripts.text: Professor Worm's portrait has been found.
scripts.translation: 找到了沃姆教授的畫像。

scripts.text: Since Professor Worm's portrait is found there is no need to search through the books anymore.
scripts.translation: 已經找到沃姆教授的畫像，不必再翻書了。

scripts.text: Let's go show it to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 去把畫像拿給沃姆教授看。

scripts.text: Don't read it!
scripts.translation: 別讀！

scripts.text: Read it.
scripts.translation: 閱讀

scripts.text: It doesn't seem very interesting at all!
scripts.translation: 看起來一點意思也沒有！

scripts.text: Read through the notes.
scripts.translation: 閱讀筆記

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: Read it again.
scripts.translation: 再讀一遍

scripts.text: It's not like it needs to be memorized so I'll just stop reading.
scripts.translation: 不用特地背下來，還是不讀了。

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
I succeeded in putting Bifrost to sleep.
I am just so amazing!
But why do I have to remain in a place like this, too?
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 {0}]
我成功讓彩虹橋沉睡了。
我真是天才！
可我為什麼也得待在這種地方？

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
It hasn't been too long since I was imprisoned in the tower, but my memories are leaving me so rapidly.
It may be Bifrost's strong will to stay awake that is affecting me this way.
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 {0}]
我被關進塔裡還沒多久，記憶卻消失得飛快。
也許是彩虹橋強烈的求生意志影響了我。

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
My appearance is changing!
My hands, my skin...
This is without a doubt the form of a worm!
I can't believe I'm changing into a worm..
How could this be!
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 {0}]
我的外表變了！
我的手、我的皮膚...
毫無疑問，我正在變成蟲子！
我不敢相信自己會變成蟲...怎麼會這樣！

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
Bifrost's head is still growing continuously. I can't believe this... She's keep stretching beyond the tower!
Could it be her strong will, is still awake and is trying to send a message?
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 {0}]
彩虹橋的樹冠還在不斷生長，我簡直不敢相信...她已經長得比塔還高！
難道是她的意志仍然清醒，正試圖傳遞什麼資訊？

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
The person who will be under attack after Bifrost is none other than me!
I feel an eerie gaze directed at me!
I can't just sit here and take it.
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 {0}]
彩虹橋之後，下一個遭殃的就是我！
我感覺有股詭異的視線盯著我！
我不能坐以待斃。

scripts.text: [Wall Note {0}]
scripts.translation: [牆上的留言 {0}]

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 2]
I wonder if I'll forget even my name... How it worries me...
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 2]
我會不會連自己的名字都忘了...真讓人擔心...

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 3]
Is this also because of Bifrost?
Is it Bifrost's curse against me for putting her to sleep?
Is it doing this to me while it's asleep?
I can't believe it... My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 3]
這也是彩虹橋造成的嗎？
是她因為我讓她沉睡而詛咒我嗎？
她睡著了還要這樣對我？
我不敢相信...天啊！

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 5]
Monsters, I have to create more monsters to protect me. As many as I could possibly create!
scripts.translation:
[牆上留言 5]
魔物！我得製造更多魔物保護自己，能造多少就造多少！

scripts.text:
The wall is filled with Professor Worm's notes. 
It seems like some of it can be read.
scripts.translation:
牆上貼滿了沃姆教授的筆記。
有些內容似乎還看得清。

scripts.text: Professor Worm's notes on this wall have already been read.
scripts.translation: 這面牆上的沃姆教授筆記已經讀過了。

scripts.text:
The wall is filled with 
Professor Worm's notes.

scripts.translation:
牆上貼滿了沃姆教授的筆記。
有些內容似乎還看得清。

scripts.text: Professor Worm's notes on this wall have already been read.
scripts.translation: 這面牆上的沃姆教授筆記已經讀過了。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
Professor Worm threw me out here.
He used to chuck us out anytime he was furious.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
沃姆教授把我扔到這裡來了。
他以前一生氣就把我們全扔出去。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
Are you interested in the diary recording?
I don't have much else to do so would you like to hear it again?
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
你想聽日記錄音嗎？
我也沒什麼事做，要不要再聽一次？

scripts.text: A talking frog?
scripts.translation: 會說話的青蛙？

scripts.text: I want to listen to Professor Worm's diary.
scripts.translation: 我想聽沃姆教授的日記

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
I am a frog made of wood that can be used for recording.
I'm a masterpiece by Professor Worm.
Sheer loneliness can lead to inventions such as this, isn't it amazing?
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
我是一隻用來錄音的木製青蛙。
我是沃姆教授的傑作。
孤獨竟能催生這樣的發明，很神奇吧？

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
I'll let you listen to it like the real thing.
I have to imitate Professor's Worm's voice so I have to shape my throat first...
Erhem Erm... Keerhm Cough Cough!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
我會盡量逼真地放給你聽。
得先模仿沃姆教授的聲音，調整一下喉嚨...
咳嗯、咳嗯...咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
Are you interested in the diary recording?
I don't have much else to do so would you like to hear it again?
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
你想聽日記錄音嗎？
我也沒什麼事做，要不要再聽一次？

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 3]
...He really feared Bifrost!
He said that she needs to be eliminated because one day she will endanger him.
He sure said it, that person! Ahhhh~ I can't remember him- that person!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙3號逼真的日記錄音]
...他真的很害怕彩虹橋！
他說必須消滅她，因為她遲早會威脅到自己。
那個人肯定這麼說過！啊...我想不起那個人了！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
This is the end of the recording.
Another Diary Frog probably got thrown onto the first floor of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
錄音到此結束。
另一隻日記青蛙大概被扔到塔的一樓了。

scripts.text: Where are other Diary Frogs?
scripts.translation: 其他日記青蛙在哪裡？

scripts.text: Please let me hear it again.
scripts.translation: 再放一次給我聽

scripts.text: Is there any more?
scripts.translation: 還有別的內容嗎？

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
{0} probably got thrown onto the first floor of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
{0}大概被扔到塔的一樓了。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
I'll let you listen to it like the real thing.
I have to imitate Professor's Worm's voice so I have to shape my throat first...
Erhem Erm... Keerhm Cough Cough!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
我會盡量逼真地放給你聽。
得先模仿沃姆教授的聲音，調整一下喉嚨...
咳嗯、咳嗯...咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.3]
I used to have more, but unfortunately, the fuel I need to live is the recordings themselves, so part of it got digested away.
It's the way I work so I can't do much about it.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙3號]
我原本還記得更多，可我賴以生存的燃料就是錄音本身，所以有些內容被消化掉了。
這是我的運作方式，也沒辦法。

scripts.text: [Diary Frog No.3]
scripts.translation: [日記青蛙 3號]

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 3]
...He really feared Bifrost!
He said that she needs to be eliminated because one day she will endanger him.
He sure said it, that person! Ahhhh~ I can't remember him- that person!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙3號的寫實日記]
...他真的很害怕彩虹橋！
他說必須消滅它，因為總有一天它會威脅到他。
他確實這麼說了，那個人！啊...我想不起來他...那個人了！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.6]
Professor Worm was looking for me?
I thought he threw me out because he didn't need me!
He threw me realy hard, he did!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
沃姆教授在找我？
我還以為他不需要我了，才把我扔出去！
他扔得可真用力！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.6]
You got rid of 15 ^FF0000Lichtern(blue)^000000.
Now I can relax a little bit.
As I promised, I'll let you hear the diary.
I have to imitate Professor's Worm's voice so I have to shape my throat first...
Erhem Erm... Keerhm Cough Cough!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
你消滅了15個^FF0000元素鬼火(藍)^000000。
現在我可以稍微放鬆一下了。
正如我答應你的，我會讓你聽日記。
我得模仿沃姆教授的聲音，先調整一下喉嚨...
呃哼...咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.6]
Do you want to listen to the diary again?
I'll let you hear it as much as you want!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
你想再聽一遍日記嗎？
你想聽多少遍都可以！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.6]
Professor Worm dared to throw me out here!
To a place where there are so many monsters!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
沃姆教授竟敢把我扔到這裡！
這裡有這麼多魔物！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No.6]
If you return to me after getting rid of 15 ^FF0000Lichtern(blue)^000000
I'll let you listen to Professor Worm's diary as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
消滅15個^FF0000元素鬼火(藍)^000000後再來找我，我就讓你隨意聽沃姆教授的日記。

scripts.text: [Diary Frog No.6]
scripts.translation: [日記青蛙 6號]

scripts.text: You look fine.
scripts.translation: 你看起來沒事

scripts.text: Please calm down and let me hear the diary.
scripts.translation: 請冷靜下來，讓我聽聽日記

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
You would only understand if you were abandoned like I am!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
只有像我一樣被拋棄過的人才能理解！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Why are you interested in other people's diaries?
If you do me a favor, I'll let you hear it.
Among the many monsters Professor Worm let loose, ^FF0000Lichtern(blue)^000000 keep trying to bite me.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
你為什麼對別人的日記感興趣？
幫我個忙，我就讓你聽。
沃姆教授放出的魔物裡，^FF0000元素鬼火(藍)^000000一直想咬我。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
I am always living in anxiety.. Who would've thought that the life of a Diary Frog would be so hard?
If you return to me after getting rid of 15 ^FF0000Lichtern(blue)^000000
I'll let you listen to Professor Worm's diary as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
我總是生活在焦慮中...誰能想到日記青蛙的日子這麼難熬？
消滅15個^FF0000元素鬼火(藍)^000000後再來找我，我就讓你隨意聽沃姆教授的日記。

scripts.text: That's a tough favor!
scripts.translation: 這要求太苛刻了！

scripts.text: I'll get rid of them.
scripts.translation: 我會消滅它們的

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Well, then I won't say a word about the diary!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
好吧，那我就不提日記的事了！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Ok, be on your way now.
You know, right? The recordings I have serve as the fuel I need to live.
You should be haste before all of it gets digested away.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
好了，快去吧。
你知道嗎？我儲存的錄音是我活下去的能量來源。
趁它們還沒被消化掉，趕快回來。

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 6]
Let's put Bifrost to sleep.
He told me to remain here and control her sleep.
If she awakes, it would be my fault.
It has already been many decades.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙6號的寫實日記]
讓彩虹橋沉睡吧。
他讓我留在這裡，控制她的睡眠。
如果她醒來，那就是我的錯。
這已經持續了好幾十年。

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 6]
It enrages me! How irritating!
I want to just awaken her!
Wait... Who do I need to awaken again?
A frog? What is this?
Do I have to wake you up?
Oh whatever, I'm going to throw you out!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙6號的寫實日記]
真讓我火大！煩死了！
我真想直接把她叫醒！
等等...我要叫醒誰來著？
青蛙？這是什麼？
我要把你叫醒嗎？
算了，我要把你扔出去！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
This is the end of the recording.
And that's when I was thrown out all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
錄音到此結束。
就在那時，我被一路扔到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Another Diary Frog would be outside the tower somewhere.
If nothing took it away, you'll probably find it without much difficulty.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
另一隻日記青蛙應該在塔外的某處。
如果沒被什麼東西帶走，你應該不難找到它。

scripts.text: Where are other Diary Frogs?
scripts.translation: 其他日記青蛙在哪裡？

scripts.text: Please let me hear it again.
scripts.translation: 請讓我再聽一遍

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Another Diary Frog would be outside the tower somewhere.
If nothing took it away, you'll probably find it without much difficulty.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
另一隻日記青蛙應該在塔外的某處。
如果沒被什麼東西帶走，你應該不難找到它。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
I'll let you hear it loud and clear!
I have to imitate Professor's Worm's voice so I have to shape my throat first...
Erhem Erm... Keerhm Cough Cough!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
我會讓你聽得清清楚楚！
我得模仿沃姆教授的聲音，先調整一下喉嚨...
呃哼...咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 6]
Let's put Bifrost to sleep.
He told me to remain here and control her sleep.
If she awakes, it would be my fault.
It has already been many decades.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙6號的寫實日記]
讓彩虹橋沉睡吧。
他讓我留在這裡，控制她的睡眠。
如果她醒來，那就是我的錯。
這已經持續了好幾十年。

scripts.text:
[Realistic diary recording by Frog No. 6]
It enrages me! How irritating!
I want to just awaken her!
Wait... Who do I need to awaken again?
Onetwothreefourfivesixseveneightninetenonetwothreefourfivesixseven
A frog? What is this?
Do I have to wake you up?
scripts.translation:
[青蛙6號的寫實日記]
真讓我火大！煩死了！
我真想直接把她叫醒！
等等...我要叫醒誰來著？
一二三四五六七八九十，一二三四五六七
青蛙？這是什麼？
我要把你叫醒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 6]
Oh whatever, I'm going to throw you out!
This is the end of the recording.
And that's when I was-
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 6號]
算了，我要把你扔出去！
錄音到此結束。
就在那時，我被——

scripts.text: Where are other Diary Frogs?
scripts.translation: 其他日記青蛙在哪裡？

scripts.text: Please let me hear it again.
scripts.translation: 請讓我再聽一遍

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
They were either eaten up by monsters or severely broken after being thrown out.
I doubt there are other remaining frogs.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
它們要麼被魔物吃掉了，要麼被扔出去後嚴重損壞了。
我懷疑沒有其他倖存的青蛙了。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I'll let you listen to Professor Worm's diary with a well composed voice.
Let me first shape my throat here...
Erhem.... Prrhaaha!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
我會用沉穩的聲音為你播放沃姆教授的日記。
先讓我調整一下喉嚨...
呃哼...噗哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This tower possesses amazing secrets!
How incredible, oh so incredible!
After hundreds of years, I finally figured it all out! How could this be!
It is so shocking that I forgot everything that I ever knew!
scripts.translation:
[30號的日記記錄]
這座塔隱藏著驚人的秘密！
太不可思議了，簡直太不可思議了！
經過數百年的研究，我終於弄明白了一切！怎麼會這樣！
這太令人震驚了，我把自己知道的一切都忘了！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This damned frog!
I'm so mad, I ought'a throw this out!
scripts.translation:
[30號的日記記錄]
該死的青蛙！
我氣死了，真該把它扔出去！

scripts.text: It seems that a continued search for diary recordings would be meaningless. I should go back to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 看來繼續尋找日記記錄也沒意義了。我該回去找沃姆教授。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
As you can see, I am a broken Diary Frog.
Professor Worm threw me out really hard all the way out here.
I didn't even do anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
如你所見，我是一隻損壞的日記青蛙。
沃姆教授把我一路狠狠地扔到了這裡。
我明明什麼都沒做錯！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I need 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
They can be obtained from Petals that roam the land of blooming flowers.
Please hurry.
Before I lose all of the diary recordings!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
我需要10個^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
在花海之地遊蕩的花瓣怪蟲會掉落這種蘑菇。
請快一點，趁我還沒丟光所有日記記錄！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
You brought all 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 for me.
I have to first treat my wounds, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
你給我帶來了10個^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
我得先處理傷口，請稍等。

scripts.text: [Diary Frog No. 30]
scripts.translation: [日記青蛙 30號]

scripts.text: You look fine.
scripts.translation: 你看起來沒事

scripts.text: Please calm down and let me hear the diary.
scripts.translation: 請冷靜下來，讓我聽聽日記

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Come over here please. Let me break one of your legs.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
請過來，讓我打斷你一條腿。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I got hurt when I was thrown out that I don't have the energy to playback the diary recording.
To help me repair myself, please bring me 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 from the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
我被扔出去時受了傷，現在沒有能量播放日記。
幫我修復身體的話，請從花海之地帶來10個^FF0000星星香菇^000000。

scripts.text: Just walk it off.
scripts.translation: 自己活動活動就好了

scripts.text: I'll bring them for you.
scripts.translation: 我幫你帶來

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Then, all I can let you hear are my moans and groans.
ARGGGGGG!!!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
那我只能讓你聽聽我的呻吟聲了。
啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 can be obtained from Petals that roam the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
在花海之地遊蕩的花瓣怪蟲會掉落^FF0000星星香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Do you know this?
My recordings give me the fuel I need to live.
If you come back to late, all you'll hear are my moans and groans.
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
你知道嗎？
我的錄音是我活下去的能量來源。
你要是回來得太晚，就只能聽到我的呻吟聲了。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Nibble nibble
Glug glug
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
咔嚓咔嚓
咕嚕咕嚕

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I feel all better.
I'll let you listen to Professor Worm's diary with a well composed voice.
Let me first shape my throat here...
Erhem.... Prrhaaha!
scripts.translation:
[日記青蛙 30號]
我感覺好多了。
我會用沉穩的聲音為你播放沃姆教授的日記。
先讓我調整一下喉嚨...
呃哼...噗哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This tower possesses amazing secrets!
How incredible, oh so incredible!
After hundreds of years, I finally figured it all out! How could this be!
It is so shocking that I forgot everything that I ever knew!
scripts.translation:
[30號的日記記錄]
這座塔隱藏著驚人的秘密！
太不可思議了，簡直太不可思議了！
經過數百年的研究，我終於弄明白了一切！怎麼會這樣！
這太令人震驚了，我把自己知道的一切都忘了！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This damned frog!
I'm so mad, I ought'a throw this out!
scripts.translation:
[30號的日記記錄]
該死的青蛙！
我氣死了，真該把它扔出去！

scripts.text: It seems that a continued search for diary recordings would be meaningless. I should go back to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 看來繼續尋找日記記錄也沒意義了。我該回去找沃姆教授。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
I've gone through Hazy Forest Maze and come all the way here just to see Eclage and I really don't want to go through that maze ever again.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
我穿過迷霧森林迷宮，一路來到這裡只為看看埃克拉珠，實在不想再走一遍那座迷宮了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
It horrifies me just thinking about returning to the camp after visiting Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
一想到參觀完埃克拉珠後還得穿過迷宮返回營地，我就害怕。

scripts.text: Eclage?
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠？

scripts.text: Easy way to return to the camp
scripts.translation: 返回營地的捷徑

scripts.text: pat pat...
scripts.translation: 拍拍...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Huh? You didn't know it yet?
Eclage is the capital of the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
咦？你還不知道嗎？
埃克拉珠是拉菲尼族的首都。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Hmm? I mean, you could fly there using the mysterious seeds that you collected in the maze.
You mean, I have to jump off the huge flower?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
嗯？你可以用在迷宮裡收集到的神奇種子飛過去。
你是說，要我從那朵巨大的花上跳下去？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Are you consoling me?
It's so nice of you...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
你是在安慰我嗎？
你人真好...

scripts.text: [Expedition Member]
scripts.translation: [遠征隊成員]

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Many Laphine and travellers come to Mora Village from Eclage for various reasons such as transporting goods and so on...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
許多拉菲尼族人和旅行者會因為運送貨物等各種原因，從埃克拉珠來到穆拉村...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Since you're here, you should go there, too.
I mean, like...for sightseeing!!
Head north from Bifrost and you'll see it.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
既然你都來了，不妨也去那裡看看。
我是說...去觀光！！
從彩虹橋往北走就能看到。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
So, it's hard to get in, but not as hard to get out.
I didn't know there would be such a way.
Haha. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊成員]
原來如此，進去很難，出來倒沒那麼難。
我都不知道還有這種辦法。
哈哈，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Excuse me for a moment.
Is there anyone from Splendide here?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
打擾一下。
這裡有來自輝煌領域的人嗎？

scripts.text: I am, but why?
scripts.translation: 我就是，怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Ah, you are?
There's someone who wants to see you. Do you have time right now?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
啊，是你啊。
有人想見你。你現在有空嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
You don't have to worry. It's nothing suspicious or bad.
We just wanted to ask you about Splendide, so please spare your time for us.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
別擔心，沒什麼可疑或不好的事。
我們只是想向你打聽輝煌領域的情況，請抽出一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I'll guide you if it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
如果沒問題的話，我來帶你去。

scripts.text: Sure. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好的，走吧

scripts.text: I don't have time for it right now...
scripts.translation: 我現在沒時間...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
那就請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, is that right?
That's too bad. 
But if you have some time later, please pay us a visit.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
哦，是這樣嗎？
真遺憾。
之後有空的話，請來找我們。

scripts.text: [Eclage Guard]
scripts.translation: [埃克拉珠衛兵]

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I'll be at the east side of the place near the gate.
Please, find me there.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
我會在靠近大門的東側等你。
請到那裡找我。
期待與你見面。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Mm? You're a traveler, too?
You mean, you're going to travel through Eclage with that little skill you have?
The fact that you made it here actually seems just short of a miracle...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
嗯？你也是旅行者嗎？
你是說，就憑你那點本事也要穿越埃克拉珠？
你能來到這裡，簡直就是奇蹟...

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Oh my, did I talk too much?
But you're really lucky.
If you tell them that you're here to congratulate on the birth of new Mayor Jun, you'll surely meet the great Kardui.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
哎呀，我是不是說太多了？
不過你真的很幸運。
告訴他們你是來祝賀卡爾杜伊成為新市長的，他們一定會讓你見到他。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Ah...how beautiful.
I heard some bad rumors but I don't believe in them at all~
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
啊...真美。
雖然聽到了一些不好的傳聞，但我完全不信～

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Ha, I almost went too far again.
Did you talk to Litrip and York?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
哈哈，我又差點說漏嘴了。
你和利特里普、約克談過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
When it comes to Bifrost Tower, which is the most popular tourist attraction, Litrip knows the best!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
說到最熱門的旅遊景點——彩虹橋高塔，利特里普最瞭解了！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Come here and have a talk with us.
My name is Fome and I'm from the central region of Alpheim.
You are...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
過來和我們聊聊吧。
我叫弗梅，來自阿爾海姆中部。
你是...？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
An Eclage Guard was looking for you just a minute ago, right?
I think he said he'll be waiting for you at the east gate. Don't you have to go?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
剛才有位埃克拉珠衛兵在找你，對吧？
我記得他說會在東門等你。你不該過去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
You've been working for the king of Laphines all along?!
How could you not say a word about it to me?
I want to be able to meet the king often, too.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
你一直在為拉菲尼族的國王效力嗎？！
怎麼不早點告訴我？
我也想經常見到國王。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
You seem very busy.
I heard so much about you from here and there.
I see that you're friends with Laphines already.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
你看起來很忙。
我到處都聽到了關於你的傳聞。
看來你已經和拉菲尼族人成為朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I'm sure there is something.
It seemed from my observation that they were anxious while celebrating the birth of the king.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
他們肯定有什麼心事。
據我觀察，他們慶祝新王誕生時顯得很焦慮。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I should start planning on moving to the next region. 
I'm debating whether I should just go back or go to Mora Village...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我該開始計劃前往下一個地區了。
我在猶豫是回去還是去穆拉村...

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Wait, let me guess!
You're a member of the famous Midgard expedition, right?!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
等等，讓我猜猜！
你是著名的米德加爾特遠征隊成員，對吧？！

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: How did he know?
scripts.translation: 他怎麼知道的？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Well, it's simple.
There's no one who looks like you or dresses like you around Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
這很簡單。
埃克拉珠裡沒有人像你這樣打扮。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I heard the ways to Bifrost are blocked by a strange rift and soon, travelers who came here through the Hazy Forest started to appear.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我聽說通往彩虹橋的路被一道奇怪的裂縫堵住了，之後便陸續有旅行者穿過迷霧森林來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
They are humans who came from Midgard passing through Jotunheim!
Seriously...I'm glad I came to Eclage.
I didn't expect to meet a person from Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
他們是來自米德加爾特、途經約頓海姆的人類！
說真的...我很慶幸來到了埃克拉珠。
沒想到能遇到來自米德加爾特的人！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Eclage is crowded with travelers, and until recently, most of them were from Alpheim.
It's nice to see you. I was about to talk to you just now.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
埃克拉珠擠滿了旅行者，直到最近，他們大多來自阿爾海姆。
見到你真好，我剛才正想和你聊聊。

scripts.text: Why is Eclage popular among travelers?
scripts.translation: 為什麼埃克拉珠在旅行者中很受歡迎？

scripts.text: What is the main attraction of Eclage?
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠的主要景點是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Why does this place have so many travelers...?
First of all, I think it's due to the fact that you're able to communicate freely here since Eclage is with Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
為什麼這裡有這麼多旅行者...？
首先，我覺得是因為埃克拉珠與彩虹橋相連，大家可以在這裡自由交流。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
The main attraction of Eclage?
It's Bifrost Tower, of course!
Although It's not inside Eclage, technically! Ahhahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
埃克拉珠的主要景點？
當然是彩虹橋高塔！
雖然嚴格來說它不在埃克拉珠境內！啊哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: [Fome]
scripts.translation: [弗梅]

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Thanks to Bifrost's will, everyone is able to communicate with no problem here just like you and I right now.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
多虧了彩虹橋的意志，大家才能像你我現在這樣毫無障礙地交流。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Second, it's because Eclage is the end and the gateway of Alpheim.
It's the only way to get to Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
其次，埃克拉珠是阿爾海姆的盡頭，也是通往約頓海姆的門戶。
這是前往約頓海姆的唯一道路。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
A great number of travelers who admire the unknown world come to Eclage.
Also, they want to see Bifrost, which connects Jotunheim and Alpheim, with their own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
許多向往未知世界的旅行者都會來到埃克拉珠。
他們也想親眼看看連線約頓海姆和阿爾海姆的彩虹橋。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Moreover, the biggest reason why Eclage is so crowded recently is...!!!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
而且，最近埃克拉珠如此擁擠，最主要的原因是...！！！

scripts.text: It is...?!

[Fome]
A new Mayor Jun was born!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
新市長卡爾杜伊上任了！

scripts.text: Whosa whatsits?
scripts.translation: 誰家的什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
No, no, Mayor Jun. It's a Laphine name.
It's a...right, it means a 'king.'
The King is born!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
不是不是，是卡爾杜伊。這是拉菲尼族的稱呼。
意思是...對，就是“國王”。
新王誕生了！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Although he is pretty old, he became a king.
As the king of Laphines, he is so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
他雖然年紀不小，卻成了國王。
身為拉菲尼族的國王，他真是美極了。

scripts.text: When was that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼時候的事？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Mm? Maybe 10 years ago?
5 years ago? Or 15? Anyway, it's less than 100 years.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
嗯？大概是10年前？
5年前？還是15年前？總之不到100年。

scripts.text:
This traveler named Fome is going on forever about the king of Laphines.
It seems as if she doesn't care about others and is sinking into her own world, so it's hard to understand what she's talking about.
Let's talk to other travelers.
scripts.translation:
這位名叫弗梅的旅行者一直喋喋不休地談論拉菲尼族的國王。
她似乎沉浸在自己的世界裡，不太在意別人，讓人很難聽懂她在說什麼。
還是去和其他旅行者聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I've come here just recently, so I didn't have a chance to go outside Eclage.
Whew, it's kind of scary.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我剛來這裡不久，還沒機會去埃克拉珠外面看看。
呼，有點嚇人呢。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Bifrost Tower is...oh, right.
Litrip has been there, right? Ask Litrip about it!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
彩虹橋高塔...啊，對了。
利特里普去過那裡，對吧？去問問他吧！

scripts.text:
A traveler named Litrip seems to know about Bifrost Tower.
Let's go talk to him.
scripts.translation:
名叫利特里普的旅行者似乎知道彩虹橋高塔的事。
去和他談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Since he was very polite and all, I'm sure it's something good.
Sure. The Laphines in Eclage are very generous to travelers.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
他那麼有禮貌，想必是個好人。
是啊，埃克拉珠的拉菲尼族人對旅行者很慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I've seen him only once when I was congratulating him, and I only said few words...
Seriously~ I remember how beautiful he was.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我只在向他祝賀時見過他一次，只說了幾句話...
天哪～我記得他長得真好看。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
But it seems like Laphines aren't all that delighted to see their king.
Why is that? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
但看起來拉菲尼族人並不太高興見到他們的國王。
這是為什麼？你知道些什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I couldn't ask them straightforward questions related to that since I was afraid that it might hurt their pride.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我擔心會傷害他們的自尊心，所以不敢直接問。

scripts.text:
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favorable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
據你所知，拉菲尼族人表面上對卡爾杜伊頗為友善。
可實際上，大多數人對他感到不安、懷疑，也不信任他。
別光擔心，直接去問卡爾杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Fome said is interesting.
A distrusted king...should I listen to what other Laphines say about it?
scripts.translation:
弗梅說的話很有意思。
一個不受信任的國王...要不要再聽聽其他拉菲尼族人怎麼說？

scripts.text: A group of travelers of Alpheim are having a conversation.
scripts.translation: 一群來自阿爾海姆的旅行者正在交談。

scripts.text: Avoid them.
scripts.translation: 避開他們

scripts.text: Join the group.
scripts.translation: 加入他們

scripts.text: They don't seem to care that much.
scripts.translation: 他們似乎不怎麼在意。

scripts.text:
When you approach, they stop talking for a second and make a seat for you.
Start a conversation.
scripts.translation:
你走近時，他們停頓了片刻，為你讓出一個位置。
開始交談。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Hey, young man.
It's very impressive that you're able to come this far...
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
嘿，年輕人。
你能來到這麼遠的地方，真令人佩服...

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
It's not fun listening to my story only.
You should go talk to Fome and Chiba, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
只聽我一個人的故事可沒意思。
你也去聽聽弗梅和千葉怎麼說吧。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
And Let me know if you ever solve the mystery of Bifrost Tower.
I'll be looking forward to hearing from you, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
如果你解開了彩虹橋高塔的秘密，記得告訴我。
我很期待聽到你的訊息，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Oh, look at this strange traveler. 
Come here. My name is Litrip.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
哦，看看這位奇怪的旅行者。
過來吧，我叫利特里普。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
The celebratory atmostphere for the new king is almost gone now.
But something feels weird here.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
慶祝新王登基的熱鬧勁兒差不多已經散了。
不過這裡總覺得有些不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
It seems like Laphines have some official affairs to do with you. 
Didn't they tell you to come to the east gate?
You should go.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
看來拉菲尼族有公務要和你談。
他們沒讓你去東門嗎？
快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Weren't you supposed to meet someone at the east gate?
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
你不是該去東門見人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Since the last time I saw you talking to the guard, I hear your name here and there. 
Is it something important? You've become pretty famous here.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
自從上次看到你和衛兵交談後，我就到處聽到你的名字。
是什麼重要的事嗎？你在這裡可出名了。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
I'm thinking about going to the tower again with Chiba.
I heard it's got a nice view.
If I'm lucky enough, I'll go to Mora, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
我正打算再和千葉去一次高塔。
聽說那裡的風景不錯。
要是運氣好，我還會去穆拉。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
You're from Mora?
You must have seen Bifrost Tower on the way then?
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
你來自穆拉？
那你一定在途中見過彩虹橋高塔吧？

scripts.text: I saw it from the outside.
scripts.translation: 我從外面看過

scripts.text: I've gone inside the tower.
scripts.translation: 我進過塔裡面

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
I see. Wasn't it pretty crazy?
Once upon a time, It used to be a very nice observatory.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
是嗎？是不是很壯觀？
很久以前，那裡曾是一座景色絕佳的觀測臺。

scripts.text: [Litrip]
scripts.translation: [利特里普]

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Really? That's too bad.
Well, but it's good to play it safe since there are frightful monsters inside the tower.
It's certainly better than losing your life by being rash.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
是嗎？真遺憾。
不過塔裡有很多可怕的魔物，謹慎一點總是好的。
總比魯莽行事丟了性命強。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Although it's occupied by horrible monsters now.
Seeing that you went into the tower and came out unharmed, I can tell you're pretty skilled.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
不過現在塔裡到處都是可怕的魔物。看你能進去又平安出來，身手一定不錯。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
There's a rumor that a suspicious alchemist resides on top of the tower.
No one knows why, but I heard he's been there for a good while.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
聽說塔頂住著一位來歷可疑的鍊金術士。沒人知道原因，不過他似乎在那裡待了很久。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
If that alchemist is still alive, he could be a living history himself since the tower, the alchemist, and Bifrost have existed even before Eclage was founded.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
如果他還活著，本身就稱得上一段活歷史了。畢竟這座塔、那位鍊金術士和彩虹橋，在埃克拉珠建成前就已存在。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
A good number of people still challenge themselves to find the mysterious legend of Bifrost Tower but so far, none of them succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
許多人都想揭開彩虹橋塔的神秘傳說，至今卻沒人成功。

scripts.text: What about Laphines?
scripts.translation: 那拉菲尼族呢？

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Hmm, Laphines?
For some reason, they're not interested in Bifrost Tower at all. 
I think they perceive it just as a natural object.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
拉菲尼族嗎？
不知為何，他們對彩虹橋塔毫無興趣。
在他們看來，那大概只是自然景觀。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
They're actually more than capable of solving the mystery if they wanted to but I feel like they're just respecting the existence of Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
他們真想查的話，肯定有能力解開謎團。但我覺得他們只是尊重彩虹橋塔的存在。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
However, they don't necessarily stop people from going into the tower, either. So I'm thinking maybe they're just not aware of it.
If you're curious, go challenge yourself and solve the mystery of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
不過，他們也沒阻止別人進塔，所以可能只是沒意識到這件事。
你好奇的話，不妨親自去挑戰，解開塔的謎團。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
My story ends here.
Go ask Fome and Chiba. They should have useful information, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
我的故事就講到這裡。
再去問問弗梅和千葉吧，他們或許也有有用的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Just like a feeling of emptiness that comes after an exciting festival...
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
就像熱鬧慶典散場後，那種悵然若失的感覺...

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Although I prefer traveling alone,
I don't mind having some company in dangerous areas.
But you...Hmm...I don't think you're skilled enough to travel around this area.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
我雖喜歡獨自旅行，但在危險的地方有個伴也不錯。
不過你嘛...嗯...實力似乎還不足以在這附近旅行。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I know Laphines perform a huge ceremony for the succession of kingship but I don't know exactly what the ceremony is about.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
我知道拉菲尼族會舉行盛大的王位交接儀式，但不清楚儀式具體是怎麼回事。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
It's a rare opportunity to see the ceremony with your own eyes since Mayor Jun lives pretty long.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
君市長壽命很長，所以能親眼見到這場儀式的機會相當難得。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
You're a human from Midgard.
I'm Chiba.
As you can see, I'm a traveler just like you.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
你是來自米德加爾特的人類。
我叫千葉。
如你所見，我也是個旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Wasn't there an Eclage Guard looking for you just now?
You'd better respect Laphines as much as possible in order to avoid any discord.
It's the basis of traveling.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
剛才是不是有位埃克拉珠衛兵在找你？
為了避免衝突，儘量尊重拉菲尼族，這是旅行的基本原則。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Didn't you go somewhere with an Eclage Guard?
If you're lost on the way, ask the guard at the east gate. 
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
你剛才是不是跟埃克拉珠衛兵走了？
要是迷路了，就去東門問衛兵，他會帶你過去。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
So, you weren't a mere traveler after all.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
看來你並非普通的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Mm...should I try to go through Hazy Forest?
Maybe it's too much...isn't it?
I'll just go to the tower with Litrip again.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
嗯...要不要試著穿過迷霧森林？
或許太勉強了吧？
我還是和利特里普再去一次塔好了。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I think local area information is the most important when traveling. 
You think so, too?
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
我覺得旅行時最重要的是瞭解當地情況。
你也這麼認為吧？

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I heard there's a way to avoid a rift that is blocking Jotunheim...
Do people really travel through Hazy Forest?
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
我聽說有辦法繞過阻斷約頓海姆的裂隙...
真的有人會穿過迷霧森林嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: By magic!
scripts.translation: 靠魔法！

scripts.text: [Chiba]
scripts.translation: [千葉]

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
So it is.
That's how strong humans are, I guess.
When I was Mora, I heard there are many missing men in Hazy Forest...
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
原來如此。
人類果然很厲害。
我在穆拉聽說，迷霧森林裡有很多人失蹤...

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Indeed...people who get to Mora first use magic to help others travel?
That's brilliant.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
真的？先抵達穆拉的人會用魔法幫助其他人通行？
真聰明。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Anyway it's true that there are active interactions thanks to you people.
I should be grateful for that.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
總之，多虧了你們，這裡才有這麼頻繁的往來。
我應該感謝你們。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Do you want to know something more interesting?
Everyone in Alpheim knows about it, but I'm sure you people have never heard about it.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
想聽點更有趣的事嗎？
阿爾夫海姆人人都知道，但我敢說你們肯定沒聽過。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Among Laphines, have you seen the taller ones with especially bright skin and gorgeous wings?
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
你見過那些特別高挑、膚色明亮、翅膀華麗的拉菲尼族嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
They're the 'Donas.' By the way, normal-looking Laphines are called 'Papang' in their language. 
It sounds like some kind of a snack, but well, we should respect them.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
他們叫“多納族”。普通外貌的拉菲尼族則叫“帕潘族”。
聽起來像零食，不過還是尊重他們比較好。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
The reason Donas are taller and gorgeous is because they're all candidates for Mayor.
That is, they all have a chance of becoming the king.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
多納族身材高挑、外表華麗，是因為他們都是市長候選人。
也就是說，每個人都有機會成為國王。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
We're not talking about upper class or lower class here. They are classified according to their job.
It might not be important, but it's good to know about it as a foreigner.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
這不是階級高低之分，而是按職責分類。
作為外來者，瞭解一下也沒壞處。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Anyway, Donas have strong magical powers and they live longer. But since there are not many of them most of them are assigned to important positions. 
Who knows? It might be good to win their favor. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
總之，多納族魔力強、壽命長。人數又少，所以大多擔任要職。
說不定和他們打好關係會有幫助呢，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
The throne of the king of Laphines seems to be inherited by blood, but it isn't in reality.
Mayor Jun is known to emerge among the Donas but it's just exactly that.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
拉菲尼族的王位看起來像是血統繼承，實際上並非如此。
據說君市長會從多納族中誕生，但也僅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
He literally just emerges without any kind of a formal inheritance process.
Isn't it pretty interesting?
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
他就這麼出現了，沒有任何正式的繼承儀式。
是不是很有意思？

scripts.text:
You received information related to Laphines from Chiba. 
Let's go talk to other travelers.
scripts.translation:
你從千葉那裡得知了拉菲尼族的相關資訊。
接下來去和其他旅行者談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
If I came earlier, I could have become a part of a historic moment...
but I missed it. Kekeke.
scripts.translation:
[千葉]
要是我早點來，說不定就能見證歷史時刻了...
可惜錯過了。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, I should hurry and go back to where I was. 
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
哦，我得趕緊回崗位了。
失陪。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Eh, good to see you again.
We should have introduced ourselves earlier if we knew we would run into each other so often like this.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
啊，又見面了。
早知道會這麼常碰面，我們該早點自我介紹的。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I'm Minuel.
It's such a common name. I don't even know what it means.
I think my parents just gave me a name that is easy on the ear.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我叫米努埃爾。
這名字很普通，我也不知道是什麼意思。
大概是父母覺得讀起來順口才取的。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, I heard the news.
You've decided to work in Eclage...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
對了，我聽說了訊息。
你決定留在埃克拉珠工作...

scripts.text: It's just a rumor.
scripts.translation: 那只是傳聞

scripts.text: Do they have a job for me?
scripts.translation: 有適合我的工作嗎？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Actually I don't have any time for myself since I have to be here all the time.
Not only I, but most Laphines who are in this business are faced with that position, too.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我得一直守在這裡，幾乎沒有自己的時間。
不只是我，大多數做這份工作的拉菲尼族也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
對了，你也幫了其他拉菲尼族不少忙。
這些已經足夠了。現在去見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Eh? Really?
That's too bad. There was a suitable job for you.
Well, I understand.
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
咦？真的嗎？
真遺憾，本來有份適合你的工作。
好吧，我明白了。
[米努埃爾]
對了，你也幫了其他拉菲尼族不少忙。
這些已經足夠了。現在去見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我身邊的拉菲尼族都很喜歡我用魔物素材裝飾的雅伊。
說不定會成為新潮流。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Eh? Really?
That's too bad. There was a suitable job for you.
Well, I understand.
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
咦？真的嗎？
真遺憾，本來有份適合你的工作。
好吧，我明白了。
我身邊的拉菲尼族都很喜歡我用魔物素材裝飾的雅伊。
說不定會成為新潮流。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
So, we don't have any time to decorate our Yai. 
Of course we could buy the materials. But just like any other consumers, we would like to gather them on our own.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
所以我們沒空裝飾自己的雅伊。
當然可以買材料，不過就像其他人一樣，我們更想自己收集。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Since you're free to go anywhere,
could you gather some decorations for Yai?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
既然你能自由行動，能幫忙收集一些裝飾雅伊的材料嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Thank you.
You need to find
5 Horns of Hillslion, 5 Magical Powers, and 5 Horse's Hooves each.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
謝謝。
請各找5個希斯利安之角、魔力之角和馬蹄。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I would like to decorate it with unpolished beauty.
You can get the materials by hunting the monsters near Splendide, where I'm not supoosed to go.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我想用未經雕琢的自然之美來裝飾它。
去我不能去的輝煌領域附近打獵，就能找到這些材料。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I've heard some rumors about Hillslions, and they seem to appear in Sapha's areas.
Their horns, Mystic Horns of Cornuses that live in the grasslands and something called Horse's Hooves.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我聽說過希斯利安，它們似乎出沒在薩法族的區域。
還要找生活在草原上的科努斯之魔力之角，以及馬蹄。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I'm sure you would know more about those hooves than I do.
I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
你肯定比我更瞭解馬蹄。
就拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Ha, do you really think so?
You will be coming here again.
Soon, in the near future. Hehehe
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
哈，你真這麼想？
你還會再來的。
很快，就在不久之後。呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You are here already!
Let me check the items.
Mm...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
你來了！
讓我檢查一下材料。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I asked you for 5 Horns of Hillslion, 5 Mystic Horns, and 5 Horse's Hooves.
You'll be able to get Mystic Horns by catching Cornuses near Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我請你找各5個希斯利安之角、魔力之角和馬蹄。
輝煌領域附近的科努斯身上能找到魔力之角。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
If they are scratched fittingly, they will look even wilder. 
These are great. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
只要適當刮磨，就會顯得更狂野。
這些真棒，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
對了，你也幫了其他拉菲尼族不少忙。
這些已經足夠了。現在去見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Soon, you'll be able to hear good news.
You should look forward to it.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
很快就會有好訊息。
等著瞧吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
My job is to deliver his will at the right time.
And I think now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我的職責是在適當的時候傳達他的意思。
我想現在時機到了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I think I've grown attached to you since I was seeing you very often.
Well, I'm just saying how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
經常見到你，我好像漸漸喜歡上你了。
嗯，我只是說說自己的感受。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
對了，你也幫了其他拉菲尼族不少忙。
這些已經足夠了。現在去見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
My job is to deliver his will at the right time.
And I think now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我的職責是在適當的時候傳達他的意思。
我想現在時機到了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I think I've grown attached to you since I was seeing you very often.
Well, I'm just saying how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
經常見到你，我好像漸漸喜歡上你了。
嗯，我只是說說自己的感受。

scripts.text:
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
我身邊的其他拉菲尼族都迷上了我用魔物素材裝飾的雅伊。
這也許會成為新潮流。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Welcome to Eclage.
Enjoy your trip.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
歡迎來到埃克拉珠。
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, you are here!
May I escort take you to the one who wants to meet you?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
哦，您來了！
要我帶您去見那位想見您的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I thought you sill had something to do.
May I guide you?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
我還以為您有事要辦。
需要我帶路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see you pretty often.
I was notified in advance that the Chief of Staff requested for an audience.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
最近常見到您。
我已接到通知，參謀長想召見您。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
May I escort you to the audience chamber?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
要我帶您去會客廳嗎？

scripts.text: [Eclage Guard]
scripts.translation: [埃克拉珠衛兵]

scripts.text: Sure. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好，走吧

scripts.text: I don't have time for it right now...
scripts.translation: 我現在沒空...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
Ah...is that right?
I'll wait then.
scripts.translation:
啊...是嗎？
那我在這裡等您。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Don't worry about me.
I'll just wait here as long as it takes.
Well, it's my job. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
別擔心我。
我會一直在這裡等著。
這是我的工作，不用擔心。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，麻煩你

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Is that right?
I see. Come find me whenever you need it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
這樣啊。
有需要時再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
But I'm afraid it's too early.
I think you have to wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
恐怕還太早了。
我想您還得再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Since it's about time, should I lead you in now?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
時間差不多了，要我現在帶您進去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，麻煩你

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Follow me, please.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Do as you wish although Mayor Jun might be upset if you keep him waiting for too long.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
請便。不過要是讓君市長等太久，他可能會不高興。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，麻煩你

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Follow me, please.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Thank you.
I thought you were using me for teleportation since you're here so often.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
謝謝。
您常來這裡，我還以為您只是把我當傳送工具呢。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Mayor Jun wants to see you.
I don't have time to guide you right now, so I'll just tell you how to get there.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
君市長想見您。
我現在沒空帶您過去，就告訴您怎麼走吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Are you on your way from the palace again?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
您又從宮殿那邊過來？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Hey, what a strong and pleasant morning it is!
Wait, is it morning?
Anyway, you seem so healthy just like a fresh-caught fish.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
早晨真是神清氣爽！
等等，現在是早晨嗎？
總之，您看起來精神十足，像條剛釣上來的魚。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You need to find 10 Horns of Hillslion, 10 Mystic Horns, and 10 Horse's Hooves.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
請找10個希斯利安之角、10個魔力之角和10個馬蹄。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You are here already!
Let me check the items.
Mm...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
你已經來了！
我來檢查一下材料。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Do you have a minute?
My friends love the by products of monsters that you brought me the other day and I was going to ask you if you could get some more. Is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
你有空嗎？
我的朋友們很喜歡你上次帶來的魔物素材，能不能再幫我收集一些？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Good to see you again.
The Chief of Staff? You have to go upstairs through the spiral road to see him.
He's inside the conference hall, which is on the right side of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
很高興又見到您。
參謀長嗎？沿著螺旋通道上樓，就能找到他。
他在宮殿右側的會議廳裡。

scripts.text: [Minuel]
scripts.translation: [米努埃爾]

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I have to decorate Yai with the materials you brought me the other day, but I don't know when I could leave...
I hope time passes as quickly as possible.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我得用你上次帶來的材料裝飾雅伊，可不知道什麼時候才有空...
真希望時間快點過去。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Go through the exit here, go up twice following the spiral road, and you'll find the entrance to the audience chamber.
This way please.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
從這裡出去，沿螺旋通道上兩層，就能找到會客廳入口。
請往這邊走。

scripts.text: A scholar of magics sponsored by Shenime
scripts.translation: 由謝尼梅資助的魔法學者

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Is the Chief of Staff sponsoring a scholar of magics?
I had no idea...Now that I think about it...ah...that's why...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
參謀長資助了一位魔法學者？
我完全不知道...仔細想想...啊...難怪...

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
When he gets off work,
I saw him going to the east side pretty often.
His Yai is on the opposite side, but often I saw him heading east.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
他下班後，我常看到他往東邊去。
他的雅伊明明在另一邊，卻總往東走。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
So I thought maybe he has someone to meet there.
Now that I think about it, wouldn't that someone be the scholar that he is sponsoring?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
我還以為他是去見什麼人。
這麼說來，那人會不會就是他資助的學者？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Of course it's just my guess...
But I'm glad if this could help you by any chance.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
當然這只是我的猜測...
不過能幫上你就好了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Mm? What's that look for?
A traveler from Mora told me that it's a popular way of saying hello...Did I say something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
嗯？您這是什麼表情？
穆拉來的旅行者說這是流行的問候方式...我說錯了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Oh, by the way, the decorations you brought are very popular among other Laphines. 
I might have to ask you another favor later.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
對了，你帶來的裝飾品在其他拉菲尼族中很受歡迎。
以後可能還得再麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
If they are scratched fittingly, they will look even wilder. 
These are great. My friends will love it!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
適當地刮出紋路，會讓它們顯得更狂野。
這些真不錯，我的朋友們一定喜歡！

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text: Fine. I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好，我來幫忙

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
That's too bad.
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
真遺憾。
那下次吧！

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Thank you so much.
The Horns of Hillslion, Mystic Horns, and Horse's Hooves that you brought were just so popular among my friends.
I would like you to bring me 10 of each, please.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
太感謝了。
你帶來的希斯利安之角、魔力之角和馬蹄，在我朋友中很受歡迎。
請再各帶10個來。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Decorating Yai wildly and with unpolished beauty became a new trend among my friends.
Haha...I'll be waiting here, then.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃爾]
用狂野而自然的美感裝飾雅伊，在我朋友中成了新潮流。
哈哈...我就在這裡等你。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Chief of Staff]
Sorry, but no unauthorized entry is allowed here.
scripts.translation:
[參謀長]
抱歉，未經許可不得入內。

scripts.text:
[Chief of Staff]
Welcome to Eclage.
I order them to lead you here.
scripts.translation:
[參謀長]
歡迎來到埃克拉珠。
我讓他們帶您過來的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm in charge of the military supplies that are sent to the outpost of Splendide.
My name is Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我負責管理運往輝煌領域前哨站的軍需品。
我叫謝尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Our supplies sent to Mora Village...
oww...I'm sorry. I've been having this headache recently...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我們送往穆拉村的補給...
啊...抱歉，我最近一直頭痛。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, I've heard that there are people
who deliver our supplies to Splendide through Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
總之，我聽說有人會穿過迷霧森林，把我們的補給送到輝煌領域。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's so good to see you in person. 
People who are clever enough are already trying hard to build relationships with Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
很高興見到你。
有遠見的人已經在努力和埃克拉珠建立關係了。

scripts.text: So, I'm not the first one?
scripts.translation: 所以，我不是第一個？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Yes, you're not...oww...
But it doesn't matter.
You humans are already doing so much for Splendide and us.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
沒錯，你不是第一個...啊...
不過沒關係。
你們人類已經為輝煌領域和我們做了很多。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh, the reason I'm frowning is because of this headache.
Don't get me wrong.
Um..anyway, to go on with my story...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我皺眉只是因為頭痛，別誤會。
嗯...總之，繼續說正事...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
We are supposed to welcome you.
Should I get to the point now? I mean, the reason why I wanted to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我們本該好好歡迎你。
現在說正題吧，也就是我想見你的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
As you know already, we're disconnected from Splendide due to the accident in Bifrost.
And for us Laphines, it's hard to go against the will of the forest and Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
如你所知，彩虹橋發生事故後，我們與輝煌領域失去了聯絡。
對我們拉菲尼族而言，很難違背森林和彩虹橋的意志。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm sure every fairy in Alpheim feels the same, too.
Anyway, I want to know what's going on in Splendide and Jotunheim nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我相信阿爾夫海姆的妖精們也有同感。
總之，我想了解輝煌領域和約頓海姆最近的情況。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I heard the battle against Manuk has recently calmed down to the point of a truce...
and it could have been that they didn't get supplies in time.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我聽說與馬努克的戰事最近已緩和到停戰的程度...
也可能是他們沒能及時收到補給。

scripts.text: You've answered Shenime's serious questions and describe the situation as far as you could remember.
scripts.translation: 你回答了謝尼梅的問題，並儘可能詳細地描述了自己記得的情況。

scripts.text: Now that I think about it...
scripts.translation: 這麼一想...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What is it?
What you've told me is going to be very helpful.
Is there anything else you would like to talk about?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
怎麼了？
你剛才說的對我很有幫助。
還有什麼想談的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was told that Sapha made Yggdrasil Tree sick,
and your side started a war in order to protect the tree
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說薩法族讓世界樹生病，你們為了保護世界樹而發動了戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
but what I know is a little bit different from that.
Apparently, the cause of the war seems to be the damage given to Yggdrasil Tree caused by Sapha's excessive mining, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過我所知道的有些不同。
戰爭似乎是因為薩法族過度採礦，損害了世界樹...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Wait, stop there.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
等等，先別說了。

scripts.text: What's the matter?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This war is like a holy war for us.
It's a war that we carry on upon our honor and dignity.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這場戰爭對我們來說如同聖戰。
我們是為了榮譽與尊嚴而戰。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
So whatever the truth you know is,
if you're not going to hold responsibility for the backlash it might bring,
don't say anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
所以不管你知道什麼真相，如果不打算承擔它可能帶來的後果，就別說出來。

scripts.text: Why are you trying to hide the truth...
scripts.translation: 你為什麼想隱瞞真相...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This is a matter between Yggdrasil the world-ash and its protector.
Mayor Jun should be the one listening to your story, not me.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這是世界樹與其守護者之間的事。
該由君市長聽你說，而不是我。

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
My work is done here.
What I'm saying is that I'm not the one to clear up your question.
I'll arrange a meeting with Mayor Jun for you.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我的職責到此為止。
我是說，我無法解答你的疑問。
我會替你安排與君市長會面。

scripts.text:
In the middle of the conversation, Shenime stopped talking and frowned as if he was having a headache again.
After massaging his head for a while, he looked much better and continued to go on.
scripts.translation:
談話中，謝尼梅突然停下來，皺著眉，像是又頭痛了。
他揉了揉頭，稍微好些後繼續說下去。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Promise me that you will not tell anyone 
about the truth that you believe.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
答應我，別把你認定的真相告訴任何人。

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Yes, I promise.
scripts.translation: 是的，我保證

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You put me on the spot.
I don't want you to be the cause of friction.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你真讓我為難。
我不希望你成為引發紛爭的導火索。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Can't you just keep it to yourself before discussing the matter with Mayor Jun?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
在和君市長談過之前，能不能先把這件事保密？

scripts.text: No, I can't!
scripts.translation: 不行，我做不到！

scripts.text: Fine, I won't tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我不會告訴別人

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I see that you've made up your mind.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
看來你已經下定決心了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh well...
It's your loss..
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
唉...
那是你的損失。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'll arrange a meeting to let Mayor Jun get to know you.
You need to wait a little bit. Please bear with us.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我會安排你和君市長會面。
請稍等一會兒，耐心等候。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'll notify the guard that brought you here.
Go find the guard after some time. 
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我會通知帶你來的衛兵。
過一會兒去找他，他會帶你過去。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Until then, I hope you have a good time.
I'll send you to the plaza.
By the way, the guard who is going to lead you will be at the east gate. Don't forget the time.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
在那之前，祝你玩得愉快。
我會送你到廣場。
負責帶路的衛兵會在東門，記得按時去找他。

scripts.text: Shenime is pressing his head with a hand and seems to be having a headache.
scripts.translation: 謝尼梅用手按著額頭，看起來頭痛得很厲害。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This headache has gotten worse recently.
....What brings you here?
Didn't Mayor call you?
You should go talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
最近頭痛越來越嚴重了。
...你來這裡做什麼？
不是市長找你嗎？
去和他談談吧。

scripts.text: Shenime held his hand out with a suspicious smile.
scripts.translation: 謝尼梅帶著懷疑的笑容向你伸出手。

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，還沒準備好

scripts.text: Hold his hand.
scripts.translation: 握住他的手

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This is one of the places you should watch carefully.
Shouldn't you, a foreigner, consider it as an honor and receive the offer?
You're hesitating too much.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這裡是你應該仔細觀察的地方之一。
身為外國人，能得到這份邀請難道不是一種榮幸嗎？
你猶豫太久了。

scripts.text:
When you held Shenime's hand, you felt a sharp pain in your hand.
You took your hand off quickly and examined it, but nothing was there.
scripts.translation:
你握住謝尼梅的手，掌心突然一陣刺痛。
你趕緊抽回手檢查，卻什麼也沒發現。

scripts.text: Is it just imagination...?
scripts.translation: 難道是錯覺...？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What's wrong?
May I guide you?
Now, this is the place you should watch carefully.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
怎麼了？
要我帶你過去嗎？
這裡正是你該仔細觀察的地方。

scripts.text:
[Stranger Laphine]
What is it you want?
If you're looking for Shenime, that's too bad. I'm newly appointed to his position since he disappeared out of the blue.
I have to work. So, if it's not anything important, I would like you to not bother me.
scripts.translation:
[陌生的拉菲尼族]
你有什麼事？
找謝尼梅的話，你來晚了。他突然失蹤，我剛被任命接替他。
我還得工作，沒什麼要緊事就別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You need to wait a little longer to see Mayor Jun.
He is pretty busy, so please bear with us.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
還得再等一會兒才能見君市長。
他很忙，請耐心等候。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
There's another guard who was supposed to be guiding you...
I can't go anywhere right now.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
原本還有另一位衛兵負責帶你...
但我現在走不開。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Did you tell Mayor Jun about what you think?
He should be the one to decide.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你把自己的想法告訴君市長了嗎？
該由他來決定。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I've heard about you.
You've decided to work for Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我聽說過你。
你決定為埃克拉珠效力了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Welcome.
You are a foreigner yet you gained Mayor's recognition, which is rare.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
歡迎。
身為外國人還能得到市長認可，可不常見。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah, you've come at just the right time.
I heard you've been going to Bifrost Tower recently?
I wanted to ask you a favor since you're going there anyway...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你來得正好。
聽說你最近常去彩虹橋塔？既然你本來就要去，想請你幫個忙...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I need 10 dustaballs and 10 bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
You can find them inside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我需要10個塵埃球和10枚落葉書籤。
在塔裡就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You found them!
Thank you.
This should last for a while.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
找到了！謝謝。
這些夠用一陣子了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Avant that you just asked isn't he a genius who disappeared decades ago after doing some inappropriate experiments?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你剛才提到的阿旺，不是那位幾十年前做了不當實驗後失蹤的天才嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Are you still interested in the scholar that I was sponsoring?
Unfortunately, he disappeared all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你還在打聽我資助的那位學者嗎？
很遺憾，他突然失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Mayor ordered us to heighten security around the Orb.
I don't know why, but you should pay attention, too.
Since you're still working for the king and all...right?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
市長命令我們加強寶珠周圍的警戒。
我不知道原因，不過你也該多留心。
畢竟你還在為國王效力，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah...I'm starting to have a headache.
Mayor is ordering me to reinforce the guards for the Orb without even telling me why...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
啊...我又開始頭疼了。
市長連原因都不說，就命令我加強寶珠周圍的守衛...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I hope you intervene actively in this matter.
Although we can't let any other races to be in charge of the Orb since it is very meaningful to us Laphines,
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
希望你能積極介入此事。
寶珠對我們拉菲尼族意義重大，不能交給其他種族負責，

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
How much do you know about the Orb?
A crystal filled with concentrated magical powers, pride of all Laphines?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你對寶珠瞭解多少？
那是蘊含濃縮魔力的水晶，也是所有拉菲尼族的驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The place where the lighting for the Orb is installed in other words, the place where the guards stay is the ceiling.
It's a place that you pass by before going up to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
寶珠照明裝置所在的位置，也就是衛兵駐守的地方，在天花板上。
那是上宮殿前會經過的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I heard you are helping out here and there nowadays.
You must be busy.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
聽說你最近到處幫忙。
一定很忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
There's a guard at the east side of the plaza near the gate.
I notified him already, so just ask him to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
大門附近、廣場東側有位衛兵。
我已經通知他了，直接請他帶路就行。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It seems like you haven't even met him yet. Ask the guard to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
看來你還沒見到他。去請衛兵帶路吧。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
At the starting point of Bifrost, there should be a messenger stamping his feet.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
在彩虹橋起點附近，應該有位信使正焦急地來回踱步。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's a messenger that we sent in an effort to contact Splendide regularly,
but I think it's still difficult to do so.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我們派他定期聯絡輝煌領域，但看來目前還是很難聯絡上。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If you could help us with that, wouldn't other Laphines think better of you?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
如果你能幫上忙，其他拉菲尼族說不定會更認可你。

scripts.text: I'm supposed to give you something..
scripts.translation: 我本來應該交給你一樣東西...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh, yes. Mayor has bestowed a wing on you.
Here it is.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
啊，對。市長賜給你一對翅膀。
給你。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's nothing huge, but it's not common, either.
Just shake it gently and you'll find yourself in Eclage anytime.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這不是什麼稀罕的寶物，不過也不常見。
輕輕一搖，你就能隨時回到埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's an item that fits you perfectly. I mean you, who work for the king. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這東西很適合你——這位為國王效力的人。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Actually, I'm sponsoring a scholar of magics.
He needs some materials for experiments, and I was told you can find the materials in Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
其實我資助了一位魔法學者。
他需要一些實驗材料，聽說你能在彩虹橋塔裡找到。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If it's okay, can you do me a favor?
Of course I'll give you a big reward.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
方便的話能幫我一個忙嗎？
我會給你豐厚的報酬。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I was worried since it's something unexpected for you. I'm so glad.
Collect the following items for me, please.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
這事有些突然，我本來還擔心你不答應。太好了。
請替我收集以下物品。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah, that's too bad.
I'll ask someone else then.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
啊，真遺憾。
那我再找別人幫忙。

scripts.text: [Shenime]
scripts.translation: [謝尼梅]

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I need Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
You can find them inside the tower.
Bring me 10 of each for now, please.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我需要塵埃球和落葉書籤。
在塔裡就能找到。
請先各帶10個來。

scripts.text: Who is the scholar of magics?
scripts.translation: 那位魔法學者是誰？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm just sponsoring him personally. 
Scholars and alchemists who belong to the door of truth fall short in many areas aside from research. 
Some of them can't make a living and things like that...
The one I'm sponsoring is one of them.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我只是私人資助他。
真理之門的學者和鍊金術士，除了研究之外，很多方面都捉襟見肘。
有些人甚至難以維持生計...
我資助的那位就是其中之一。

scripts.text: I would like to meet him.
scripts.translation: 我想見見他

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
That's not going to be possible.
He is in the middle of a very important experiment, and since he's so sensitive, he doesn't like meeting strangers.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
恐怕不行。
他正在做非常重要的實驗，性格又敏感，不喜歡見陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's difficult for me to tell you about him and besides, I'm not obligated to tell you about his personal information. 
Don't bother to ask about him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我不便透露他的事，也沒有義務公開他的個人資訊。
別再打聽他了。

scripts.text: About Avant.
scripts.translation: 關於阿旺

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Avant?
I don't know him.
A scholar of magics? There's no one with that name among the scholars I know. 
I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
阿旺？
我不認識他。
魔法學者？在我認識的學者中沒有叫這個名字的人。
我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't know where you heard about him but you should give up. You won't be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我不知道你在哪裡聽說的，但你還是放棄吧。你找不到他的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Since he was interested in humans like you, I was going to arrange a meeting for you two,
but I don't know where he is...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
既然他對你們人類感興趣，我本來打算安排你們見面的，但我不知道他在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, are you still interested in the scholar of magics that I was sponsoring?
That's what you wanted to ask in the first place, right?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
總之，你對我資助的那位魔法學者還感興趣嗎？
你一開始想問的就是這個，對吧？

scripts.text: Do you know anything about his research?
scripts.translation: 你知道他的研究內容嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't.
He told me he would do me a favor if I sponsored him.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我不知道。
他告訴我，如果我資助他，他會幫我一個忙。

scripts.text:
