[Shenime]
There's nothing more to say.
I resent his sudden disappearance.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
沒什麼好說的了。
我討厭他這種突然消失的行為。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
and the scholar that I was sponsoring is gone...
Oh my...is this cheat-and-run?!
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
而且我資助的那位學者也失蹤了...
天哪...這是捲款潛逃嗎？！

scripts.text: Are you upset?
scripts.translation: 你生氣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Am I upset?
Ha...I think I might have been cheated.
He promised to do a research on the topic that I'm interested in, only if I sponsored him for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我生氣嗎？
哈...我覺得自己可能被騙了。
他答應只要我資助他一段時間，就會研究我感興趣的課題。

scripts.text: Did you know what he was researching?
scripts.translation: 你知道他在研究什麼嗎？

scripts.text: What did you want him to research about?
scripts.translation: 你想讓他研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What he asked for was pretty simple. 
I provided a place for living and researching and the cost of materials used when doing a research upon my request.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
他的要求很簡單：我提供住處和研究場地，並支付按我要求開展研究所需的材料費。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I didn't want to provide him with food and a place to live for free,
so I asked him to do a research on Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我不想白白提供食宿，所以讓他研究彩虹橋塔。

scripts.text: [Shenime]
scripts.translation: [謝尼梅]

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I thought he was doing a research on the topic that I was interested in.
Didn't you give me the materials the other day?
The ones related to the monsters inside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我以為他在研究我感興趣的課題。
前幾天你不是把材料交給我了嗎？
就是那些和塔裡魔物有關的東西。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
He just ran away when I had fed him, housed him, and provided him with the materials for experiments!!
I'm very shocked.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我給他提供食宿和實驗材料，他卻就這麼逃走了！！
真讓人震驚。

scripts.text: Why do you complain after so long a time?
scripts.translation: 為什麼現在才抱怨？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
...I thought about it and I didn't have anyone else to talk to.
I wasn't sponsoring him in secret, but still...
When I asked about his whereabouts to the scholars in the gate of the truth, they didn't know either...
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
...我想了想，實在找不到別人傾訴。
我資助他並沒有刻意隱瞞，不過...
我去真理之門問他的下落，那裡的學者也不知道...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
...and I was going to ask him to do a research on Hazy Forest. 
I have to look for another scholar now.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
...我本來還打算讓他研究迷霧森林。
現在只好另找一位學者了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
That's all I did, and I don't know anything other than that.
When he finishes the research, I was going to ask him to do another research on Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我做的就這些，其他一概不知。
本想等他完成研究後，再讓他研究迷霧森林。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
But I didn't know he would be irresponsible like this.
I've been fooled!
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
沒想到他這麼不負責任。
我被騙了！

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm going to have to find another scholar who is more eligible for the job.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
看來我得找位更稱職的學者。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, this is what happened to me.
By the way, you who work for the king do you know what is on Mayor's mind nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
總之，事情就是這樣。
對了，身為國王的協力者，你知道市長最近在想什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Mayor has to be a representative of Laphines as a whole.
If he's planning something on his own, it's unacceptable.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
市長必須代表全體拉菲尼族。
如果他擅自行動，我們不能接受。

scripts.text: There is no such thing.
scripts.translation: 沒有這回事

scripts.text: What do you want to know?
scripts.translation: 您想知道什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's about the Orb.
He ordered to reinforce the guard around the Orb.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
是關於寶珠的事。
市長下令加強寶珠周圍的警戒。
你知道為什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him why.
scripts.translation: 告訴他原因

scripts.text: I don't know, either.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道

scripts.text: To what extent should you tell him?
scripts.translation: 你打算告訴他多少？

scripts.text: Tell him all about it.
scripts.translation: 全部告訴他

scripts.text: Make up something.
scripts.translation: 編個理由

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What?
So, you're saying that the scholar I was sponsoring is 'the Avant?'
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
什麼？
你是說我資助的學者就是“阿旺”？

scripts.text: You didn't even know the name of the person you were sponsoring?
scripts.translation: 你連資助的人叫什麼名字都不知道？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
No...no way...!
It's just that he went by a different name.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
不...不可能！
他只是用了另一個名字。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, if what you're saying is true, then it is a big problem.
But from my observation, I've never seen him talking to other people.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
如果你說的是真的，那事情就嚴重了。
不過據我觀察，我從沒見過他和別人交談。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Considering his personality, he might have done it out of interest, not with a specific purpose.
Actually I'm hoping that he did it out of interest.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
以他的性格，或許只是出於興趣，並非有什麼特定目的。
其實我希望他真的只是好奇。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The incident in Splendide alone gives me a headache...but things are getting even worse.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
光是輝煌領域的事件就夠讓我頭疼了...現在情況更糟。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Although you're a foreigner, you're under obligation to protect the Orb since you know everything.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你雖是外國人，但既然知道內情，就有責任保護寶珠。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I hope not, but if something bad happens I would like you to help me.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
希望不會出事，不過真有狀況的話，還請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Now I should focus more on deploying the guards.
.. ..
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我得專心部署衛兵了。
...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You don't know, either?
Mayor Jun didn't feel safe for some reason and because of that, he ordered us to tighten guard?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你也不知道嗎？
君市長不知為何覺得不安，所以才下令加強警戒？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Well, I understand.
I should do it if he says so.
I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
好吧，我明白了。
既然是他的命令，我就照辦。
我應該相信市長是經過理性考量才下令的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's unexpected.
I thought you were the one who Mayor Jun trusts the most in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
真出乎意料。
我還以為你是君市長在埃克拉珠最信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Whatever the reason is, I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
不管原因是什麼，我都該相信市長是經過理性考量才下達命令。

scripts.text: You don't want to follow his order?
scripts.translation: 你不想聽從他的命令？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Of course I do!
I'm just worried that the corrupt blood might have clouded Mayor's judgement.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我當然會聽從！
只是擔心市長受到腐化血脈影響，判斷出了差錯。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Fine. Let's put it this way.
You seem to trust and follow Mayor Jun not caring about the sense of uneasiness among us.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
好吧，換句話說：即使我們心存不安，你似乎依舊信任並追隨君市長。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
We pray that the modern Mayor will be like the wind that just passes by.
Once is enough of that kind of a strong wind.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我們祈願現任市長如風般平靜地過去。
那種狂風，有一次就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't know why Mayor is so obsessed with the Orb but since he made that decision after talking to you, I'm sure you had great influence on him as well.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我不知道市長為何如此執著於寶珠。不過他是在和你談過後才下令的，你肯定也對他產生了很大影響。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Let's wait and see
what happens to the Orb, the pride and origin of us Laphines. 
Of course you should be there, too.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我們就等著看，身為拉菲尼族驕傲與起源的寶珠會發生什麼吧。
當然，你也得在場。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
shouldn't you wait and see whether Mayor, the one you trust so much, has made the right decision or not?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
你不該親眼看看自己如此信任的市長，究竟有沒有做出正確決定嗎？

scripts.text: He is right.
scripts.translation: 他是正確的

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If he's not right, it's a problem for me as well!
I'm just keeping my eyes on him since you never know when he will reveal his personal ambitions just like Seneth did.
Who can be sure about his integrity? This could be a manipulative trick that looks fine only on the surface.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
如果他做錯了，我也脫不了干係！
我只是在留意他，畢竟誰也不知道他會不會像塞內斯那樣顯露野心。
誰能保證他真心正直？這也可能只是表面好看的操縱伎倆。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
However, the presence of Mayor itself is perfect and worthy of reverence.
Therefore, we have to stay vigilant while hoping that he would make the right decisions.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
不過，市長的身份本身完美而崇高，值得敬畏。
所以我們只能保持警惕，同時盼著他做出正確決定。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
So this is only for caution's sake.
There is only one thing I want.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我只是想謹慎行事。
我只有一個請求。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I want you to be a witness and judge whether a series of actions taken around the Orb were truly for the sake of the Orb and Laphines or not.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我希望你作個見證人，判斷圍繞寶珠採取的一系列行動，是否真的是為了寶珠和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm talking about something structural, noot those abstract concepts.
Have you ever looked up to see the ceiling of the plaza, which is decorated with the Orb?
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我說的是具體結構，不是抽象概念。
你抬頭看過廣場的天花板嗎？寶珠就裝飾在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Maybe not.
Even if you have, you would have been blinded by the bright light.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
也許沒有。
就算看過，耀眼的光也會讓你睜不開眼。

scripts.text: Why are you saying all this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼說這些？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Didn't Mayor tell you?
In the ceiling, there are light fixtures installed to bring out the brightness of the Orb even more.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
市長沒告訴你嗎？
天花板上裝有照明裝置，讓寶珠顯得更加明亮。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The Orb is always exposed in the plaza and since all Laphines have their eyes on it the guards who protect the Orb look down from the ceiling where the light fixtures are installed.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
寶珠一直展現在廣場上，所有拉菲尼族都看著它；守衛寶珠的衛兵則從裝有照明裝置的天花板上方俯視廣場。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
In other words, it is easy to harm the Orb once the ceiling is attacked and disabled.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
換句話說，只要攻擊天花板並使其失效，寶珠就很容易遭到破壞。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Do you want to go and take a look?
It should be fine if it's you.
Moreover, you are under obligation to judge whether the king has made the right decision or not.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
想去看看嗎？
換作是你應該沒問題。
而且你有責任判斷國王的決定是否正確。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Let me guide you.
Hold my hand.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
我帶你過去。
握住我的手。

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Ask Kardui first.
scripts.translation: 先問問卡爾杜伊

scripts.text: Hold his hand.
scripts.translation: 握住他的手

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't understand why you're telling me this important information.
Give me some time to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不明白你為什麼把這麼重要的事告訴我。
請給我些時間考慮。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You need some time to think about it?
I'm not usually this hospitable to a foreigner, but I see.
Come back later then.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
還要時間考慮嗎？
我平時可不會對外國人這麼客氣，不過也好。
之後再來吧。

scripts.text:
When you held Shenime's hand, you felt a sharp pain in your hand.
You took your hand off quickly and examined it, but nothing was there.
scripts.translation:
你握住謝尼梅的手，掌心突然一陣刺痛。
你趕緊抽回手檢查，卻什麼也沒發現。

scripts.text: Is it just imagination...?
scripts.translation: 難道是錯覺...？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What's wrong?
May I guide you?
Now, this is the place you should watch carefully.
scripts.translation:
[謝尼梅]
怎麼了？
要我帶你過去嗎？
這裡正是你該仔細觀察的地方。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Is this how people feel when they lose blood?
The feeling of magical powers oozing out of my body...
Sorry. I'm a little bit tired.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這就是失血的感覺嗎？
魔力正從我體內流失...
抱歉，我有點累了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Wait...leave him alone.
He just fell asleep.
He must be very tired from replacing the magical powers of the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
等等，別打擾他。
他只是睡著了。
替換寶珠的魔力一定讓他累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm not so happy about it, but Avant is in the process of making something that will replace the Orb's inner core.
If he suceeds, things will be the way they used to be, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
雖然我不太情願，但阿旺正在製作替代寶珠核心的東西。
他要是成功，一切就能恢復原狀了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Seriously...I can't believe I have to ask him a favor.
....
scripts.translation:
[希西]
真是的...我竟然得向他求助。
...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
My head is cluttered with too many things.
The brains of Mayor is supposed to be filled with hundreds of thousands of drawers...
But this is way beyond that.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我腦子裡塞滿了各種事。
市長的腦海本該裝著成千上萬個抽屜...
可現在連那些都不夠用了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, I just want to whine. Where did my brother go...?
If other Laphines see me like this, they'll probably be frightened.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
啊，我只是想發發牢騷。我哥哥去哪兒了...？
其他拉菲尼族看到我這樣，大概會嚇一跳吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ahahahahahaha-
You see. I feel like either knowledges of a thousand years or memories of a ten thousand years is so useless.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
啊哈哈哈哈——
你看，千年的知識、萬年的記憶，到頭來好像全無用處。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm racking my brains searching through all the memories, informations, and history of every Mayor,
but there's no such thing as ways of fighting against the king of demons.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我絞盡腦汁翻遍歷代市長的記憶、情報和歷史，卻找不到對付魔王的方法。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I should probably leave this to an expert?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
或許該交給專家處理？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Welcome to Eclage, stranger.
... this was a popular way of greeting each other, but I guess it's not fun anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
歡迎來到埃克拉珠，陌生人。
...這曾是很流行的問候語，不過現在好像沒什麼意思了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Now, you who work for the king!
Work your fingers to the bone for me!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你現在可是替國王辦事的人！
給我賣力工作吧！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It looks like you've been doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
看來你過得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Long time no see.
Is there anything you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
好久不見。
有什麼事要找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How do you like staying in Eclage?
Since you people don't have wings, we've made roads for your convenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你覺得在埃克拉珠住得如何？
你們沒有翅膀，所以我們修了道路方便你們出行...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I was going to tell you when we first met,
but isn't it difficult for you to travel around Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
本來第一次見面時就想問你，在埃克拉珠四處走動是不是很不方便？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Have you been to Bifrost Tower?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你去過彩虹橋塔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Isn't my brother so cool?
He is the only one who understands how I feel. 
He is the one who comforted me and made my hatred go away.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我哥哥很厲害吧？
他是唯一理解我的人。
是他安慰了我，讓我放下仇恨。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, is there any progress...?
...
Huh? Brother?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那麼，有進展了嗎...？
...
咦？哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Go to Avant's laboratory and see what kind of research he is doing.
If it's something useless, it's even better to mess up his research materials.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
去阿旺的實驗室看看他在研究什麼。
要是沒什麼用，把他的研究材料弄亂也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I heard your story from my brother already.
You took care of Avant with your bare hands, right?
puhehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我哥哥已經告訴我你的事了。
你徒手製服了阿旺，對吧？
噗呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I had no idea he would be doing a research on things like this.
Brother, you know what it means, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
總之，我沒想到他會研究這種東西。
哥哥，你明白這意味著什麼吧？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, do you guys have any good news?
What was Avant researching about?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
有好訊息嗎？
阿旺到底在研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I commanded the guards to strengthen security patrols around the Orb.
They seemed quite confused since it's all so sudden but...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我已命令衛兵加強寶珠周圍的巡邏。
他們似乎不太明白怎麼回事，畢竟命令來得太突然...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, you and my brother talked about such things.
Now that I think about it, he was sponsoring Avant.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
原來你和我哥哥談過這件事。
這麼說來，他一直在資助阿旺。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I've been waiting for you. My brother told me about you.
Since I was so focused on finding Avant, I totally forgot about the Chief of Staff.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我一直在等你。哥哥跟我提起過你。
我忙著找阿旺，完全把參謀長的事忘了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I want to know what this anxiety is about.
Could this be a warning sign coming from Yggdrasil?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我想知道這份不安究竟從何而來。
會不會是世界樹發出的警告？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Gosh, it's getting even more interesting!
Why on earth is he doing that?
Every Laphine knows about the lightings in the ceiling.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
事情越來越有意思了！
他為什麼要這麼做？
每個拉菲尼族都知道天花板上的燈具。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
We have to find out why the Chief of Staff want to take you to the lighting room.
Do we just have to wait and see for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我們得查清參謀長為什麼要帶你去燈具室。
現在只能先觀望嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's all my fault...for making you...go through this.
I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
都是我的錯...害你...經歷這些。
對不起...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The incident in the lighting room is proven to be an act of self-defense.
You're free to go anywhere for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
燈具室事件已被認定為正當防衛。
目前你可以自由行動。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
A dead body with a hole...
The Chief of Staff was manipulated, too.
His name was Shenime, right?
Then what might have been the original name of the Chief of Staff...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
一具身上有洞的屍體...
參謀長也遭到了操縱。
他叫謝尼梅，對吧？
那麼，參謀長原本叫什麼名字...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mmm...
I don't know who you are, but could you wait until I call you?
I'll have to meet you some day, but now is not the right time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
嗯...
我不知道你是誰，不過能等我通知你再來嗎？
總有一天我會見你，但現在還不是時候。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I have a gift for you. Go and ask the Chief of Staff.
You will find it useful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我有份禮物給你，去找參謀長拿吧。
你會用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Isn't that brooch really really cute?
You can use it to come to Eclage anytime. 
This is all I can do for your convenience right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那枚胸針很可愛吧？
用它就能隨時來埃克拉珠。
眼下我能為你提供的方便就只有這個。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Go to the top floor of Bifrost Tower and give this letter to my brother.
You'll know when you get there.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
去彩虹橋塔頂層，把這封信交給我哥哥。
到了那裡你就明白了。

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡爾杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, you who came from a long way away
and reconized by the guardian.
There is a truth that you would like to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
總之，你遠道而來，還得到了守護者的認可。
有什麼真相想告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If that's the case, you will be very busy from now on.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
如果真是這樣，你接下來會很忙。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You have to do a lot of work in order to convince me, the elders, and many other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
為了讓我、長老們和其他拉菲尼族相信你，你得做不少事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Of couse I could trust everything you say,
but will other Laphines accept a Mayor Jun who is swayed by a word of a foreigner?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我當然可以相信你說的話，但其他拉菲尼族會接受一個被外國人三言兩語說動的市長嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Especially when that Mayor Jun is me. Ah...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
尤其是這個市長就是我。唉...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Don't you understand?
Here, in Eclage, You have to get more recognition from Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你還不明白嗎？
在埃克拉珠，你得贏得更多拉菲尼族的認可。

scripts.text: Do I have to make a contribution?
scripts.translation: 我得做出貢獻嗎？

scripts.text: It's about Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation: 這是關於世界樹的事！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
See, you understood it right.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
看來你明白了。

scripts.text: It's about Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation: 這是關於世界樹的事！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Um.
I know.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
嗯。
我知道。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You don't have to make a face.
No matter what I look like to you, I am the history and the spirit of Laphines, and also the protector of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
別擺出那副表情。
不管你怎麼看我，我都承載著拉菲尼族的歷史與精神，也是世界樹的守護者。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Do you think I, who inherited the will of Yggdrasil, don't know anything?
I don't blame you since it is ignorance.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你覺得繼承了世界樹意志的我會什麼都不知道嗎？
我不怪你，畢竟你不瞭解情況。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The war of Jotunheim will soon be over.
And it will happen not by constraint, but as a result of mutual agreement.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
約頓海姆的戰爭很快就會結束。
不是靠強迫，而是靠雙方達成共識。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, stranger,
don't worry about it and do you want to work with me for Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
所以，陌生人，別擔心。
你願意和我一起為埃克拉珠效力嗎？

scripts.text: Then why do you make war and disregard the truth?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼發動戰爭、無視真相？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Hmm...
I'll tell you when we get closer to each other.
I'm not obligated to talk about this important subject with a person I just met.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
嗯...
等我們更熟悉彼此時，我會告訴你。
我沒義務向剛認識的人談這麼重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
For now, I will tell the administrative ruler, the elders, and all the guards
about you,
and you will enjoy all the rights in Eclage as a person who works for the king.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
眼下我會把你的事告訴行政官、長老和所有衛兵。
身為替國王效力的人，你在埃克拉珠可以享有一切權利。

scripts.text: Just hire a worker then!
scripts.translation: 那就直接僱個工人！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's a part of building relationships with me, the king of a race. You don't like it?
If that's the case, I guess there's no friendship between the two of us.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這是和我——一族之王——建立關係的一環。你不喜歡嗎？
那看來我們之間也談不上什麼友情了。

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the two of us?'
scripts.translation: 你說“我們”是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Us? 
Umm...
Friends who share their secrets from now on?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我們？
嗯...
從今往後互相分享秘密的朋友？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
..Haha...wasn't it funny?
What's up with that face.
Anyway, I allow you to visit anytime.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...哈哈...不好笑嗎？
你那是什麼表情？
總之，你隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, if you don't meet my expectation, you won't get anything.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you, stranger who will be my friend.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不過，要是你達不到我的期望，就什麼也得不到。
期待再見到你，我未來的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...It's a joke.
I truly want you to become an important figure in Eclage.
Even if you don't, I want you to be recognized as a harmless person who gives benefit to Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...開玩笑的。
我真心希望你能成為埃克拉珠的重要人物。
即使做不到，也希望大家認定你無害，而且對埃克拉珠有益。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's going to be tough, but think of it as having insurance.
Some day, a person who remembers your name will be a great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這條路不容易，就當是為未來買份保障吧。
總有一天，認識你的人會幫上大忙。

scripts.text: Yes, thanks to you.
scripts.translation: 是的，謝謝你

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
All I wanted was for you to gain recognition in Eclage, and I didn't intend anything bad by what I did.
Seriously, I called you again right away, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我只是想讓你在埃克拉珠贏得認可，絕沒有惡意。
再說，我不是馬上又把你叫來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
.....
You think I did it on purpose to trick you.
I had no intention to do that.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...
你以為我是故意騙你的。
我可沒有那個意思。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The reason I requested your presence today is
to tell you the unfinished story from the other day. So, I hope you feel better.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
今天請你來，是想把上次沒講完的事告訴你。
希望你現在消氣了。

scripts.text: I'm not mad.
scripts.translation: 我沒生氣

scripts.text: Unfinished story?
scripts.translation: 沒講完的故事？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Really? What a relief.
Should I continue then?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
真的？那就好。
我繼續說了？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You were trying to tell me about the confrontation around Yggdrasil the other day.
Now, it's my turn to tell you how I got to know about that.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
前幾天你想告訴我世界樹周圍發生的衝突。
現在輪到我告訴你，我是怎麼得知此事的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Listen and just forget what I'm about to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
聽完後，把我要說的事忘掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Yggdrasil and its protector are connected to each other and are able to communicate to a certain extent.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
世界樹和它的守護者彼此相連，能夠在一定程度上交流。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I even knew through Yggdrasil that the strange incident that happened inside the tree was not because of the excessive mining.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我甚至從世界樹那裡得知，樹內發生的怪事並非由過度採礦引起。

scripts.text: Then why?
scripts.translation: 那到底是為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's only natural for you to wonder why.
But when they detected something strange inside Yggdrasil, I couldn't communicate with Yggdrasil for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你當然會想知道原因。
但世界樹內部出現異狀時，我不知為何無法與它溝通。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So I dispatched a research group in an effort to find out what happened.
But even the research group couldn't come up with better ideas.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
於是我派出研究隊調查原因。
可連研究隊也拿不出更好的解釋。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
According to their report, it was due to the excessive mining.
You already know what happened next.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
據他們報告，問題是過度採礦。
之後發生的事你已經知道了。

scripts.text: So it all started just because...
scripts.translation: 所以這一切都是因為...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Mayor Jun could not communicate with Yggdrasil?
What about now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...君市長當時無法與世界樹溝通？
那現在呢？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Everything's fine, of course.
I'm sitting here, yet I have an insight into every truth.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
當然沒問題。
我人雖坐在這裡，卻能洞悉所有真相。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
At that time, it might have been the best way to go.
Communicating with Yggdrasil was possible only after the war began and everything became irremediable.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
當時那或許是最好的辦法。
直到戰爭爆發、一切無法挽回之後，我才重新與世界樹取得聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
When Mayor Jun was disconnected from Yggdrasil,
there appeared an evil spirit that we've never seen before.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
君市長與世界樹斷開連線時，出現了一個前所未見的邪靈。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
To make things even worse, other protector betrayed and failed in his duty.
No one knew what was going on at that time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
更糟的是，另一位守護者背叛了大家，沒有履行職責。
當時沒人知道究竟發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The Mayor Jun, who was disconnected from Yggdrasil for a moment, could not go on
and became obsolete.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那位短暫與世界樹斷開連線的君市長無法再繼續履行職責，最後被取代了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, there came another Mayor Jun, which is me.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
於是新一任君市長出現了，也就是我。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
After realizing it, I pondered about ways to untangle this twisted truth
for a long long time.
Since I have some problems to resolve myself, too...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
明白這一切後，我花了很長時間思考如何解開這段被扭曲的真相。
畢竟我自己也有問題要解決...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Have you met the ones who participated in sealing and purification in regard to the nest of the guardians?
They are the ones among the very few who know the truth.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你見過那些參與封印、淨化守護者巢穴的人嗎？
他們是少數知曉真相的人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But they say the same thing.
That it is too late to stop the war.
That this war has been going on for a good while and both sides are too proud to give in.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
可他們都說一樣的話：
現在阻止戰爭已經太遲了。
戰爭持續了很久，雙方都拉不下臉讓步。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, a third party came into the scene unexpectedly.
That is, you, humans.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不過，一個意想不到的第三方介入了，那就是你們人類。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
By the entrance of you people, both Saphas and Laphines are distracted. 
I'm trying to use this as an opportunity to change Laphines' thinking.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你們的到來分散了薩法族和拉菲尼族的注意力。
我正想趁機改變拉菲尼族的想法。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Saphas, the giants of Jotunheim, know already
that we are not each other's enemy.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
約頓海姆的巨人薩法族已經知道，我們並不是彼此的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, you don't need to worry too much.
That's why I'm telling you this long story needlessly.
This is the problem that I, Mayor Jun, should solve.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
所以你不用太擔心。
我才會把這些事一股腦告訴你。
這是我——君市長——該解決的問題。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Are you relieved now?
Or are you still worried?
No matter how you feel, I'm sure most of your questions are answered.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
現在放心些了嗎？
還是仍然擔心？
不管怎樣，我想你的大部分疑問都解開了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Although all your questions are answered, come to see me from time to time.
I might look pretty busy, but actually, I get bored, too. 
Oh, by the way, I told the Chief of Staff to give you something.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你的問題雖然都解答了，還是偶爾來看看我吧。
我看起來很忙，其實也會無聊。
對了，我讓參謀長給你準備了東西。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text: You said I'm a tyrant!
scripts.translation: 你不是說我是暴君嗎！

scripts.text: The cause of misery!
scripts.translation: 痛苦的根源！

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡爾杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That? What is 'that?'
If you ask in a third-person determiner without any context, I wouldn't understand...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那個？你說“那個”是什麼？
沒上下文就用代詞，我可聽不懂...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm a tyrant? Ahahahahaha
That's the best joke I've ever heard.
I've never done any act of tyranny or forced to execute anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我是暴君？啊哈哈哈哈！
這真是我聽過最好笑的笑話。
我從沒做過暴虐之事，也沒強迫過任何人...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Misery? The cause of misery...
Is that an expression about me?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
痛苦？痛苦的根源...
你是在說我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Where have you been and what have you been doing? Why are you saying these random things?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你去了哪裡，又做了什麼？怎麼突然說這些莫名其妙的話？

scripts.text: Tell him about the rumor.
scripts.translation: 告訴他那些傳聞

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
What you're saying is that Laphines are looking at me with distrust and that they are worried, right?
Haha...I know already, but thanks for caring and telling me this in person.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你的意思是，拉菲尼族不信任我，對我感到擔憂？
哈哈...我早就知道了。謝謝你關心我，還特意親口告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, you should be more careful or think again before saying something like that.
Others might think you're telling me this to make mischief between me and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不過，說這種話前最好謹慎些，再考慮清楚。
別人可能會以為你在挑撥我和拉菲尼族的關係。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I'm already like your friend in your heart?
Only a friend would be worried about those rumors.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
總之，你已經把我當朋友了？
只有朋友才會擔心這些傳聞吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well, even if you weren't, let's just say that you were worried about me. I want to make a close friend of you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
即便不是，就當你是在擔心我吧。我想和你成為親密的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Do you remember what I told you before?
We're going to be friends who share secrets.
To celebrate our friendship, I'll tell you my secrets.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
還記得我之前說過什麼嗎？
我們要成為分享秘密的朋友。
為了慶祝這份友情，我告訴你我的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mayor Jun is the one who inherited all the memories of the kings of many generations.
That is, the memories of every king, from the first Mayor Jun to the late Mayor Jun.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
君市長繼承了歷代國王的全部記憶。
從第一任到上一任君市長的記憶，他全都擁有。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It is a vast collection of information and a whirlpool of emotions at the same time.
Also, it is the reason for Donas' existence. Donas are ready to be used anytime.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那既是龐大的資訊集合，也是情感的漩渦。
多納族的存在也與此有關，他們隨時準備接任。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If something ever happens and I die from it, 
then all the memories are transferred to one of the Donas and he becomes a new king, a Mayor Jun.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
如果我遭遇意外身亡，所有記憶都會轉移給一位多納族，他就會成為新一任君市長。

scripts.text: It's interesting, but why is that important?
scripts.translation: 這很有意思，可為什麼重要？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's because I'm half Dona and half Papang.
Having mixed blood in the lineage of Dona, a prospective Mayor Jun...
It would be the most frightful thing to Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
因為我一半是多納族，一半是帕潘族。
作為市長候選人的多納族竟然混入了其他血統...
這讓拉菲尼族非常恐懼。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Actually I'm not the first king with mixed blood.
However, the first mixed-blood king was a complete tyrant, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
其實我不是第一位混血國王。
可惜，第一位混血國王是個徹頭徹尾的暴君。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Having a mixed-blood king itself is frightful for Laphines. But thinking about the possibility of inheriting the violent nature of the previous mixed-blood king...
I understand their uneasiness.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
混血國王本身就讓拉菲尼族害怕，更何況前一位混血國王如此暴虐...
我理解他們的不安。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I tried not to show it, but I was sad and distressed for a while after inheriting that memory.
Upon becoming Mayor, I can no longer forget things. So I can't even forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我努力不表現出來，但繼承那段記憶後，曾經悲傷又痛苦了一陣子。
成為市長後，我再也無法忘記任何事，當然也忘不了那段經歷。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Seneth, the first king with mixed blood, hated and cursed the fact that he has mixed blood, which led him toward total destruction.
What Laphines are worried about right now is the same. They're worried that Mayor Jun would fail in his duty and lose his mind...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
塞內斯是第一位混血國王。他憎恨並詛咒自己的血統，最終走向毀滅。
拉菲尼族如今擔心的也是這件事：怕君市長失職，甚至失去理智...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Haha...the more they're worried, the harder I should try.
Even though I'm half breed, which is discriminated against, I will fulfill my duties
and I will never avoid my fate like Seneth.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
哈哈...他們越擔心，我就越要努力。
即使我是受歧視的混血兒，也會盡好職責，絕不重蹈塞內斯逃避命運的覆轍。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It was boring and long story.
It's good to have someone to whom I can open up myself and talk.
That's how I've been enduring all this time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
故事又長又無聊。
能有人聽我傾訴真好。
我一直就是這麼熬過來的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I sometimes think to myself. If only Seneth had someone he could talk to,
things would have been different...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我有時會想，如果塞內斯也有個能傾訴的人，結局會不會不一樣...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Now that I think about it, I answered two of your questions already!
I'll give you a chance to pay back next time. Just wait for it!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這麼說來，我已經回答了你兩個問題！
下次給你機會還人情，等著吧！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
By the way, I'm going to stop talking in a serious manner when talking to you.
Even though I'm Mayor, I sometimes want to act my age.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
對了，以後和你說話我就不那麼嚴肅了。
雖然我是市長，有時也想像自己的年紀那樣活著。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mayor is like an endless cycle of previous lives,
and being Mayor is like living hundreds of lives..
...When I'm overwhelmed with all the memories, I act like an old man who is thousands of years old before I know it.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
市長彷彿經歷著無盡的前世輪迴，當上市長就像活過幾百輩子...
記憶一多，我不知不覺就會像個幾千歲的老人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Sometimes I feel like it would be nice to live as Kardui, not as Kardui the Mayor Jun.
Of course I've never tried to do so.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
有時我希望自己只是卡爾杜伊，而不是身為君市長的卡爾杜伊。
當然，我從沒試過這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, the two of us should build good relationships.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
所以，我們倆得好好相處。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It will be better for you to improve your skills.
You'll be able to see more then.
You should work on it since I can't protect you outside of Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你最好繼續提升實力。
這樣才能走得更遠。
畢竟離開埃克拉珠後，我可保護不了你。

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是，我去過

scripts.text: No, but I'm thinking about it.
scripts.translation: 還沒去，不過正在考慮

scripts.text: No, I've never thought about it.
scripts.translation: 沒有，從沒想過

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, that's tood bad.
It's one of the main attractions of Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
啊，真遺憾。
那是埃克拉珠的一大看點。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Then I can trust you and give some works.
My brother is in Bifrost Tower,
and I would like you to deliver a letter to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
既然如此，我就信任你，把事情交給你辦。
我哥哥在彩虹橋塔裡，幫我送封信給他吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Since this is something personal, I'm aksing you, my friend. Will you do it for me?
Think of this as a way of paying me back.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這是私事，所以我以朋友的身份拜託你。願意幫我嗎？
就當還我個人情。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You will find him on the top floor of Bifrost Tower.
He lives there.
Give him this, please.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
他在彩虹橋塔頂層。
就住在那裡。
請把這封信交給他。

scripts.text: Kardui gave a letter to you.
scripts.translation: 卡爾杜伊交給你一封信。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If it wasn't for him, I would have become like Seneth, who knows?
....
The other one is pretty important, too. I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
要不是因為他，我說不定會變成塞內斯那樣的人。
...
另一件事也很重要，拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's been a while
since the last time we talked to each other like this.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們已經很久沒有像這樣聊過天了。

scripts.text: How did you get in here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I just did.
I think the security is not as tight as before.
I had no trouble getting in.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我就這麼進來了。
這裡的警備似乎不如從前森嚴，我輕輕鬆鬆就進來了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I feel like I'm dreaming.
So, if the security is like this, will I be able to see you everyday?
They should keep it this way.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我簡直像在做夢。
安保要是一直這麼松，我是不是就能天天來看你了？
最好他們一直保持這樣。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No, brother. Just stay here.
Don't go back to the tower...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不，哥哥，你就留在這裡。
別回塔裡去了...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You'll get in trouble then.
I'll come more often instead. That should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那樣你會惹上麻煩的。
還是我多來看看你吧，這樣就夠了。

scripts.text: Eh...
Get to the point!
scripts.translation: 說正事吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand that you're so happy to see your brother, but this is enough.
Aren't you embarrassed? I almost felt sick...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道你見到哥哥很高興，但也該適可而止了吧。
你不覺得尷尬嗎？我都快吐了...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If you felt sick, then it's a big problem.
If you ever get sick, I'll guarantee your living from now on.
Poor thing...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你要是真覺得噁心，那可就糟了。
要是你病倒了，以後的生活我都包了。
真可憐...

scripts.text: You know it doesn't mean that!!
scripts.translation: 我不是那個意思！！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, you're right.
So, there must have been some progress since both of you are here together?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
啊，對了。既然你們一起來了，事情應該有進展了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It feels so new now that I see you with my own eyes.
I don't know how this sounds to you, but I think it's a good thing that you became Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
現在親眼見到你，感覺真不一樣。
不知道你聽了會怎麼想，不過我覺得你當上市長是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Eh? Brother, what do you mean?
You're joking...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
咦？哥哥，你這話是什麼意思？
你在開玩笑吧...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I mean it's good to see you bright and cheerful.
If I go on, your companion will really get sick, so I'll get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我是說，看到你這麼精神，我很高興。
再說下去，你的同伴真要吐了。我就直說吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I found out where Avant is.
He's living in Eclage.
Moreover, I think he's into some kind of experiments.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我查到阿旺的下落了。
他住在埃克拉珠。
而且我覺得他好像在做什麼實驗。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No way, is he doing something weird again?
Even if he isn't, I want to interrupt him so badly.
Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不會吧，他又在搞什麼奇怪的研究？
就算沒有，我也真想去打斷他。
嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Me, too.
I don't know what it is, but I would like to see his work.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我也是。
雖然不知道他在研究什麼，但我想看看他的成果。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Avant hates something exceptional that happens out of his routine, right?
Let's make it happen. Let's make tons of exceptional situations.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
阿旺最討厭日常被打亂，對吧？
那我們就打亂他的日常，給他製造一大堆意外！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Should we go now?
Get ready. Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
現在就去嗎？
準備好了就出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Just thinking about it makes me so excited!
Take care of my brother, please.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
光是想想就讓我興奮不已！
拜託你照顧好我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I had no idea he would be doing a research on things like this.
Brother, you know what it means, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不過，我真沒想到他會研究這種東西。
哥哥，你明白這意味著什麼吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
This is a research on extracting the magical powers of the Orb.
He must have gone crazy.
He has been doing everything that is prohibited since forever...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他在研究如何提取寶珠中的魔力。
他一定是瘋了。
這麼多年來，他一直在做各種禁忌實驗...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well...but thanks to that, we're here.
It's soooo irritating though.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
嗯...不過也多虧了他，我們才能走到今天。
雖然還是讓人火大。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Oh...right.
Anyway, this time, he has gone too far.
Did you expect this when you told me to find Avant all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
啊...說得也是。
不過這次他確實做得太過分了。
你突然讓我去找阿旺時，就預料到會是這種情況嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well, I don't know. I just felt something uneasy from Yggdrasil.
I didn't know what exactly it was, but while I was pondering on it, Avant just came across my mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不知道。我只是感到世界樹傳來一絲不安。
雖然不清楚具體是什麼，但我琢磨這件事時，腦海裡突然浮現出阿旺。

scripts.text: How are Yggdrasil and the Orb related?
scripts.translation: 世界樹和寶珠有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You might think they're not related at all, but the Orb is the essence of all magical powers of us Laphines.
You could say that it is filled with a tremendous amount of magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你可能覺得兩者毫無關係，但寶珠是我們拉菲尼族全部魔力的精華。
可以說，裡面蘊含著極其強大的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If one could extract magical powers from the Orb, just like Avant's research, 
he gets to possess great power with no effort.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
如果有人能像阿旺研究的那樣提取寶珠中的魔力，就能不費吹灰之力獲得強大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If somebody steals magical powers from the Orb with ulterior motives and starts using it...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
如果有人懷著惡意竊取寶珠的魔力，並加以利用...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's a disaster.
When looking at the results, he was close to completing the research. 
It's a relief if we're the only ones that know about the results of this research...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那就會釀成災難。
從研究成果來看，他已經快完成了。
幸好目前只有我們知道這項研究的成果...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The Orb is in danger if there is anyone else who knows about it.
I will heighten security around it.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
要是還有別人知道寶珠的事，它就危險了。
我會加強周圍的戒備。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I will question Avant persistently.
What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我會繼續追問阿旺。
你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Should I help protecting the Orb?
scripts.translation: 我要幫忙保護寶珠

scripts.text: Come on, I'm a busy person.
scripts.translation: 算了，我很忙

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡爾杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm glad to hear that.
The Orb is going to be alright if you help us.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那太好了。有你幫忙，寶珠就能確保無恙。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Whatever.
You have to keep what you've seen and heard to yourself.
You understand?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
隨你吧。
不過，你必須對看到和聽到的一切保密。
明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Thank you brother.
Both of you should leave the Orb to me and take some rest.
And promise me to keep it secret.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
謝謝你，哥哥。
寶珠就交給我吧，你們兩個去休息。
還有，答應我一定保密。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
{0}.
This is a present for you.
I hope my magical powers help you improve.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
{0}。
這是送給你的禮物。
希望我的魔力能助你更進一步。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
What's that look for?
You didn't bring anything?
Did you forget and leave it somewhere? Go bring it.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你這是什麼表情？
你什麼都沒帶嗎？
是不是忘在哪兒了？快去拿來。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm sure everyone will come forward in honor since it's for the sake of the Orb.
No one would argue when it comes to protecting the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
既然是為了寶珠，我相信大家都會挺身而出。
保護寶珠這種事，沒人會反對。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No, more precisely, he didn't know that the scholar he was sponsoring was actually Avant.
Anyway, I don't have a say in his personal sponsorship matters.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不，準確地說，他並不知道自己資助的學者就是阿旺。
不過，別人私下資助誰，我也無權過問。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Just like my brother said, we'd be so glad if you help us.
We need your help.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
就像哥哥說的，有你相助，我們會很感激。
我們需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you find out anything?
On the surface, there is no room for doubt. 
He sponsored a scholar by chance, whom he happened to meet by another chance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
有查到什麼嗎？
表面上看，確實沒什麼可疑之處：他只是偶然資助了一位學者，而那位學者也是他偶然遇見的。

scripts.text: When I told him everything...
scripts.translation: 當我把一切都告訴他之後...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Did you tell him that the scholar is Avant?
Did you tell him about the research, too?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你告訴他那位學者就是阿旺了嗎？
也告訴他那項研究了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But in the end, Shenime didn't know anything about the scholar he was sponsoring and he had no idea about the scholar's personal research?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
所以說，謝尼梅既不知道自己資助的學者是誰，也不知道那位學者在私下研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But he could be pretending not to know anything when he actually knows everything.
We can't find out anything this way...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但也可能他其實什麼都知道，只是假裝不知情。
這樣下去，我們什麼也查不出來...

scripts.text: He was more interested in the Orb than the scholar of magics.
scripts.translation: 他對寶珠的興趣，比對那位魔法學者更濃

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's too bad...
So, it's more likely that Avant did a research on his own?
By the way, every Laphine has a great interest in the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
真可惜...
所以，阿旺更可能是在獨自研究嗎？
不過，拉菲尼族的每個人都對寶珠很感興趣。

scripts.text: He is trying to get me involved.
scripts.translation: 他想把我也扯進來

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Get you involved? What does that mean?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
把你扯進來？什麼意思？

scripts.text: Tell him about the conversation you had with Shenime.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你和謝尼梅談過的話。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...Wow..if he doesn't trust me that much, why does he still let me be in this place?
Is it because the authority of Mayor is not transferable unless I die?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...哇...他要是不信任我，為什麼還讓我留在這個位置上？
難道因為市長之位只有我死了才能轉交？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No matter how hard I've tried, I guess it wasn't enough to cure mistrusts among them.
Although I was aware of it, hearing it again makes me feel lonely.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
看來無論我多努力，也沒能消除他們對我的疑慮。
我早就知道，可再次聽到還是覺得孤單。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Don't take it seriously.
Let them think whatever they want to and leave them alone.
Kar, you just have to remain steadfast in your beliefs.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
別放在心上。
讓他們愛怎麼想就怎麼想吧，別理他們。
卡爾，你只要堅守自己的信念就好。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
All that aside, I'm sure Shenime is hiding something.
Otherwise, he wouldn't let a foreigner like you be in charge of the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
先不說別的，我敢肯定謝尼梅有所隱瞞。
否則，他不會讓你這樣的外鄉人負責寶珠。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You're right, my brother.
He told you to wait and see? A witness hoping that I'm normal?
I thought he was different from other officials and treated me without prejudice, but it was all a lie...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
你說得對，哥哥。
他讓你等著看？還讓你當個見證人，看看我能不能表現正常？
我還以為他和其他官員不一樣，會不帶偏見地對待我，原來都是騙人的...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar, he is just one of many Laphines out there.
You know it already. It's nothing new.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡爾，他不過是眾多拉菲尼族人中的一個。
你早就知道了，沒什麼新鮮的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's okay. Some day, everyone will recognize
that you're not a doll that needs to be protected, but a ture Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
沒關係。總有一天，大家都會明白，你不是需要別人保護的人偶，而是一位真正的市長。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Right. If I'm just carried away by my feelings, I'm not different from Seneth.
Let's think about the problems we're facing right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
沒錯。如果我只顧著感情用事，就和塞內斯沒兩樣了。
先想想眼下的問題吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
{0}
It seems like I always ask you a favor.
Please help me again this time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
{0}
我好像總是在麻煩你。
這次也請再幫我一次。

scripts.text: I'm at your service.
scripts.translation: 隨時聽候差遣

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Why is Shenime trying to get you involved in this. Of course he has his reasons like witness or evidence or whatever...
I'm sure there's something more.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
謝尼梅為什麼要把你捲進來？當然，他可以說是為了找見證人、證據什麼的...
但我總覺得還有別的原因。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I can't get rid of this anxiety..
And it's about you, the Orb, and Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這種不安揮之不去...
而且這件事牽涉到你、寶珠和謝尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But I feel so reassured knowing that you, who could be the key to the case, are on my side. 
I don't know why Shenime is trying to get you involved, but you should approach him actively.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
想到你這個案件關鍵人物站在我這邊，我就安心多了。
雖然不明白謝尼梅為什麼要把你捲進來，但你應該主動接近他。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll be staying here for a while, so come straight here anytime if you ever find anything.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我會在這裡待一陣子。你要是發現什麼，隨時來找我。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I hope my fears about Shenime are unfounded. 
I can't be sure of anything right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
希望我對謝尼梅的擔心是多餘的。
現在我什麼都不敢確定。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, I'll leave Shenime into your hands.
There's nothing I can do to help you since I'm not the one who reigns here.
Sorry for asking you too many favors.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
謝尼梅就交給你了。
這裡畢竟不是由我統治，我也幫不上你什麼。
總是麻煩你，真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But there is a huge difference between knowing it and letting someone else know it on purpose.
I would like to question him myself, but since you're involved, it will eventually look like I'm the one who caused all this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
知道這件事，和故意讓別人知道，可是天差地別。
我也想親自審問他，但你既然已經卷進來，最後恐怕會變成是我惹出了這一切。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Don't be impatient. 
Nothing has happened yet.
Instead, shouldn't we be thinking about how to deal with Shenime in the future?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
彆著急。
事情還沒發生呢。
我們不如先想想以後該怎麼應對謝尼梅？

scripts.text: Hisie is right.
scripts.translation: 希西說得沒錯

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
....What we can do...right now...
{0} is you doing whatever Shenime tells you to do and finding out the truth...?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...我們眼下能做的...
{0}就是按謝尼梅的要求行事，查明真相...嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I guess there's no other way.
Just in case, I'll send additional troops there.
Do whatever Shenime wants you to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
看來也沒有別的辦法了。
以防萬一，我會派增援過去。
謝尼梅讓你做什麼，你就照辦吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
For now, we just have to believe...that Shenime did all this unintentionally.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
現在只能先相信...謝尼梅並非有意為之。

scripts.text: What about the Orb?
scripts.translation: 寶珠那邊怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Laphines don't know yet.
Although the Orb's inner core is gone, my brother and I are collecting our magical powers and supplying the Orb constantly.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
拉菲尼族人還不知道。
雖然寶珠的核心已經不見了，但我和哥哥一直在匯聚魔力，為寶珠補充能量。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's a trick of the eye though...but no one noticed it.
Surprisingly, our magical powers were pretty strong.
Haha...do we have to thank Avant for this?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
不過這只是障眼法...居然沒人看出來。
沒想到我們的魔力還挺強。
哈哈...看來得謝謝阿旺？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm just two to three times more tired than usual.
If you're asking me about how I feel, magical powers are oozing of my body and it doesn't feel that great.
Would I be able to collect these abundant magical powers and fill the Orb's inner core?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我只是比平時累了兩三倍。
要說感受的話，魔力不斷從體內湧出，感覺可不太好。
我能不能收集這些多出來的魔力，填補寶珠的核心？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
......Don't work too hard.
No matter how much I help, our magical powers will reach the limit some day.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...別太勉強自己。
不管我怎麼幫忙，我們的魔力總有耗盡的一天。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Let's think about that later. 
Anyway...I heard from Nydhog.
The Chief of Staff seemed to be manipulated by a subordinate of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這事以後再說吧。
總之...我從尼德霍格那裡聽說，參謀長似乎受到了夢羅克手下的操縱。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How could I have not known.
...Was I really a king in name only...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我怎麼會一點都沒察覺...
...難道我真的只是個有名無實的國王...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
We have to take care of the Orb and Shenime, but the biggest problem right now is {0} taking care -.
Everyone should keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我們得處理寶珠和謝尼梅的事，不過眼下最要緊的是處理{0}的問題。
大家都記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I see. The situation is not good since the elders is blaming you for the incident that took place in the lighting room.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
原來如此。情況不太妙，長老們把照明室事故歸咎於你。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I just told the elders that the Orb is fine.
What they care about the most is the death of our soldiers and Shenime's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我剛告訴長老們，寶珠安然無恙。
他們最在意的是犧牲計程車兵，以及謝尼梅的下落。

scripts.text: Tell him about Avant.
scripts.translation: 告訴他阿旺的事

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Right. Avant is in the prison, where you were imprisoned for a moment.
I almost forgot that he is the main culprit of this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
沒錯。阿旺就在你之前被關過的那座監獄裡。
我差點忘了，他才是這起事件的主謀。

scripts.text: You told him about the conversation you had with Avant.
scripts.translation: 你把和阿旺的談話告訴了他。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
...........
So, in the end, we're all manipulated by Shenime, no I mean, by the king of demons.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...
所以到頭來，我們都被謝尼梅操縱了——不，是被惡魔之王操縱了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Then we return to the problem of {0}- ....
Fortunately, Laphines that you've helped are taking your side.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那就又回到{0}的問題上了...
幸好你幫助過的那些拉菲尼族人都站在你這邊。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That's a relief.
However, even if they admit that it was self-defense on the outside,
they wouldn't believe it in their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那就好。
不過，就算他們對外宣稱這是正當防衛，心裡恐怕還是不相信。

scripts.text: I'll go after Shenime!
scripts.translation: 我去追謝尼梅！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although I was acting in self-defense, it's true that I...hurt the soldiers.
Give me a chance to pay back.
I'll find Shenime, the main instigator of everything. I'll find the Orb, too!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雖然我是出於自衛，但我確實...傷了那些士兵。
請給我一個彌補過失的機會。
我會找到這起事件的主謀謝尼梅，也會找回寶珠！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...If you think so,
I'll hold you responsible for this incident and give you an order to find Shinime.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...既然你這麼想，我就追究你在這起事件中的責任，並命令你去尋找謝尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's perfect if you could find the Orb
but we'll have to get ready for the worst.
I'm going to talk to Avant.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
要是能找到寶珠就再好不過了，不過我們也得做好最壞的打算。
我去和阿旺談談。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
......It was a perfect chance to kill him.
Too bad.
Now I have to ask him a favor.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
...本來是個殺他的絕佳機會。
真可惜。
現在反倒得請他幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar, everything is going to be fine.
Don't be impatient.
We have protectors here. It will all work out.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡爾，一切都會好起來的。
彆著急。
有守護者在這裡，一定會沒事的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Are we pretty much decided then?
Let Kar proceed with the official works and {0} let - be in charge of finding Shenime.
As for me, I'll stay with Kar since I have to add my magical powers to the Orb as well.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那就這麼定了？
卡爾繼續處理公務，{0}負責尋找謝尼梅。
我則留下來陪卡爾，繼續為寶珠注入魔力。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That's good to hear, brother.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
那就好，哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'll manage to guarantee your freedom of action,
so find Shenime, please.
According to my brother, ^4d4dffyou will be able to find clues somewhere in Bifrost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我會盡量確保你能自由行動，請務必找到謝尼梅。
聽哥哥說，^4d4dff你應該能在彩虹橋某處找到線索。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Find Shenime, please.
According to my brother, ^4d4dffyou will be able to find clues somewhere in Bifrost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
請務必找到謝尼梅。
聽哥哥說，^4d4dff你應該能在彩虹橋某處找到線索。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How is it possible that no one knows it?
Is this because of our mental laziness and carelessness...?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
怎麼會沒人知道？
難道是我們思想懈怠、疏於防範了嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I have to stay alert myself.
The corpse of the Chief of Staff will help in imposing my will on others.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
我自己也得保持警惕。
參謀長的屍體會讓其他人更容易接受我的意志。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It may be tough, but from now on, I'll prepare to fight against the king of demons.
That's the best I can do right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
雖然不容易，但從現在起，我會做好與惡魔之王交戰的準備。
這是我眼下唯一能做的事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You've been a great help all this time.
Will you stay as my friend now and forever?
May the blessing of Yggdrasil be upon you...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾杜伊]
這段時間多虧有你幫忙。
今後也願意一直做我的朋友嗎？
願世界樹庇佑你...

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄空間不足，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of Laphines and a gateway to Alpheim.
I hope you enjoy your trip.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
歡迎來到埃克拉珠，拉菲尼族的首都，也是通往阿爾夫海姆的大門。
祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hi, how are you?
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
嗨，最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
How are you, really!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
你真的還好嗎？

scripts.text: Does he want something?
scripts.translation: 他是不是有事想說？

scripts.text: It's a strange fairy!
scripts.translation: 真是個奇怪的妖精！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Mayor Jun told us
that you would do anything for Laphines and Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
君市長告訴我們，你願意為拉菲尼族和埃克拉珠盡心盡力。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
In order to take care of the urgent matter...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
為了處理一件急事...

scripts.text: No, I refuse!
scripts.translation: 不，我不幹！

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Although you have all the rights to say no, this is what I get...
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
你當然有權拒絕，可我得到的答覆居然是這個...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
It's nothing more than a request for Pinguicula's pickled fruits and Luciola's honey jam,
which are specialties of Splendide...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
其實只是想請你幫忙帶些輝煌領域特產——捕蟲堇醃漬果和毒黃蜂蜜醬...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I know it's something personal...but Hazy Forest is such a huge obstacle...
so I couldn't help but...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
我知道這是私事...可迷霧森林實在太難穿越了...
所以我才不得不...

scripts.text: You said it's something urgent!!!
scripts.translation: 你不是說有急事嗎！！！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I feel like I might die if I don't eat them!!!
What's more urgent than this?!!?!?
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
不吃到它們我感覺自己就要死了！！！
還有什麼比這更急？！？！？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You visit Splendide pretty often anyway!
On your way back, just carry one under your arm, another in your hand, please~
I won't ask you anything like this ever again!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
反正你經常去輝煌領域！
回來時幫我帶兩罐吧，一罐夾在胳膊下，一罐拿在手裡，拜託啦～
我再也不提這種要求了！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
So...is that yes?
I need 3 jars of Pinguicula's pickled fruits and another 3 jars of Luciola's honey jam~
They are sold inside the base of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
那麼...你這是答應了？
我要三罐捕蟲堇醃漬果，再加三罐毒黃蜂蜜醬～
輝煌領域基地裡有賣。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You might need Splendide Coins to buy pickled fruits and honey jam.
You could earn those coins if you work in Splendide, so...hehe..........
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
買醃漬果和蜜醬可能需要輝煌領域硬幣。
在輝煌領域工作就能賺到硬幣，所以...嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Helping out in Splendide is eventually helping Eclage, too.
Now, go for it!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
在輝煌領域幫忙，也是在幫埃克拉珠。
快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Oh...no. I'm not a weird Laphine.
You got me wrong. It's a misunderstanding...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
啊...不是，我可不是奇怪的拉菲尼族人。
你誤會了，這只是個誤會...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I need 3 jars of Pinguicula's pickled fruits and another 3 jars of Luciola's honey jam~
They are specialties of the base of Splendide.
I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
我要三罐捕蟲堇醃漬果，再加三罐毒黃蜂蜜醬～
這都是輝煌領域基地的特產。
拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ohhhhh look at that!!!
Sweet pickled fruits and honey jam that is even sweeter!!!
You saved my life.
I don't know how I managed to live without these sweets!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
哇啊啊，快看！！！
甜甜的醃漬果，還有更甜的蜜醬！！！
你救了我的命。
沒有這些甜食，我都不知道自己怎麼活下來的！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I should judge you again.
It seems like Mayor Jun has an eye for character.
So he is Mayor after all...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
我得重新評價你了。
看來君市長確實很會看人。
不愧是市長...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
給你。
君市長說你已經做得夠多了，讓我來找你。
里奧交代的事也辦完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
知道了。
那我把市長的話轉告給你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
你或許還想為埃克拉珠多做些事，不過我看你已經做得夠多了。
其實這事沒那麼重要，我只是想讓你跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
就是這些。
市長說你一聽就會明白其中的意思。那我先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Well, that's what he said.
It might be inappropriate for me to say this since I'm the one asking the favor,
but I don't understand why Mayor does this.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
嗯，他就是這麼說的。
雖然是我在求你幫忙，不該這麼說，但我不明白市長為什麼要這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Anyway, I'll make sure to report your story to the superior office, and you will hear from them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
總之，我會把你的事蹟上報給上級。你遲早會收到他們的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
給你。
君市長說你已經做得夠多了，讓我來找你。
里奧交代的事也辦完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
知道了。
那我把市長的話轉告給你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
你或許還想為埃克拉珠多做些事，不過我看你已經做得夠多了。
其實這事沒那麼重要，我只是想讓你跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
就是這些。
市長說你一聽就會明白其中的意思。那我先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I don't want to know about what he told you.
I'm just guessing that there is some kind of conspiracy between you and Mayor Jun.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
我不想知道他對你說了什麼。
我只是猜，你和君市長之間是不是有什麼計劃。
他到底在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
別再談君市長了。
想想你眼下該做什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hmm...Are you and Mayor Jun involved in some kind of conspiracy?
The more I think about it, I feel like there is something going on.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
嗯...你和君市長是不是在謀劃什麼？
越想越覺得有問題。
他到底在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
The honey jam and pickled fruits were so delicious.
Those guys in the base must be feasting on these everyday.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
蜜醬和醃漬果真好吃。
基地裡那些傢伙肯定天天都能吃到。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I've already reported about your cooperation to the superior office.
Don't worry.
I think I might have to see you again sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
我已經把你幫忙的事上報給上級了。
放心吧。
我想我們遲早還會再見面的。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hmm...Are you and Mayor Jun involved in some kind of conspiracy?
The more I think about it, I feel like there is something going on.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
嗯...你和君市長是不是在謀劃什麼？
越想越覺得有問題。
他到底在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
別再談君市長了。
想想你眼下該做什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favourable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
據你所知，拉菲尼族人表面上對卡爾杜伊頗為友善。
可實際上，大多數人對他感到不安、懷疑，也不信任他。
別光擔心，直接去問卡爾杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favourable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
據你所知，拉菲尼族人表面上對卡爾杜伊頗為友善。
可實際上，大多數人對他感到不安、懷疑，也不信任他。
別光擔心，直接去問卡爾杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
Leo doesn't seem to trust Kardui, who is their king.
If you have a chance, you'll be able to listen to other Laphines as well.
scripts.translation:
里奧似乎不信任身為國王的卡爾杜伊。
有機會的話，也可以聽聽其他拉菲尼族人怎麼說。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
別再談君市長了。
想想你眼下該做什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
By the way, Bifrost Tower must be a generator of monsters.
When you eliminate one, there appears another one, and this goes on and on...
It like you're sprinting only to find yourself standing at the starting line again.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
對了，中央塔簡直就是魔物製造機。
打倒一隻，馬上又冒出一隻，沒完沒了...
就像拼命衝刺，最後卻發現自己還站在起點。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Welcome to Eclage.
- ,{0}who recently became famous.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
歡迎來到埃克拉珠。
——最近聲名鵲起的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
They never get exhasted.
There has been a stream of complaints regarding safety from travellers. 
Seriously...they're so annoying.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
它們永遠不會累。
最近旅行者不斷抱怨治安問題。
真是...煩死了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Since we bear down on them while we're on patrol,
thankfully there's less complaints from travellers.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
幸好我們巡邏時會壓制它們，旅行者的投訴也少了些。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You've done a great job again.
Here, it's a reward.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
你又幹得漂亮。
給，這是給你的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
5 bodies of Menblatt and Fetal, each.
You know?
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
花妖精和花瓣怪蟲各五隻。
記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
How's everything today?
I have a work that is somewhat good and beneficial for you.
It's to eliminate Menblatta and Petals that appear in the blooming field.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
今天過得怎麼樣？
我有份不錯、對你也有好處的工作。
去消滅出現在花田裡的花妖精和花瓣怪蟲。

scripts.text: [Leo]
scripts.translation: [里奧]

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Only if your level was higher, I could have guided you to a nice route for a walk...
That's too bad.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
要是你的等級再高些，我就能帶你走一條不錯的散步路線了...
真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I ask you to eliminate them when you patrol the area next time.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
下次在這附近巡邏時，麻煩把它們清理掉。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
If you don't mind, let's go patrol the area again.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
不介意的話，我們再去附近巡邏一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
If you want, please return this time tomorrow.
I'll make your position secure. Of course, your job is to patrol in the blooming field.
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
願意的話，明天這個時候再來。
我會給你安排好位置。當然，你的工作就是去花田巡邏。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Honestly, isn't Menblatt pretty?
I wonder how it became that....pretty.
Laphines? No, they're not Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
說真的，花妖精是不是挺漂亮的？
真想知道它們怎麼會變得這麼...漂亮。
你說拉菲尼族人？不，它們不是拉菲尼族人。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Petal? Petals are so cute, too.
I would like to have one in my Yai.
But...you saw it.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
花瓣怪蟲？它們也很可愛。
我真想在自己的雅伊裡養一隻。
不過...你也看到了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
They trample flower beds!
That's why they're unacceptable...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
它們會踩壞花壇！
所以絕不能放任不管...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
There have been many complaints from travellers saying that those guys bother travellers for no reason.
Do you want to do it?
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
很多旅行者投訴說，那些傢伙無緣無故地騷擾他們。
你願意去處理嗎？

scripts.text: I'll go! I'll do it! I'll get rid of them!
scripts.translation: 我去！我來！我把它們統統趕走！

scripts.text: I don't feel like it today.
scripts.translation: 我今天沒興致

scripts.text: Don't you want pickled fruits?
scripts.translation: 你不想要醃漬果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Look at your fighting spirit!
Alright, let's go! But of couse! Only you will go!
Let's go punish Menblatts and Petals that bother travellers and trample flower beds!
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
瞧瞧這股幹勁！
好，出發！當然，只有你一個人去！
去教訓那些騷擾旅行者、踩壞花壇的花妖精和花瓣怪蟲吧！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ah...you don't want to?
I'll have to do it alone.
All by myself...
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
啊...你不想去嗎？
那我只好自己動手了。
我一個人...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ah..pickled fruits.
I decided not to eat it for some time.
I ate so much that I took to my bed with a bad toothache.
.........isn't it depressing.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
唉...醃漬果。
我決定暫時不吃了。
吃太多，牙疼得我只能臥床休息。
...真讓人沮喪。

scripts.text: [Leo]
scripts.translation: [里奧]

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You have to punish 5 Menblatts and 5 Petals.
They will be playing all over the blooming field, in which stands Bifrost Tower in front of Eclage.
You know already, right?
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
你得教訓五隻花妖精和五隻花瓣怪蟲。
它們會在埃克拉珠前方、中央塔附近的花田裡到處亂跑。
你知道地方吧？

scripts.text: You don't like the king?
scripts.translation: 你討厭國王嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
No, it's not that I don't like him. I'm rather concerned...or having trouble trusting him...something like that.
Since he didn't do anything wrong, I don't have any reason to hate him, but..
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
不，不是不喜歡他。我只是有些擔心...或者說不太信任他...差不多就是這樣。
他沒做錯什麼，我也沒理由討厭他，不過...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
there was a precedent
and it's a pretty rare case...so I'm just concerned in many ways.
It should not bother a foreigner like you.
scripts.translation:
[里奧]
以前發生過類似的事，而且情況相當罕見...所以我難免會擔心。
不過，這些事與你這個外鄉人無關。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄空間不足，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's hard.
It really is hard.
The more I think about it, I feel like Shenime has a nasty temper.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
真難辦。
真的很難辦。
越想越覺得謝尼梅脾氣古怪。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
You, who appeared in this time of crisis.
You, who went through Hazy Forest Maze..Are you the guidance of god? Or a blessing from god?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
你在這種危急關頭出現，還穿越了迷霧森林迷宮...你是神明的指引，還是神明的恩賜？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I guess I have no other choice.
They say Laphines are nothing without their pride, but since I value my life over pride,
can I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
看來我別無選擇了。
聽說拉菲尼族人最看重尊嚴，但我還是覺得活命更重要。
能拜託你一件事嗎？

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's something difficult for Laphines, but for humans, it's very easy.
That is, brining the news from Splendide!
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
這事對拉菲尼族人來說很難，對人類卻很容易。
就是去輝煌領域帶回訊息！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ah...
It took you less than a second to say no, how clear is that.
Now, I'll erase the memory of this very moment!
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
唉...
你連一秒都沒用就拒絕了，真夠乾脆的。
我現在就把這一刻忘掉！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
給你。
君市長說你已經做得夠多了，讓我來找你。
里奧交代的事也辦完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
[Roy]
...Only if we could get that...canned food, too...we wouldn't have to suffer so much like this...
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
...要是連那些罐頭也能弄到...我們就不用這麼受苦了...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I should take care of it but...
my magical powers are not all that great.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
本來該由我去辦，可是...
我的魔力實在不強。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...well, you don't need to know the details!
You just need to collect mails from the contact officer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
...算了，細節你不用知道！
你只要去輝煌領域找聯絡官收信就行。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
There's nothing confidential, so you can do it, too.
Bringing one mail. I'm sure it's easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
信裡沒有機密內容，你也能幫忙。
帶一封回來就行，對你來說肯定很容易。

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交給我吧！

scripts.text: I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 我不想去

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Good!
Go to Splendide and meet the contact officer!
Collect mails that are not confidential and could be a love letter to someone!
and bring them to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
好！
去輝煌領域找聯絡官！
收集那些不涉密、可能是情書的信件！
然後帶給我，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
What? You're saying no after making me talk all this time?
....Well, things happen.
But you'll come back. So I'm not worried.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
什麼？害我說了半天，你最後才說不？
...好吧，誰都會有這種時候。
不過你會回來的，我一點也不擔心。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ah...
It took you less than a second to say no, how clear is that.
Now, I'll erase the memory of this very moment!
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
唉...
你連一秒都沒用就拒絕了，真夠乾脆的。
我現在就把這一刻忘掉！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Isn't that easy?
I'll be standing here and waiting for you to bring me that mail.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
這不是很簡單嗎？
我就在這裡等你把信帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Hehe. I knew it.
From the moment they picked me for this job,
everything is in 'the big invisible hand!!'
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
呵呵，我就知道。
從他們選我做這份工作的那一刻起，一切都在“無形的大手”掌控之中！！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
So that I could ask you again with a renewed mind.
Ahahahah...ha...hahha..hahaa..
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
這樣我就能振作起來，再拜託你一次。
啊哈哈哈...哈...哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Let me explain again.
Go to Splendide and meet the contact officer!
Collect mails that are not confidential and could be a love letter to someone!
and bring them to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
我再說一遍。
去輝煌領域找聯絡官！
收集那些不涉密、可能是情書的信件！
然後帶給我，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
This is right. This is the right box.
You've done it right.
See, there's nothing important here.
Most of them are just personal letters asking about each other's health.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
沒錯，就是這個箱子。
你做得很好。
看吧，裡面沒什麼重要的東西。
大多是些問候近況的私人信件。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Now, I have to go and make a report on these mails. 
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
我得去彙報這些信件的情況了。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
給你。
君市長說你已經做得夠多了，讓我來找你。
里奧交代的事也辦完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
知道了。
那我把市長的話轉告給你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
你或許還想為埃克拉珠多做些事，不過我看你已經做得夠多了。
其實這事沒那麼重要，我只是想讓你跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠衛兵]
就是這些。
市長說你一聽就會明白其中的意思。那我先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
你聽見了吧？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...Only if we could get that...canned food, too...we wouldn't have to suffer so much like this...
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
...要是連那些罐頭也能弄到...我們就不用這麼受苦了...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
There are just too many useless letters.
What's even worse is that long-distance couples send love letters and...
Why a messenger like me has to listen to other people's love stories?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
沒用的信實在太多了。
更過分的是，異地戀的人還寄情書...
我一個送信的，為什麼還得聽別人的愛情故事？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Collect the mailbox from the contact officer
in the advanced base of Splendide.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
去輝煌領域前進基地找聯絡官，把郵箱取回來。
這很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Hmm...once again, it's filled with useless letters saying hello
and bragging about animal horns.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
嗯...又是些沒用的信，盡是問候，還有人炫耀自己收集的鍬形蟲角。
謝了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Um, I'm sorry,
but could you go again?
to Splendide, to collect the mails...
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
那個，不好意思，能不能再麻煩你跑一趟？
去輝煌領域收信...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I can make it to Mora Village.
But how can I go through Hazy Forest? All alone?
...Ah.. I'm just feeling sorry for myself, so just continue on your way.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
我能走到穆拉村。
可我怎麼一個人穿過迷霧森林？
...唉，我只是在自怨自艾，你繼續趕路吧。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
To recall what the guard that just dropped by said,
Mayor wants to meet you, right?
Don't you have to go?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
剛才那衛兵說，市長想見你，對吧？
你不該趕緊過去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
In the end, I'm not a messenger, but a mailman.
...That's right. Actually, I'm not even a mailman. Ah....
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
到頭來，我不是信使，只是個郵差。
...沒錯，其實我連郵差都算不上。唉...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's about time that the mailbox was filled up.
...I get more anxious as time goes by.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
郵箱差不多該裝滿了吧。
...時間越久，我越不安。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...I thought it'd be so nice to become a soldier...
So I applied to the advanced base, but I became a messenger and eventually......
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
...我以前還以為當士兵很不錯...
所以申請加入前進基地，結果卻成了信使，最後...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...There will be those useless love letters again after some time, right?
You bring them, and I deliver them. You could say we're a couple, too. A delivery couple.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
...過陣子又會收到那些沒用的情書吧？
你送來，我負責投遞。咱們也算一對搭檔——送信搭檔。

scripts.text: - From the back, Roy seems lonely. -
scripts.translation: - 羅伊的背影看起來有些落寞。 -

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Since you've done such a good job,
I'll be in charge of delivering mails in Eclage and
...let's work together on a regular basis, please?
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
你這次幫了大忙。以後埃克拉珠的信件就由我負責投遞。
...今後也請和我長期合作，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Promise me that you will work with me again, please.
This is a little something for you.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you!
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
答應我以後還和我合作吧。
這是給你的一點謝禮。
期待再見到你！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊

scripts.text: I don't feel like it today.
scripts.translation: 我今天沒興致

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Thank you so much.
Go to Splendide, meet the contact officer, and collect the mailbox.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
太感謝你了。
去輝煌領域找聯絡官，把郵箱取回來。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ek!
I didn't know you would say no like that...
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
哎！
沒想到你會拒絕得這麼幹脆...

scripts.text: [Roy]
scripts.translation: [羅伊]

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Mails from Eclage are sent along with the supplies for the base,
but they can't send us mails.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
埃克拉珠寄來的信會和基地補給一起送來，但基地這邊的信寄不出去。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It has to be done on a regular basis, so you've been a great help.
I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[羅伊]
這事得定期處理，你幫了大忙。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄空間不足，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Mm...give that box to Roy, please.
Roy will take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
嗯...把那個箱子交給羅伊吧。
他會處理的。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
What is it?
Someone from the camp?
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
怎麼了？
是營地那邊來的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Thank you for helping us again. 
Bring it to Roy and he will know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
又要麻煩你了，謝謝。
把箱子交給羅伊，他知道該怎麼處理。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You're here to collect the mails again?
I have one mailbox that is filled up...
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
你又來取信件了？
這裡有個裝滿信的郵箱...

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You from the camp?
Have you been to Eclage?
If you went as far as Mora, you should visit Eclage as well. 
It's so beautiful there.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
你是營地的人？
去過埃克拉珠嗎？
既然都到了穆拉，不妨也去埃克拉珠看看。
那裡美極了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Um, it's too hard for us to go through Hazy Forest, and the roads are blocke because of a rift...
It's a big problem. I'm getting old because of the stress!
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
唉，迷霧森林對我們來說太難穿越了，而且裂縫還封住了道路...
真是個大麻煩，壓力大得我都老了！

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Mails from Eclage are sent along with the supplies for the base.
Before, it was hard to send mails from this side to that side. But thanks to you, we no longer have a problem sending mails and we're so happy.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
埃克拉珠寄來的信會和基地補給一起送來。
以前從這邊往那邊寄信很困難，但多虧了你，現在通訊暢通了，大家都很高興。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You're from Eclage?
Hmm? Roy? I see. I've been waiting for so long.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
你是從埃克拉珠來的？
嗯？羅伊？原來如此。我等了好久。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
I knew it'd be almost impossible to get here...but I was waiting just to be sure.
What a relief that you came on Roy's behalf!
Give this box to Roy, please.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
我知道要來這裡幾乎不可能...但還是等著試試看。
你替羅伊來了，真是幫大忙了！
請把這個箱子交給羅伊。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Well, most of them are personal letters, so it's more of a mail delivery.
Please, help us out.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
大部分都是私人信件，說是送信也不為過。
拜託你了。

scripts.text: Yes, that's what I'm for.
scripts.translation: 對，這正是我該做的

scripts.text: No, that's not why I'm here.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是為這個來的

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Here, take this.
Everyone in the base is so excited
that they can send anything they want.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
給，拿著。
基地裡的大家都很興奮，終於能寄出想寄的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Huh...really.
That's sad.
Well.. What can I say.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
啊...是嗎。
真遺憾。
唉...我也不知道該說什麼。

scripts.text: [Contact Officer]
scripts.translation: [聯絡官]

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Don't dump anything on the way or throw anything,
but deliver them safely, please.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
路上別把東西丟下，也別亂扔，請務必安全送達。

scripts.text:
A female Laphine and a male Laphine are talking about something.
But they stopped talking as soon as they saw me. 
I think I've interrupted the conversation.
scripts.translation:
一名女性拉菲尼族人和一名男性拉菲尼族人正在交談。
可他們一看見你就停了下來。
看來你打斷了他們的談話。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
Ahhhh I didn't say anything. I didn't...
It's true that I'm one of the most talkative Laphines in town, but I don't tell everything down to the last detail.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼族人]
啊，我什麼都沒說...真的沒有...
我確實是鎮上最健談的拉菲尼族人之一，但也不會把每件事都說得一清二楚。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
So, you'd better not try to find out something from me, outsider!
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼族人]
外鄉人，別想從我這裡打聽什麼！

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
You shouldn't get involved in the matters of other races.
Especially when it's something like family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼族人]
你不該插手其他種族的事，尤其是家事。

scripts.text:
